title: How Far Can the Gemma 4 Speech Encoder Go Without Changing Its Weights? Saudi and Gulf Arabic Speech Recognition with a Frozen and an Adapter-Augmented Encoder
comment: 24 pages, 15 tables, 5 figures. Code and public-set results: https://github.com/AmrKhalil9/frozen-embeddinggemma2-arabic-asr
summary: We study the 305M-parameter audio encoder shared by Gemma 4 and EmbeddingGemma 2 (identical except for its final projection) for Saudi and Gulf Arabic speech recognition, without changing any of its weights. A frozen system trains only a 22.6M-parameter CTC reader over a mix of encoder layers; an adapted system adds 3.1M low-rank adapter parameters, a 41.5M-parameter hybrid CTC/attention reader and joint decoding with a sub-word language model. Against Cohere Transcribe Arabic (2.07B parameters), re-run on identical audio, the frozen system trails in word error rate (WER) but is statistically indistinguishable in character error rate (CER) on five of six human-labelled conditions, while running 3.4 times faster on CPU with greedy decoding. The adapted system is statistically indistinguishable in WER on a public Saudi customer-service call (19.20% against 19.27%) and on clean Emirati speech, is significantly better on telephone-coded Emirati speech, has a significantly lower CER on all six conditions of these sets, and beats a 0.6B recogniser fine-tuned on SADA in WER on all six; it still trails Cohere in WER on long-form Saudi speech. On a blind, human-corrected public call-centre sample it ranks 4 of 15 systems, behind three commercial APIs (significantly only one) and ahead of the other self-hostable systems by point estimate. An optimised joint decoder runs it at 139 times real time on one GPU. We also show that references made by correcting machine drafts favour the drafting system. Code and public-set results are released.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结的305M参数Gemma 4/EmbeddingGemma 2音频编码器在沙特与海湾阿拉伯语语音识别中的表现：仅训练22.6M参数的CTC读取器，冻结系统在CER上与2.07B的Cohere Transcribe阿拉伯语系统在6个条件中的5个统计无差异，且CPU上快3.4倍；适配系统在部分测试集上统计无差异或显著更优，盲测15系统中排第4。
AI.motivation: 探索在不改动大规模预训练音频编码器权重的前提下，能否用极小的附加参数与算力，在沙特/海湾阿拉伯语ASR上达到与参数量达2.07B的商用系统（Cohere Transcribe Arabic）相当的效果，并关注低成本自托管部署的可行性。
AI.method: 以Gemma 4与EmbeddingGemma 2共享的305M音频编码器为冻结骨干：(1) 冻结系统仅训练22.6M的CTC读取器，在多个编码器层特征上混合；(2) 适配系统增加3.1M低秩适配器、41.5M混合CTC/注意力读取器，并结合子词语言模型做联合解码。与Cohere Transcribe在相同音频上对比，并做盲测、CPU/GPU效率评估；同时分析"基于机器草稿人工纠错"的参考文本偏差。
AI.result: 冻结系统：WER落后Cohere，但CER在6个人工标注条件中的5个统计无差异，贪心解码在CPU上快3.4倍。适配系统：公开沙特客服电话语音上WER统计无差异（19.20% vs 19.27%），干净阿联酋语音无差异，电话编码阿联酋语音显著更优，六条件CER均显著更低，并在全部六个条件上WER优于在SADA上微调的0.6B识别器；但在长时沙特语音WER上仍落后Cohere。盲测经人工校正的公共呼叫中心样本中，15个系统排名第4，落后于三个商用API（仅一个显著），领先其他可自托管系统。优化联合解码器单GPU达139倍实时。另发现纠错机器草稿得到的参考文本偏向草稿系统。
AI.conclusion: 冻结或轻量适配大型预训练音频编码器即可在海湾阿拉伯语ASR上接近十亿级商用系统的CER水平，并具备显著更高的推理效率，适配系统在多数条件上具竞争力；同时提示"机器草稿+人工纠错"评测范式存在偏向性，需谨慎使用，代码与公开集结果已开源。

title: Translation and data ethics
comment: Joss Moorkens and Monja Jannet. Translation and data ethics. To appear in: S. Castilho, D. Kenny, J. Moorkens & M. I. Rivas Ginel (eds.). Developing AI literacy for translation Berlin: Language Science Press
summary: This chapter introduces data ethics for translation and discusses a number of ethical issues regarding data. These include issues of copyright, ownership and bias, which apply to all types of data, whereas there are further issues particular to minoritised language communities and those on either side of the digital divide, as data is implicated in power imbalances and dynamics. We close with a discussion of responsibility and regulation, and reflect on the growing attention on data ethics from translation studies researchers.

AI.tldr: 本章系统梳理翻译研究中的数据伦理议题，涵盖版权、所有权与偏见等通用问题，以及少数语言社区和数字鸿沟群体的特殊问题，并讨论责任与监管，指出翻译学界对数据伦理关注度上升。
AI.motivation: 数据在翻译实践中深度介入权力关系与不平衡结构，亟需明确伦理框架以回应版权、归属、偏见及弱势语言社区面临的特殊风险，并为责任划分与监管提供讨论基础。
AI.method: 采用章节综述/概念性论述方式：按议题分层展开，先讨论适用于所有数据类型的版权、所有权与偏见问题，再讨论少数语言社区与数字鸿沟两侧群体的特有问题，最后探讨责任与监管，并结合翻译研究领域既有文献进行反思。
AI.result: 构建了一个多层次的数据伦理议题框架，区分通用性伦理问题与情境性（弱势群体相关）伦理问题，并将数据与权力不对称、数字鸿沟联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 翻译研究中的数据处理不能仅视为技术问题，而须纳入伦理与监管考量；翻译学界对数据伦理的关注正在增长，但仍需进一步系统化研究与制度建设。

title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
summary: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. We also demonstrate the utility of SkillEval in two downstream tasks: (1) LLM routing, which dynamically assigns each query to a capable but efficient model, reducing inference cost by over 60% while achieving improved performance, and (2) Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT), where an unseen model can be efficiently evaluated using a trained CDM. Furthermore, we show that these skill profiles provide useful insights, for example, how benchmarks share skills and how instruction-tuned models differ from their base models.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillEval 框架，用 LLM 自动发现可解释技能标签，再用心理测量学的认知诊断模型（CDM）估计模型在各技能上的能力，将基准评测从单一标量分数升级为跨模型、技能级的细粒度画像；在 5 个基准（MATH、BBH、GPQA、MuSR、IFEval）、3,811 个模型、9,523 道题上验证其可靠性、校准性与预测力，并展示于 LLM 路由（降本 60%+）与计算机自适应测试（CAT）两个下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现行基准评测将逐题表现聚合成单一标量分数，粒度过粗，忽略基准数据覆盖的技能多样性，既浪费基准数据的信息，也难以刻画模型能力的结构差异。作者希望更充分地利用基准数据，获得可靠、校准良好、简洁却信息量大的模型能力刻画。
AI.method: 框架融合两领域进展：(1) 利用 LLM 的元认知能力，从题目中自动挖掘可解释的技能标签；(2) 引入心理测量学中的认知诊断模型（CDM），基于模型-题目作答矩阵估计每个模型在各技能维度上的能力参数，实现跨模型的技能级分析。
AI.result: 在 5 个跨领域基准（MATH、BBH、GPQA、MuSR、IFEval）上，对 3,811 个模型、9,523 道题进行实验。相比传统平均分范式，SkillEval 生成的模型画像更可靠、校准更好、信息更丰富且简洁，对未见题目的行为预测更准确。下游应用：(1) LLM 路由按查询动态分配能力足够且高效的模型，在性能提升的同时降低推理成本 60% 以上；(2) 计算机自适应测试（CAT）可用训练好的 CDM 高效评测未见模型。
AI.conclusion: 技能级评测在实践中可行且更具信息价值：技能画像揭示了基准间共享技能、指令微调模型与基座模型的差异等洞见，并可直接支撑路由与自适应测试等实际场景，为超越单一标量分数的评测范式提供了可扩展路径。

title: Scaling Therapy Supervision: Assessing Psychotherapy Fidelity Using Large Language Models
summary: Psychotherapy fidelity assessment measures how faithfully a therapist adheres to a treatment protocol, a critical determinant of positive patient outcomes. However, fidelity assessment is bottlenecked by manual expert review, rendering the process labor-intensive and unscalable. To scale therapy supervision and support clinician self-learning, we present an integrated application of large language models (LLMs) that automates psychotherapy fidelity workflows and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic, long-form clinical transcripts. We evaluate three open-weight models across multiple task decomposition configurations and reasoning strategies, demonstrating that evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation. Furthermore, we establish the framework's external construct validity on an independent randomized controlled trial (RCT), where it reliably distinguishes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) from non-CBT sessions across core therapeutic skills. Through a user study that evaluates the generated feedback, mental health experts indicate that the pipeline synthesizes actionable clinical feedback. Ultimately, our work offers a practical, scalable solution toward bridging the community mental health supervision gap.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的整合应用，自动化心理治疗保真度评估流程并从真实长程临床转录生成可操作的督导反馈。
AI.motivation: 保真度评估（治疗师对治疗方案的依从程度）是影响患者疗效的关键因素，但依赖专家人工审阅，耗时且难以规模化，造成社区心理健康督导缺口。
AI.method: 在真实长程临床转录上评估三个开源权重模型，比较多种任务分解配置与推理策略；采用"证据优先"（evidence-first）推理；并以独立随机对照试验（RCT）数据检验外部构念效度，另开展专家用户研究评估生成反馈。
AI.result: 证据优先推理提升了保真度估计表现；框架在独立RCT上能可靠区分CBT与非CBT会谈的核心治疗技能；心理健康专家认为该流程可生成可操作的临床反馈。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实用、可扩展的方案，有助于弥合社区心理健康督导资源缺口，并支持临床医生自我学习。

title: Accelerating CPU Speculative Decoding via Unified Graph Execution and Transactional KV Isolation
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but deploying it on CPUs introduces severe systems bottlenecks: context-swapping latency between draft and target graphs, and memory allocation overhead during KV cache rollbacks. We introduce SubTernary, an execution framework that eliminates these costs through Unified Graph Caching and Transactional KV-Cache Isolation. By compiling both models into a single memory arena with a persistent thread pool and routing speculative tokens to a static scratchpad for zero-copy pointer resets, SubTernary avoids dynamic reallocation and thread synchronization entirely. We integrate a 256-bit AVX2 ternary SIMD kernel as a low-bit case study. Ablations reveal our systems runtime drives 35.0% of the throughput gains, while the ternary kernel adds 6.0%. SubTernary achieves a $1.35\times$ speedup over llama.cpp speculative decoding and $3.99\times$ over autoregressive decoding, maintaining $O(1)$ rollback latency.

AI.tldr: SubTernary 是一个面向 CPU 的投机解码执行框架，通过统一图缓存与事务性 KV-Cache 隔离消除上下文切换与内存分配开销，配合 256-bit AVX2 三值 SIMD 内核，实现 1.35×（对比 llama.cpp 投机解码）与 3.99×（对比自回归解码）加速，并保持 O(1) 回滚延迟。
AI.motivation: 在 CPU 上部署投机解码存在两类严重系统级瓶颈：（1）draft 模型图与 target 模型图之间的上下文切换延迟；（2）KV cache 回滚过程中的动态内存分配开销。已有工作多关注算法或低比特量化，未针对这些系统开销进行优化。
AI.method: 提出 Unified Graph Caching：将两个模型编译进单一内存 arena，并配以持久化线程池，避免重复图初始化与线程同步；提出 Transactional KV-Cache Isolation：将投机 token 路由到静态 scratchpad，实现零拷贝指针重置，从而完全规避动态重分配。此外集成 256-bit AVX2 三值（ternary）SIMD 内核作为低比特案例研究。
AI.result: 消融实验显示系统运行时优化贡献了 35.0% 的吞吐提升，三值内核额外贡献 6.0%；整体相对 llama.cpp 投机解码加速 1.35×，相对自回归解码加速 3.99×，且回滚延迟保持 O(1)。
AI.conclusion: 投机解码在 CPU 上的主要收益瓶颈来自系统层开销而非数值计算，通过统一图缓存、静态 scratchpad 与事务性 KV-Cache 隔离可将回滚成本降为常数级；低比特 SIMD 内核提供叠加增益。该框架为 CPU 端投机解码部署提供了以系统优化为主导的可行路径。

title: Different Defects, Different Effects: A Controlled Audit of Face Recognition Training Data
summary: The development of face recognition has been strongly supported by the availability of large-scale training datasets. Among them, MS-Celeb-1M has played an important role by providing millions of facial images from nearly 100K identities. However, the size and heterogeneity of such datasets increase the likelihood of annotation errors, redundant samples, and other forms of data inconsistency. This motivated the introduction of refined versions, such as MS1MV2 and MS1MV3, aimed at improving the quality of the training data. Despite these cleaning efforts, we show that several types of training-data defects remain in MS1MV3. By proposing complementary data-auditing strategies, we identify five defect categories: exact and near-duplicate images, split identities, crop errors, multiple-face ambiguity, and invalid content. We then assess the effect of correcting these defects under a controlled face-recognition training protocol based on IResNet-50 and ArcFace. The results show that targeted interventions can preserve, and in some cases improve, recognition performance while requiring fewer optimization steps to reach the performance of the original training set. Duplicate removal provides the clearest overall benefit, while split-identity merging and invalid-content removal also improve training efficiency. Overall, the results indicate that the effect of dataset cleaning depends strongly on the type of defect being addressed and provide further evidence that training-data quality remains an important and comparatively underexplored factor in large-scale face recognition. The training manifests and code used in this work will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文审计MS1MV3数据集，识别出五类残留数据缺陷，并在IResNet-50+ArcFace受控训练协议下评估针对性修复的效果：修复可保持甚至提升识别性能，并减少所需优化步数，其中去重收益最明显。
AI.motivation: 大规模人脸识别训练集（如MS-Celeb-1M及其精炼版MS1MV2/MS1MV3）规模大、异质性强，易产生标注错误、冗余样本等不一致；即便经过清洗，缺陷仍存在，而训练数据质量这一因素相对研究不足。
AI.method: 提出互补的数据审计策略，在MS1MV3中识别五类缺陷：完全/近重复图像、身份分裂、裁剪错误、多人脸歧义、无效内容；随后在基于IResNet-50与ArcFace的受控人脸识别训练协议下，对比修复前后的效果。
AI.result: 针对性干预可保持甚至在某些情况下提升识别性能，同时以更少的优化步数达到原始训练集的性能水平；去重带来最显著的总体收益，身份分裂合并与无效内容移除也提升训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 数据集清洗的效果强烈依赖于所针对的缺陷类型；训练数据质量仍是大规模人脸识别中重要且相对未被充分探索的因素。训练清单与代码将在录用后公开。

title: Phase-Coherent Multistatic Sensing under Phase Noise in Distributed ISAC
summary: We investigate phase-coherent multistatic sensing in distributed ISAC systems where spatially separated access points (APs) share a common, non-ideal local oscillator (LO) impaired by phase noise (PN). In the presence of a single transmit AP and multiple receive APs with OFDM transmission, we derive the joint statistics of PN across receive APs and reveal its unique covariance structure that depends on target location through propagation delays of individual bistatic links. Based on this statistical characterization, we carry out a Cramér-Rao bound analysis of three receiver models, namely PN-free, PN-aware and PN-ignorant, for both isotropic and non-isotropic targets. Simulation results verify the location-dependent statistics of PN in shared-LO distributed architectures while demonstrating how transmit power, LO quality, AP deployment and scattering characteristics affect multistatic localization.

AI.tldr: 研究共享非理想本振导致相位噪声（PN）的分布式ISAC系统中相位相干多基地感知，推导PN跨接收AP的联合统计及其依赖目标位置的协方差结构，并给出三种接收机模型的CRB分析。
AI.motivation: 分布式ISAC中空间分离的AP共享同一非理想本振，PN在多基地链路间相关且与目标位置耦合，现有分析多忽略该统计特性对定位性能的影响。
AI.method: 单发射AP、多接收AP的OFDM传输场景下，推导PN跨接收AP的联合统计并刻画由各双基地链路传播时延决定的位置相关协方差结构；据此对PN-free、PN-aware、PN-ignorant三种接收机模型，分别针对各向同性与非各向同性目标进行Cramér-Rao界分析，并用仿真验证。
AI.result: 仿真验证了共享本振分布式架构中PN统计的位置依赖性，并量化了发射功率、本振质量、AP部署与散射特性对多基地定位性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 共享本振下的PN具有位置相关的协方差结构，需在接收机建模中显式考虑（PN-aware）以准确评估并提升多基地定位性能。

title: Comprehensive Acoustic Characterization of a Broadband Lateral MEMS Ultrasonic Transducer by Near-Field Acoustic Holography and Coupled Multiphysics Simulation
summary:
Broadband airborne ultrasonic transducers are attractive for applications such as ranging, echo-location, and acoustic material characterization, where wide bandwidths enable advanced excitation and signal-processing techniques. Recently, a lateral capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer (L-CMUT) employing electrostatically actuated in-plane microbeams was introduced as a broadband MEMS transducer concept. However, a comprehensive investigation of its acoustic radiation behavior and quantitative validation of corresponding multiphysics models have not yet been reported.
  In this work, we present a combined experimental and numerical characterization of a previously reported L-CMUT device operating between 10 kHz and 60 kHz. A coupled electrostatic--structural--thermoviscous finite-element model is combined with an acoustic boundary-element formulation to investigate the complete transduction chain from electrostatic actuation to acoustic radiation. The numerical predictions are validated experimentally using spherical near-field acoustic holography, enabling reconstruction of three-dimensional directivity patterns, radiated acoustic power, and spherical harmonic representations of the radiated sound field.
  The results show that the broadband behavior originates from strong thermoviscous damping within the narrow beam--stator cavities, resulting in strongly overdamped operation despite a mechanical eigenfrequency near 50 kHz. Good agreement between simulations and measurements is obtained for radiation patterns, radiated sound power, and spherical harmonic content. Furthermore, horn loading primarily redistributes acoustic energy and modifies directivity while only weakly affecting the total radiated acoustic power.

AI.tldr: 本文对10–60 kHz横向电容式微机械超声换能器（L-CMUT）建立了静电–结构–热黏性有限元与声学边界元耦合的多物理场模型，并用球面近场声全息实验验证，揭示了其宽带特性源于窄梁–定子腔内的强热黏性阻尼。
AI.motivation: L-CMUT（基于面内微梁静电驱动的宽带MEMS换能器）虽已被提出，但其声辐射行为缺乏系统研究，相应多物理场模型也缺少定量验证，限制其在测距、回声定位与声学材料表征中的应用。
AI.method: 构建静电–结构–热黏性耦合有限元模型，并与声学边界元方法结合，模拟从静电驱动到声辐射的完整换能链路；采用球面近场声全息实验进行验证，重建三维指向性、辐射声功率及球谐表示。
AI.result: 仿真与实验在辐射指向性、辐射声功率和球谐成分上吻合良好；宽带特性源于窄梁–定子腔内强热黏性阻尼导致的重度过阻尼（尽管机械本征频率约50 kHz）；喇叭加载主要重分布声能并改变指向性，仅微弱影响总辐射声功率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次对L-CMUT的完整换能链路给出定量模型与实验验证，确认热黏性阻尼是其宽带机理，所建立的多物理场建模与声全息表征框架可用于宽带MEMS超声换能器的设计与优化。

title: Second-Order Nonlinear Microresonators on Thin-Film Lithium Tantalate
summary: Nonlinear frequency conversion enables coherent light generation in spectral regions that conventional lasers cannot reach directly and is foundational to the generation of squeezed states and correlated photon pairs. Implementing these nonlinear processes in microresonators lowers the required optical power by orders of magnitude but requires two conditions to be met simultaneously across wide optical bandwidths: phase matching between the interacting fields, and an appropriate coupling condition to the resonator both in the fundamental and second harmonic band. While the former can be addressed by quasi-phase matching through periodic poling, coupling two widely separated spectral bands to the resonator is nontrivial because of the wavelength dependence of mode overlap. Here, we demonstrate parametric oscillation and efficient second-harmonic generation in periodically poled racetracks on thin-film lithium tantalate on insulator. The proposed resonators feature bus-ring coupling engineered independently in the two spectral bands via a long synchronous directional coupler. Quasi-phase matching is achieved using sidewall poling that is also wavelength-calibrated and locally adapted to compensate for thickness nonuniformities. Together, these two design elements enable second-order parametric oscillation with an on-chip threshold of 181 uW and 9.8% conversion efficiency, with signal and idler tunable over tens of nanometers by a few hundred megahertz of pump detuning. Our design strategy can be flexibly applied to efficient second-harmonic generation, reaching 25% absolute conversion efficiency at milliwatt pump powers. These results show how the coupling condition is a design variable in second-order nonlinear resonators and establish thin-film lithium tantalate as a competitive platform for efficient and low-power frequency conversion.

AI.tldr: 该论文在绝缘体上薄膜钽酸锂的周期极化跑道微腔中，通过长同步定向耦合器实现基频与倍频两个波段的独立耦合，并结合波长校准、局部适配侧壁极化实现准相位匹配，从而获得阈值181 µW、转换效率9.8%的二阶参量振荡及25%的二次谐波产生效率。
AI.motivation: 非线性频率转换可实现传统激光器难以直接覆盖波段的相干光产生，是压缩态与关联光子对的基础。在微腔中实施可大幅降低所需光功率，但需在宽带宽内同时满足相位匹配与基频/倍频波段的耦合条件；准相位匹配可由周期极化解决，而跨越宽光谱间隔的双波段耦合因模式重叠的波长依赖性而困难。
AI.method: 在绝缘体上薄膜钽酸锂（TFLT）上制备周期极化跑道微腔；利用长同步定向耦合器对总线-环耦合在两个波段分别独立设计；采用侧壁极化实现准相位匹配，并进行波长校准与局部适配以补偿厚度不均匀。
AI.result: 实现二阶参量振荡，片上阈值181 µW，转换效率9.8%，信号光与闲频光可通过数百MHz泵浦失谐在数十纳米范围调谐；二次谐波产生在毫瓦泵浦功率下达到25%的绝对转换效率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明耦合条件应作为二阶非线性谐振腔的设计变量，并确立薄膜钽酸锂作为高效、低功耗频率转换的竞争性平台，该设计策略可灵活推广至高效二次谐波产生。

title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to separate out queries that are truly ambiguous from queries that may look ambiguous but are not (i.e., can be resolved from the context). The same LoRA achieves high performance in both pre-retrieval and post-retrieval scenarios; thus, it can be used in two places in a RAG pipeline as a check before answer generation. The ClariEdge dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge.

AI.tldr: 提出ClariEdge数据集（约3900个多轮对话中需澄清/不需澄清的查询样本），并证明轻量LoRA微调模型在澄清需求分类（96.6%准确率）与澄清请求生成质量上优于多个大模型的提示基线，硬负例是关键要素。
AI.motivation: RAG系统面对歧义用户查询时需要先做查询澄清；现有多轮对话场景下，查询可能在形式或语境上歧义，也可能表面正常但在检索文档下存在多种合理解释，需同时识别这两类情况并生成澄清请求，而缺乏相应数据与轻量方案。
AI.method: 构建ClariEdge数据集，约3900个样例，包含歧义查询及无需澄清的负例（含硬负例，即看似歧义但可由上下文消解）。在多轮对话与检索文档语境下训练轻量LoRA微调模型，完成"是否需澄清"的二分类及澄清请求生成，并在预检索与后检索两种场景下评估。
AI.result: LoRA分类准确率达96.6%；在分类与澄清生成质量上均优于多个更大模型的提示基线；硬负例对区分真实歧义与可消解歧义至关重要；同一LoRA在预检索与后检索场景均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 轻量LoRA可作为RAG流水线中答案生成前的澄清检查模块，部署于检索前或检索后两处；数据集已公开。

title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
summary: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

AI.tldr: KVLearn：面向分离式LLM服务的学习型KV缓存保留框架，用前缀复用预测、成本感知保留评分与自适应阈值在线决策，显著降低TTFT与跨节点KV传输量。
AI.motivation: 分离式（disaggregated）LLM服务将prefill与decode分置于不同节点池，KV缓存的计算端与消费端之间隔着网络fabric。这打破了经典缓存策略"未命中仅需本地重算"的假设：miss还带来到decode节点的网络传输开销；而将一个block准入全局缓存同样需要额外传输，因此错误的保留决策会同时浪费内存与带宽。
AI.method: KVLearn由三部分组成：(i) Prefix Reuse Predictor (PRP)：轻量级前缀复用预测器，基于结构性与时序性前缀特征估计复用概率，且不修改模型权重；(ii) Cost-Aware Retention Score (CARS)：将复用概率结合重算、传输与存储成本，转化为keep/admit决策；(iii) Adaptive Threshold Controller (ATC)：依据观测到的命中率与内存压力在线调整准入阈值。整体集成于全局分离式服务拓扑，并在文本与多模态负载（含大图像/视频派生KV block、异构复用模式）上评估。
AI.result: 端到端TTFT相比No-Cache最多降低56%，相比LRU-Pool降低38%，相比Mooncake类基线降低33%；跨节点KV传输量相比LRU-Pool最多减少53%；在MM-Session上吞吐与oracle相差约5%以内。
AI.conclusion: 在分离式服务下，缓存决策需显式纳入网络传输成本；学习式复用预测与成本感知、自适应的准入控制可在保持接近oracle吞吐的同时显著改善TTFT并节约带宽。代码已开源。

title: Is Anyone Enforcing the Cartel? What Reinforcement Learning Teaches LLM Agents in Markets
summary: Evaluations of large language model (LLM) agents report that pricing agents collude at others' expense. Yet collusion is defined by enforcement: a cartel, in which competitors share monopoly profits, holds only if a member who cheats is punished. We introduce an audit that tests enforcement by forcing a member to cheat in counterfactual copies of a market, and use it to study what reinforcement learning (RL) teaches agents in pricing and trading. Small LLMs trained by RL learn what their training rivals reward, but only what they readily try. In self-play, they learn fixed rules ignoring their rivals; against a punishing rival, to be deterred; against a cheating rival, to match its cuts, never the costly price war that would deter it, which they rarely try. A war forced into training is learned, but mostly only where it was forced. Against their own copies, deterred and matching agents can earn the same cartel profits, but only matching ones can enforce them, and then thinly: as a by-product and only against large cuts. Q-learners enforce collusion only in pricing. Prompted LLMs reach cartel-like outcomes mostly through rules that ignore the market. Outcome measures cannot tell these cases apart; the audit can.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"审计"(audit)方法，通过在反事实复制市场中强制某一成员作弊来检验共谋的"执行"(enforcement)环节，并用于刻画强化学习在定价与交易任务中真正教会智能体的行为。
AI.motivation: 现有研究据报道LLM定价智能体以牺牲他人为代价共谋，但共谋的本质在于"执行"：只有作弊成员被惩罚时卡特尔才成立。仅凭结果指标（如价格、利润）无法区分真正的可执行共谋与忽略对手的固定规则或模仿行为。
AI.method: 设计审计实验：在市场的反事实副本中强制某一成员作弊，观察其他成员是否惩罚及惩罚强度；将其应用于强化学习（RL）训练的定价与交易智能体，比较小模型在自我对弈、面对惩罚型对手、面对作弊型对手、以及在训练中强制注入价格战等条件；同时考察Q-learning与提示式LLM。
AI.result: RL训练的小型LLM只学到其训练对手所奖励的内容，且仅限其容易尝试的行为。自我对弈中学到忽略对手的固定规则；面对惩罚型对手学会被威慑；面对作弊型对手学会跟随降价，但很少尝试可威慑对方的代价高昂的价格战。训练中强制的价格战主要只在被强制的场景被学到。对自身副本时，被威慑型与跟随型智能体都能获得相同的卡特尔利润，但只有跟随型能真正执行，且执行很弱——仅作为副产品、且只对大幅降价。Q-learner仅在定价情境下执行共谋。提示式LLM主要通过忽略市场的规则达成类卡特尔结果。结果指标无法区分这些情形，审计可以。
AI.conclusion: 共谋不应由结果指标判定，而应通过执行审计来判定；RL训练的小型LLM大多并未习得真正的可执行共谋，审计能揭示这类被结果指标掩盖的差异。

title: VHDLBench: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for VHDL-Based Chip Design
comment: This paper is a long version of a paper accepted for the 4th International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models, 2026
summary: The rapid evolution of digital circuit complexity demands innovative approaches to hardware design automation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have influenced software development, their application to Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation remains largely unexplored, particularly for VHDL. This paper presents a comprehensive study for AI-assisted digital circuit design, addressing gaps in current Electronic Design Automation workflows. The work introduces a VHDL dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified examples from open-source repositories and converted Verilog designs. Five 7B-parameter LLMs were fine-tuned using parameter-efficient QLoRA technique, enabling deployment in resource-constrained environments. To evaluate model efficacy, a rigorous three-level pipeline was established: (1) syntax and synthesis validation, (2) functional simulation with testbenches, and (3) FPGA prototyping on Zynq SoCs. Results show fine-tuned models achieve up to 92% syntax correctness and 73% functional accuracy on common design tasks, with DeepSeek-Coder demonstrating the highest performance gains. Generated designs were successfully deployed on real hardware, confirming not only syntactic but operational viability. This work demonstrates that LLMs, when tailored with domain-specific data and lightweight fine-tuning can contribute meaningfully to the future of generative EDA workflows.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了18,500+条VHDL数据集，采用QLoRA对五个7B级LLM微调，并通过"语法与综合验证—功能仿真—FPGA原型"三级流水线评估，验证了LLM辅助VHDL电路生成的可行性。
AI.motivation: 数字电路复杂度快速上升，亟需硬件设计自动化的新方法。LLM已影响软件开发，但在HDL生成（尤其VHDL）领域探索不足，现有EDA工作流存在空白。
AI.method: 构建含18,500+条经语法校验样例的VHDL数据集（源自开源仓库及Verilog转换设计）；用参数高效QLoRA对5个7B参数LLM进行微调，使其适配资源受限环境；建立三级评估流水线：(1)语法与综合验证，(2)带测试平台的功能仿真，(3)Zynq SoC上的FPGA原型验证。
AI.result: 微调后模型在常见设计任务上语法正确率最高达92%，功能准确率73%，其中DeepSeek-Coder提升最大；生成设计成功部署至真实硬件，证实其不仅语法可行且具备运行可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结合领域数据与轻量微调的LLM可对生成式EDA工作流作出实质贡献，为AI辅助数字电路设计提供可行路径。

title: Complexity-Aware Surgical Video Reasoning Segmentation with Digital Twin and Context Memory
summary: Conventional surgical segmentation relies on closed-set categories or explicit text queries, which cannot resolve implicit queries that require reasoning about workflows, instrument functions, and temporal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose SurgReasonSeg, a complexity-aware method that brings reasoning segmentation over digital twin (DT) representations to surgical video. Specifically, SurgReasonSeg constructs DT representations from surgical foundation models and trains two low-rank adapters (LoRA) of one large language model with reinforcement learning (RL), each specialized for a different query complexity. A lightweight router, also trained with RL, selects between the two adapters to balance latency against accuracy. SurgReasonSeg also sets the temporal context with an adaptive sliding window conditioned on query complexity and workflow phase, and retrieves relevant historical cases from a surgical context memory by workflow similarity and procedural relevance. We further introduce EndoVis-ReasonSeg, a surgical reasoning segmentation benchmark with 1,460 training and 961 test samples across semantic, spatial, and temporal categories. On EndoVis-ReasonSeg, SurgReasonSeg improves J&F over the strongest baseline, ReSurgSAM2, by 0.178, 0.237, and 0.297 on semantic, spatial, and temporal queries, and it also achieves the best results on the Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 referring segmentation benchmarks. A backbone-matched attribution protocol separates the contribution of the upstream segmenter from that of the reasoning modules. Our method runs at 18.8 FPS averaged over the query distribution, enabling real-time reasoning segmentation in surgical videos.

AI.tldr: 提出 SurgReasonSeg，将推理分割引入手术视频，在数字孪生表示上用强化学习训练双 LoRA 与路由器，并构建 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 基准，J&F 大幅提升且达 18.8 FPS。
AI.motivation: 传统手术分割依赖闭集类别或显式文本查询，无法处理需要推理工作流程、器械功能与时间关系的隐式查询。
AI.method: 基于手术基础模型构建数字孪生（DT）表示；用强化学习（RL）训练同一大语言模型的两个 LoRA 适配器，分别面向不同查询复杂度；再由同样以 RL 训练的轻量路由器在两者间选择，以权衡延迟与精度；采用随查询复杂度与工作流阶段变化的自适应滑动窗口设定时序上下文；并通过工作流相似性与流程相关性从手术上下文记忆中检索历史病例。同时提出 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 基准（1,460 训练 / 961 测试样本，覆盖语义、空间、时间三类查询），并设计主干匹配的归因协议。
AI.result: 在 EndoVis-ReasonSeg 上，语义、空间、时间查询的 J&F 分别较最强基线 ReSurgSAM2 提升 0.178、0.237、0.297；在 Ref-EndoVis17 与 Ref-EndoVis18 指代分割基准上取得最优结果；平均查询分布下运行速度 18.8 FPS；主干匹配归因协议分离了上游分割器与推理模块的贡献。
AI.conclusion: SurgReasonSeg 实现了手术视频中的实时推理分割，兼顾精度与效率，并为该任务提供了可复用的基准与公平的归因评估方法。

title: The Metrology Atlas: describing recorded physiological data as a measurement system, with VitalDB as a first application
summary: Every value in a recorded physiological dataset is a pair: a recorded time and a recorded value. Neither is the truth. The time comes from a clock that drifts and is corrected in jumps, and often describes a window that ended earlier. The value was quantised, rounded, sometimes heaped by hand, and measured by an instrument with its own error. We present the Metrology Atlas, a dataset-independent way of describing a recorded dataset as a measurement system, and its first application, to VitalDB, an open dataset of 6,388 surgical patients, as a proof of principle. For every variable, the atlas states what was measured, the measurement model linking it to the recorded pair, and what is known about the true time and true value given a record. Each part of the model carries its evidence: 69 studies, 49 parameters and 54 observations, each marked as measured, derived, estimated or assumed. The atlas maps 11 clocks and 14 devices into one timing network, and closes loops in that network to test its own model. Synchronisation reduces the median timing error between the EEG and ECG from 794 ms to 42 ms, and between ventilator and monitor waveforms from 378 ms to 55 ms. The atlas also documents data-quality issues, several of which correct the dataset's own documentation. It is published as a website and a single machine-readable file, with open-source code and a scheme of time-aware labels. Everything is open under CC BY 4.0 and MIT licences. The engine, schema and timing tools carry over unchanged, and the aim is to describe many other datasets the same way.

AI.tldr: 提出"Metrology Atlas"，一种数据集无关的方法，把记录型生理数据集描述为测量系统，并首次应用于VitalDB（6,388例手术患者），以证明该框架的可行性。
AI.motivation: 记录型生理数据中的时间与数值均非真值：时钟会漂移并被跳变校正、时间窗口常滞后结束；数值经过量化、取整、手工堆积及仪器误差。现有数据文档未刻画这种"记录—真值"之间的测量关系，导致跨设备对齐与不确定性评估缺乏依据。
AI.method: 建立元测量学框架：对每个变量给出所测物理量、连接真值与记录对的测量模型，以及给定记录时关于真实时间与真实值的已知信息。模型各部分附证据，涵盖69项研究、49个参数、54个观测，并标注为measured/derived/estimated/assumed。将11个时钟与14个设备映射为统一时间网络，通过闭环校验自测模型。
AI.result: 同步后EEG与ECG间中位时间误差由794 ms降至42 ms，呼吸机与监护仪波形间由378 ms降至55 ms。同时记录多项数据质量问题，其中若干修正了数据集自带文档。
AI.conclusion: Atlas以网站与单一机器可读文件发布，附开源代码与时间感知标签方案，全部以CC BY 4.0与MIT许可开放。引擎、模式与时间工具可原样迁移，目标是以同一方式描述更多数据集。

title: Coupled Loop-within-Loop Resonators at the near-field: Extended Bandwidth and Short Pulse Response upon Parametric Conversion
summary: Parametric frequency conversion have seen a renewed interest, specifically in superconducting quantum circuits at GHz range. These nonlinear convertors are typically narrow band and one may wish to extend their frequency range. Here, two coupled resonators are investigated: a loop-within-loop structure, whose gap is coupled by short, a diode, or simply left open. While simulations and experimental results are limited to GHz range, the concept is general. On their own, the loops exhibit natural frequencies of ca, f=1.5 GHz and f/2=0.73 GHz, respectively; the coupling modifies the resonance frequencies and increases its bandwidth. In one example, signal is fed from one loop and is received by the other. In another example, the input signal is provided across a coupling diode and is received by either loops. It is shown that in the case of nonlinear coupling, the frequency bandwidth can be as large as 3 GHz. Such bandwidth is associated with a very narrow temporal response of less than 150 ps, suggesting coherent effects through high-harmonic excitations at the near-field.

AI.tldr: 该文研究两个耦合谐振环（环中环结构）用于拓展参量频率转换的带宽，通过短接、二极管或开路方式实现间隙耦合，在非线性耦合下获得约3 GHz带宽及<150 ps的时域响应。
AI.motivation: 参量频率转换器（尤其在GHz波段超导量子电路中）通常是窄带的，研究者希望拓展其频率工作范围，因此探索耦合谐振器结构以扩大带宽。
AI.method: 采用环中环（loop-within-loop）双耦合谐振器结构，其间隙通过短路线、二极管或直接开路耦合；利用仿真与实验研究耦合对共振频率与带宽的影响，并测试不同信号馈入/接收配置（一环馈入另一环接收、或经耦合二极管输入由任一环接收）。
AI.result: 单环固有频率分别约为1.5 GHz与0.73 GHz（f与f/2）；耦合使共振频率发生偏移并增加带宽。在非线性（二极管）耦合情形下，频率带宽可达约3 GHz，对应小于150 ps的极窄时间响应。
AI.conclusion: 耦合谐振环结构可有效展宽参量频率转换的带宽，非线性耦合下的大带宽伴随极短时域响应，暗示近场高次谐波激发引起的相干效应；该概念具有普适性，不限于GHz波段。

title: Microlens-Integrated Grating Couplers for Efficient Free-Space Coupling in Silicon Photonics
summary: Grating-coupler arrays are used to couple free-space light into photonic chips, but the space required for tapers and routing waveguides limits their optical fill factor. Microlens arrays can increase the effective fill factor by collecting light over a larger area and focusing it onto each grating. Separately fabricated lens arrays, however, require assembly and precise alignment to the chip. Here we integrate refractive microlenses directly with high-efficiency, normal-incidence grating couplers using two-photon polymerization. Each lens has a 100 x 100 um2 aperture and focuses incident light onto the grating. Writing the lens body at coarse resolution and the optical surface at fine resolution reduces the print time from 9 h to 19 min per lens. Under illumination by a Gaussian beam with a 276 um mode-field diameter, a printed lens increases the measured coupled power by a factor of 33 (15.2 dB) relative to the same grating before printing. Loss normalization gives an estimated lens-to-mode efficiency of 68%. The lenses show no measurable change in coupling after three 3 h thermal cycles at 150C. These results support direct printing as an approach to increasing free-space collection while simplifying lens integration in photonic systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用双光子聚合直接在常入射高效率光栅耦合器上打印折射微透镜，将耦合功率提升33倍（15.2 dB），估算透镜-模式效率68%，并在150 °C热循环下保持稳定，为简化透镜集成、提高自由空间收集效率提供了方案。
AI.motivation: 光栅耦合器阵列用于将自由空间光耦合进光子芯片，但锥形波导与路由波导占据的面积限制了其光学填充因子。微透镜阵列可通过更大面积收光并聚焦到各光栅上提高有效填充因子，然而独立制备的透镜阵列需要装配并与芯片精确对准，工艺复杂。
AI.method: 采用双光子聚合技术将折射微透镜直接集成到常入射高效率光栅耦合器上；每个透镜孔径为100 × 100 μm²，将入射光聚焦到光栅上；通过粗分辨率打印透镜主体、细分辨率打印光学表面的分区打印策略缩短打印时间；并在276 μm模场直径的高斯光束照明下测量耦合功率与热稳定性。
AI.result: 分区打印使单透镜打印时间由9 h降至19 min；在276 μm模场直径高斯光束照明下，打印透镜使测得耦合功率相对打印前同一光栅提升33倍（15.2 dB）；经损耗归一化估算透镜-模式效率约68%；在150 °C下进行三次3 h热循环后耦合无明显变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，直接打印是一种在提高自由空间收集效率的同时简化光子系统中透镜集成的方式。

title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
summary: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过控制实验研究继续预训练（CPT）在虚拟世界具身学习中的可扩展性，跨数据量、数据多样性与模型规模三个维度训练了120个配置，揭示了各因素的增益边界并拟合出经验缩放律。
AI.motivation: 物理环境中的具身学习已能从数据、多样性和模型容量扩展中获益，但这些收益能否迁移到视觉风格、动力学、控制方式和目标各异的虚拟世界尚不清楚，因此需要系统厘清CPT在各扩展轴上的作用边界。
AI.method: 开展受控的继续预训练研究：覆盖4种模型规模（0.8B–27B）、6档数据预算（50–1600小时）、5种数据混合（从仅Minecraft到多世界语料），共120个训练配置；采用三级验证损失与从语料内世界到未见世界的游戏基准评估性能与泛化。
AI.result: (1) 更多数据提升语料内表现，多样性提升向相关世界的迁移但向远距离世界增益有限，模型规模提升数据效率但在单世界训练下对远距离世界泛化更差；(2) 观察到早期“接口阶段”带来广泛跨世界收益、后期“世界阶段”收益收窄至语料内与相关世界，并拟合出验证损失与数据量、多样性、模型规模的经验缩放律；(3) 模型在3D世界中与Minecraft专家模型及前沿模型具竞争力，实时场景表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 模仿学习的局限性与远距离世界的持续差距表明，构建通用具身智能体需要比继续预训练更丰富的训练阶段。

title: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset using a subject-exclusive training, validation, and test protocol show that TF-IG achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.227 BPM, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 2.060 BPM, a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9934, and 92.28 percent of estimates within 3 BPM, while remaining parameter-efficient with only 84.6K parameters. Ablation results further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the temporal and frequency branches, interaction-gated fusion, and shared regression head. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-domain interactions provides an effective accuracy-complexity trade-off for lightweight PPG-based HR estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出TF-IG：参数高效的双分支交互门控时频学习框架，用于PPG心率估计，仅84.6K参数即在BIDMC数据集上取得MAE 1.227 BPM。
AI.motivation: PPG心率监测成本低、无创，但易受波形失真、生理变异与测量干扰影响；时域波形特征与频域周期性信息互补，然而在紧凑模型中有效挖掘并融合这两类表征仍有挑战。
AI.method: 采用双分支架构：时域分支用空洞深度可分离卷积捕捉脉搏形态；频域分支从有界对数谱图表示中提取心脏周期性。引入交互门控融合模块，显式建模特征一致性与差异性并学习逐特征权重以平衡时域与频谱信息；共享参数回归头将时域、频谱及融合表示映射到HR预测空间。
AI.result: 在BIDMC PPG and Respiration数据集上采用受试者互斥的训练/验证/测试划分：MAE 1.227 BPM，RMSE 2.060 BPM，Pearson相关系数0.9934，92.28%估计误差在3 BPM内，参数量仅84.6K。消融实验验证了时域分支、频域分支、交互门控融合及共享回归头各自的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨域交互可在轻量级PPG心率估计中实现有效的精度—复杂度权衡。

title: Where Do Legal Factors Live in LLMs?
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at JURIX 2026, the 39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems
summary: In case-based legal reasoning, legal professionals identify legally significant fact patterns in a new dispute and compare them with those of decided cases. In AI & Law, HYPO dimensions and CATO factors represent these patterns symbolically, organizing expert knowledge distilled from case narratives as explicit, structured, interpretable, and auditable legal concepts and relations that support case comparison, legal argument, and precedent-based reasoning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for legal tasks, yet their internal organization of legal knowledge remains difficult to trace. We investigate whether LLMs form internal representations corresponding to all 26 CATO factors. Two research questions examine linear decodability and sparse localization with sparse autoencoders. Experiments cover three open models, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2 2B, supported by cross-model comparison and human audit of controlled natural-language passages. Results show that all 26 factors are linearly decodable in all three models. Single-feature sparse readouts cover the complete factor catalog, with best-layer test AUCs ranging from 0.86 to 1.00. Five selected features approach full-vector readout performance. We report 78 model-specific layer-feature coordinates, one for each factor in each model. Together, these results show that information corresponding to expert-defined legal factors can be read from the internal activations of LLMs processing legal narratives. By locating these readouts, our study connects legal language and the symbolic abstractions of HYPO and CATO to learned internal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）内部是否形成与CATO全部26个法律要素相对应的表征。通过线性解码与稀疏自编码器（SAE）稀疏定位，在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2 2B三个开放模型上发现26个法律要素均可线性解码，最佳层测试AUC为0.86–1.00，并报告了78个模型特定的层-特征坐标。
AI.motivation: 在基于案例的法律推理中，法律专业人士从新争议中识别具有法律意义的事实模式，并与已决案例进行比较。HYPO维度与CATO要素以符号方式表示这些模式，将专家知识组织为显式、结构化、可解释、可审计的法律概念与关系。然而，LLM虽日益用于法律任务，其内部法律知识的组织方式却难以追踪。作者因此探究LLM是否形成与CATO要素对应的内部表征。
AI.method: 围绕两个研究问题展开：线性可解码性和基于稀疏自编码器的稀疏定位。实验覆盖Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2 2B三个开放模型，辅以跨模型比较，并对受控自然语言段落进行人工审核。定位分析报告了每个模型中每个要素对应的层-特征坐标。
AI.result: 三个模型中全部26个CATO要素均可线性解码；单特征稀疏读出覆盖完整要素目录，最佳层测试AUC范围为0.86至1.00；仅用五个选定特征即可接近全向量读出的性能；共报告78个模型特定的层-特征坐标（每个模型每个要素各一个）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，处理法律叙述时，LLM的内部激活中可读出与专家定义法律要素相对应的信息。通过定位这些读出点，研究将法律语言以及HYPO与CATO的符号抽象与模型学习到的内部表征联系起来，为法律AI的可解释性与可审计性提供了实证基础。

title: Multi-Agent AI Design of a Nanowatt Biomedical Low-Pass Filter from Topology to Layout
comment: 5 pages, 5 Figures, 1 Table, Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027
summary: We demonstrate a multi-agent framework that takes an analog circuit from topology synthesis to layout. A researcher agent directs schematic and layout agents, a four-tier memory stores the specification and lessons, and separate agents review the designs. Deterministic tools provide pass/fail simulation reports, symbolic analysis, graph-based netlist equivalence, parasitic injection, and extraction with DRC and LVS in every optimization trial. A human approves the specification and the layout plan. For a fourth-order, 250-Hz subthreshold biopotential low-pass filter, the researcher agent synthesized, through simulation-guided trial and error, a novel current-reuse architecture that shares a single dc bias branch between a super-source-follower biquad and a flipped-voltage-follower biquad. The agents completed a DRC- and LVS-clean layout in 130-nm IHP SG13G2 CMOS that meets the specification in nominal post-layout simulation, despite the noise-power trade-off and threshold-voltage sensitivity of subthreshold operation. The filter's input-referred noise over 0.5-200 Hz is 41.6% below that of the super-source-follower reference design at about equal core power.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体框架，实现从拓扑综合到版图的全流程模拟电路设计：研究智能体统筹原理图与版图智能体，四级记忆存储规格与经验，独立智能体负责评审，确定性工具在每次优化试验中提供仿真、符号分析、网表等价、寄生注入及含DRC/LVS的提取报告，并由人工审批规格与版图方案。应用于四阶250 Hz亚阈值生物电低通滤波器，智能体经仿真引导试错综合出新型电流复用架构，在130 nm IHP SG13G2 CMOS上完成DRC/LVS干净的版图并满足后仿真规格，0.5–200 Hz输入参考噪声较SSF参考设计低41.6%，核心功耗基本相当。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路设计从拓扑综合到版图高度依赖专家经验、迭代周期长，且亚阈值工作下面临噪声-功耗折中与阈值电压敏感性等难题，亟需将大模型智能体与确定性EDA工具结合，实现可验证、可审查的自动化设计闭环。
AI.method: 构建多智能体框架：研究智能体主导，调度原理图与版图智能体；四级记忆保存设计规格与经验教训；独立评审智能体进行设计审查；确定性工具链在每次优化试验中提供通过/失败仿真报告、符号分析、基于图的网表等价检查、寄生注入以及含DRC与LVS的版图提取；人类负责审批规格与版图规划。
AI.result: 针对四阶250 Hz亚阈值生物电低通滤波器，研究智能体通过仿真引导的试错，综合出一种在超级源跟随双二阶与翻转电压跟随双二阶之间共享单一直流偏置支路的新型电流复用架构；在130 nm IHP SG13G2 CMOS中完成DRC/LVS干净的版图，标称后仿真满足规格；0.5–200 Hz输入参考噪声较SSF参考设计低41.6%，核心功耗大致相当。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体框架结合确定性工具链与人工审批，可在真实工艺节点上完成从架构综合到物理实现的端到端模拟电路设计，并在亚阈值等苛刻条件下获得优于参考设计的噪声表现，表明LLM智能体驱动的可验证自动化设计流程具有可行性。

title: JUICE: Unified Multimodal Modeling in Pretrained Representation Spaces
comment: 69 pages, 31 figures, 37 tables. Project page: https://ced3-han.github.io/JUICE-Website/ Code: https://github.com/Ced3-han/JUICE-Code Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/CedLJH/juice
summary: Most unified multimodal models treat images and text asymmetrically: a pretrained language model generates text, an attached diffusion head generates images, and outputs that contain both are produced in a fixed order, so the first output cannot adapt to the second. We ask whether both modalities can instead be generated by one process that is trained on them jointly from scratch. Pretrained encoder spaces hold both modalities in one continuous form and carry knowledge learned at scale, and recent work finds them effective as generative targets for vision and language. We therefore model the joint distribution directly in these spaces. We introduce JUICE (Joint Unified multimodal modeling In Continuous Encoder spaces), a single flow matching Transformer over frozen image and text representations, in which each modality has its own noise level. Which modalities are clean and which are generated then decides the task: image generation, captioning, visual question answering, or joint generation. Controlled pretraining runs test each design choice. At equal guidance, generating text as continuous states leaves image generation intact (48.41 GenEval, against 47.86 for a model trained only for text-to-image generation), while captions lose some exact wording. Training on joint and conditional denoising together beats either alone, and semantic encoder spaces beat VAE latents and raw pixels as targets. At 2.1B parameters, with no language model initialization and at 224x224, JUICE reaches up to 0.88 on GenEval and 73.1 on VQAv2. By sampling both modalities from the joint distribution (coupled sampling), it can also draw a route on a map while writing out the matching moves. On mazes with several valid solutions, joint success rises from 54.6% with independent sampling to 93.7%, and no modality has to go first. On visual spatial planning, JUICE solves 99.8% of maps at its training sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出 JUICE：在冻结的图像与文本编码器连续表征空间中，用单个 flow matching Transformer 从零联合训练生成两种模态，实现顺序无关的多模态联合生成。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型对图像和文本处理不对称：语言模型生成文本、扩散头生成图像，混合输出按固定顺序产生，先输出的模态无法根据后生成的模态自适应。作者希望两种模态由同一个联合训练的单一过程生成。
AI.method: 利用预训练编码器空间统一承载两模态，直接在该空间建模联合分布。单个 flow matching Transformer 作用于冻结的图像和文本表征，每个模态拥有独立噪声水平；通过指定哪些模态干净、哪些被生成来切换任务（图像生成、描述、VQA、联合生成）。并进行受控预训练实验逐项验证设计选择。
AI.result: 同等引导下文本以连续状态生成几乎不损图像生成（48.41 GenEval vs 47.86 纯 T2I），但描述丢失部分精确措辞；联合与条件去噪共同训练优于单独；语义编码器空间优于 VAE 潜变量与原始像素。2.1B 参数、无语言模型初始化、224x224 下 GenEval 达 0.88、VQAv2 达 73.1。耦合采样可在绘制地图路线的同时写出对应动作；多解迷宫联合成功率由独立采样 54.6% 升至 93.7%，且无模态需先行；视觉空间规划在其训练规模地图上求解率 99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结编码器的连续空间中联合建模，可让单一模型以顺序无关方式生成图像与文本，且不牺牲单模态质量，并带来显著的联合生成收益。

title: Precision-Aware Hierarchical Spectrum Search for Finite-Precision MUSIC DOA Estimation
summary: Dense-grid spectrum search is computationally costly for multiple signal classification (MUSIC) direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation, and low-precision evaluation can introduce numerical errors that distort candidate selection. This paper proposes precision-aware hierarchical MUSIC (PAH-MUSIC), a multistage framework that coordinates arithmetic precision, angular grids, and candidate windows in spectrum evaluation, while covariance estimation and eigendecomposition remain in FP64. Stage-dependent precision is assigned from coarse candidate discovery to final DOA estimation. Under bounded perturbations and local spectral growth, a conditional displacement bound gives a sufficient window-width condition for retained, correctly associated candidates. For a two-stage continuous cost model with fixed precision weights and window coefficients, a closed-form optimal coarse step and a cost-gain condition are derived. Simulations with two separated sources and 500 frames at each tested signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from -10 to 15 dB show that FP8, FP16, and FP32 coarse searches followed by FP64 refinement achieve DOA root-mean-square errors close to a baseline using FP64 at both search stages. Relative to that baseline, the selected configurations reduce weighted spectrum-evaluation cost by 28.36\%--44.66\% under the adopted precision weights.

AI.tldr: 提出精度感知分层MUSIC（PAH-MUSIC），在多级谱搜索中协调运算精度、角度网格与候选窗，在保持DOA精度的同时降低谱评估代价。
AI.motivation: 稠密网格谱搜索计算代价高，而低精度评估会引入数值误差并干扰候选选择，因此需要一种同时兼顾精度与效率的谱评估策略。
AI.method: 协方差估计与特征分解保持FP64；谱评估按阶段分配精度，由粗候选发现到最终DOA估计逐级提高。在扰动有界与局部谱增长假设下给出条件位移界，导出保持正确关联候选的充分窗宽条件；对固定精度权重与窗系数的两阶段连续代价模型，推导闭式最优粗搜索步长与代价增益条件。
AI.result: 两分离源、各SNR下500帧（-10~15 dB）仿真显示，FP8/FP16/FP32粗搜索加FP64精化的DOA RMSE接近两阶段均用FP64的基线；相对该基线，所选配置在给定精度权重下将加权谱评估代价降低28.36%~44.66%。
AI.conclusion: 分层精度调度可在基本不损失DOA估计精度的前提下显著降低MUSIC谱搜索的计算开销，理论窗宽与步长条件为配置选择提供依据。

title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
summary: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出基于先验摊销流匹配（prior-amortized flow matching）的模块化概率多测量反演框架，将单观测后验估计器分别在推理阶段通过组合采样器融合，实现无需联合重训练的X射线/中子反射测量联合精修。
AI.motivation: 散射实验通常只记录强度而无相位信息，导致逆问题非唯一、不同结构可能产生相似散射图样。互补测量可降低歧义，但将其整合进机器学习框架仍具挑战，尤其缺乏可复用、免联合重训练的模块化方案。
AI.method: 采用先验摊销的流匹配（flow matching）为每种观测类型或物理探针分别训练单观测后验估计器；仅在推理时通过组合采样器（compositional sampler）以"后融合"（late fusion）方式组合各估计器，从而复用预训练的单观测模型。以反射测量（reflectometry）为案例，覆盖X射线、飞行时间中子与极化中子反射测量，并开展多中子对比度同质组合与X射线-中子异质多模态组合的联合精修研究。
AI.result: 单观测演示涵盖X射线、飞行时间中子与极化中子反射测量；在独立联合精修研究中，任务匹配的估计器成功实现多个中子对比度的同质组合以及X射线与中子测量的异质多模态组合，且无需针对联合任务重训练。
AI.conclusion: 组合式流匹配可作为不确定性感知反演与联合精修的模块化方法，具有推广到其他"多观测约束同一物理结构、同时保留测量特定参数"的散射问题的潜力。

title: Higher-Order Flatband-Touching Points Mediate Unconventional Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
summary: The bulk-boundary correspondence establishes a fundamental connection between bulk band topology and the emergence of boundary states, underpinning topological phenomena across electronic, acoustic, photonic, and many other wave systems. A broad class of singular flatband systems, however, exhibits an unconventional form of bulk-boundary correspondence, in which robust boundary modes (RBMs) originate from flatband-touching points (FBTPs) and the real-space topology associated with incomplete sets of compact localized states (CLSs), rather than conventional momentum-space bulk topological invariants. To date, experimental studies of such boundary modes have been limited to systems hosting lower-order FBTPs. Here, we experimentally demonstrate unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence in a photonic cross-bedded Kagome-like lattice featuring a higher-order FBTP formed by the touching of two degenerate flatbands and a dispersive band. Using continuous-wave laser writing, we observe shape-preserving propagation of both bulk CLSs and boundary RBMs. Remarkably, unlike previously reported flatband systems, the RBMs retain their boundary localization under input-field perturbations involving both singular and nonsingular CLSs, revealing an unconventional boundary response associated with the higher-order FBTP in this lattice. Our results establish the Kagome-like lattice as a new platform for exploring flatband physics and unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence, with potential applications in wave localization, flatband lasers, and other emerging topological photonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在光子交叉层状Kagome类晶格中实验实现了由高阶平带接触点（两个简并平带与一个色散带相接触）驱动的非传统体边对应，观测到体紧致局域态与边界鲁棒模式的无形变传输，且鲁棒边界模式在奇异与非奇异CLS微扰下仍保持局域性。
AI.motivation: 传统体边对应由动量空间体拓扑不变量刻画，但一类奇异平带系统的鲁棒边界模式（RBMs）源于平带接触点（FBTP）与不完整紧致局域态（CLS）集合的实空间拓扑；此前实验仅涉及低阶FBTP，高阶FBTP下的非传统体边对应尚缺乏实验验证。
AI.method: 采用连续波激光写入技术制备具有交叉层状Kagome类结构的光子晶格，该晶格中两个简并平带与一个色散带相接触形成高阶FBTP；通过激发体CLS与边界RBMs并观测其传播行为，并在输入场中引入奇异与非奇异CLS微扰以检验边界局域性的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验观测到体CLS与边界RBM的保形传输；与以往平带系统不同，RBMs在奇异和非奇异CLS输入扰动下均保持边界局域，展现出与高阶FBTP相关的非传统边界响应。
AI.conclusion: 该Kagome类晶格可作为研究平带物理与非传统体边对应的新平台，在波局域、平带激光器及其他新兴拓扑光子器件中具有应用潜力。

title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SpecEvo：多LLM协同的"推测-整合"进化搜索框架，用轻量模型负责常规探索与证据整合，前沿模型仅在稀疏检查点做战略性干预，在176个任务上匹配或超越前沿模型基线，API成本最多降低80%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的进化式科学发现方法昂贵且缓慢：推理成本被均匀施加于所有步骤，同时未能充分利用失败试验、冗余试验与饱和方向中所蕴含的证据。
AI.method: 提出SpecEvo多模型框架，持续整合搜索证据。轻量模型驱动并行的Speculators（生成与精炼候选程序）以及一个Advisor（将累积的成功、失败与饱和方向蒸馏为持久性指导）；在稀疏检查点，前沿模型担任Navigator，审视演化中的种群，并依据搜索停滞情况以综合、精细修正或重新表述三种方式介入。整体构成"先推测、后整合"的工作流。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个科学与算法发现领域的176个任务上，SpecEvo匹配或超越前沿模型基线，API成本最多降低80%；在方程发现上相比高成本效率基线取得最高1.5倍评估效率；在CO-Bench上超越最强基线3.8%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹条件化的模型协同（trajectory-conditioned model coordination）是实现高成本效率科学发现的有效途径。

title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. We further classify studies by abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain, examining how RL algorithms map onto reconfigurable and fixed hardware. Unlike surveys restricted to particular algorithms or platforms, this work provides a unified analysis of FPGA and IC implementations, covering acceleration, reconfigurable architectures, energy-aware control, and system-level optimization. Comparative assessments consider resource utilization, latency, throughput, power consumption, and reported performance gains. Finally, we identify recurring architectural patterns, practical limitations, open challenges, and research directions for efficient RL-driven hardware systems. The survey offers a consolidated reference for researchers developing and evaluating RL solutions on specialized hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了100余项关于强化学习在FPGA与集成电路（IC）上实现的研究，按RL方法族、抽象层级、硬件实现策略和应用领域进行系统分类，并对资源、时延、吞吐、功耗等指标进行比较评估，总结架构模式、局限与未来方向。
AI.motivation: RL在嵌入式、边缘及异构计算系统中实现自适应自主决策具有价值，FPGA与IC能提供低时延、高能效和架构灵活性，但也带来资源约束、实现复杂度与软硬件协同设计难题；已有综述多局限于特定算法或平台，缺乏对FPGA与IC实现的统一分析。
AI.method: 对100余篇文献进行系统性综述：按RL家族（基于模型的MDP、经典值方法、深度RL、actor-critic、策略梯度、多智能体）组织文献；再按抽象层级、硬件实现策略和应用域分类；考察RL算法如何映射到可重构与固定硬件，涵盖加速、可重构架构、能耗感知控制与系统级优化。
AI.result: 提供了跨算法与平台的统一比较评估，涵盖资源利用率、时延、吞吐量、功耗及所报告的性能提升，并归纳出反复出现的架构模式。
AI.conclusion: 该综述整合了FPGA与IC上RL实现的知识体系，指出实际局限、开放挑战与研究方向，为在专用硬件上开发与评估RL方案的研究者提供参考。

title: LIFT: Scoped Constraints for Evaluating and Training Instruction Following
summary: Common instruction following (IF) benchmarks, such as IFEval, evaluate the ability of language models (LMs) to follow simple constraints that can easily be verified programmatically. These same constraints, in turn, are used as reward signals for reinforcement learning. This design may lead to reward hacking of constraints, pushing models away from the main task. Recent attempts to address this resulted in benchmarks with richer constraints, but required expert labor, remained closed-access, and cannot be easily extended. We present Lift-Bench, an IF benchmark that asks a model to draft a document given a topic and a structured outline. Constraints are scoped to certain document sections, providing finer control over constraint density. Lift-Bench includes both verifiable and judged constraints, as well as a training counterpart, Lift-Train. Importantly, Lift-Bench provides both main task and instruction-following constraints, mitigating shallow reward hacking. On experiments with multiple models, we find that frontier models struggle with the harder subsets of our benchmark and analyze model performance along multiple axes. We also find that training on Lift-Train is much less susceptible to reward hacking than training on the common IFTrain. Lift-Bench and Lift-Train are publicly available, as well as the data generating pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出Lift-Bench：以"给定主题+结构化大纲起草文档"为任务的指令遵循基准，约束按章节限定，含可验证与评判式约束及配套训练集Lift-Train，并公开数据生成流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有IFEval类基准的约束过于简单且可程序化验证，直接用其作强化学习奖励信号易导致对约束的奖励黑客（reward hacking），使模型偏离主任务；新近更丰富的约束基准依赖专家标注、闭源且难以扩展。
AI.method: 构建Lift-Bench：任务为按主题与结构化大纲起草文档，约束作用于特定文档章节以获得更细的约束密度控制；同时包含可验证约束与模型评判约束，并提供训练对应集Lift-Train；基准中同时设置主任务约束与指令遵循约束以缓解浅层奖励黑客；公开基准、训练集与数据生成流程。
AI.result: 多模型实验中，前沿模型在较难子集上表现不佳；作者从多个维度分析模型表现；在Lift-Train上训练比在常见IFTrain上训练更不易出现奖励黑客。
AI.conclusion: Lift-Bench提供了可扩展、开放、约束密度可控且兼顾主任务与指令遵循的IF评测与训练资源，能有效缓解奖励黑客并揭示前沿模型的指令遵循短板。

title: Reorienting the Vector Axis: Restructuring FlashAttention for Long-Vector Processors
summary: A Transformer is built around attention, whose cost grows with the square of the sequence length and dominates the layer on long sequences. FlashAttention made that cost manageable by tiling the attention matrix and updating the softmax as it goes, but almost all work since has targeted GPUs. On long-vector processors one vector register can hold up to 512 single-precision numbers. The savings of a vector instruction are proportional to how much of the register it uses, so the choice of which loop to vectorize is a first-order decision. We port PyTorch's CPU FlashAttention kernel to a RISC-V CPU with 2KB vector registers and find that it reaches 16.2% of peak floating-point throughput. The kernel walks each tile one query row at a time: the product against V is vectorized along the 64-element head dimension, the softmax's per-row maximum and sum are reductions that collapse a full register to a scalar, and the software exponential's polynomial coefficients compete with tile data for vector registers and cause spilling. We propose two techniques. The first transposes the score tile and the running output so that queries lie along the contiguous axis. The algorithm and its values are unchanged. A single parameter, the number of queries in a tile, now sets the vector length of every part of the kernel and can be matched to the machine. Both reductions also disappear. The second moves the polynomial's coefficients into scalar registers, removing the spills and cutting the softmax's vector memory instructions by 78.7%. On silicon the two together cut whole-kernel cycles by 1.84 to 2.08x at a head dimension of 64, raising floating-point utilization from 16.2% to 29.7% of peak. An FPGA of the same design ranks the changes identically and scores them higher, at 2.71x.

AI.tldr: 该作者将 PyTorch CPU FlashAttention 内核移植到 2KB 向量寄存器的 RISC-V CPU 上，通过转置得分瓦片与运行输出（使 query 沿连续轴、由瓦片内 query 数统一决定向量长度并消除两次归约），以及将 softmax 多项式系数移入标量寄存器（消除溢出、softmax 向量访存指令减少 78.7%），在 head 维度 64 下将整核周期降低 1.84–2.08 倍，浮点利用率由 16.2% 提升至 29.7%；同类 FPGA 上排序一致且加速达 2.71 倍。
AI.motivation: 注意力成本随序列长度平方增长，FlashAttention 的分块与在线 softmax 使其可控，但后续工作几乎都面向 GPU。长向量处理器单个向量寄存器可容纳最多 512 个单精度数，而向量指令的收益与寄存器利用率成正比，因此"向量化哪个循环"成为首要决策；现有 CPU FlashAttention 内核在该类机器上仅达 16.2% 峰值浮点吞吐，存在低效环节（逐 query 行处理、归约、系数与瓦片争用寄存器导致溢出）。
AI.method: 将 PyTorch CPU FlashAttention 内核移植到具 2KB 向量寄存器的 RISC-V CPU，并进行两项改造：(1) 转置得分瓦片与运行输出，使 query 位于连续轴，算法与数值不变，仅由"瓦片内 query 数"这一参数统一决定核内各部分的向量长度并可匹配机器，同时消除逐行最大值与求和两次归约；(2) 将软件指数多项式的系数迁入标量寄存器，消除寄存器溢出。
AI.result: 在真实芯片上，两项技术合计在 head 维度 64 时将整核周期降低 1.84–2.08 倍，浮点利用率从峰值 16.2% 提升至 29.7%；softmax 的向量访存指令减少 78.7%。同设计的 FPGA 上各改动排序一致且得分更高，达 2.71 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 在长向量 RISC-V 处理器上，循环向量化的选择顺序与寄存器压力管理是 FlashAttention 性能的一阶因素；转置以 query 为连续轴并参数化瓦片 query 数、以及将多项式系数置于标量寄存器，是以最小算法改动换取显著吞吐提升的有效手段。

title: SAIL: A Learnable Generalisation of Spatial Autocorrelation over Graph-Structured Data
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures (7 in main paper, 15 in supplementary material). Main paper followed by supplementary material in a single file
summary: In vision and scientific domains involving spatial data, a key question is whether node feature values vary independently across space or form coherent spatial structures. Classical spatial autocorrelation statistics such as Moran's $I$ and Geary's $C$ quantify this phenomenon but operate on a single scalar variable with fixed neighbourhood weights, limiting their use for high-dimensional graph-like data. We introduce SAIL (Spatial Autocorrelation Index Learner), a differentiable framework that generalises spatial autocorrelation into a learnable operator by jointly learning feature projections defining candidate scalar fields and inter-node neighbourhood affinities. SAIL produces interpretable local and global spatial coherence descriptors, enabling supervised prediction and unsupervised discovery of spatial autocorrelation modes and hotspots. We show that SAIL exactly recovers classical spatial statistics under appropriate parametrisations and, for tasks driven by latent spatial autocorrelation, can approximate the Bayes-optimal predictor with an inductive bias matched to such tasks. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale biomedical graphs demonstrate statistical correctness and discovery of spatial coherence with applications across vision, geospatial analysis, and biomedicine. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/pkeller00/SAIL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAIL（Spatial Autocorrelation Index Learner），一个可微框架，将空间自相关从固定单变量统计量泛化为可学习算子：联合学习定义候选标量场的特征投影与节点间邻域亲和度，输出可解释的局部/全局空间一致性描述子，支持有监督预测与无监督发现自相关模式与热点。
AI.motivation: 经典空间自相关统计量（Moran's I、Geary's C）只能作用于单一标量变量且邻接权重固定，难以处理高维、图状（graph-like）数据；因此需要一个可学习的、能刻画高维特征中空间结构的框架。
AI.method: 提出可微的SAIL：以学习得到的特征投影构造候选标量场，并同时学习节点间邻域亲和度（替代固定权重），将空间自相关表述为可端到端优化的算子；输出局部与全局空间一致性描述子，可同时用于有监督预测和无监督的自相关模式/热点发现。并给出了与经典统计量的参数化对应关系及针对潜在空间自相关任务的归纳偏置分析。
AI.result: 在合适参数化下SAIL能精确还原经典空间统计量；对由潜在空间自相关驱动的任务，其归纳偏置与任务相匹配，可逼近Bayes最优预测器。合成数据与大规模生物医学图实验验证了统计正确性与空间一致性发现能力，应用覆盖视觉、地理空间分析与生物医学。
AI.conclusion: SAIL将空间自相关推广为可学习的可微算子，兼顾可解释性与预测性能，在理论上与经典统计量一致并为相关任务提供匹配的归纳偏置，实证上在视觉、地理与生物医学等空间数据场景有效。

title: Beyond Task Relevance: Interaction-Aware Semantic Communication for Wireless Agent Collaboration
summary: Semantic communication in multi-agent systems often assumes that task-relevant information benefits the team once delivered. Yet semantic sharing can alter the receiver's decision and increase inter-agent dependence, potentially reducing team utility. Motivated by this phenomenon, we develop an interaction-aware framework for wireless collaboration between heterogeneous agents. We analytically relate communication-induced dependence to expected best-of-team utility and define a team-level semantic value for candidate messages. We consider semantic units at different abstraction levels and formulate a deadline- and power-constrained problem that maximizes predicted team-level net surplus. We derive an interaction-aware policy that selects at most one unit and its transmit power, or chooses not to transmit. Experiments on two verifier-scored optimization tasks show that full-solution exchange induces stronger structural convergence and more adverse team-level effects, whereas method hints exhibit pronounced directionality. Across the evaluated power budgets, our policy achieves the highest net team-level surplus while consuming less energy than semantic-aware and full-solution baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出交互感知的多智能体无线语义通信框架，以团队级净盈余最大化为目标，实现"选择性发送、必要时不发送"的语义单元与功率联合决策。
AI.motivation: 多智能体语义通信常隐含假设"任务相关信息一旦送达就对团队有利"，但语义共享会改变接收方决策、加深智能体间依赖，反而可能降低团队效用。
AI.method: 解析刻画通信诱发的依赖性与期望"团队最优"效用之间的关系，定义候选消息的团队级语义价值；考虑不同抽象层级的语义单元，构建带截止时间与功率约束的优化问题以最大化预测团队级净盈余；推导出交互感知策略，在至多选择一个语义单元及其发射功率与"不发送"之间决策。
AI.result: 在两个由验证器评分的优化任务上，完整解交换导致更强的结构性收敛并带来更不利的团队级影响，而方法提示呈现明显的方向性；在各功率预算下，所提策略取得最高团队级净盈余，且能耗低于语义感知与完整解基线。
AI.conclusion: 语义共享并非总是有益，需在交互依赖视角下对语义内容与传输功率进行联合、可放弃的决策；所提交互感知策略在提高团队净盈余的同时降低能耗，优于现有基线。

title: Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. I. Retarded integral equations and their local finite-difference solution
summary: We describe the propagation of a nonresonant light pulse normally incident on a thin dielectric slab using an integral-equation approach to electromagnetism. This emerges naturally from the microscopic picture of the material as made of polarizable atoms, confined within the material vacuum volume by their bonding interactions, each responding to the input radiation pulse as well as to the re-radiated pulses of the other atoms to which it is causally connected. The retarded integral equations are shown to be exactly equivalent to a local wave equation coupled to an auxiliary Lorentz-oscillator equation, which we solve numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme. For a slab thick enough that the front- and back-surface reflections are temporally separated, the front-surface reflectivity extracted from the simulation agrees with the Fresnel formula to within 1 percent, and the back-surface echo appears at exactly the expected round-trip delay. For a slab thinner than one optical cycle, the multiply-reflected wavelets overlap and interfere, and a full space-time map of the field directly visualizes the build-up of thin-film-like interference in the time domain. The material parameters used here are illustrative rather than fitted to measured data, and the numerical scheme is verified by an explicit grid-convergence study. In a companion paper (Paper II) the retarded integral equations are solved directly, without the local reformulation, and the two independent numerical solutions are shown to agree.

AI.tldr: 用积分方程方法描述非共振光脉冲入射薄介质板，证明推迟积分方程严格等价于局域波动方程加洛伦兹振子方程，并用FDTD数值求解，验证前表面反射率符合菲涅尔公式（误差1%内）、后表面回波延迟正确，并可视化了亚光学周期薄板的时域薄膜干涉建立过程。
AI.motivation: 从"材料由可极化原子组成、受束缚力限制在材料真空体积内、对输入脉冲及其他原子再辐射脉冲作出响应"的微观图像出发，建立光脉冲在薄介质板中传播的严格描述，避免传统宏观唯象处理，并检验局域近似在何种条件下成立。
AI.method: 构建电磁学的推迟积分方程表述；证明其与"局域波动方程+辅助洛伦兹振子方程"完全等价；采用时域有限差分（FDTD）方案数值求解；对足够厚板提取前表面反射率与菲涅尔公式比较；对薄于一个光学周期的板绘制全时空场图；进行显式网格收敛性验证；材料参数为示意性取值。
AI.result: 厚板情形：前表面反射率与菲涅尔公式吻合在1%以内，后表面回波出现在预期往返延迟处。亚光学周期薄板：多次反射子波重叠干涉，全时空场图直接显示类薄膜干涉在时域中的建立。数值方案经网格收敛性研究验证。
AI.conclusion: 推迟积分方程与局域波动方程+Lorentz振子表述严格等价，FDTD方案可靠且收敛，能正确复现菲涅尔反射与往返延迟，并能刻画超薄板中的时域干涉建立；伴随论文（Paper II）直接求解推迟积分方程而不经局域重构，两套独立数值解相互验证。

title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
summary: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).

AI.tldr: 提出Agent4Sci长周期测试平台，覆盖11个领域20个科学ML基准，评估前沿编码智能体在真实条件下对已发表最佳模型的改进能力；发现智能体提升主要来自ML工程技巧而非领域洞察，并通过轻量插件技能（研究构思、实验管理、定期清单）将Claude Opus与Codex的平均相对提升分别从10.4%/4.4%提高至20.1%/8.1%。
AI.motivation: 前沿编码智能体被定位为端到端自动化科研者，而科学机器学习（ML-for-science）是检验这一承诺的高难度场景：改进科学模型往往需要超越常规ML工程的领域洞察。现有评估多以排行榜排名为目标，缺乏对"智能体在真实条件下能取得何种进展、在何处不足"的长周期诊断性度量。
AI.method: 构建Agent4Sci长周期testbed，横跨11个领域、20个科学ML基准，衡量智能体相对已发表SOTA的平均相对改进，并加入学术不端检测。与传统排行榜不同，采用轨迹分析刻画智能体的行为模式与失败模式；同时设计研究构思（research ideation）、实验管理（experiment management）与定期检查清单（scheduled checklists）三类轻量即插即用技能作为干预手段。
AI.result: 前沿智能体在全部20个基准上均超越已发表SOTA，Claude Opus取得10.4%平均相对改进，且无运行被标记为学术不端；但这些收益几乎全部来自ML工程技巧的"组合拳"，而非研究级洞察。轨迹分析揭示三类反复出现的局限：新颖性错配（novelty miscalibration）、资源利用不足（resource under-utilization）、迅速坍缩为局部工程搜索（rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps）。加入轻量插件技能后，Claude Opus由10.4%提升至20.1%，Codex由4.4%提升至8.1%，并产生更多样、更具领域相关性的干预。
AI.conclusion: Agent4Sci为社区提供了追踪并推动前沿智能体从ML工程走向领域洞察的评测手段，适用于真实ML-for-science问题；代码与数据已开源（GitHub与Hugging Face）。其核心判断是：当前智能体的提升源于工程技巧而非科学洞察，需通过轻量技能干预弥补构思、管理与过程控制层面的短板。

title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
summary: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. To control peak GPU memory usage, we further slice each subdomain into smaller regions whose loss gradients are evaluated sequentially and accumulated to update the NN parameters. Unlike domain decomposition approaches, our partitioning naturally ensures field continuity across the subdomains and does not require the introduction of additional terms into the loss function. For validation, we first evaluate the proposed framework on various 2D stress-constrained benchmarks and compare our results to a conventional finite element-based approach, showing that SNTO produces super-resolution designs with sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions. We then consider large-scale 3D problems with up to eight million collocation points and distribute the training over up to eight GPUs.

AI.tldr: 提出同步神经拓扑优化（SNTO）框架，用神经网络表示状态、伴随和设计变量并在单一优化循环中联合优化，实现大规模应力约束拓扑优化的高效求解。
AI.motivation: 大规模拓扑优化（尤其含应力约束问题）计算代价高昂，传统有限元方法在扩展性与锐利边界/梯度捕捉方面存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 用定制神经网络分别表示状态、伴随与设计变量，参数在统一循环中借助连续伴随分析与自动微分联合优化；损失函数融合设计目标、局部应力约束聚合与势能泛函；设计专用网络结构加速收敛并捕捉锐利梯度与边界；采用硬件感知训练：将设计域划分子域并分布到多GPU，再将子域切片以顺序计算并累积梯度以控制显存；分区天然保证跨子域场连续性，无需额外损失项。
AI.result: 二维应力约束基准上相对传统有限元方法产生超分辨设计，边界更锐利、灰色区域更小、体积分数更低；3D大规模问题扩展至八百万配点，训练分布至多达8块GPU。
AI.conclusion: SNTO在精度、边界清晰度与可扩展性上优于传统有限元方法，为大规模应力约束拓扑优化提供可行方案。

title: A Parallel Multi-Dialect Arabic Dependency Treebank
summary: Dependency parsing resource development for Arabic has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving dialectal Arabic comparatively under-resourced. We introduce MADARTB, the first large-scale parallel dependency treebank spanning five city dialects: Beirut, Cairo, Doha, Rabat and Tunis, and extending an existing parallel MSA version. In total MADARTB consists of 5,000 sentences annotated using the CATiB dependency scheme. We analyze syntactic similarity across all city dialects and MSA. Although global construction profiles exhibit high similarity across varieties, local syntactic structures frequently diverge, revealing substantial structural variation across dialects. We further establish a cross-dialect dependency parsing comparison using a supervised parser and four LLMs. The supervised parser achieves 87.5% LAS, while the best LLM setup trails at 85.7% LAS across all six varieties on the test set. We release our annotations and models publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MADARTB，首个覆盖贝鲁特、开罗、多哈、拉巴特和突尼斯五种城市方言并扩展了现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）版本的大规模并行依存树库，共5,000句、采用CATiB依存标注体系；在句法相似性分析与跨方言依存分析对比中，监督式解析器取得87.5% LAS，优于最佳LLM配置的85.7% LAS。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语依存分析资源主要集中于现代标准阿拉伯语，方言阿拉伯语资源相对匮乏，缺乏跨城市方言的并行标注数据与系统性句法对比研究。
AI.method: 构建MADARTB并行依存树库，覆盖贝鲁特、开罗、多哈、拉巴特、突尼斯五种城市方言及MSA，共5,000句，采用CATiB依存标注方案；对各方言与MSA进行句法相似性分析（全局构式画像与局部句法结构）；并开展监督式解析器与四种LLM的跨方言依存分析对比实验。
AI.result: 全局构式画像在各方言间高度相似，但局部句法结构频繁分化，体现显著的跨方言结构变异；测试集上六种语言变体中监督式解析器达87.5% LAS，最佳LLM配置为85.7% LAS。
AI.conclusion: MADARTB填补了方言阿拉伯语并行依存分析资源的空白，揭示了方言间"全局相似、局部分化"的句法特征，并表明当前监督式解析器在跨方言依存分析上仍优于LLM；标注与模型已公开释放。

title: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 34th International Conference on Real-Time Networks and Systems (RTNS 2026)
summary:
We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.
  To enable runtime certification in heterogeneous precedence-constrained systems, we introduce a schedulability-preserving prefix replacement criterion based on machine-wise cuts. The proposed criterion guarantees that runtime-generated schedule prefixes preserve the existence of a feasible continuation without requiring complete finish-time dominance with respect to a feasible reference schedule.
  Experimental results on heterogeneous DNN accelerator platforms show that the proposed framework preserves HRT schedulability while improving QoS-aware deadline satisfaction, client-level service quality, and accelerator utilization compared to state-of-the-art scheduling approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出面向异构多加速器系统的调度框架，将在线强化学习调度器与确定性运行时安全层结合，并给出保持可调度性的前缀替换准则，在保证硬实时期限的同时提升软实时QoS。
AI.motivation: 异构多加速器系统需同时承载硬实时（HRT）与软实时QoS感知的DNN推理负载；学习型调度器性能好但缺乏确定性保证，难以独立保障HRT期限。
AI.method: RL调度器联合选择子任务优先级与加速器分配以在线生成候选调度；运行时认证层通过基于machine-wise cuts的schedulability-preserving prefix replacement准则，在运行中验证并替换调度前缀，仅需保证可行续解存在，而不要求相对参考可行调度的完成时间完全占优。
AI.result: 在异构DNN加速器平台上的实验表明，该框架在保持HRT可调度性的同时，相较SOTA调度方法提升了QoS-aware期限满足率、客户端级服务质量与加速器利用率。
AI.conclusion: 将学习型调度与确定性运行时认证分层结合，可在异构、带优先级约束的系统上实现HRT安全性与QoS性能的兼顾。

title: Register Anything Model for Generalizable and Robust Point Cloud Registration
