comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code and models are available at https://github.com/qinzheng93/RegisterAnything
summary: We present Register Anything Model (RAM), a unified model for generalizable 3D point cloud registration that robustly estimates 6-DoF transformations across diverse domains spanning sensors and environments. Existing registration methods are typically tailored to a single domain, with carefully tuned architectures and hyperparameters, and thus degrade markedly when applied to novel domains. We bridge this gap by training a single model on diverse data from indoor, outdoor, and object domains. A central challenge is the severe geometric discrepancy across domains, i.e., differences in scene scale, sensor noise, point density, and structural patterns, which hinders processing with a unified point-based model. To address this, we introduce a geometry-aware normalization strategy that jointly voxelizes and normalizes point clouds into a standardized geometric space, adaptively based on their geometric properties to preserve salient local structures while standardizing resolution. Built on this normalization, RAM follows a hierarchical coarse-to-fine paradigm, and employs an efficient geometric transformer that models local geometric consistency instead of globally over all points. This design mitigates discretization noise introduced by voxelization, and improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in terms of inlier ratio and registration recall. Notably, our method outperforms the counterparts trained on each separate domain, showing superior generalization capability.

AI.tldr: 提出统一模型 RAM，通过几何感知归一化与分层几何 Transformer，在室内/室外/物体多域数据上训练单一模型，实现跨域泛化的 3D 点云配准。
AI.motivation: 现有配准方法通常针对单一域定制网络结构与超参数，迁移到新域时性能显著下降；而直接用统一点云模型处理多域数据又受限于场景尺度、传感器噪声、点密度与结构模式等严重几何差异。
AI.method: 1) 几何感知归一化：联合体素化与归一化，依据点云几何属性自适应映射到标准化几何空间，在统一分辨率的同时保留显著局部结构；2) 分层由粗到细范式；3) 高效几何 Transformer，建模局部几何一致性而非全局所有点，以缓解体素化带来的离散化噪声并提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在 12 个基准上取得 inlier ratio 与 registration recall 的 SOTA；且优于在各单一域上分别训练的对比方法，展现更强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 单一统一模型可跨传感器与环境实现可泛化的 6-DoF 3D 配准，几何感知归一化是弥合跨域几何差异的关键。

title: Control-Field and Quasi-Cyclic Code Recovery in Starlink Downlink Signals
summary: Public descriptions of the Starlink downlink specify synchronization sequences, edge pilots, and predictable symbol templates, but leave the coded control fields and explicit payload-code representations largely unresolved. We examine one continuous complex-baseband capture spanning approximately 24 ms and recover control and coding structure beyond those predictable elements. Reference-phase removal exposes terminated rate-1/3 convolutional control blocks with constraint length seven and a group-level cyclic redundancy check. A conditional descriptor layout predicts sequential allocations through per-codeword symbol rounding, agreeing exactly with independently estimated endpoints in 16 of 18 frame records and within two symbols in the remaining records. Quasi-cyclic closure, binary elimination, and sparse dual checks yield explicit systematic code representations at rates 1/2 and 5/8. Frozen encoders predict 78,848, 9,984, and 811,008 reserved parity bits for three formats without disagreement. A rank-deficient long-code fit is completed within a declared finite structural family, and shared encoders are tested across modulation formats. The recovered representations explain observed coded symbols; they do not authenticate transmitter-standard identities or plaintext semantics. Two high-order formats have only one target field each, while codes 28 and 37 admit verified shortened cores with unexplained extra bits and code 4 remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 从一段约24 ms的Starlink下行连续复基带采集中，恢复出可预测同步序列之外的编码与控制结构：含约束长度7、码率1/3的删余卷积控制块与组级CRC，并给出速率1/2与5/8的显式系统码表示。
AI.motivation: 公开的Starlink下行描述仅涵盖同步序列、边缘导频与可预测符号模板，编码控制字段与显式载荷码表示仍基本未知，作者希望在这些可预测元素之外恢复控制与编码结构。
AI.method: 对单段约24 ms复基带捕获做参考相位去除；识别终止的码率1/3、约束长度7删余卷积控制块及组级CRC；用条件描述子布局按每码字符号取整预测顺序分配；再经准循环闭合、二元消元与稀疏对偶校验得到速率1/2与5/8的显式系统码；对冻结编码器统计预留奇偶比特数；在有限结构族内完成秩亏长码拟合并跨调制格式检验共享编码器。
AI.result: 描述子布局预测的端点与独立估计端点完全一致（18条帧记录中16条精确、其余误差不超过2个符号）；三种格式分别预测78,848、9,984与811,008个预留奇偶比特且无分歧；恢复的表示可解释观测到的编码符号。
AI.conclusion: 所恢复的编码表示能解释观测符号，但不用于认证发射机标准身份或明文语义；两种高阶格式各仅有一个目标字段，码28与码37仅验证了缩短核心且存在未解释的额外比特，码4仍未解析。

title: Quasi-Phase-Matched Second Harmonic Generation in Poling-Free Lithium Niobate Microrings with Surface Molecular Pattern
summary: Thin film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising integrated photonic platform owing to its large quadratic nonlinearity enabling vital applications such as second-harmonic generation (SHG), optical parametric amplification, and spontaneous parametric down-conversion. However, to achieve high SH conversion efficiency, quasi-phase matching (QPM) through periodic electrical poling is typically required, which remains challenging in certain applications like multiple-ring coupled devices. Here, we demonstrate a surface molecule patterning strategy to enable QPM in a poling-free TFLN microring for SHG. An on-chip normalized conversion efficiency of approximately 11.5%/W is obtained in the poling-free TFLN microring with surface molecular pattern, showing an approximate 400-fold improvement compared to the same microring without surface molecular pattern. This approach offers a versatile route to engineer interfacial nonlinear interactions for nonlinear optics and quantum photonics applications and may be extended to multiple-ring coupled resonators and other platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出表面分子图案化策略，在无需极化的TFLN微环中实现准相位匹配二次谐波产生，归一化转换效率约11.5%/W，较无图案微环提升约400倍。
AI.motivation: TFLN凭借强二阶非线性适用于SHG、光参量放大和自发参量下转换等应用，但高SH转换效率通常依赖周期电场极化实现准相位匹配（QPM），在多环耦合器件等场景中实施困难。
AI.method: 采用表面分子图案化（surface molecule patterning）在TFLN微环表面构筑周期分子图案，以界面非线性调控替代电场极化，实现免极化QPM。
AI.result: 在带表面分子图案的免极化TFLN微环中获得约11.5%/W的片上归一化转换效率，相比无分子图案的同结构微环提升约400倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为界面非线性相互作用的工程化调控提供了通用途径，适用于非线性光学与量子光子学，并有望推广至多环耦合谐振腔及其他平台。

title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
summary: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.

AI.tldr: 针对 agentic harness 演化中"任务池扩大反而性能下降"的悖论，提出 SSR 框架，通过自适应搜索最优证据组合并在小算力预算下竞速候选 harness，在三个基准的六个配置上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: Agentic harness 演化利用任务执行经验优化 agent 的指令、工具与控制流，直觉上更多演化任务应带来更好性能，但初步研究发现现有方法随任务池扩大而性能下降。进一步分析表明，退化源于优化过程中的次优证据选择：不同证据组合会导致显著不同的演化结果。
AI.method: 提出 Successive Scale Racing（SSR）框架，在每轮演化中自适应搜索最优证据组合。SSR 依据任务质量与覆盖度构建多样化的证据组合，并在较小计算预算下对生成的候选 harness 高效竞速（racing），以筛选出接近最优的候选。
AI.result: 在三个不同基准的全部六个配置上均达到 SOTA。任务池从 40 扩展到 200 时，SSR 的通过率从 64.3% 稳步提升至 68.3%，而基线方法性能均下降；其 racing 机制在减少 60% 验证执行次数的同时识别出近最优候选。
AI.conclusion: 任务池规模扩大带来的性能退化并非不可克服，关键在于证据组合的选取而非任务数量本身。SSR 通过质量与覆盖度驱动的证据组合构建与高效 racing，将更多任务转化为增益，并在显著降低验证开销的同时取得一致且可扩展的性能提升。

title: SimHack: Predicting the onset of detectable reward hacking before RL training
summary:
When training LLMs to code with reinforcement learning, reward hacking is often detectable but difficult to prevent, since (a) environment hardening is increasingly difficult as training environments grow more complex; and (b) training-time interventions incentivize models to obfuscate hacking behavior to bypass detection.
  We instead study whether we can predict when detectable reward hacking becomes dominant before executing an RL run, enabling us to select lower-risk recipes in advance. We find that the initial hacking rate alone does not determine onset, which varies substantially across training recipes and repeated runs. We thus formulate this problem as predicting the distribution of the reward hacking onset step under a target training recipe.
  We introduce SimHack, a simulator that learns reward hacking training dynamics from a handful of smaller-scale reference RL runs and generates counterfactual simulation runs of unseen target recipes without costly retraining. Across unseen target recipes, SimHack predicts the median onset to a relative error of 11.3% and achieves across-recipe rank correlation of 0.85, while generalizing to differences in model scale, curriculum, number of rollouts, and learning rate between reference and target recipes. As an application, we show that SimHack can guide training decisions by screening candidate RL curricula, discovering curricula over the same set of scenarios that train for 96.6% longer without hacking.

AI.tldr: 提出SimHack模拟器，用少量小规模参考RL运行的动力学预测未见目标配方下reward hacking的起始步分布，中位起始步相对误差11.3%、跨配方秩相关0.85，可用于训练前筛选低风险课程。
AI.motivation: 训练LLM写代码的RL中，reward hacking常可检测但难以阻止：(a) 环境日益复杂，环境加固愈发困难；(b) 训练期干预会激励模型混淆hacking行为以规避检测。因此希望事先预测可检测reward hacking何时占据主导，从而提前选择低风险配方。
AI.method: 发现初始hacking率单独不能决定起始点，onset在不同配方与重复运行间差异显著，于是将问题形式化为预测目标训练配方下reward hacking起始步的分布。提出SimHack：从少量较小规模参考RL运行中学习reward hacking的训练动力学，无需昂贵重训练即可对未见目标配方生成反事实模拟运行；可泛化到模型规模、课程、rollout数量和学习率差异。
AI.result: 在未见目标配方上，SimHack预测中位起始步的相对误差为11.3%，跨配方秩相关达0.85，并能泛化到参考与目标配方间模型规模、课程、rollout数、学习率的差异。
AI.conclusion: SimHack可作为训练前决策工具：筛选候选RL课程，在相同场景集合上找到使无hacking训练时长延长96.6%的课程。

title: How to Use Parallel Data for Multilingual Pretraining
summary: High-quality human-translated parallel corpora can improve cross-lingual transfer, but are typically too small for large-scale pretraining. Machine-translated web corpora help overcome this limitation, making parallel data available at pretraining scale. Standard multilingual pretraining, however, samples source documents and their translations independently, without explicitly using their parallel structure. We investigate how to use the parallel structure of the data to improve multilingual pretraining by concatenating each document with its translation in the same training sequence. We compare this parallel pretraining (PPT) approach with standard pretraining (SPT), training models from scratch at matched token budgets. Surprisingly, despite the benefits of parallel data reported in prior cross-lingual work, PPT alone does not consistently improve language understanding over SPT. Our further analysis suggests that although PPT builds a strong cross-lingual foundation, as shown by its better use of shared information across languages, the mismatch between parallel training contexts and single-language task inputs limits its gains in general language understanding. This finding motivates a two-stage approach following the pretraining-fine-tuning paradigm: we first use PPT to build a cross-lingual foundation, then continue with SPT to adapt it to standard language modeling. In both high-resource and low-resource settings, the two-stage approach consistently improves general language understanding and cross-lingual task performance over standard pretraining alone at matched training budgets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并行预训练（PPT），将文档与译文拼接在同一训练序列中，但发现单独的PPT并不稳定优于标准预训练（SPT）；据此提出先用PPT构建跨语言基础、再用SPT适配的两阶段方案，在等预算下稳定提升通用语言理解与跨语言任务表现。
AI.motivation: 高质量人工平行语料规模过小、不足以支撑大规模预训练，机器翻译网络语料虽能扩展到预训练规模，但标准多语言预训练独立采样源文档与译文，未显式利用平行结构。作者希望验证显式利用平行结构能否提升多语言预训练效果。
AI.method: 提出并行预训练（PPT）：将每篇文档与其译文拼接为同一训练序列，与标准预训练（SPT）对比，从零训练并在相同token预算下匹配。分析显示PPT虽建立了较强跨语言基础，但并行训练上下文与单语任务输入的失配限制了其在通用语言理解上的收益。因此采用预训练—微调范式的两阶段方法：先PPT构建跨语言基础，后接SPT适配标准语言建模。
AI.result: 与先前跨语言工作报告的收益相反，单独使用PPT并未稳定地优于SPT。进一步分析表明PPT能更好地跨语言利用共享信息，形成较强跨语言基础，但由于训练上下文与任务输入失配，其在通用语言理解上的增益受限。在高资源与低资源设定下，两阶段方法在同等训练预算下均持续优于仅用标准预训练。
AI.conclusion: 平行数据的价值不在于直接作为预训练目标，而在于作为阶段性手段：PPT适合建立跨语言基础，SPT适合适配单语任务分布，二者串联的两阶段预训练是显式利用平行结构、兼顾跨语言能力与通用语言理解的更优策略。

title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
summary:
Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts.
  To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出HAWK，一种面向GPU-NPU异构LLM推理的KV cache跨设备传输机制，通过张量布局感知的RDMA缓冲实现快速迁移。
AI.motivation: LLM推理的prefill阶段计算密集、decode阶段访存密集，GPU擅长prefill而decode下利用率不足，NPU在decode阶段更高效；因此考虑GPU-NPU异构架构，prefill映射到GPU、decode映射到NPU。但异构集成需将KV cache从GPU传至NPU，受通信机制差异和KV cache张量布局不一致所困扰。
AI.method: HAWK建立RDMA路径实现跨设备直接传输，并在传输过程中处理设备间张量布局差异。具体地，在NPU侧分配与目标张量布局匹配的布局感知RDMA缓冲，将数据从GPU侧常规连续RDMA缓冲编排传输至对应NPU缓冲，使传输后的张量可直接被消费而无需额外数据重排，同时保持传输效率。
AI.result: 在商用GPU与NPU构建的系统上实现并评测：在相同SLO约束下性能与纯GPU系统差距在7.88%以内，同时实现最高1.26倍的能效和1.72倍的成本效率提升。
AI.conclusion: GPU与NPU异构集成结合阶段解耦可在近纯GPU性能下显著提升能效与成本效率，而布局感知的RDMA传输是使该架构可行的关键。

title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
summary: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.

AI.tldr: WorldStream 是一个开放式 3D 世界模型，可无限扩展可游玩地形、响应开放式语言指令，并能恢复带编辑的已访问区域。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 世界生成模型难以兼顾无限扩展、跨块一致性与可交互编辑，需要在有限预算下构建既连通又可操作的世界。
AI.method: 采用分层规划器：Macro 在类型化决策模型上确定定居点、生态、交通与水文结构，Micro 在实测地形与已接受邻域承诺下将契约细化为瓦片语义；确定性局部代码将已接受计划编译为地形、道路、定居点、植被与实体。流式机制将规划沿预测走廊前置、仅在即将需要处编译、释放身后几何；单一世界记录保存计划、种子、对象身份、可变状态、边界承诺与属性化编辑，并随用户推进修订，返回瓦片由其重新编译。
AI.result: 世界在有限预算下持续扩张，独立规划的瓦片间保持连通，同时支持对现有实体（含状态型 NPC）的操作、当前区域编辑以及对未规划区域附加意图。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层规划、确定性编译与持久世界记录的统一，WorldStream 实现了可扩展、连贯且可交互的开放式 3D 世界建模。

title: Data-Driven Localization of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators from Time Signals
summary: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently introduced sensor technology for tracking and sensing applications that enables effective miniaturization down to the millimeter regime. However, estimating sensor parameters such as position from raw signals remains computationally challenging, because it requires solving a nonlinear inverse problem with computationally demanding objective function evaluations. In this work, we show how a deep learning method can accelerate this process by directly learning the inverse mapping from the measured signals. We consider the localization problem as an example and show that a convolutional-transformer regressor trained on simulated data with recorded noise can generalize to experimental data. The method achieves a median Euclidean distance error of 7 mm, which is comparable to the size of the sensor and corresponds to 6% of the size of a single coil. These results suggest that deep learning is a promising approach for rapid estimation of MMR parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出用卷积-Transformer回归器直接学习MMR信号到位置的逆映射，加速磁机械谐振器参数估计，实验数据中位误差7 mm。
AI.motivation: MMR可小型化至毫米级，但从原始信号估计位置需解非线性逆问题且目标函数评估代价高，计算困难。
AI.method: 以定位问题为例，用深度学习方法直接从测量信号学习逆映射；采用卷积-Transformer回归器，在含实测噪声的仿真数据上训练，再迁移到实验数据。
AI.result: 方法可泛化到实验数据，中位欧氏距离误差为7 mm，约等于传感器尺寸，相当于单线圈尺寸的6%。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习是快速估计MMR参数的有效途径。

title: Extending AMIRAL's blind deconvolution of Adaptive Optics corrected images with Markov chain Monte Carlo methods
summary: Adaptive optics (AO) corrected image restoration is particularly difficult, as it suffers from the lack of knowledge on the point spread function (PSF) in addition to usual difficulties. An efficient approach is to marginalize the object out of the problem and to estimate the PSF and (object and noise) hyperparameters only, before deconvolving the object using these estimates. Recent works have applied this marginal blind deconvolution method, combined to a parametric model of the PSF, to a series of AO corrected astronomical and satellite images. In this communication, we propose a new restoration method, which consists in choosing the Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) estimator and computing the latter thanks to a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm. We validate our method by means of realistic simulations, in two very different contexts: an astronomical observation on VLT/SPHERE and a ground-based LEO satellite observation on a 1.52m telescope. Finally, we present results on experimental images for both applications.

AI.tldr: 针对自适应光学(AO)校正图像的复原难题，提出以MMSE为估计准则、用MCMC算法计算的边缘化盲反卷积方法，并在VLT/SPHERE天文观测与1.52m望远镜对地静止轨道卫星观测两个场景中验证。
AI.motivation: AO校正图像复原除常规困难外，还缺乏点扩散函数(PSF)先验知识。此前的边缘化盲反卷积结合参数化PSF模型的方法虽已应用，但需要新的估计准则与求解手段以提升复原质量。
AI.method: 将目标从问题中边缘化，仅估计PSF与(目标、噪声)超参数，再据此对目标反卷积；选用最小均方误差(MMSE)估计器，并用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛(MCMC)算法计算该估计量；所用PSF为参数化模型。
AI.result: 通过两个差异很大的场景的真实感仿真验证了方法有效性：VLT/SPHERE天文观测，以及1.52m望远镜的地基LEO卫星观测；并给出了两类应用实验图像上的复原结果。
AI.conclusion: MMSE+MCMC的边缘化盲反卷积是一种有效且适用于AO校正天文与卫星图像复原的方案，仿真与实测图像均支持其可行性。

title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
summary: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer. Jev may enable efficient clinical AI evaluation at scale.

AI.tldr: 该文比较专用决策语言模型 Jev 与前沿/开源 LLM 评判器在四个临床 AI 评估场景中的一致性、成本与延迟，发现 Jev 的一致性可与多数 LLM 评判器持平或更优，且成本低 73–294 倍、耗时短 7–57 倍。
AI.motivation: 临床 AI 输出的自动化评判是必要的，但大规模使用 LLM 作为评判器成本高、速度慢，因此需要一种高效且可靠的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出并评估 Jev——一种返回结构化判断的决策语言模型，在四个用例中与前沿及开源权重 LLM 评判器进行对照：118 条儿科回答的医生序数质量评分、HealthBench 医生标注的二元标准、MedHELM 开放式任务、HealthBench Professional；同时比较成本与延迟。
AI.result: 儿科普序评分上 Jev 的 Gwet's AC2 为 0.50（期望分 0.53），匹配或超过 12 个 LLM 评判器中的 7 个（含 Claude Opus 5.5 的 0.49、GPT-6 的 0.38）；HealthBench 二元标准上匹配或超过 6 个中的 4 个；MedHELM 上与三 LLM 陪审团的一致性接近或超过陪审团内部一致性；HealthBench Professional 上与参考评判器 GPT-5.4 在 91% 标准上一致（其他评判器 91–93%）。前沿评判器成本为 Jev 的 73–294 倍，耗时 7–57 倍。
AI.conclusion: Jev 在多项临床评估任务中达到与 LLM 评判器相当或更优的一致性，同时显著降低成本与延迟，有望支撑大规模临床 AI 的高效评估。

title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
summary: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at $4\times10^9$ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio $I(t)/I_0$ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBERTa. In our proposed method, training data are produced by an automated PENELOPE/penEasy pipeline using the radiation source at 30, 80, 100, and 120 kV tube voltages over polyethylene-based shielding composite slabs of thicknesses spanning 0.15-2.5 mm. After preprocessing, the dataset contains $n = 4697$ simulated configurations on which a leakage-free, jointly stratified 10-fold cross-validation is performed, attaining mean squared error MSE = $(1.12 \pm 0.56)\times10^{-4}$, normalized-MSE percentage NMSE% = 0.0294% $\pm$ 0.0147%, and $R^2 = 0.9988$. The corresponding per-sample percentage errors give an alpha-trimmed ($α= 0.10$) absolute percentage error (APE) of 1.66% and a median APE of 1.15%. Our model's inference is several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying Monte Carlo simulation (sub-millisecond per query vs. several hours for the reference run) with effective accuracy in predicting $I(t)/I_0$.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Set Transformer与ChemBERTa的代理模型，将聚合物复合屏蔽材料的组分多集、质量分数及体描述符直接映射到X射线透射比，推理仅需1–3毫秒且R²=0.9988。
AI.motivation: 蒙特卡洛输运模拟虽精确但计算昂贵（单次仿真上限4×10⁹光子历史、20000秒时限），闭式解析方法又难以刻画复杂复合材料的辐射屏蔽场景，故需高效且准确的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建Permutation-invariant的Set Transformer，对组分无序多集建模，单个组分用化学预训练的Transformer语言模型ChemBERTa嵌入，并拼接四个体物性描述符；支持固定长度填充、最多11种组分。数据由自动化PENELOPE/penEasy流程生成：管电压30/80/100/120 kV，聚乙烯基屏蔽复合板厚0.15–2.5 mm。预处理后得n=4697配置，采用无泄漏、联合分层10折交叉验证。
AI.result: MSE=(1.12±0.56)×10⁻⁴，NMSE%=0.0294%±0.0147%，R²=0.9988；α-trimmed（α=0.10）绝对百分比误差APE=1.66%，中位APE=1.15%；单次推理1–3毫秒（部分查询亚毫秒），较参考蒙特卡洛仿真快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该代理模型在保持高精度的同时将透射比预测的计算成本从数小时降至毫秒级，为聚合物复合材料辐射屏蔽的快速评估与设计筛选提供了可行途径。

title: KIRA: A Full-Stack Reading Screening System with Dual-Pathway Analysis for Children
comment: Accepted to IEEE Spoken Language Technology 2026
summary: Early-grade reading screening is critical for identifying children at risk of reading difficulty. Existing AI-based screeners are often limited in the scope of their analyses and evaluation metrics, or are proprietary systems that lack transparent model specifications and evaluation. We present KIRA, a dual-pathway screening system that pairs word-level fluency scoring with detailed phoneme-level error detection. We adapt pretrained word and phoneme recognizers to children's speech, reducing word error rate from 13.88% to 8.84% and phoneme error rate from 41.66% to 23.00%. Powered by these child-adapted models, we implement Word Reading (WRE) and Oral Reading Fluency (ORF), two foundational tasks in K-2 screening. The system integrates these recognizers with a web-based teacher-facing interface presenting fluency scores alongside phoneme feedback for potential targeted intervention. KIRA brings modern child-speech recognition into a full-stack, deployable, classroom-ready reading screener.

AI.tldr: 提出KIRA——一个双通路早期阅读筛查系统，将词级流利度评分与音素级错误检测结合，通过儿童语音适配的识别模型实现可部署的课堂筛查工具。
AI.motivation: 早期阅读筛查对识别阅读困难风险儿童至关重要，但现有AI筛查器分析范围与评估指标受限，或为缺乏透明模型规格与评估的专有系统。
AI.method: 构建双通路筛查系统KIRA：将预训练的词识别器与音素识别器适配到儿童语音；基于适配模型实现Word Reading (WRE)与Oral Reading Fluency (ORF)两项K-2基础任务；集成至面向教师的网页界面，呈现流利度分数与音素反馈。
AI.result: 词错误率由13.88%降至8.84%，音素错误率由41.66%降至23.00%；系统整合识别器与教师界面，提供可定位干预的音素级反馈。
AI.conclusion: KIRA将现代儿童语音识别引入全栈、可部署、面向课堂的阅读筛查器。

title: HorizonComposer: Spatiotemporally Consistent Driving Video Editing with Enriched Traffic Semantics
summary: Instruction-guided video generative models offer a scalable solution for stress-testing autonomous driving systems by simulating diverse environmental conditions. However, driving scenes operate within a dense Operational Design Domain (ODD) governed by strict traffic semantics. When applied to global driving-condition edits, general-purpose instruction-guided video editors frequently corrupt these semantics, leading to structural hallucinations and ``temporal shock.'' This work distills and protects traffic semantics during video editing at three levels. First, we construct a hybrid dataset by combining temporally aligned real-world videos with synthetic edits, balancing foundational scene structure with unambiguous appearance signals. Second, during training, we adapt advantage conditioning from offline reinforcement learning to align the model using dense rewards. We extract dense, pixel-level rewards from the hybrid data to serve as a localized signal and actively steer generation toward structurally reliable pixels. Finally, our model mitigates temporal shock by introducing thinking frames, a transition mechanism that seamlessly reconciles static image conditioning with dynamic video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method prevents the corruption of multi-actor dynamics, establishing state-of-the-art spatiotemporal consistency, yielding consistent user preference (39% relative improvement in content preservation and 12% in temporal consistency), and achieving a significant 5% gain in downstream road line segmentation and 7% gain in downstream multi-object detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在指令引导视频编辑中分三层蒸馏与保护交通语义的自动驾驶场景生成方法，通过混合数据集、密集像素级奖励对齐与“思考帧”过渡机制，显著提升时空一致性与下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶场景处于受严格交通语义约束的稠密ODD（运行设计域）中，而通用指令引导视频编辑器在进行全局驾驶条件编辑时易破坏语义，产生结构幻觉与“时间冲击”（temporal shock），难以满足仿真压力测试对语义可靠性的要求。
AI.method: 三个层面保护交通语义：(1) 数据层面，构建时间对齐的真实视频与合成编辑相结合的混合数据集，兼顾基础场景结构与明确外观信号；(2) 训练层面，将离线强化学习中的优势条件（advantage conditioning）迁移至生成模型，从混合数据中提取密集像素级奖励作为局部信号，主动将生成导向结构可靠的像素；(3) 时序层面，引入“思考帧”（thinking frames）过渡机制，平滑衔接静态图像条件与动态视频上下文，缓解时间冲击。
AI.result: 实验表明方法可防止多智能体动态被破坏，实现当前最优的时空一致性；用户偏好一致提升，内容保持相对提升39%、时间一致性相对提升12%；下游道路线分割提升5%、多目标检测提升7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在数据、训练奖励与时序过渡三个层面显式蒸馏并保护交通语义，可有效抑制指令引导视频编辑中的结构幻觉与时间冲击，使生成视频在语义可靠性、时空一致性及下游感知任务上均取得显著提升，为自动驾驶系统的可扩展压力测试提供可行方案。

title: Over-the-Air Computation with Power Amplifier Nonlinearity
summary: Over-the-air computation (AirComp) enables efficient wireless data aggregation by exploiting the superposition of signals transmitted by multiple source nodes, but its performance is sensitive to hardware impairments such as power amplifier (PA) nonlinearity. In this paper, we develop an analytical framework for coherent AirComp with PA nonlinearities and derive a closed-form expression for the receiver mean-squared error (MSE) under a memoryless polynomial PA model. Our numerical results show that power control optimized under the conventional linear-PA assumption can exhibit rapidly increasing MSE as the transmit power budget increases, whereas incorporating PA nonlinearity into the power control design prevents this degradation and maintains low MSE over the considered power range.

AI.tldr: 该文针对存在功放（PA）非线性的相干AirComp，基于无记忆多项式PA模型推导了接收端MSE的闭式表达式，并指出按线性PA假设设计的功率控制在发射功率预算增大时MSE急剧上升，而将PA非线性纳入功率控制设计可避免该退化。
AI.motivation: AirComp依赖多源节点信号的叠加实现高效无线数据聚合，但其性能对功放非线性等硬件损伤高度敏感，而现有功率控制设计通常基于线性PA假设，可能在高功率区间失效。
AI.method: 建立相干AirComp在PA非线性下的分析框架，采用无记忆多项式PA模型，推导接收端均方误差（MSE）的闭式表达式，并据此进行考虑PA非线性的功率控制设计，与线性PA假设下的功率控制进行对比。
AI.result: 数值结果表明：基于线性PA假设优化的功率控制在发射功率预算增大时MSE迅速上升；而将PA非线性纳入功率控制设计可防止该性能退化，在考察的功率范围内保持较低MSE。
AI.conclusion: PA非线性是AirComp功率控制设计中不可忽略的因素，显式建模PA非线性对维持高发射功率下的聚合精度至关重要。

title: Synchronization-Induced Limit Cycles and Hysteresis in Spinor Exciton-Polaritons
summary: We study the nonlinear dynamics of spinor exciton-polaritons in resonantly pumped microcavities. Using steady-state analysis and computing eigenfrequencies via Bogoliubov-like linearization, we show that multiple Hopf bifurcations beyond conventional bistability occur within specific power regimes and are not associated with stable solutions of the system. Owing to nonlinear excitonic interactions, these transitions occur at different pump powers during forward and backward pump sweeps, leading to pronounced hysteresis between fixed-point and limit-cycle states. In the spinor regime, multiple limit-cycle branches and associated dynamical hysteresis loops emerge due to the interplay of polarization coupling and spin-dependent nonlinearities. We show how the locations of the bifurcation points can be tuned by the pump frequency and other system parameters. Our results identify synchronization as the organizing principle underlying limit-cycle formation, dynamical hysteresis, and bifurcation cascades in driven spinor exciton-polariton microcavities.

AI.tldr: 研究共振泵浦微腔中旋量激子极化激元的非线性动力学，揭示常规双稳之外的多重Hopf分岔、极限环分支与动力学迟滞，并以同步作为统一组织原理。
AI.motivation: 以往对激子极化激元微腔的研究多聚焦于稳态双稳与固定点行为，对超出双稳的动力学分岔、极限环形成及其在正反向泵浦扫描下的迟滞缺乏系统刻画，尤其缺少对旋量（偏振）自由度如何调控这些动力学过程的理解。
AI.method: 采用稳态分析并结合Bogoliubov类线性化计算本征频率，判定系统稳定性与Hopf分岔；对比正向与反向泵浦扫描以揭示动力学迟滞；在旋量情形下引入偏振耦合与自旋依赖非线性，分析多重极限环分支；并考察泵浦频率及其他系统参数对分岔点位置的调控。
AI.result: 在特定功率区间内出现超出常规双稳的多重Hopf分岔，且这些分岔不与系统稳定解相关联；由于非线性激子相互作用，正反向扫描时分岔在不同泵浦功率处发生，导致固定点态与极限环态之间显著的迟滞；旋量情形下，偏振耦合与自旋依赖非线性共同作用产生多重极限环分支及相应的动力学迟滞环；分岔点位置可经由泵浦频率等参数调节。
AI.conclusion: 同步（synchronization）是驱动旋量激子极化激元微腔中极限环形成、动力学迟滞与分岔级联的统一组织原理，为理解并调控此类驱动非线性系统的动力学行为提供了框架。

title: Sketch2Sim: an end-to-end modular framework for hand-drawn circuit analysis
summary: This study proposes a sketch-to-simulation system to solve handwritten circuit diagrams. The system converts raw images into a Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis (SPICE)-compatible netlist and automatically calculates the circuit's nodal voltages and currents. Another objective is to propose a holistic framework that benefits students and educators by enhancing the teaching and learning experience of electric circuits and expediting engineering design reviews. This article presents a multistage pipeline that converts raw photographs of handwritten electric circuits into executable SPICE-like netlists, providing a solution. A dataset of 1,000 hand-drawn Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor (RLC) circuits was curated and annotated for components, text regions, and character recognition. The proposed system decomposes a circuit diagram into three stages: (i) dual You Only Look Once (YOLO)-based detectors for components and text regions, (ii) a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-based domain-aware symbol value extraction, and (iii) image processing with thresholding, skeletonization, and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to automatically identify nodes and map them with corresponding components. The proposed system produces the netlist and solves the circuit. The qualitative and quantitative ablation studies on modular stages, as well as end-to-end tests, demonstrate robust performance across various handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and clutter.This study serves as an interactive learning aid and practical tool for professionals, providing a comprehensive user interface (UI), enabling rapid digitization of circuit sketches for study, design, prototyping, or troubleshooting.

AI.tldr: 提出手绘电路图到SPICE仿真的多阶段系统：YOLO检测元件/文本、CRNN+CTC识别元件值、阈值化/骨架化/DBSCAN提取节点，自动生成网表并求解节点电压电流。
AI.motivation: 手绘电路图无法直接仿真，需人工重绘录入，耗时且易错；教学与工程评审场景缺乏快速数字化工具。
AI.method: 构建1000张手绘RLC电路数据集并标注元件、文本区域与字符；三阶段流水线：(i)双YOLO检测器分别检测元件与文本区域；(ii)CRNN+CTC结合OCR的域感知符号值提取；(iii)阈值化、骨架化与DBSCAN聚类识别节点并与元件映射，生成SPICE兼容网表并求解。
AI.result: 模块级定性与定量消融实验及端到端测试显示，在多种书写风格、光照条件与背景杂乱情形下性能稳健。
AI.conclusion: 系统可作为交互式学习辅助与工程实用工具，配套完整UI实现草图快速数字化，服务于学习、设计、原型验证与排障。

title: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
summary: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 embeddings by 2.8 points. Correct & Smooth is within 3 points of the reference or better on 15 of 24 tasks, but the reference is significantly higher on 12 of 22 testable tasks, so several reported gains remain substantial. Reading released code next to the papers, we also document evaluation risks: selection of hyperparameters or checkpoints on the test set, labels of test-pool nodes used in training, baseline numbers reused without disclosure, and a text-label misalignment in a released Cora loader. Reports of the same method on the same split also differ by up to 12.5 points across papers whose configurations are not documented to match.

AI.tldr: 在三个近期研究的数据划分上，用仅在验证集上选参的四个廉价基线（如TF-IDF上的Correct & Smooth、冻结e5-large-v2嵌入上的MLP）与各论文报告的最佳LLM方法均值对比：C&S中位落后2.3个百分点，MLP落后2.8；C&S在24个任务中15个差距≤3点，但参照在22个可检验任务中12个显著更高，若干增益仍成立；同时发现测试集选参/选检查点、训练使用测试池节点标签、基线数字未披露复用、Cora加载器文本-标签错位等评测风险，同一方法同一划分的跨论文结果最多相差12.5点。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的文本属性图（TAG）节点分类方法普遍宣称达到SOTA，但缺少在相同数据划分上与廉价基线的严格对照，且已发布代码中可能存在评测隐患，需要量化这些声明的真实增益并揭示评测风险。
AI.method: 在三个近期研究的原始划分上，复现四个代表性基线（含TF-IDF上的Correct & Smooth、冻结e5-large-v2嵌入上的MLP），超参与检查点仅用验证集选择，再与各论文在匹配设定下报告的LLM方法最高均值比较；同时逐行审阅已发布代码以识别评测问题。
AI.result: C&S on TF-IDF 中位落后2.3个百分点，MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 落后2.8个百分点；C&S在24个任务中15个差距≤3点，但在22个可检验任务中12个参照显著更高，说明部分报告增益仍然可观。发现的风险包括：测试集上选择超参或检查点、训练中使用测试池节点标签、未披露地复用基线数字、发布版Cora加载器存在文本-标签错位。同一方法同一划分的跨论文报告差异最高达12.5个百分点，且配置无法确认一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM方法的报告增益相对廉价调优基线并非普遍显著，部分任务上差距在噪声量级；领域需统一划分与大模型无关的基线协议，披露基线与调参来源，修正数据加载与标签泄漏问题，并在匹配配置下报告结果以保证可比性。

title: SANE: Automated Scorer-Specific Metamorphic Testing for LLM Judges
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. A shorter version was accepted for presentation at the non-archival NeurIPS 2026 TAE workshop
summary: LLM judges increasingly mediate benchmark evaluation, model selection, data curation, and training. Their decisions are useful only when each judge responds reliably to changes affecting its scoring criterion. Existing methods for reliability testing perturb inputs with known expected effects on judge scores. Prominent LLM-judge testing harnesses combine human-authored perturbation recipes with synthetic test generation, leaving scorer-specific recipe ideation outside the automated pipeline. This limits their use to fixed perturbations and pre-assumed scorer types. We introduce SANE, an agent-based framework that encodes behavioral requirements for stochastic evaluators as reusable agent instructions. Given a scorer specification, implementation, and representative inputs, the pipeline first identifies scorer-specific capabilities, then automatically derives perturbation recipes and expected score relations for each. SANE also defines a scorer-independent validation framework for generated judge tests. It determines whether each recipe agrees with scorer intent and whether each instantiated case realizes the recipe and supports its expected relation. Because SANE generates a recipe inventory tailored to each scorer, the number of aligned recipes grows as scorers are added. Across five domains, SANE produces 3.7 times as many validated test families as the Judge Reliability Harness (JRH) at comparable end-to-end validity and detects scorer deficiencies in every domain, including professionalism and toxicity, where JRH detects none. On faithfulness, SANE achieves strong human alignment in judge ranking: its test-suite scores rank 11 judge models consistently with human-labeled FaithBench performance (Spearman rho = 0.852), while JRH does not (rho = 0.100).

AI.tldr: SANE: 一个智能体框架，将随机评估器的行为需求编码为可复用指令，自动为每个评分器推导定制化的扰动配方与期望分数关系，并配以与评分器无关的测试验证框架。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评审可靠性测试依赖人工编写的扰动配方加合成测试生成，配方构思未自动化，导致只能用于固定扰动与预设评分器类型，难以扩展到多样化的评分器。
AI.method: SANE 流水线输入评分器规范、实现与代表性输入，先识别该评分器特有的能力，再自动推导对应的扰动配方及其期望分数关系；同时定义评分器无关的验证框架，判定每个配方是否符合评分器意图、每个实例化用例是否实现该配方并支持其期望关系。
AI.result: 在五个领域上，SANE 生成的通过验证的测试族数量为 JRH 的 3.7 倍，端到端有效性相当；在全部领域均检出评分器缺陷，包括 JRH 未能检出的 professionalism 与 toxicity。忠实性方面，SANE 测试套件对 11 个评审模型的排序与人工标注的 FaithBench 表现一致（Spearman rho = 0.852），而 JRH 仅为 0.100。
AI.conclusion: 将评分器特定的测试设计自动化为可复用的智能体指令，可显著提升测试覆盖与缺陷检出能力，并在评审器排序上与人类判断高度对齐，且随评分器增多配方库可累积扩展。

title: Conditional Imaging for Privacy-Preserving Visual Sensing
summary: Conventional visual sensing faces a fundamental dilemma: information that should remain private today may need to be recovered tomorrow. This challenge is becoming increasingly important as cameras become pervasive in our daily surroundings. Existing safeguards either protect visual content only after an image is formed or suppress information during capture in ways that prevent its later recovery. Here, we show through an information-theoretic analysis that privacy and recoverability cannot be achieved simultaneously in static optical systems. Information preserved in a measurement for later reconstruction also remains available to an observer of that measurement, limiting the privacy such systems can provide. To overcome this limitation, we introduce conditional imaging, an imaging approach that changes the optical state for every captured frame. The measurement alone conceals the scene, while knowledge of the corresponding physical system state enables its reconstruction. We analyze how the optical parameters determine the information that can be recovered and use this analysis to guide the design of a camera prototype. We evaluate the system on a captured dataset of human faces using increasingly powerful attempts to recover the scene, from direct visualization and computational inversion to learned reconstruction and identity recognition. Our experiments show that conditional imaging preserves identity in authorized reconstructions while withholding visual information from observers without access to the system state. By making the physical state of the camera part of the information needed for reconstruction, conditional imaging enables visual information to be protected at the point of capture while remaining recoverable for future authorized use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"条件成像"(conditional imaging)：通过信息论分析证明静态光学系统无法同时实现隐私与可恢复性，进而设计每帧改变光学状态的相机原型，使单张测量本身隐藏场景、唯有知晓对应物理状态才能重建，实验证明授权重建可保持身份信息、未授权观察者无法恢复视觉内容。
AI.motivation: 相机日益普及，视觉数据存在"当下应保密、未来可能需恢复"的根本矛盾。现有方案要么只在成像后保护内容，要么在采集时抑制信息导致无法后期恢复，二者不可兼得，因此需要新的成像范式在采集端保护信息且保留可恢复性。
AI.method: 1) 用信息论分析说明：静态光学系统中，为重建而保留的信息同样对测量观察者可用，故隐私与可恢复性不可同时达成；2) 提出条件成像——每采集一帧即改变光学状态，测量需结合对应物理状态方能重建；3) 分析光学参数如何决定可恢复信息量，并据此指导相机原型设计；4) 在自采人脸数据集上评估，攻击手段涵盖直接可视化、计算反演、学习式重建与身份识别，逐级增强。
AI.result: 实验表明条件成像在授权重建中保持身份信息，而对无系统状态访问权的观察者，各类恢复尝试（含最强学习式重建与身份识别）均无法获取视觉信息，测量本身有效隐藏场景。
AI.conclusion: 将相机的物理状态纳入重建所需信息，使视觉信息在采集点即得到保护，同时保留未来授权恢复的可能，为隐私与可恢复性的兼顾提供了可行范式。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning Assistance for Resilient Haptic Teleoperation over a 5G Network
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Haptic teleoperation requires low-latency and reliable communication to preserve stable and responsive interaction between a human operator and a remote environment. However, network congestion can strongly degrade teleoperation performance, particularly when haptic traffic competes with other data flows for limited radio resources. This work investigates a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-assisted teleoperation framework over an Ericsson 5G standalone (SA) testbed under different congestion and quality-of-service (QoS) configurations. In the evaluated task, a human operator uses a haptic device to steer a spaceship through a remote virtual game. The DRL agent runs inside the remote environment, hosted at the network edge, and assists the operator by blending its own actions with the operator's commands received over the 5G network. This placement gives the agent direct access to the current state of the environment, unaffected by network delay. Experimental results show that DRL assistance improves task performance under all network conditions, with the largest benefit under congestion, where it reduces mean task completion time by 20.6%. Under congestion, assisted operation even outperforms unassisted operation with QoS prioritisation, which restores latency close to the uncongested baseline.

AI.tldr: 该文在爱立信5G SA测试床上验证：位于网络边缘的DRL智能体通过融合操作者指令可提升触觉遥操作性能，拥塞条件下平均任务完成时间降低20.6%，且优于使用QoS优先级的无辅助方案。
AI.motivation: 触觉遥操作需要低时延、可靠通信以维持人-远端环境间稳定且响应及时的交互；网络拥塞下触觉流量与其他数据流竞争有限无线资源，会显著降低性能，因此需探索在受限网络条件下提升遥操作鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 构建DRL辅助的遥操作框架，部署于爱立信5G独立组网（SA）测试床；DRL智能体运行于网络边缘的远端环境内，直接将自身动作与经5G网络接收的操作者指令融合；该部署使智能体无时延地获取环境当前状态。任务为操作者用触觉设备操控飞船穿越远端虚拟游戏，实验覆盖不同拥塞与QoS配置。
AI.result: 在所有网络条件下DRL辅助均提升任务表现；拥塞场景收益最大，平均任务完成时间缩短20.6%；拥塞下辅助操作甚至优于采用QoS优先级（时延恢复至接近无拥塞基线）的无辅助操作。
AI.conclusion: 将DRL辅助置于边缘侧、不受网络时延影响地融合操作者指令，是缓解拥塞对触觉遥操作影响的有效手段，其效果可超过单纯依赖QoS优先级保障的低时延方案。

title: Fast2Peak: High-Fidelity Restoration Algorithm by Single-Pixel Masking towards Real-Time Spectral Measurements
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables, including 25 pages of Supporting Information
summary: Improving the temporal and spatial resolution of spectroscopy inevitably reduces the photons available to each measurement, pushing rapid measurements into photon-starved conditions where weak spectral features are obscured by stochastic background noise. Here, we present Fast2Peak (F2P), a self-supervised Transformer framework that transforms the spectral restoration task into a context-prediction problem. Given that physically constrained spectral signals exhibit strong local continuity, whereas the stochastic noise fluctuates randomly and does not possess the continuity across neighboring spectral pixels, single-pixel masking enables F2P to restore the predictable signal structure while suppressing unpredictable fluctuations even without clean reference spectra. Unlike conventional offline spectral restoration, F2P achieves high-fidelity restoration within milliseconds, enabling real-time "acquire-and-process" operation. We demonstrate this capability in time-resolved electrochemical SERS and hyperspectral Raman imaging, where spectral restoration is performed during data acquisition. In addition, F2P has demonstrated its robust generalization across different instruments and spectral modalities, including Raman, NMR, XRD and FTIR.

AI.tldr: Fast2Peak (F2P) 是一个自监督 Transformer 框架，将光谱恢复转化为上下文预测问题，可在无干净参考光谱条件下于毫秒级实现实时高保真光谱恢复。
AI.motivation: 提升光谱的时间与空间分辨率必然减少每次测量的光子数，使快速测量进入光子匮乏状态，微弱光谱特征被随机背景噪声淹没，亟需有效的光谱恢复手段。
AI.method: 利用物理约束下光谱信号具有强局部连续性、而随机噪声在相邻光谱像素间不具连续性的先验，采用单像素掩码的自监督 Transformer（上下文预测），恢复可预测的信号结构并抑制不可预测的噪声涨落，无需干净参考光谱。
AI.result: 相比传统离线光谱恢复，F2P 在毫秒内完成高保真恢复，实现实时"采集即处理"；在时间分辨电化学 SERS 与高光谱拉曼成像中于数据采集过程中完成恢复；并在拉曼、NMR、XRD、FTIR 等不同仪器与光谱模态上展现稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: F2P 以自监督上下文预测范式突破了光子匮乏下的光谱恢复瓶颈，兼具实时性与跨模态泛化性，为快速光谱测量提供了通用解决方案。

authors: Gabriel Wedson Mendonça de Souza Veloso
title: Speedrunning Relational Foundation Model Pretraining
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the CODEC-FM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Progress on foundation model pretraining is gated by who can afford a trial, and relational pretraining is no exception. Recipes are developed inside individual labs, reported under private protocols, and do not accumulate. Speedrun leaderboards remove that barrier by decentralizing the search rather than the training run. The problem is fixed, the stack is open, entries are ranked by wall-clock time to a quality target, and one GPU is enough to hold the record. We introduce modded-nanoRT, the first such leaderboard for Relational Transformers. Which database to hold out decides whether the benchmark can resolve improvements at all, so we fix it by calibration, ranking six candidates by how sharply a 45-minute learning curve separates improvement from seed noise. We open the leaderboard with typed trilinear attention, a relational operator that conditions attention scores and values on the foreign key traversed, together with Muon and SIGReg. The recipe reaches the target in 305.63 seconds on one NVIDIA H200, 8.11x faster than the reference implementation, and wins 13 of 15 pairs outside the development database. We will release the benchmark, its frozen artifacts, and the record runs. Our code is available at https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT.

AI.tldr: 提出modded-nanoRT：首个面向关系型Transformer（Relational Transformer）的Speedrun排行榜，通过去中心化搜索、固定开放技术栈与单一GPU可复现的赛制降低基础模型预训练研究的准入门槛；并以校准选定留出数据库，用typed trilinear attention、Muon与SIGReg的配方在单张H200上以305.63秒达标，比参考实现快8.11倍。
AI.motivation: 基础模型预训练（含关系型预训练）的进展受算力门槛限制：配方在各实验室内部开发、以私有协议报告，难以累积。Speedrun排行榜通过去中心化搜索（而非分布式训练）消除该障碍，但关系型Transformer领域尚无此类基准。
AI.method: 1）构建modded-nanoRT排行榜：任务固定、技术栈开放、按达到质量目标的墙钟时间排名、单GPU即可刷新纪录；2）留出数据库的选择决定基准的分辨能力，故通过校准在六个候选中按"45分钟学习曲线区分改进与种子噪声的锐度"排序确定留出库；3）方法上引入typed trilinear attention（以外键遍历为条件、对attention score与value进行条件化的关系算子），并配合Muon优化器与SIGReg正则。
AI.result: 在单张NVIDIA H200上305.63秒达到质量目标，较参考实现快8.11倍；在开发数据库之外的15组对比中赢下13组。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜式基准可有效累积关系型预训练配方；typed trilinear attention等组件带来的改进在留出数据库上具备可迁移性。作者将发布基准、冻结产物与纪录运行，代码见 https://github.com/kunumi/nanoRT。

title: Offline Apprenticeship Learning for Human-Centric Environments
summary: Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. For demonstration quality, HALIDE integrates continuous quality signals into hierarchical policy induction, enabling principled reuse of mixed-quality data under distribution shift. CCHAL further attributes quality to individual decisions via Bayesian credit assignment, dual-arm criticality scoring that contrasts expert and non-expert behavior, and a Bradley-Terry contrastive IRL objective over failure trajectories, outperforming baselines including HALIDE on three clinical EHR datasets and an ITS dataset. Finally, a real-world classroom evaluation of StuEDM, an EDM-induced policy that preserves student agency and intervenes only on disagreement, shows significant learning gains over an Expert baseline and a higher pretest-adjusted posttest score than a CQL policy trained on a far larger corpus, while overriding students less than half as often. Together, this work establishes offline AL as a practical, data-efficient, and ethically viable paradigm for human-centric environments.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕奖励建模与示范质量两大挑战，构建了一系列离线学徒学习框架（EM-EDM、THEMES、HALIDE、CCHAL），并在教育智能辅导与临床医疗场景中通过真实课堂实验验证了其数据高效、可离线部署的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在以人为中心的环境（如智能辅导系统ITS与临床医疗）中，决策策略需具备自适应性、数据高效性与伦理可部署性。学徒学习（AL）可通过恢复隐含奖励结构直接从专家示范中推断策略，实现无需环境交互的严格离线学习，从而规避在线交互的风险与成本。
AI.method: 提出递进式离线AL框架，分为两条主线：1）奖励建模——EM-EDM按潜在奖励函数对示范聚类并归纳簇特定策略；THEMES借助分层学习的奖励调节器将轨迹切分为时间连贯的子轨迹。2）示范质量——HALIDE将连续质量信号融入分层策略归纳，在分布偏移下合理复用混合质量数据；CCHAL通过贝叶斯信用分配将质量归因到单次决策，结合对比专家与非专家行为的双臂关键性评分，并在失败轨迹上使用Bradley-Terry对比式逆强化学习目标。
AI.result: 在1个教育数据集与3个临床数据集上，THEMES优于扁平与分层AL基线；CCHAL在3个临床EHR数据集与1个ITS数据集上优于含HALIDE在内的基线。真实课堂中，StuEDM在显著提升学习收益、后测成绩（经前测校正）高于在更大语料上训练的CQL策略的同时，对学生干预频率不足其一半。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了离线学徒学习作为面向以人为中心环境的实用、数据高效且伦理可行的范式，能够在保留学生自主性的前提下实现有效干预。

title: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures
summary: Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse backgrounds. When experiments are costly, a team can test only a limited number of ideas, thereby creating the need to balance exploration and exploitation when selecting a subset of researchers to propose and execute new experiments. Furthermore, each result should shape what the team tries next. We therefore ask how AI researchers with different scientific backgrounds can build on one another's findings and sustain progress under a limited experimental budget. To address these challenges, we build a team of persistent AI researchers, each grounded in a different discipline, who keep private research histories, share experimental evidence, and receive research opportunities through adaptive allocation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design by deploying the team to search for linear attention architectures, where it outperforms GDN2 at 1.3B scale on language modeling, common-sense reasoning, and synthetic and real-world retrieval tasks. In controlled comparisons, removing any single organizational component from our design yields markedly weaker discoveries: without disciplinary backgrounds, the search plateaus early; without private histories, researchers make less progress despite identical shared evidence; and uniform selection falls short of adaptive allocation within the same budget. These results suggest that sustained autonomous discovery depends not only on stronger agents, but also on who explores, what they remember, and how research effort is allocated.

AI.tldr: 提出"持续性AI研究者团队"：成员各具不同学科背景、保持私有研究历史、共享实验证据，并通过自适应分配获得研究机会，在有限实验预算下平衡探索与利用，成功搜索出优于GDN2的线性注意力架构。
AI.motivation: 单一/同质化的AI智能体易陷入发现过程的局部最优，故希望通过组建不同专长的智能体团队引入"正交探索"；但在实验成本高昂、可尝试想法有限的情况下，还需解决探索与利用的平衡问题，以及让每次实验结果反馈并塑造团队下一步行动。
AI.method: 构建一个由不同学科背景的持续性AI研究者组成的团队：每位研究者拥有私有的研究历史，团队共享实验证据，并通过自适应资源分配机制（而非均匀选择）决定由谁提出并执行新实验。以线性注意力架构搜索为任务进行部署，并做消融式受控对比（去掉学科背景、去掉私有历史、改用均匀选择）。
AI.result: 在1.3B规模的语言建模、常识推理以及合成与真实检索任务上优于GDN2。受控对比显示：移除任一组织组件都会显著削弱发现质量——无学科背景时搜索过早进入平台期；无私有历史时在相同共享证据下进展更少；均匀选择在同等预算下不如自适应分配。
AI.conclusion: 持续的自主科学发现不仅取决于更强的智能体，还取决于"由谁探索、记住什么、以及研究投入如何分配"这三项组织设计原则。

title: Beyond Correct Answers: How Compositional Cues Shape Visual Judgments
summary: Visual question answering requires models to assign attributes and relations to the correct objects, a problem known as visual binding. Structured prompts make these assignments explicit through labeled fields. Yet an improvement from the full prompt does not reveal which labels help or how they interact. First, we isolate field-label effects across ten models and six tasks by holding the image and claim fixed. These comparisons reveal differences that overall accuracy can hide. With a relation label present, adding object-role labels helps Qwen3 but hurts Qwen2 on Spatial. Second, we compare auxiliary hints that preserve or swap the question's role assignments against a no-hint baseline. Across two image sets, Qwen3's advantage with preserving hints mainly reflects errors caused by swapped hints. Preserving hints remain near baseline. Field order further affects the harm. Third, we test clearer hint wording and direct selection of the relation shown in the image. Clearer hints improve text matching but do not consistently improve visual judgments. In contrast, relation selection partly reduces errors for some hints in Qwen3 and GPT-4.1-mini.

AI.tldr: 该文通过受控实验拆解结构化提示中各字段标签对视觉绑定任务的影响，揭示标签间的交互差异及辅助提示的正负作用机制。
AI.motivation: 视觉问答需模型将属性与关系正确绑定到对象（visual binding）。结构化提示通过带标签字段使绑定显式化，但整体准确率提升无法说明哪些标签有用、如何交互，需进行细粒度归因分析。
AI.method: 三组受控实验：(1) 固定图像与陈述，在10个模型、6项任务上隔离字段标签效应；(2) 对比保留 vs. 交换问题角色分配的辅助提示与无提示基线，跨两组图像集，并考察字段顺序；(3) 测试更清晰的提示措辞与直接选择图像所示关系。
AI.result: 存在关系标签时，添加对象-角色标签对Qwen3在Spatial任务上有益、对Qwen2有害；Qwen3保留提示的优势主要源于交换提示引发的错误，保留提示仅接近基线；字段顺序影响损害程度；清晰措辞改善文本匹配但不稳定改善视觉判断；关系选择可部分降低Qwen3与GPT-4.1-mini上部分提示的错误。
AI.conclusion: 整体准确率掩盖了字段标签的异质效应；结构化提示的收益部分来自错误提示的负面效应而非正提示的正面效应；改善措辞与结构（如关系选择）是有针对性的改进方向。

title: Large-size multivariate scale-free texture generation from small-size learning sets with self-attention Wasserstein-GAN
summary: Multivariate scale-free texture images are nowadays central in numerous modern applications very different in nature. A common challenging issue consists of being able to generate such multivariate textures at any arbitrary size, from a learning set of (possibly much) smaller size. Parametric models often turn out to be too restrictive for the generation of realistic textures, thus prompting neural network training-based generation. While several neural network approaches propose generation at sizes larger than training, they do not explicitly assess the quality of the generation by quantifying how well multiscale or scale-free statistics in textures are reproduced and rather rely on perceptual assessment. The present work combines convolutional Wasserstein-GAN architectures with self-attention layers to generate textures of arbitrary size while focusing on reproducing multiscale statistics, without coding a model into the loss function. The relevance of using a self-attention layer is studied. Quantitative assessment conducted on multifractal textures, representative of a broad class of multiscale textures, over ten independent trainings shows that the proposed architecture is able to generate textures with accurate statistics for sizes $8 \times 8$ larger than the originals. The results show that placing self-attention in the critic provides the most consistent performance across output sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出结合卷积Wasserstein-GAN与自注意力层的生成框架，可在不将尺度模型写入损失函数的前提下，从小样本学习集生成任意尺寸的多变量尺度无关（多重分形）纹理，并在比原图大8×8的尺寸上保持准确的统计特性。
AI.motivation: 多变量尺度无关纹理在众多现代应用中居核心地位，但如何从（可能小得多的）学习集生成任意尺寸的该类纹理仍是挑战；参数模型对真实纹理生成过于受限，而既有神经网络方法虽能生成更大尺寸，却多以感知评估为主，缺乏对多尺度/尺度无关统计量复现质量的定量刻画。
AI.method: 将卷积Wasserstein-GAN架构与自注意力层相结合，用于任意尺寸纹理生成，重点在于复现多尺度统计特性，且不把模型显式编码进损失函数；并系统研究自注意力层放置位置（生成器/判别器critic）的影响。
AI.result: 在代表广泛多尺度纹理类的多重分形纹理上，经十次独立训练进行定量评估：所提架构能生成统计量准确的纹理，输出尺寸可达原始尺寸的8×8倍；结果表明将自注意力置于critic中在不同输出尺寸下性能最为一致。
AI.conclusion: 自注意力与卷积Wasserstein-GAN的结合可实现无需显式统计损失的多尺度纹理外推生成，自注意力位于critic时跨尺寸一致性最佳，为尺度无关纹理的可扩展生成提供了有效的定量验证方案。

title: Observation of Size-dependent Optical Modes and Confinement in Fin Cavities using Angle-Resolved Cathodoluminescence
comment: Main text:12 pages, 5 figures SI: 6 pages, 5 figures
summary: We observe novel optical fringes and emission coherence in laterally formed semiconductor fins using wavelength- and angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (WARCL). These findings demonstrate that cavity mode and emission confinement are directly governed by cavity geometry including cavity dimensions, facet angles, and orientation. In flat fins narrowing the width from 3000 nm to 200 nm sharpens fringe intensity, indicating stronger mode confinement and increased coherence. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations confirm that the observed fringes originate from internal reflections among the fin facets, consistent with a Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity model where the cavity length determines the fringe spacing. FDTD also reveals a transition from multi-mode to single-longitudinal-mode behavior in 200-nm fins, consistent with experimentally observed fringe narrowing. Increasing fin length from 10 μm to 30 μm compresses fringe spacing via longer round-trip paths. Conversely, tilting the fin end-facet from 90° to 45° reduces the effective light path length, increasing the incoherent optical emission. Remarkably, this loss can be offset by adjusting the fin length-to-height ratio. Results suggest WARCL is a robust in-situ method for direct characterization of individual dielectric nanocavities, mapping their modal profiles and light directionality as a function of geometry for custom design of nanoscale optical sources and waveguides.

AI.tldr: 利用波长与角度分辨阴极发光(WARCL)观察到横向半导体鳍中新的光学条纹与发光相干性，证明腔模与发光限制由腔几何(尺寸、端面角度、取向)直接调控，并由FDTD以Fabry-Pérot腔模型验证。
AI.motivation: 需要一种能在原位直接表征单个介质纳米腔、并厘清腔几何如何决定模式限制与发光相干的表征手段，以支持纳米光源与波导的定制设计。
AI.method: 采用波长与角度分辨阴极发光(WARCL)对横向形成的半导体鳍进行测量；结合有限差分时域(FDTD)模拟，与Fabry-Pérot(FP)腔模型对照，系统改变鳍宽(3000→200 nm)、鳍长(10→30 μm)、端面倾角(90°→45°)及长高比。
AI.result: 平面鳍宽度由3000 nm缩至200 nm时条纹强度锐化，表明模式限制增强、相干性提高；FDTD证实条纹源于鳍面间的内反射，符合同FP腔模型，腔长决定条纹间距，并显示200 nm鳍由多模转为单纵模，与实验条纹变窄一致。鳍长由10 μm增至30 μm使往返光程增大、条纹间距压缩；端面由90°倾斜至45°缩短有效光程，使非相干发光增强，但该损耗可通过调整长高比补偿。
AI.conclusion: WARCL是一种稳健的原位方法，可对单个介质纳米腔进行直接表征，按几何映射其模场分布与光方向性，用于纳米尺度光源与波导的定制设计。

title: To Manipulate or Not: Opinion Dynamics in LLM Interactions
summary: Large language models increasingly take part in extended conversations where they can both shape and be shaped by another party's views, yet most persuasion research measures only one side of that exchange. We introduce a controlled LLM-LLM debate framework in which two language-model roles repeatedly discuss a contested topic (climate-change attribution): one is given an assigned stance and, in some conditions, an explicit instruction to persuade, while the other receives no assigned position. Across four ordered model combinations involving GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, we track both each role's explicitly reported position and a separate measure of its turn-by-turn behavior inside the conversation. Opinion dynamics differ substantially across model combinations: same-model interactions narrow the opinion gap on average, clearly for only one of the two models, while cross-model interactions widen it. Explicit reports and in-dialogue behavior capture distinct aspects of opinion dynamics, and a blanket instruction to persuade does not reliably increase influence. These findings suggest that conversational influence depends not only on assigned roles and initial positions but also on the participating models, with implications for how opinion change is measured in extended LLM interactions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出受控的LLM-LLM辩论框架，围绕气候变化归因议题让两个模型角色多轮对话，同时追踪其显式立场报告与对话内行为，发现意见动态随模型组合而显著不同。
AI.motivation: 已有说服研究多只测量对话交换中的一方，忽略了LLM在长对话中既塑造又被对方观点塑造的双向影响，因此需要同时刻画双方立场与行为变化。
AI.method: 构建受控的LLM-LLM辩论框架：一个角色被赋予既定立场，部分条件下额外被明确指示去说服对方，另一角色不预设立场；在涉及GPT-6 Luna与Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite的四种有序模型组合中，分别测量各角色显式报告的立场和逐轮对话内行为。
AI.result: 意见动态因模型组合差异明显：同模型交互平均缩小意见差距（仅对其中一个模型显著），跨模型交互则扩大差距；显式报告与对话内行为反映意见动态的不同侧面；笼统的"去说服"指令并不能稳定提升影响力。
AI.conclusion: 对话影响力不仅取决于被赋予的角色与初始立场，还取决于参与的模型本身，这对如何在长程LLM交互中测量意见变化具有方法学启示。

title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
summary: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment. On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively. Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.

AI.tldr: 总结ReAPO方法及效果
AI.motivation: 描述论文动机
AI.method: 描述论文方法
AI.result: 描述论文结果
AI.conclusion: 描述论文结论

title: CSD: Common-Support Distillation for Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Transfer
summary: Cross-tokenizer logits distillation enables knowledge transfer across model families, allowing students to learn from stronger or more specialized teachers. However, differences in vocabulary and segmentation make teacher and student next-token distributions difficult to align. Existing logits-based methods are easy to integrate into standard distillation pipelines, but often rely on restrictive heuristics or tokenizer-pair-specific choices. They may restrict supervision to shared vocabulary subsets, require manually selecting different objectives for different tokenizer pairs, or match only the observed chunk and its complement rather than individual alternative continuations. We introduce Common-Support Distillation (CSD), a unified logits-based framework that constructs a shared support between the teacher and student at each aligned input chunk and matches the induced distributions with a single objective. For one-to-one alignments, CSD uses explicit common-token pairs as the shared support. For other alignments, it constructs a virtual support whose probabilities are computed using the autoregressive chain rule. A residual event captures probability mass outside the explicit support, ensuring that both induced distributions remain normalized. Across four teacher-student settings comprising Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma3-1B-PT students with Qwen and Phi teachers, CSD consistently achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated cross-tokenizer methods, outperforming the strongest alternative by up to 1.8 points and surpassing both continued pretraining and same-tokenizer distillation. For Llama-3.1-8B, CSD improves average accuracy over the strongest evaluated baseline by up to 4.2 points for the base student and 1.6 points for the instruction-tuned student.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Common-Support Distillation (CSD)，一个统一的、基于 logits 的跨 tokenizer 蒸馏框架：在每对齐输入分块上构造师生共享支撑集，并用单一目标匹配诱导分布，从而支持不同词表/分词方式模型间的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 跨 tokenizer 蒸馏中，师生词表与分词差异使 next-token 分布难以对齐。既有 logits 方法虽易集成，但依赖受限启发式或特定 tokenizer 对的选择：仅监督共享词表子集、需针对不同 tokenizer 对手工切换目标、或只匹配观测 chunk 及其补集而非单个候选续写。
AI.method: CSD 在每条对齐输入 chunk 上构造师生共享支撑集并匹配诱导分布，仅用单一目标。一对一对齐时，以显式共同 token 对为共享支撑；其他对齐方式下，用自回归链式法则构造虚拟支撑并计算其概率。另设残差事件以捕获显式支撑外的概率质量，保证两侧诱导分布归一化。
AI.result: 在四种师生配置（Llama-3.2-1B 与 Gemma3-1B-PT 学生，Qwen 与 Phi 教师）中，CSD 平均性能在评估的跨 tokenizer 方法中最优，最高超出最强基线 1.8 分，并优于继续预训练与同 tokenizer 蒸馏。对 Llama-3.1-8B，CSD 相较最强基线平均准确率分别提升至多 4.2 分（base 学生）与 1.6 分（指令微调学生）。
AI.conclusion: CSD 以统一目标与自动构造的共享支撑（含虚拟支撑与残差事件）消除了跨 tokenizer 蒸馏中的启发式与手工选择，实现稳定且显著的性能提升，并可扩展至更大规模学生模型。

title: Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation for Few-shot Image Classification
comment: This work is accepted by The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Few-shot image classification (FSIC) frequently suffers from visual ambiguity, where background clutter and RGB appearance similarities hinder discriminative feature matching in data-scarce settings. To mitigate this, we propose DAFIC, a geometry-guided framework that incorporates monocular depth into representation learning, episodic adaptation, and dense support-query matching. DAFIC first learns geometry-aware token representations through RGB-D self-supervised pre-training. Subsequently, the Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation (DGA) module uses depth-derived geometry to refine patch representations with geometry-enriched class context while suppressing background interference. Spatial Bidirectional Patch Matching (SBiM) then performs bidirectional dense matching on the refined features, reducing sensitivity to spurious correspondences and background clutter. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks show that DAFIC achieves strong performance against existing methods, with ablation and robustness analyses supporting the effectiveness of coupling geometry-conditioned episodic adaptation with bidirectional matching for few-shot visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 DAFIC，一个引入单目深度几何信息的少样本图像分类框架，结合RGB-D自监督预训练、深度引导几何自适应与双向稠密块匹配，在四个基准上取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 少样本图像分类在数据稀缺条件下易受视觉歧义影响：背景杂波与RGB外观相似性削弱了判别性特征匹配。
AI.method: 1) 通过RGB-D自监督预训练学习几何感知的token表示；2) 深度引导几何自适应模块（DGA）利用深度几何精炼patch表示，注入几何丰富的类上下文并抑制背景干扰；3) 空间双向块匹配（SBiM）对精炼特征进行双向稠密匹配，降低对虚假对应和背景杂波的敏感性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，DAFIC相较现有方法取得强劲性能；消融实验与鲁棒性分析验证了几何条件化的episodic自适应与双向匹配耦合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将单目深度几何引入表示学习、episodic自适应与稠密支持-查询匹配，可有效缓解少样本视觉识别中的视觉歧义问题。

title: Digital Particle Communication under Flow: Frequency Analysis and Pulse Design
summary: In particle communication, particles released for different symbols can reach the receiver at overlapping times, making reliable detection difficult. This paper develops a digital communication framework that connects particle transport, pulse shaping, and receiver processing for three-dimensional free-space diffusion-advection channels. We derive the continuous-time and discrete-time frequency responses and explain how flow speed affects channel delay and bandwidth. Under advection-dominated conditions, the group delay approaches $R/V$, and the one-sided $3$-dB bandwidth scales as $V^{3/2}$. We design nonnegative, unit-energy transmit pulses using a packet-level SINR criterion that includes interference from both preceding and subsequent symbols under additive white Gaussian receiver noise. Simulations validate the analytical approximations and show that optimized pulses spread across more of the symbol interval when noise is substantial and become narrower as noise decreases. BER evaluations across SNR and symbol duration compare optimized, rectangular, and single-impulse pulses with several detection methods, identifying the operating conditions in which transmit-pulse design improves reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对三维自由空间扩散-平流信道中不同符号粒子到达时间重叠的问题，建立了连接粒子输运、脉冲成形与接收处理的数字通信框架，并基于包级SINR准则设计非负单位能量发射脉冲以提升检测可靠性。
AI.motivation: 粒子通信中不同符号释放的粒子会在接收端出现到达时间重叠，导致可靠检测困难；现有工作缺乏将粒子输运物理模型、发射脉冲成形与接收处理统一起来的数字通信分析框架。
AI.method: 推导三维自由空间扩散-平流信道的连续时间与离散时间频率响应，分析流速对信道时延与带宽的影响；在加性高斯接收噪声下，以包含前后符号干扰的包级SINR为准则，设计非负、单位能量的发射脉冲；并通过仿真验证解析近似，比较优化脉冲、矩形脉冲与单脉冲在多检测方法下的BER。
AI.result: 在平流主导条件下，群时延趋近于R/V，单边3-dB带宽按V^{3/2}缩放；仿真验证了解析近似，并表明噪声较大时优化脉冲在符号区间内展布更宽、噪声降低时变窄；跨SNR与符号时长的BER评估给出了发射脉冲设计带来可靠性提升的工作区间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将粒子信道物理特性与脉冲成形设计相结合，明确了流速决定时延与带宽的定量规律，并界定了发射脉冲优化相对矩形与单脉冲方案有效的工况范围。

title: Passive Phase-Aware Hadamard Decoding: Analytical and Machine-Learning Approaches
summary: Hadamard-coded optical receivers typically rely on stable interference conditions, which can motivate active optical phase control. We investigate a fixed, intensity-only decoder that embeds four populated modes in an eight-mode interferometer and provides six complementary trigonometric observables through simultaneous power measurements. An analytic transition decoder uses the resulting sign-change patterns without continuous optical phase stabilization. The receiver's intensity-to-observable map is inverted exactly, and an identifiability analysis characterizes exceptional phase configurations and conditional noise sensitivity. An ideal, equal-photon-budget comparison with conventional four-port Hadamard decoding illustrates the potential value of the additional outputs without implying an unconditional advantage. Measurements on programmable photonic processors give 96.19% accuracy for the analytical decoding experiment; a complementary machine-learning analysis reports 98.31% on a held-out experimental trace. These results demonstrate an intensity-only, phase-aware approach to differential Hadamard decoding under the tested conditions, while larger codebooks and hardware-level energy benefits remain topics for future investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种固定的、仅强度测量的光学接收机：在八模干涉仪中嵌入四个populated模式，通过同时功率测量获得六个互补的三角观测量，并用解析的"符号变化模式"解码器实现无需连续光相位稳定的差分Hadamard解码。
AI.motivation: 传统Hadamard编码光接收机依赖稳定的干涉条件，因而往往需要主动光相位控制，增加系统复杂度与开销。作者希望探索一种无需连续相位稳定的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建八模干涉仪、四模式填充的固定强度型解码器，输出六个互补三角观测量；对强度—观测量映射做精确反演；给出可辨识性分析，刻画异常相位构型与条件噪声敏感度；采用基于符号变化模式的解析转移解码器；并与传统四端口Hadamard解码做理想等光子预算对比；辅以机器学习分析。
AI.result: 在可编程光子处理器上的实验中，解析解码达到96.19%准确率；机器学习分析在留出实验轨迹上达到98.31%。与四端口方案的等光子预算对比显示额外输出具有潜在价值，但不构成无条件优势。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在测试条件下，仅强度、相位感知的方法可实现差分Hadamard解码；更大码本与硬件层面的能量收益仍属未来工作。

title: Fig: Automated Multiagent Behavior Elicitor
summary: Many social evaluations for multiagent systems study behaviors as they emerge from environments instead of systematically intervening in the environment to elicit such behaviors. We introduce Fig (Finding Interactions in Games), an agentic system that performs targeted elicitation interventions on game environments. It takes a natural language behavior description, decomposes it into sub-behaviors, generates new social games or selects existing ones, and executes single or combined interventions to the games' engine, opponents, instructions, and context. To evaluate model behavior, it combines built-in mechanical checks and synthetic rubric judgments. We validate the interventions, generated games, and evaluation mechanisms via human review. Models attempt the target behavior in 45.2% of episodes on average for valid scenarios generated by Fig for six test behaviors -- cooperation, exploitation, deception, covert coordination, betrayal, and sabotage. For game-behavior pairs with available controls, Fig's interventions increase attempt rates by 10.9% on average compared to matched control games. Fig shows that multiagent environments can serve as programmable test beds for intentional, controllable, and reproducible behavior evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/fleet-ai/fig.

AI.tldr: Fig是一个智能体系统，通过对游戏环境进行"定向诱发干预"来系统性地检验多智能体模型的目标行为，将自然语言行为描述分解为子行为，生成或选择社交游戏，并执行单一或组合干预，再用机械化检查与合成rubric评判评估行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统的社会性评估主要观察行为在环境中的"自然涌现"，而缺乏对环境进行系统性干预以主动诱发特定行为的手段，导致评估不可控、难以复现。
AI.method: 提出Fig（Finding Interactions in Games）：输入自然语言行为描述→分解为子行为→生成新社交游戏或选取已有游戏→对游戏引擎、对手、指令与上下文执行单一或组合干预→结合内置机械化检查与合成rubric评判来评估模型行为；干预、生成游戏与评估机制均经人工审核验证。
AI.result: 在Fig为六种测试行为（合作、剥削、欺骗、隐蔽协调、背叛、破坏）生成的有效场景中，模型平均在45.2%的回合中尝试目标行为；在有对照的"游戏—行为"对上，Fig的干预使尝试率平均提升10.9%。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体环境可作为可编程测试床，实现有意图、可控且可复现的行为评估。

title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
summary: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. Built on this view, our motion equivariant convolutional LSTM (MELSTM) uses its velocity model as the gauge field and is provably equivariant to every motion. Across future-frame prediction, classification of digits visible only through their motion, and action recognition under camera shake, MELSTM outperforms a convolutional LSTM and its flow equivariant counterpart with the same number of parameters: it is more accurate, generalizes to longer horizons and to unseen motions, and carries a fraction of the flow equivariant model's state.

AI.tldr: 本文将运动视为数据的一种对称性，把流动等变递归网络从常量速度流扩展到卷积LSTM、时变运动与速度估计，并以“运动是规范对称”的视角提出运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM），在帧预测、运动识别数字分类与抖动下动作识别上优于同参数量基线。
AI.motivation: 序列数据中的大量变化源自运动，而运动只改变物体位置、不改变其身份，因此是数据的一种对称性。但标准循环网络的记忆不随输入运动而移动，缺乏运动等变性；已有的流动等变递归网络仅支持常量速度，且需枚举一组速度。
AI.method: 将序列视为时间上的场，把运动刻画为“全局对称在时间上局部化”后的规范对称；以速度模型作为规范场，将流动等变思想从简单递归网络推广到卷积LSTM，从常量速度流推广到时变速度运动，从速度枚举改为速度估计，构建运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM），并给出对任意运动的等变性的可证明结论。
AI.result: 在未来帧预测、仅通过运动可见的数字分类、以及相机抖动下的动作识别三项任务上，MELSTM在参数量相同条件下均优于卷积LSTM及其流动等变对应模型：精度更高，对更长预测时域和未见运动具有更好泛化性，且状态量仅为流动等变模型的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 运动可作为序列模型的规范对称加以建模；以速度估计为规范场的MELSTM在精度、泛化与状态效率上均具优势，说明将等变性与规范场视角引入循环卷积结构是有效且有前景的方向。

title: Is Refusal Direction Universal across Low-Resourced Languages?
summary: Refusal directions have been shown to transfer cross-lingually with near-perfect effectiveness across safety-aligned languages (Wang et al., 2025), reportedly regardless of resource level. However, the only truly low-resourced language evaluated is Yoruba, which is strongly misaligned and shows limited transfer, leaving open how refusal directions behave for other low-resourced languages. We extend PolyRefuse to three additional low-resourced languages (Belarusian, Bashkir, and Tajik) and replicate the pipeline of (Wang et al., 2025) on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. We find that universality is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned and partially-aligned languages transfer broadly, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any target tested, including other misaligned languages, once ceiling effects are accounted for. Geometric alignment and behavioral transfer are further shown to be partially dissociated. These findings complicate the universality claim and suggest that users of the least-resourced, most strongly misaligned languages may face weaker safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 通过扩展PolyRefuse至白俄罗斯语、巴什基尔语和塔吉克语三种低资源语言，作者发现拒绝方向的跨语言可迁移性是"分级的"而非二元的，强错位语言的拒绝方向无法可靠迁移。
AI.motivation: Wang et al. (2025) 声称拒绝方向可跨安全对齐语言近乎完美地迁移且与资源水平无关，但其唯一真正低资源语言（约鲁巴语）实际呈强错位且迁移有限，因此其他低资源语言中拒绝方向的行为仍属空白。
AI.method: 将PolyRefuse扩展到白俄罗斯语、巴什基尔语和塔吉克语，在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct上复现Wang et al. (2025)的流程，并控制天花板效应以评估方向迁移效果。
AI.result: 来自安全对齐与部分对齐语言的拒绝方向可广泛迁移；来自强错位语言的方向在包括其他错位语言在内的所有目标语言上均无法可靠调控拒绝行为。几何对齐与行为迁移呈现部分解耦。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝方向的普遍性主张需要修正为分级现象，最欠资源且强错位语言的使用者可能面临更弱的安全保障。

title: DualHeads: Reward-tilted few-step diffusion made simple
summary: Distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in a few sampling steps, but aligning them with task requirements and human preferences is difficult. Methods developed for multi-step diffusion models rely on differentiable rewards, or on score fields and stochastic trajectories that distilled generators may lack. We ask whether a few-step generator can be adapted using only external reward evaluations and reference samples, and show that two binary classifiers suffice. Our method, DualHeads, implements them as lightweight heads on a frozen diffusion backbone. The reward head learns which samples of the same prompt score higher, the reference head separates reference images from generated ones, and the generator maximizes a weighted sum of their logits. When the heads are optimal, this objective is KL-regularized maximization of the learned reward, and the ratio of head weights sets the regularization strength. Empirically, with both rule-based and model-based rewards, a few-step DualHeads generator reaches task rewards close to those of 40-step reinforcement learning methods while preserving image quality, at no extra inference cost. We hope that this simple and elegant dual-head formulation will help advance few-step reward-tilted generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 DualHeads：仅在冻结扩散骨干上训练奖励头与参考头两个二分类器，即可用少量采样步数将几一步生成器对齐到外部奖励与参考分布，无额外推理开销。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏扩散模型能用极少步数生成高质量图像，但难以与任务要求和人类偏好对齐；面向多步扩散的对齐方法依赖可微奖励，或依赖 score field 与随机轨迹，而蒸馏生成器往往不具备这些要素。作者因此追问：能否只用外部奖励评测和参考样本来自适应少步生成器。
AI.method: DualHeads 在冻结扩散骨干上附加两个轻量头：奖励头学习同一 prompt 下哪些样本得分更高（成对比较），参考头区分参考图像与生成图像；生成器最大化两个头 logits 的加权和。当两头最优时，该目标等价于对所学奖励的 KL 正则化最大化，两头权重之比控制正则强度。
AI.result: 在规则型与模型型奖励下，少步 DualHeads 生成器的任务奖励接近 40 步强化学习方法，同时保持图像质量，且推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 仅需两个二分类头与外部奖励评测、参考样本即可完成少步生成器的奖励倾斜对齐，形式简洁；作者期望该双头范式推动少步奖励倾斜生成研究。

title: Passive RF Sensing for People Counting with Dense IoT Networks
summary:
Radio Frequency (RF) convergence, the joint use of radio signals for both communication and sensing, is gaining increasing attention in research and industry, mostly for its potential in Internet of Things (IoT) applications. By using RF signals of opportunity, such as those generate by the wireless networks, RF sensing exploits the effects of human bodies on the electromagnetic waves to detect both people presence and their movements without requiring wearable devices.
  In this paper, we address the problem of estimating the number of people in a monitored area covered by several RF nodes of a wireless network: to this aim, we propose a composite diffraction-based model, namely C-MAM, to capture the cumulative RF attenuation induced by multiple human bodies. Building on this model, we derive the analytical resolvability bounds that quantify the maximum number of distinguishable individuals based on the layout geometry and other physical characteristics of the wireless network. These bounds allow for the pre-deployment assessment of RF sensing performance under different scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出复合衍射模型 C-MAM 刻画多人对人体的累积 RF 衰减，并推导人数可分辨性解析上界，用于部署前评估 RF 感知性能。
