AI.motivation: RF 通信与感知融合（RF convergence）在 IoT 中潜力大，利用机会性 RF 信号可在无需可穿戴设备的情况下检测人员存在与运动；但多人场景下人数估计缺乏物理模型支撑与性能边界。
AI.method: 针对多 RF 节点覆盖的监测区域内人数估计问题，构建基于衍射的复合模型 C-MAM，建模多个人体引起的累积 RF 衰减；在此基础上推导解析可分辨性界（resolvability bounds），量化由网络布局几何与物理特性决定的最大可区分人数。
AI.result: 给出可分辨人数的解析上界，明确其与布局几何及无线网络物理参数的关系，从而支持不同场景下 RF 感知性能的部署前评估。
AI.conclusion: C-MAM 与解析可分辨性界为多人体 RF 感知提供了物理可解释的建模与性能预评估工具，可用于网络部署前的容量与几何设计权衡。

title: Broadband Mid-Wave Infrared Imaging Enabled by All-Silicon Hyperboloid Metalens
summary: The mid-wave infrared (MWIR, 3-5 microns) is indispensable for thermal sensing, gas detection, long-range imaging, and free-space optical communications. Meta-optics offer a compact, lightweight, and potentially low-cost alternative to conventional refractive optics, making them attractive for size, weight, and power (SWaP)-constrained systems. However, their strong chromatic dispersion has largely restricted imaging to narrow spectral bands. Here, we demonstrate broadband imaging across the full 3-5 micron MWIR band using a single-layer silicon metasurface coupled with computational reconstruction. Remarkably, the reconstruction model is adapted using only four image captures, overcoming large training data requirements and enabling broadband image recovery despite the strongly wavelength-dependent optical response. In contrast to approaches that engineer complex, dispersion-optimized metalens profiles for broadband operation, our method leverages the wavelength-dependent information encoded by a simple 2cm diameter hyperboloid metalens. We show that this metasurface captures sufficient broadband intensity information for computational reconstruction across the entire MWIR band. These results establish a simple route toward broadband computational meta-optics without requiring broadband achromatic metalens designs, offering a promising platform for compact MWIR imaging systems.

AI.tldr: 提出单层硅超表面+计算重建方案，仅用4幅图像即可自适应重建模型，实现对3–5 μm全中波红外波段的宽带成像。
AI.motivation: 中波红外（3–5 μm）在热感知、气体检测、远距离成像与自由空间光通信中不可或缺；超构光学（meta-optics）相比传统折射光学更紧凑轻量，有望满足SWaP受限系统需求，但其强色散导致成像通常局限于窄波段。
AI.method: 采用单片（单层）硅超表面——直径2 cm的双曲面（hyperboloid）金属透镜，利用其强波长依赖响应所编码的宽带强度信息，配合计算重建实现成像；重建模型仅需4次图像采集即完成自适应，避免大规模训练数据。区别于设计复杂色散优化轮廓的宽带消色差超透镜路线。
AI.result: 在完整3–5 μm中波红外波段实现宽带成像；证实该简单双曲面金属透镜捕获的宽带强度信息足以支撑全波段计算重建，且仅用4幅捕获图像即可适配重建模型。
AI.conclusion: 无需宽带消色差超透镜设计即可实现宽带计算超构光学，为紧凑型中波红外成像系统提供了一条简单可行的技术路径。

title: Hidden Messages Between Diffusion Language Model Agents: Causal Evidence for Latent Communication
comment: Accepted at the DiffuLM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Diffusion language models form answers through a sequence of revisable continuous states, but multi-agent systems usually discard those states and make agents communicate only after decoding text. We ask whether one independent diffusion trajectory can pass a compact hidden message into another and, crucially, whether the receiver uses what that message means. In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact. On QASC with the two supporting facts split across agents, matched communication reaches 80.8%, but a wrong-example message lowers accuracy to 46.8%, a content effect of +34.0 points. The surprising result is temporal: one late transfer reaches 87.8%, exceeding four recurrent exchanges by +7.0 points. These experiments provide causal evidence for continuous hidden communication between diffusion-LM agents and show that when information is transferred can matter more than how many times agents exchange it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Hidden Messages"机制，让扩散语言模型智能体在去噪轨迹层面传递连续隐状态，并通过移除/置换/替换消息的因果实验证明接收方确实利用了消息内容，同时发现单次晚期传输优于多次循环交换。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统通常丢弃扩散模型的连续中间状态，只在解码出文本后才通信，浪费了可修订的连续表示；作者想验证一条独立的扩散轨迹能否把紧凑隐消息传入另一条轨迹，且接收方能否利用其语义内容。
AI.method: 发送方将去噪状态压缩为四个带符号的稠密向量，接收方在保留自身上下文、画布与轨迹的前提下消费这些向量；设计三类对照：移除消息（检验通道是否存在）、乱序/他例置换（检验内容是否有因果作用）、定向替换（检验是否被引导至替换事实）；在控制任务、Tiny-A2D、Dream-7B 及 QASC（两支持事实分属不同智能体）上评测，并比较传输时机。
AI.result: 移除消息后 Tiny-A2D 上 +63.6 分优势消失、Dream-7B 上 +100.0 分优势消失；定向替换可把接收方引向替换事实；QASC 匹配通信达 80.8%，错误样例消息降至 46.8%（内容效应 +34.0 分）；单次晚期传输达 87.8%，比四次循环交换高 +7.0 分。
AI.conclusion: 实验为扩散语言模型智能体间的连续隐通信提供了因果证据：信息内容真实被使用；且"何时传输"可能比"交换多少次"更重要。

title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
summary: Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity. To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally. At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter. This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets. We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines. Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust from 70% onward. This high-sparsity advantage largely persists after posterior distillation across four of five models and translates into improved retention of aggregate zero-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出LADDER方法，通过增量式、损伤驱动的逐层稀疏度分配，改善大模型后训练剪枝在高稀疏度下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 非均匀分配能改善大语言模型的后训练剪枝，但在高稀疏度下质量仍会急剧下降，需要一种能在稀疏度上升时控制性能退化的分配策略。
AI.method: LADDER（Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement）逐步分配稀疏度：每一步对每个可用层评估额外剪除一定比例权重的效果，并选择"每移除一个参数所导致端到端退化最小"的层进行更新；以SparseGPT作为候选生成后端，产生非均匀稀疏度剖面和跨多个预算严格嵌套的掩码。
AI.result: 在OPT、Llama、Qwen共五个模型、10–90%稀疏度范围内与均匀分配和自适应分配基线对比：低稀疏度下LADDER相当或略弱，但从70%起显著更稳健；该高稀疏度优势在五个模型中的四个经后验蒸馏后大体保持，并转化为更好的零样本聚合准确率保持度。
AI.conclusion: LADDER呈现出明确的工作区间权衡：良性稀疏度无明显优势，高稀疏度下鲁棒性突出，且优势可部分迁移至蒸馏后模型。

title: Guilt by Association: Semantic Leakage Drives Associative Gender Bias
summary: Semantic leakage occurs when a concept in the prompt steers model generation about an entity, even though the concept is irrelevant to it (e.g., a person who likes yellow is said to work as a school bus driver). It has mostly been studied in settings where the concept is directly attributed to the entity the model is asked about. This leaves open whether leakage is a flawed heuristic, where the model builds a profile of that entity, or a much broader associative tendency, e.g., working across seemingly unrelated entities. We argue for the latter: even after removing the attribution of the concept to the specific entity, leakage persists. Next, we extend this idea to gender bias. While work on gender bias in LMs typically looks at cases where the stereotyped concept is attributed to an entity, our findings suggest that a concept may steer outputs with its mere presence in the scene. We show this using gendered concepts under two conditions: when the subject engages with the concept, and when the concept just sits in the scene. We find that both shift model generation toward the stereotype to a similar extent. Together, our results suggest that semantic leakage drives a form of bias that is overlooked by current evaluations.

AI.tldr: 语义泄漏并不依赖概念被归因于特定实体，而是一种更广泛的联想倾向，连"概念仅在场景中出现"也会引导生成并造成被现有评测忽视的偏见。
AI.motivation: 既有语义泄漏研究多限于概念直接归因于被询问实体的设定，尚不清楚泄漏是"针对该实体构建画像"的有缺陷启发式，还是跨实体的更广泛联想倾向；同时性别偏见评测通常只看刻板概念被归因于实体的情形。
AI.method: 在去除概念对该实体的归因后测试泄漏是否仍存在；并将框架扩展到性别偏见，在两种条件下使用性别化概念对比：主体与该概念发生互动 vs. 概念仅存在于场景中。
AI.result: 即使移除概念对特定实体的归因，泄漏依然持续；两种条件下生成都朝刻板印象偏移，且偏移程度相近。
AI.conclusion: 语义泄漏是一种更广泛的联想倾向而非实体画像式启发式；仅凭概念在场即可诱发偏见，这类偏见被现有评测所忽略。

title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$Σ$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Policy-Mask：在冻结扩散模型中，用预算条件策略联合选择时间步、网络块与通道子集，服务于下游判别任务。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型中间层的判别信号分散在去噪轨迹（时间步）、网络深度（块）和通道维度上，现有方法多靠手工固定或仅优化少数提取超参数（如时间步），并对所有输入和通道预算复用同一规则，缺乏自适应性。
AI.method: 训练一个以通道预算为条件的策略（Policy-Mask），在下游目标上端到端优化，同时输出时间步、块和通道子集三者的选择；关键实现点是按子集基数对通道得分贡献做归一化，使三个策略头量级可比、联合训练稳定；并扩展到 DiT 架构（PixArt-Σ、SD3.5 MMDiT），以图像 token 隐藏维度替代 U-Net 通道维度。
AI.result: 在等预算条件下优于固定提取与特征筛选基线：ADE20K 上 38.9 mIoU，CIFAR-100 在 128 维下 75.4% top-1，SPair-71k 上 76.3 PCK@0.1；消融显示块选择对下游精度影响显著，最优通道预算评分出现在保留 256 通道处。
AI.conclusion: 联合、自适应且预算感知的特征选择能有效提升冻结扩散特征的判别能力，256 通道是紧凑扩散表征的实用工作点，方法可迁移到 DiT 架构。

title: Training-Efficient Channel Estimation for the Multiuser Uplink Relying on Generalized Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces
summary: We consider uplink multiuser channel estimation for a generalized flexible intelligent metasurface at the base station, under narrowband far-field propagation and a twin-time-scale mechanical protocol: on the slow time-scale the panel translates rigidly over a planar grid, while on the fast time-scale the surface morphs along its normal direction. From orthogonal multiuser pilots, we show that each user's channel admits a fourth-order canonical polyadic tensor structure. We develop two complementary estimators: alternating least squares factorization followed by paired rotational-invariance wavevector extraction, and a tensor spatial-smoothing multiple signal classification estimator that preserves the multilinear array manifold. Both share a minimum description length front-end for automatic tensor-rank detection. We derive Kruskal identifiability conditions that relate the numbers of elements, morphing states and grid positions to the maximum number of recoverable multipath components, and show that the tensor model reconstructs the channel at panel configurations beyond the training grid. This prediction capability drives a configuration-selective multiuser transmit precoder that searches the entire motion grid without additional pilot overhead. Numerical results confirm the identifiability limits and show that, once the model order is resolved, the configuration search makes the same choice from estimated as from perfect channel state information. The reconfiguration gain over a fixed panel of identical aperture and training budget grows with the user load, and fast morphing proves valuable for conditioning the tensor factorization rather than as a source of beamforming gain.

AI.tldr: 研究柔性智能超表面（FIM）在基站端的上行多用户信道估计：利用面板"慢时标平移+快时标形变"的双时标机械协议，证明各用户信道具有四阶CP张量结构，提出两种估计器并给出可辨识性条件，最终支撑免额外导频开销的配置选择式多用户预编码。
AI.motivation: 柔性/可形变超表面的机械运动自由度带来新的信道维度，但如何在该双时标协议下从多用户正交导频中高效估计信道、并判断可恢复多径数上限、同时利用训练网格之外的配置增益，尚缺乏系统建模与理论保证。
AI.method: 窄带远场假设下，慢时标面板在平面网格上刚性平移、快时标沿法向形变；由正交多用户导频导出信道的四阶规范多路（CP）张量分解结构。提出两类互补估计器：(1) ALS分解+成对旋转不变波矢量提取；(2) 保持多线性阵列流形的张量空间平滑MUSIC。二者共用基于MDL的自动张量秩检测前端。进一步推导Kruskal可辨识性条件，将阵元数、形变状态数与网格位置数与最大可恢复多径分量数关联；并据此设计配置选择式多用户发送预编码器，在完整运动网格上搜索而无需额外导频。
AI.result: 数值结果验证了可辨识性界限；一旦模型阶数确定，基于估计CSI的配置搜索与基于理想CSI的选择完全一致；相对同孔径、同训练预算的固定面板，重构增益随用户负载增大而提升；快速形变的价值主要体现在改善张量分解的conditioning（条件数），而非提供波束成形增益。
AI.conclusion: 双时标机械协议下的FIM上行多用户信道可被建模为四阶CP张量并具备可预测性，能外推至训练网格外的面板配置；所提估计与预编码框架在可辨识范围内达到与理想CSI相当的配置选择性能，且增益随用户数增长，为可形变超表面的信道获取与传输设计提供了理论基础与实用方案。

title: UNWRAP: Single-shot phase analysis of bright squeezed vacuum by Newton-ring interferometry
summary: The mean field of pulsed bright squeezed vacuum (BSV) vanishes, but the variance can be large, and is strongly phase-dependent. We employ ultrafast Newton-ring wavefront retrieval and analysis of phase (UNWRAP) to extract the field amplitude and phase profile of each BSV pulse, by Fourier analysis of the interference rings between the BSV and a coherent reference with different phase-front curvature. The concentric ring interference fringes are robust against pointing mismatch and drift, thereby simplifying the analysis. The measured distribution has two phase peaks separated by π radians. The rings sweep the delay between the two pulses, so a single frame can capture the temporal field profile of the BSV, even when it is composed of several temporal modes.

AI.tldr: 提出UNWRAP方法，通过牛顿环式波前检索与干涉环傅里叶分析，单帧提取脉冲明亮压缩真空（BSV）每个脉冲的场振幅与相位分布。
AI.motivation: BSV的场均值为零但方差大且强相位依赖，常规场测量手段难以直接刻画其逐脉冲的振幅与相位结构。
AI.method: 利用BSV与不同相位前曲率的相干参考光之间的牛顿环干涉，对同心环条纹做傅里叶分析，反演场振幅与相位轮廓；同心环对指向失配与漂移不敏感，条纹扫描两脉冲间延迟。
AI.result: 测得相位分布呈相隔π弧度的双峰；单帧即可捕获BSV的时间场分布，即使其由多个时间模式组成。
AI.conclusion: UNWRAP为少周期/多模BSV的逐脉冲场层析提供了稳健、简便的单帧测量方案。

title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: DiffResearch将扩散语言模型（dLLM）置于多智能体深度研究的各阶段核心，在与AR模型保持脚手架/检索/提示/评测不变的前提下，实现端到端约6倍加速，并提出从中间去噪状态提前抽取子查询的dFast模式。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统需迭代地进行规划、取证、综合与修订，端到端延迟成为交互式使用的关键瓶颈；而现有生产系统几乎都基于自回归模型，规划与长文写作继承左到右解码的低效性。
AI.method: 提出开源多智能体框架DiffResearch，在每个阶段使用扩散语言模型作为骨干；采用受控对比实验，固定agentic scaffold、检索代码、提示与评测，仅在开放dLLM与可比AR模型间切换骨干；并设计dFast分解模式，读取中间去噪状态、在生成完成前抽取子查询。
AI.result: 在100个Deep Research Bench任务上，扩散骨干端到端约快6倍，主要来自规划与写作阶段的数量级加速；dFast使分解单独运行时的中位加速达1.99倍且报告质量无损；在RACE评分标准下dFast取得三种配置中的最高总分；基于更强扩散模型的实例在公开系统级排行榜快照中超过若干商业系统。
AI.conclusion: 扩散骨干可在不损害报告质量的前提下显著降低深度研究的端到端延迟，并具备系统级竞争力；DiffResearch以Apache-2.0许可开源。

title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
summary: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

AI.tldr: SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination）以actor自身序列的重复想象rollout作为共享参考，同时缩放探索信号与计划接受判据，统一了世界模型下的探索与规划。
AI.motivation: 世界模型使智能体可在行动前比较想象结果，但仍存在两个未解决问题：探索哪些备选方案，以及何时用计划替换已学策略。作者认为二者可经由同一actor参考统一起来。
AI.method: 在同一模型状态上想象多个动作序列，对actor自身序列做重复rollout以度量固定行为下的波动作为参考；该参考同时缩放候选回报间的离散度（探索信号）与候选计划的预测优势（接受准则）。当计划优势超过参考波动固定倍数时执行计划，否则执行actor；复用基础智能体的世界模型、actor与critic，无需额外分歧集成。探索与规划用于训练数据收集，评估仅用学到的actor。含组件消融与稳健性分析，以及相同模拟器状态下的配对评估。
AI.result: 在Meta-World、Adroit、DM-Control三个套件上，SDI的任务平均分均高于所有对比基线，18个任务中15个达到或超过最强基线。相同状态配对评估显示，门控相比非门控规划同时改善actor失败后的恢复与成功行为的保持，并显著减少回报退化。
AI.conclusion: 以共享actor参考比较想象备选，是可作为世界模型下探索与规划统一方法的有效途径。

title: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG
summary: Scanning every passage in a long document seems thorough, but does it preserve more useful evidence or produce better answers? We compare 11 retrieval configurations spanning lexical and dense search, hybrid reranking, and full-document scanning with Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and Cloudflare Clef. Our evaluation uses 396 QASPER questions and 80 questions from eight complete textbooks, with common passages, a five-passage limit, and a fixed answer generator. On books, Hybrid + Jev achieves the highest observed evidence coverage (94.1%), compared with 88.7% for Jev full scan and 81.3\% for OpenAI dense retrieval. Full scans examine every passage initially, yet later reduction steps can discard relevant evidence. Higher evidence coverage also does not consistently produce better answers: Hybrid + Decisions achieves the highest observed book Answer Accuracy among retrieval methods (0.892), despite recovering less reference evidence. Full scanning incurs substantially higher latency on books under the tested deployments, while reusable dense retrieval has lower projected API cost than paid decision-based methods as queries accumulate. Most QASPER articles already fit within the hybrid candidate pool, limiting the benefit of scanning. These results highlight evidence retention, answer quality, and reuse cost as complementary criteria for choosing a long-document retrieval strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文比较11种检索配置（词法/稠密检索、混合重排、全文扫描，结合Jev、OpenAI Decisions、Cloudflare Clef），在396个QASPER问题和8本完整教材的80个问题上评估证据覆盖率、答案质量与成本，发现全文扫描并不必然带来更好的保留证据或答案。
AI.motivation: 直觉上"扫描长文档每个段落"似乎更彻底、更可能保留有用证据并给出更好答案，但这一假设缺乏系统比较验证；同时全文扫描在延迟与成本上代价高，需要明确证据保留、答案质量与复用成本三者之间的关系以指导长文档检索策略选择。
AI.method: 对比11种检索配置，涵盖词法检索、稠密检索、混合重排以及全文扫描，分别结合Jev、OpenAI Decisions、Cloudflare Clef三种系统；评估集为396个QASPER问题与来自8本完整教材的80个问题，控制共同段落、五段落上限与固定答案生成器，从而隔离检索环节的影响。
AI.result: 在书籍数据上，Hybrid+Jev取得最高证据覆盖率94.1%，Jev全文扫描为88.7%，OpenAI稠密检索为81.3%；全文扫描虽初始检查所有段落，但后续削减步骤可能丢弃相关证据。证据覆盖率更高并不稳定带来更好答案：Hybrid+Decisions在检索方法中取得最高书籍答案准确率0.892，尽管其恢复的参考证据较少。全文扫描在测试部署下延迟显著更高，而可复用的稠密检索在查询累积时预计API成本低于付费决策方法。多数QASPER文章本身已落在混合候选池内，扫描收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 全文扫描并不等同于更高的证据保留或更好的答案；证据保留、答案质量与复用成本应作为选择长文档检索策略的互补标准，而非单一优化目标。

title: Data-Driven Glyph Positioning for Handwritten Music Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 1 biblio page, presented at The 20th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition
summary: Synthesised data is a common strategy to address the lack of annotated handwritten music scores in Optical Music Recognition (OMR). Smashcima is a recent synthesis framework that assembles pages of handwritten scores by sampling glyph images from MUSCIMA++ and positioning them with hard-coded rules. In this work we ask whether these rules are grounded empirically and whether a learned model for context-dependent positioning can further improve synthesis quality. We extract inter-glyph distributions from around 285 thousand annotated relationships across MUSCIMA++ and OmniOMR, finding that several key parameters deviate systematically from real handwriting. Replacing these constants with empirical means reduces positioning RMSE by up to 60%. We then train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) on the Music Notation Graph structure to predict context-dependent offsets, achieving an additional 50 to 85% RMSE reduction on stems and beams by modelling how neighbouring glyphs constrain placement. Cross-dataset analysis shows that spacing differences between the two corpora are explained by note density (3.3), not style, and that duration-proportional spacing does not hold in handwriting (R2 = 0.001). In downstream evaluation, a YOLOv8 detector pretrained on GNN-positioned synthetic data achieves +30% mAP50 over the baseline and +11% over empirical means when fine-tuned on 200 real handwritten staves, showing that positioning accuracy matters for downstream OMR.

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验了Smashcima合成框架中硬编码的乐谱符号定位规则，并从MUSCIMA++与OmniOMR中提取经验分布以替代常数，进而训练GNN建模上下文相关偏移；合成数据的位置精度显著提升，并带来下游OMR检测性能增益。
AI.motivation: 手写乐谱标注数据稀缺，合成数据是光学音乐识别（OMR）常用对策，但Smashcima等框架依赖硬编码规则采样与摆放字形，其规则是否具有经验依据存疑，且缺乏对上下文相关定位的建模。
AI.method: 从MUSCIMA++与OmniOMR约28.5万条标注关系（inter-glyph relationships）中提取符号间距分布，与Smashcima常数对比；用经验均值替换常数；在Music Notation Graph结构上训练GNN预测上下文相关偏移量；并进行跨数据集分析与下游YOLOv8检测评估。
AI.result: 多个关键参数系统偏离真实手写；经验均值替换使定位RMSE最多降低60%，GNN在符干与符梁上进一步降低50–85% RMSE；两语料间距差异由音符密度（3.3）而非风格解释，时值比例间距在手写中不成立（R²=0.001）；在200个真实手写谱表上微调后，GNN定位合成数据预训练的YOLOv8相对基线mAP50 +30%，相对经验均值 +11%。
AI.conclusion: Smashcima的定位规则缺乏经验支撑，经验分布与学习式上下文建模可有效提升合成乐谱的真实性与下游OMR性能，说明定位精度对下游任务具有实质影响。

title: Wave Processing Unit: Closed-Form Matrix Synthesis for Wave Computing in Multiuser MIMO Communications
comment: Submitted to IEEE journals for possible publication
summary: Wave computing offers a compelling route to bypass the latency and energy bottlenecks of digital baseband processing. However, existing wave-domain processors rely on task-specific, non-convex iterative optimization, which incurs substantial configuration overhead and limits real-time applications. In this paper, we propose the wave processing unit (WPU), a programmable planar Mach--Zehnder interferometer (MZI) network that accelerates matrix--vector multiplications in MIMO communications. First, we model the tunable MZI element as a parameterized $2\times2$ unitary transformation, and establish a closed-form synthesis framework for the WPU that decomposes an arbitrary unitary matrix into a cascade of MZI elements arranged in a compact rectangular topology. To handle arbitrary complex-valued operators, we further extend the method through singular value decomposition (SVD) and a hardware-efficient semi-unitary synthesis, avoiding redundant hardware and reducing the compilation complexity. We then apply the WPU to multiuser downlink precoding by an efficient WPU synthesis method, and compare the proposed architecture with hybrid and wave-domain ones. Numerical results demonstrate machine-precision synthesis with negligible residuals for up to $64\times64$ operators, with approximately $380\times$ faster configuration than iterative wave computing baselines. For 64-antenna, 8-user downlink precoding, WPU requires 87.5% fewer RF chains than the fully digital architecture while achieving the same sum rate under ideal hardware. These results highlight the potential of the WPU for precise, hardware-efficient wave-domain processing with rapid configuration.

AI.tldr: 提出可编程平面MZI网络（WPU），通过闭式酉矩阵分解实现MIMO矩阵向量乘法的快速、精确波域加速。
AI.motivation: 现有波域处理器依赖任务特定、非凸的迭代优化，配置开销大，难以满足实时应用需求。
AI.method: 将可调MZI建模为参数化2×2酉变换，建立将任意酉矩阵分解为紧凑矩形拓扑MZI级联的闭式综合框架；用SVD与硬件高效的半酉综合扩展以处理任意复值算子，避免冗余硬件、降低编译复杂度；并将WPU用于多用户下行预编码。
AI.result: 对至多64×64算子实现机器精度综合且残差可忽略，配置速度约为迭代基线380倍；64天线8用户预编码下比全数字架构少87.5%射频链且理想硬件下和速率相同。
AI.conclusion: WPU可实现精确、硬件高效且可快速配置的波域处理，适合MIMO通信等实时场景。

title: Electrically Pumped Quadratic-Soliton Mode-Locked Laser in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
summary: Femtosecond mode-locked lasers are the workhorse of modern photonics, enabling optical atomic clocks, frequency combs, precision spectroscopy, and ultrafast signal processing. Bringing them onto nanophotonic chips promises miniaturized ultrafast systems, yet combining femtosecond pulse generation with electrical pumping remains a major challenge, rooted in a trade-off between the speed and energy efficiency of mode-locking mechanisms. Kerr-based mechanisms offer nearly instantaneous response but typically require high intracavity peak powers that are difficult to achieve with nanophotonic-compatible semiconductor gain. Conversely, semiconductor saturable absorbers enable strong nonlinear responses at low energies but are limited by their slow carrier dynamics. Here we break this trade-off by introducing quadratic-soliton mode-locking based on a quadratic nonlinear interferometer (QNLI): an effective saturable absorber built from cascaded second-order nonlinearity in periodically poled lithium niobate nanophotonics, with a measured sub-20 fs response time. Through hybrid integration with an electrically pumped semiconductor gain element, we demonstrate a self-starting quadratic-soliton mode-locked laser with femtojoule pulse energies, operating in single- and multiple-soliton states. Quadratic solitons arise through the QNLI's dissipative and dispersive nonlinear response, which we confirm with a modified complex Ginzburg-Landau equation in agreement with measurements. By combining soliton formation with intracavity electro-optic modulation, we generate 750 fs pulses with flat-top spectra. Our engineerable, ultra-energy-efficient, electrically powered laser provides the critical source for fully integrated ultrafast photonic circuits in lithium niobate nanophotonics that natively offers electro-optic control, quadratic wavelength conversion, pulse compression, and spectral broadening.

AI.tldr: 提出基于二次非线性干涉仪(QNLI)的二次孤子锁模机制，在薄膜铌酸锂平台上实现电泵浦、飞秒级、飞焦级能量的自启动锁模激光器。
AI.motivation: 将飞秒锁模激光器集成到纳米光子芯片上可实现小型化超快系统，但电泵浦与飞秒脉冲产生的结合受制于锁模机制在速度与能效之间的权衡：Kerr机制响应近乎瞬时但需高峰值功率，半导体可饱和吸收体低能量下响应强但载流子动力学慢。
AI.method: 利用周期极化铌酸锂纳米光子学中的级联二阶非线性构建二次非线性干涉仪(QNLI)作为有效可饱和吸收体，实测响应时间低于20 fs；与电泵浦半导体增益元件混合集成，实现自启动二次孤子锁模；采用修正的复金兹堡-朗道方程建模验证；并结合腔内电光调制。
AI.result: 实现自启动二次孤子锁模激光器，脉冲能量为飞焦量级，可工作于单孤子和多孤子态；模型与测量吻合；通过腔内电光调制产生750 fs、平顶光谱的脉冲。
AI.conclusion: 该可工程化、超高能效、电泵浦的激光源为铌酸锂纳米光子学中全集成超快光子电路提供关键光源，天然兼容电光调控、二次波长转换、脉冲压缩与光谱展宽。

title: Simply Logical -- The First Three Decades
summary: This paper charts the evolution of the Prolog textbook Simply Logical -- Intelligent Reasoning by Example from print with runnable programmes on a 3.5-inch diskette published in 1994, via various intermediate online versions, to the fully interactive online edition available today. Our aim is to investigate -- from both the writer's and the reader's perspectives -- the potential impact of technology on educational materials. The three authors of this paper present three distinct and complementary points of view, which come together to shape an interactive online book that offers an immersive learning experience. Peter describes the philosophy behind the original book and experiences teaching from it. Jan demonstrates how contemporary web programming has enabled a fully interactive realisation of the book's philosophy. Kacper reports how different technologies can be adopted to build a versatile authoring toolkit that underpins the interactive online edition of the book. Collating these distinct yet coherent perspectives allows us to reflect on future opportunities for interactive Prolog teaching materials arising from the continuous development of web technologies. The insights we offer should be of interest to teachers of Prolog as well as those wanting to find out about the latest educational technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理 Prolog 教材《Simply Logical — Intelligent Reasoning by Example》从1994年附带3.5英寸软盘可运行程序的纸质版，经多个中间在线版本，发展到如今完全交互式在线版的演化历程，并从作者与读者双重视角探讨技术对教育材料的潜在影响。
AI.motivation: 探究技术（尤其是Web技术）如何影响教育材料的设计与使用体验，并总结Prolog教学材料在持续演进的Web技术下所面临的未来机遇。
AI.method: 采用三位作者互补视角的案例式回顾：(1) Peter 阐述原书的教学理念及基于该书的教学经验；(2) Jan 说明当代Web编程如何实现对原书理念的完全交互式落地；(3) Kacper 介绍如何用多种技术构建支撑该交互式在线版的多功能创作工具链。最后整合三种视角进行反思。
AI.result: 形成了融合原书教学理念、现代Web交互实现与灵活创作工具链的沉浸式交互在线教材，并归纳出三方视角汇聚所揭示的技术赋能路径与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 交互式在线教材的构建需要教学理念、Web交互技术与创作工具三者的协同；持续发展的Web技术为Prolog及其他编程语言教学材料提供了新的交互式设计空间，对Prolog教师及教育技术关注者具有参考价值。

title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
summary: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 Transformer 电力负荷预测模型在 3/5/7/16 状态极低比特权重量化下的可保持性，比较 PTQ、QAT-FT 与 Scratch-QAT，并提出 accumulated-update thresholding 以大幅减少权重状态切换。
AI.motivation: 激进低状态权重量化会显著削弱神经网络表征灵活性，在仅有少量离散权重状态时难以保持预测性能；作者希望在 Transformer 电力负荷预测任务中刻画该区间的可量化损失与可恢复性。
AI.method: 在两个共主电力消耗数据集上，以过去 48 小时预测未来 1 小时或 24 小时；采用 3、5、7、16 状态权重量化，分别考察仅前馈层与注意力+前馈层量化；对比直接 PTQ、量化感知微调（QAT-FT）与随机初始化量化感知训练（Scratch-QAT），并提出 accumulated-update thresholding：累积优化器建议的权重更新后再提交。
AI.result: 直接 PTQ 使平均 NRMSE 相对全精度分别上升 6.25 与 7.04 个百分点（数据集 A、B）；QAT-FT 分别恢复约 90.2% 与 94.5% 的损失；Scratch-QAT 亦具竞争力，3 状态时表现尤佳。相比配对的 Scratch-QAT 对照，accumulated-update thresholding 将已提交影子权重更新减少约 99.7%，离散状态切换减少约 77–80%，平均 NRMSE 仅变化 +0.042 与 +0.197 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在高度离散权重表征下仍可保留可用的 Transformer 负荷预测性能，同时显著抑制目标状态活动，为基于多电平突触器件的紧凑、低活动边缘预测提供了可行路径。

title: Language Impairment as a Lens onto Large Language Models
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) encode language in highly distributed spaces, they remain vulnerable to focal disruptions---a phenomenon strikingly similar to how localized brain damage causes clinical aphasia in humans. To investigate this theoretical tension, we ask whether LLMs possess a functional structure analogous to the human language system, by introducing a novel mechanistic interpretability framework inspired by aphasia. Through two complementary approaches, classifier-guided lesioning and continuous activation steering, we systematically induce aphasia-like breakdowns in LLMs. We find that language functions can be successfully isolated to discrete structural circuits and continuous representational vectors, yet these functions remain densely entangled with significant circuit overlap and vector similarities across distinct aphasic profiles. Furthermore, while steering generalizes robustly across downstream tasks, structural lesioning remains asymmetrically constrained. By bridging neuropsychology and mechanistic interpretability, we demonstrate that LLMs, functionally analogous to biological brains, rely on a densely entangled architecture that can be systematically mapped through clinically-informed interventions.

AI.tldr: 论文借鉴失语症研究，提出新的机制可解释性框架，用分类器引导的病灶消融与连续激活引导两种方法在大语言模型中系统性诱发类失语症的语言功能崩解，发现语言功能既可定位于离散的电路与表征向量，又在不同失语症剖面间高度纠缠、重叠，且激活引导的泛化性强于结构性消融。
AI.motivation: LLM虽以高度分布式方式编码语言，却对"局灶性破坏"高度敏感，这一现象与人类局部脑损伤导致临床失语症高度相似。作者由此提出理论张力问题：LLM是否具备与人类语言系统类似的功能结构，并希望通过神经心理学视角的机制可解释性框架加以检验。
AI.method: 受失语症启发构建新的机制可解释性框架，采用两种互补手段：分类器引导的病灶消融（classifier-guided lesioning，定位离散结构电路）与连续激活引导（continuous activation steering，定位连续表征向量），在LLM中系统性诱发类失语症的功能崩解，并考察其在下游任务上的泛化性与约束特性。
AI.result: 语言功能可被成功隔离到离散的结构电路与连续的表征向量中；但这些功能仍与大量成分密集纠缠，不同失语症剖面之间存在显著的电路重叠与向量相似性。此外，激活引导能稳健泛化到下游任务，而结构性消融则受到不对称约束。
AI.conclusion: LLM在功能上类比于生物大脑，依赖一种密集纠缠的架构，且该架构可通过临床启发的干预手段被系统性映射；研究架起了神经心理学与机制可解释性之间的桥梁。

title: MINER: Modeling Inter- and Intra-Person Variance for Reidentification
comment: Paper accepted to the WACV 2027 Algorithms track
summary: Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification (CC-ReID) remains challenging due to drastic appearance shifts across outfits. Most prior works devise biometric signal-extraction heuristics to enhance inter-person variance, e.g., using segmentation masks, while leaving intra-person variance uncontrolled. We present MINER, a simple model-agnostic framework that suppresses garment bias by contrasting hard examples and adaptively balancing dataset-dependent intra- and inter-person variance. Extensive experiments show that MINER improves retrieval across CC-ReID benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance on four datasets and ranking among the leaders in all three tracks of the open TVRID RGB-Depth ReID challenge.

AI.tldr: MINER 是一个模型无关框架，通过对比难样本并自适应平衡数据集相关的人内/人间方差来抑制服装偏置，在四个 CC-ReID 基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 换衣行人重识别（CC-ReID）中外观跨服装剧变，现有方法多依赖分割掩码等生物特征信号提取的启发式手段来增强人间方差，但人内方差未受控制。
AI.method: 提出 MINER：简单、模型无关的框架，通过对难样本进行对比学习抑制服装偏置，并自适应地平衡数据集相关的人内方差与人间方差。
AI.result: 在多个 CC-ReID 基准上提升检索性能，在四个数据集上达到 SOTA，并在开放 TVRID RGB-Depth ReID 挑战赛全部三个赛道中位居前列。
AI.conclusion: 控制人内方差与服装偏置是提升 CC-ReID 的有效途径，MINER 具备通用性与模型无关优势，可广泛适用。

title: Delay-Doppler Domain Aided OFDM (DD-a-OFDM): Pulsone Pilot and Cross-Domain Iterative Receiver Design
summary: In high-mobility channels, the widely adopted orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation waveform suffers from significant performance degradation due to channel variation and severe inter-carrier interference. Although delay-Doppler (DD) domain multicarrier (DDMC) modulation enjoys a higher channel estimation (CE) accuracy via exploiting the inherent DD-domain channel stability, sparsity, and separability, its high detection complexity limits its practical deployment, making OFDM still a promising waveform candidate for the sixth-generation (6G) cellular networks. To simultaneously harness the complementary strengths of DDMC and OFDM and mitigate their respective limitations, this paper proposes a DD-domain aided OFDM (DD-a-OFDM) framework, including a pulsone pilot (PP) design and a cross-domain iterative receiver design, to enhance the CE and detection performance of OFDM in high-mobility channels. Specifically, a pulsone pilot sequence is periodically inserted before the cyclic prefix (CP) for each OFDM symbol in the time-domain, which is equivalent to a single DD-domain pilot impulse and enables accurate DD-domain CE. Then, we propose a cross-domain iterative receiver in which the time-frequency (TF) domain detection results are transformed into the DD-domain for interference cancellation and CE; in turn, the DD-domain estimated channel is transformed into the TF-domain for channel reconstruction and symbol detection. The proposed cross-domain iterative receiver achieves a higher CE accuracy and detection performance with a much lower pilot overhead, compared to the conventional OFDM system. Simulation results validate the fast convergence and superior performance of the proposed DD-a-OFDM scheme and demonstrate that it maintains a robust CE and detection performance even in high-mobility channels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DD域辅助的OFDM（DD-a-OFDM）框架，通过脉音（pulsone）导频设计与跨域迭代接收机，在低导频开销下提升高移动信道中OFDM的信道估计与检测性能。
AI.motivation: 高移动信道下OFDM受信道时变与严重载波间干扰影响，性能显著下降；DDMC虽利用DD域信道的稳定性、稀疏性和可分性获得更高信道估计精度，但检测复杂度过高难以实用。因此需要融合DDMC与OFDM的互补优势，同时规避各自缺陷。
AI.method: 1）导频设计：在每个OFDM符号的循环前缀（CP）前周期性插入脉音导频序列，其时域形式等效于单个DD域导频冲激，从而实现精确的DD域信道估计；2）接收机设计：提出跨域迭代接收机，将时频（TF）域检测结果变换至DD域用于干扰消除与信道估计，再将DD域估计信道变换回TF域用于信道重建与符号检测，形成闭环迭代。
AI.result: 仿真验证了所提DD-a-OFDM方案具有快速收敛性；相比传统OFDM系统，在更低导频开销下获得更高的信道估计精度与检测性能；在高移动信道中仍保持稳健的信道估计与检测性能。
AI.conclusion: DD-a-OFDM通过DD域导频与跨域迭代处理，有效结合DDMC的信道估计优势与OFDM的低复杂度检测优势，为6G高移动场景提供了一种兼顾性能与复杂度的波形增强方案。

title: Phonon-assisted free-electron recoil control and mechanical sensing
summary: Mechanical vibrations are fundamental to a wide range of physical phenomena and technologies, yet their ability to actively shape free-electron dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here we theoretically show how an optomechanical membrane provides a phonon-assisted optical interface for controlling free-electron recoil and sensing localized forces. Transverse membrane motion scatters cavity light into high-momentum evanescent sidebands that enable phase-matched interaction with electrons traveling in vacuum. Beyond supplying momentum for phase matching, the vibration amplitude controls the electron-light interaction strength and redistributes electron populations among recoil orders. External forces that perturb the vibration are thereby encoded in the electron recoil spectrum. Under the modeled conditions, electron readout of localized stochastic forces can yield a higher signal-to-noise ratio than a Gaussian optical homodyne benchmark at equal detected probe rates. These results provide a theoretical basis for mechanically reconfigurable free-electron optics and mode-selective mechanical sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文理论提出利用光机械薄膜的振动作为声子辅助的光学接口，通过倏逝边带实现与真空自由电子的相位匹配相互作用，从而控制电子反冲并传感局域力。
AI.motivation: 机械振动普遍存在，但其主动塑造自由电子动力学的能力尚少被探索；作者希望建立机械可重构的自由电子光学与模式选择性力学传感的理论基础。
AI.method: 理论上分析薄膜横向运动将腔光散射为高动量倏逝边带，使其与真空传播电子相位匹配；振动幅度不仅提供相位匹配所需动量，还调控电子-光相互作用强度并重新分配电子在各反冲阶间的布居。外力扰动振动后编码于电子反冲谱中，并建模与高斯光学零拍探测基准在相同探测速率下的信噪比比较。
AI.result: 在建模条件下，电子对局域随机力的读出信噪比可高于等探测率的高斯光学零拍基准。
AI.conclusion: 结果为机械可重构的自由电子光学与模式选择性力学传感提供了理论依据。

title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
summary: Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights. After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT. Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher. Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.

AI.tldr: D-Skill 将教师模型视为黑盒，通过对比成对轨迹把其行为优势蒸馏为可解释的自然语言“技能文档”，在推理时提供给小模型，无需权重更新即可弥合 75%–95% 的师生差距。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型在复杂任务上表现优异但推理成本高，需向小模型迁移能力。传统知识蒸馏依赖参数更新，要求访问学生权重、额外训练算力，且知识隐式编码于参数中、缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出 D-Skill 框架：教师作为黑盒，分析教师与学生的成对 rollout，识别行为分歧与一致之处；将经验离线整合为自然语言技能文档（可接入任意兼容的技能更新后端）；在推理时把该文档作为上下文提供给学生。整个过程仅基于固定轨迹离线完成，无需标签、额外环境交互或权重更新。
AI.result: 在 SpreadsheetBench-Verified、ALFWorld 与国际象棋谜题上，跨多组师生配对，D-Skill 在不改动模型权重的情况下弥合 75%–95% 的师生差距；单次离线处理即优于一 epoch SFT 基线，并与多 epoch SFT 持平；同模型族下学生每任务推理成本比教师低 5.7–8.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言技能蒸馏是性能良好、可解释且高效的能力迁移替代方案，可与基于权重的蒸馏互补或替代。

title: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.

AI.tldr: 该文利用"奖励分歧"指导 MCP 工具调用环境中 harness 评测与 rollout 预算分配，提出 Discord 评测方法与 BRACE 前瞻性分配策略；BRACE 以更少的训练 rollout 超过最强基线，并在 BFCL、NESTFUL 上领先。
AI.motivation: 训练工具使用型语言模型需昂贵交互；同一 rollout 组内奖励完全相同则缺乏组相对学习信号（无梯度/无对比信息），因此需要识别并优先采集"混合奖励"样本以提升训练效率，同时需要可靠的 harness 评测手段。
AI.method: 1) Discord：用精确配对推理与"决策保持的早停"评测 harness 修改，仅当配对结果出现分歧时才判定某 harness 更优；2) BRACE（Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes）：结合历史任务证据、任务成功率不确定性与相关奖励模型，在分配生成预算前预测哪些 rollout 组会出现混合奖励；3) 消融覆盖 history bank、估计器与分配打分，并做前瞻性校准检验。
AI.result: 受控 harness 实验支持 Discord；在线 MCP 实验揭示留存-成本权衡；在三种 Qwen3-VL 规模下，BRACE 以更少的新训练 rollout 超过最强绘制的基线峰值（历史 bank 采集单独计费）；未再训练即在 BFCL 与 NESTFUL 上领先对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 奖励分歧是可行的信号来源：可用于 harness 选择与前瞻性 rollout 分配，支持"在生成前预测奖励对比度"这一核心主张。

title: Target Regeneration Shrinks the Gains of Draft-Training Objectives in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language models by verifying drafted tokens in parallel. New draft-training objectives are usually credited with the acceptance they add over cross-entropy on externally written responses, yet many pipelines let the target rewrite them. We ask how much of that gain survives. With a vision-language target and a block drafter, we train three objectives on four versions of one corpus: cross-entropy on corpus tokens, token-level distillation from the target, and distillation gated to positions that would survive verification. Distillation and the gate add large gains on external responses, but after greedy regeneration, distillation adds a smaller gain and the gate little or none. The shrinkage persists across data orders, position weights, verifiers, decoding temperatures and, for distillation, initializations and learning rates. Most of it remains at matched supervised length and at each objective's best measured training length. A second vision corpus shows the shrinkage, as does a text-only replication, for distillation also with an autoregressive drafter. Objective gains should therefore be measured against a target-regenerated baseline and across training lengths. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRegeneration.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验投机解码中"新草稿训练目标带来的接受率增益"在目标模型重写训练响应后还剩多少，发现大部分增益消失，呼吁以目标再生成基线来衡量目标增益。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的新草稿训练目标（如蒸馏、验证门控蒸馏）通常在外部撰写的响应上相对交叉熵显示出大幅接受率提升，但许多流程实际会用目标模型重写这些响应。作者质疑：这些增益在响应被目标模型重新生成后能否保留，以及现有评估基线是否高估了目标本身的贡献。
AI.method: 以视觉-语言目标模型与块式草稿模型为设置，在单一语料的四个版本上训练三种目标：语料token上的交叉熵、来自目标的token级蒸馏、以及仅在能通过验证的位置上加权的门控蒸馏。随后用贪心再生成改写响应，比较增益变化，并做消融：数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度、初始化与学习率、匹配的监督长度、各目标最佳训练长度；另在第二个视觉语料及纯文本复现中验证，蒸馏部分还用自回归草稿模型复现。
AI.result: 在外部响应上，蒸馏与门控均带来大幅增益；但经贪心再生成后，蒸馏增益显著缩小，门控几乎无增益。该收缩在数据顺序、位置权重、验证器、解码温度及蒸馏的初始化与学习率上均持续存在；大部分收缩在匹配监督长度和各目标最佳训练长度下依然存在。第二视觉语料、纯文本复现以及自回归草稿模型下的蒸馏均再现该现象。
AI.conclusion: 草稿训练目标的增益应在目标模型再生成的基线上、并跨多个训练长度进行度量；否则易高估新目标相对交叉熵的真实收益。代码已开源。

title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
summary: Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/.

AI.tldr: 提出无需配对视频的Coarse-to-real (C2R#) 视频生成框架：利用易得的real-to-coarse图像对训练DINO-R2C在DINO特征空间做真实→粗糙转换，逐帧合成伪粗糙视频，从而仅用真实视频训练C2R#模型，推理时丢弃DINO-R2C，直接用真实粗糙视频驱动。
AI.motivation: C2R视频生成旨在将粗糙动画/仿真/游戏渲染视频转为照片级真实视频，同时保持场景布局、相机运动与动态。但训练需要对齐的(coarse, realistic)视频对，制作昂贵，且导致现有系统局限于狭窄的合成域。作者观察到一种不对称性：配对视频难以获得，但配对的real-to-coarse图像可用现有编辑与3D重建工具轻松构建。
AI.method: 先用编辑/3D重建工具构造图像级real→coarse配对，训练DINO-R2C模型在DINO特征空间将真实图像转换为粗糙图像；再将其逐帧应用于普通真实视频，合成伪粗糙视频；用(伪粗糙, 真实)视频对训练C2R#模型学习从伪粗糙生成真实视频。推理阶段丢弃DINO-R2C，由真实粗糙视频直接驱动C2R#。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标；主要结果是训练摆脱了(coarse, realistic)视频对的依赖，使模型可随任意真实视频语料扩展，而非受限于配对的合成视频规模。作者将公开模型与项目页面。
AI.conclusion: 以图像级配对替代视频级配对是一种简单有效的"pair-free"训练范式，可突破C2R数据瓶颈并泛化到更广泛的真实视频域。

title: Pilot Decontamination via Data-aided Channel Tracking in Cell-free Massive MIMO
summary: As cell-free massive MIMO emerges as a promising technology for future wireless networks, robust channel estimation becomes increasingly important. Channel estimation relies on pilot transmissions, and with increasing number of users, pilot reuse inevitably introduces contamination that degrades channel estimation and symbol detection. This limitation is compounded by rapidly evolving channels, which render the estimates obsolete over time. To address both the problems, viz. pilot contamination and channel aging without additional pilot overhead, we propose a Kalman filter-based data-aided channel tracking strategy. By leveraging the symbol estimates as virtual pilots, the proposed approach successively refines the channel estimates over time. Unlike the conventional Kalman filter model, here, the observation model depends on symbol estimates, introducing symbol uncertainty that gets coupled with channel uncertainty. This requires a careful calculation of the innovation covariance matrices. Additionally, we discuss a stochastic-gradient-descent based tracking approach with low computational complexity. Extensive simulations are used to demonstrate that successive refinement progressively decontaminates the channel estimate, achieving lower channel estimation error and improved spectral efficiency.

AI.tldr: 针对无蜂窝大规模MIMO中的导频污染与信道老化问题，提出基于卡尔曼滤波的数据辅助信道跟踪策略，利用符号估计作为"虚拟导频"在无额外导频开销下逐步精化信道估计。
AI.motivation: 无蜂窝大规模MIMO中用户数增加导致导频复用不可避免，产生导频污染；信道快速变化又使估计随时间失效（信道老化）。传统方法需增加导频开销才能同时应对这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出卡尔曼滤波（Kalman filter）数据辅助信道跟踪：以符号估计作为虚拟导频，随时间迭代精化信道估计。由于观测模型依赖符号估计，符号不确定性会与信道不确定性耦合，需仔细计算新息协方差矩阵（innovation covariance matrices）。另给出低计算复杂度的随机梯度下降（SGD）跟踪方案作为替代。
AI.result: 大量仿真表明，逐步精化可渐进地去污染信道估计，获得更低的信道估计误差和更高的频谱效率。
AI.conclusion: 数据辅助的信道跟踪可在不增加导频开销的前提下同时缓解导频污染与信道老化，滤波器设计中正确处理符号-信道不确定性耦合是关键。

title: Back Up Before You Regret: Measuring Backup Awareness and Automating Backup in Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. To evaluate backup awareness, we introduce RegretBench, a benchmark of 205 executable tasks grounded in regret moments reported on platforms such as X.com, GitHub, and Stack Overflow, where users explicitly regretted not preserving state they later needed. Across six frontier models, agents complete 86.1% of tasks on average yet back up before these moments in only 15.2%, showing that task completion ability does not imply backup awareness. Because it is hard to predict which changes will be regretted, we propose BackUpper, a harness plug-in backup layer that checks every tool call and preserves affected state before modification. It combines rule-based strategies for common operations with a lightweight subagent for complex cases, and its rule table can expand with subagent decisions over time. On RegretBench, BackUpper covers every regret moment action and restores states with 92.2% average similarity to the original. Achieving this costs only $0.014 per task, with 7x fewer tokens than the main-agent self-backup baseline. When users have preferences on what to back up, BackUpper can also narrow its scope accordingly, matching human annotations on whether an action is worth preserving with an 84.5% F1 score. These results suggest that agents can keep actions reversible at low cost while respecting users' preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RegretBench 基准（205 个可执行任务）量化编码智能体的“备份意识”，发现六个前沿模型平均完成 86.1% 任务但仅在 15.2% 的后悔时刻前备份；并提出即插即用备份框架 BackUpper，基于规则与轻量子代理在每次工具调用前保存受影响状态，实现 100% 后悔时刻覆盖、92.2% 平均状态恢复相似度、每任务仅 $0.014 且 token 消耗为主代理自备份基线的 1/7。
AI.motivation: 自主编码智能体会修改工件、软件环境与配置等真实世界状态，但缺乏“备份意识”：难以在行动前识别该状态未来可能被需要并预先保存，导致不可逆的后悔性损失。
AI.method: 构建 RegretBench：取材于 X.com、GitHub、Stack Overflow 上用户明确后悔未保存状态的真实案例，含 205 个可执行任务；提出 BackUpper，作为 harness 插件式备份层拦截每次工具调用并在修改前保存受影响状态，结合常见操作的规则化策略与处理复杂情形的轻量子代理，规则表可随子代理决策持续扩充。
AI.result: RegretBench 上六个前沿模型平均任务完成率 86.1%，但后悔时刻前备份率仅 15.2%；BackUpper 覆盖全部后悔时刻动作，恢复状态与原状态平均相似度 92.2%，每任务成本 $0.014，token 消耗为主代理自备份基线的 1/7；在用户偏好约束下可将备份范围收窄，判定动作是否值得保存与人工标注的 F1 达 84.5%。
AI.conclusion: 任务完成能力不等价于备份意识；通过在工具调用层外置通用备份机制，智能体可在低成本下保持动作可逆，并能尊重用户偏好，为构建可后悔、可回滚的智能体系统提供可行路径。

title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
summary: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. For native velocity objectives, multi-budget endpoint supervision applies the same principle without replacing the native update. Both realizations preserve the architecture and deployment-time cost. Across DM Control, manipulation, and locomotion, ArcFlow attains the highest mean one-step return among five flow-policy baselines on 25 of 30 tasks under each method's reported training settings. Component studies identify complementary improvements from boundary supervision, the fixed-grid bridge, budget exposure, and deployment selection. These results establish deployment-budget-aware training as an effective route to strong low-step control with one policy serving multiple inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArcFlow，在指定求解器预算范围内训练单一 flow 策略，实现部署预算感知的强化学习，在低步数推理下保持强控制性能。
AI.motivation: Flow-matching 策略通过求解器步数调节推理成本，但固定单一预算的 RL 训练可能掩盖更廉价部署预算下的性能退化，甚至抹除预训练策略中有用的一步行为。
AI.method: ArcFlow 结合动作对齐监督、预算暴露与最差预算检查点选择。对重建目标，其 bridge 将时间探测聚合为单一替代比率与每动作的 PPO 式裁剪，边界残差恰等于部署的一步重建误差；循环暴露使共享场覆盖部署范围，选择优化性能下限。对原生速度目标，采用多预算端点监督且不替换原生更新。两种实现均保持架构与部署成本不变。
AI.result: 在 DM Control、操作与运动任务上，ArcFlow 在各方法报告的设置下于 30 个任务中的 25 个取得五种 flow 策略基线中最高的平均一步回报；消融研究确认边界监督、固定网格 bridge、预算暴露与部署选择的互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 部署预算感知训练是获得强低步控制、并以单一策略服务多种推理成本的有效途径。

title: Our Own Jev: Typed Decisions in One Forward Pass, from an In-House Judge to Open LoRA Models
summary: A typed decision maps evidence, a question and a fixed set of options to a probability for every option, computed in one forward pass, by reading a language model's logits or a small head over its hidden states, instead of generating and parsing text. The commercial system Jev popularised this System~1 interface, and open reproductions have followed. We report two uses of the pattern. \emph{Part I} describes an in-house System~1 judge that triages about 148K agentic coding session records for a training corpus. It replaces a frontier LLM judge that cost on the order of \$1,000 per pass and whose stored labels matched a fresh two-judge consensus on only 26.9\% of the sessions where the two judges agreed; a self-hosted frozen backbone with a rank-16 LoRA adapter and a pointer head answers three typed questions in one forward pass, judges 1,000 sessions in about three minutes of one GPU, about \$0.06 at a reference rate and roughly 1\% of the frontier judge's cost, and keeps every session inside the organisation. \emph{Part II} asks whether a readout that adds no parameters can be competitive and whether training one helps. Applying the public Eikos recipe and corpus of about 25K decisions to three further backbones (1B, 2B and 35B), we read the frozen output layer of a LoRA-adapted decoder. On the 111 public hard items of JevBench our single-seed 35B, developed with those items in view, scores 79.3\%, not significantly different from the commercial reference (73.0\%, unadjusted $p=0.12$) and ahead of five open systems after Holm--Bonferroni correction; our 2B is ahead of all four kev checkpoints on the leaderboard. A single-seed ablation finds no detectable benefit from training the 26 letter rows of the output layer, and a retrain on a later corpus release moves the 2B's hard-tier accuracy by 11.7 points, which shows how little small evaluations resolve.

AI.tldr: 本文报告"typed decision map"（类型化决策映射）这一System-1式接口的两种应用：Part I构建内部廉价判官对约148K智能体编程会话记录进行分诊；Part II在Eikos配方下验证无参数读出层是否可竞争，并考察训练输出层字母行是否有益。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿LLM判官成本高昂（约$1,000/轮）且存储标签与新鲜双判官共识仅26.9%一致，缺乏廉价、可私有化部署的替代方案；同时需检验无参数读出能否与商业系统（如Jev）竞争。
AI.method: Part I：自托管冻结骨干+rank-16 LoRA+指针头，单次前向回答三个类型化问题。Part II：采用Eikos公开配方与约25K决策语料，在1B/2B/35B三个骨干上读取LoRA适配解码器的冻结输出层，并在JevBench 111个公开难题上评估，含Single-seed消融（训练输出层26个字母行）及后续语料重训。
AI.result: Part I：1,000会话约3分钟单GPU、约$0.06（参考费率），约为前沿判官成本的1%，数据不出组织。Part II：单seed 35B在JevBench难题得79.3%，与商业参考73.0%无显著差异（未校正p=0.12），Holm–Bonferroni校正后优于五个开放系统；2B优于排行榜上全部四个kev检查点。消融未发现训练26个字母行可检测收益；换用后续语料重训使2B难题档准确率变动11.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策映射可作为低成本、可私有化的高效判官；无参数读出已具竞争力，训练输出层字母行无明显收益，且小规模评测的方差极大，结论稳健性有限。

title: RoPT: Robust 6DoF Object Pose Tracking in Video
summary: Accurate 6-DoF object pose tracking is essential for robotic interaction, yet conventional monocular pipelines frequently suffer from catastrophic divergence under rapid object motion. We present RoPT, a robust tracking framework engineered to overcome this limitation by unifying visual perception, temporal kinematics, and global re-localization into a tightly coupled closed loop. Unlike existing open-loop trackers, RoPT delivers three critical capabilities that fundamentally alter system resilience. First, the visual perception component tracks object masks to robustly handle partial and severe occlusions. Second, a kinematic factor graph regularizes frame-to-frame updates, forecasts forward pose predictions, and drives a parallel multi-hypothesis verification scheme to bypass local minima. Finally, an active re-localization module transforms the pipeline into a closed-loop system, making it failure-aware and capable of deterministic self-recovery. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework across challenging benchmarks alongside real-world robotic demonstrations, achieving significantly higher tracking survivability under rapid motion.

AI.tldr: 提出RoPT框架，将视觉感知、时序运动学与全局重定位紧耦合为闭环6-DoF物体位姿跟踪系统，显著提升快速运动下的跟踪存活率。
AI.motivation: 单目6-DoF位姿跟踪对机器人交互至关重要，但传统单目流水线在物体快速运动时易发生灾难性发散，且现有跟踪器多为开环结构，缺乏失效检测与自恢复能力。
AI.method: 三项核心设计：(1) 视觉感知模块跟踪物体掩码，稳健应对部分及严重遮挡；(2) 运动学因子图正则化帧间更新、进行前向位姿预测，并驱动并行多假设验证以跳出局部极小；(3) 主动重定位模块将流水线转为闭环，实现失效感知与确定性自恢复。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准及真实机器人演示中验证，快速运动条件下跟踪存活率（tracking survivability）显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过感知—运动学—重定位的紧耦合闭环设计，RoPT突破了开环跟踪器在快速运动下的发散瓶颈，具备遮挡鲁棒性与确定性自恢复能力。

title: Multiuser Channel Estimation in FIM Systems: A Structured Block Term Decomposition Approach
summary: Flexible intelligent metasurfaces (FIMs) create geometry-dependent array responses that provide spatial diversity but complicate multiuser channel estimation. This paper studies uplink estimation using pilot observations collected under multiple prescribed and calibrated morphing configurations. Each user contributes a matrix--vector block that couples its diagonal reference-array response with its morphing-dependent phases, while its third-mode vector is the known pilot scaled by the complex channel gain. We develop a pilot-constrained structured block term decomposition (BTD) estimator whose alternating least-squares updates exploit both the known pilot directions and the diagonal spatial factors. The undeformed configuration sets the columnwise scaling convention, and a unit first-entry normalization assigns the remaining block scale to the channel gain. Matching the recovered factors to the calibrated spatial--morphing manifold then yields the physical angles and configuration-dependent channels. We characterize the rank conditions for unique conditional least-squares updates, distinguish these conditions from global factor and physical-angle identifiability, and summarize the training, coherence-time, and computational requirements. Simulations show accurate two-dimensional angle and channel recovery in the tested settings, equal total pilot-symbol overhead in rigid-panel comparisons, improved steering-vector estimates as morphing diversity increases, and degradation as user loading or pilot correlation increases.

AI.tldr: 针对柔性智能超表面（FIM）多用户上行信道估计，提出导频约束的结构化块项分解（BTD）估计器，利用多组形变配置下的观测联合恢复物理角度与形变相关信道。
AI.motivation: FIM 的几何形变带来依赖于配置的阵列响应，可提供空间分集，但也使多用户信道估计复杂化：每个用户的观测是参考阵列对角响应与形变相位的耦合，传统方法难以直接处理。
AI.method: 在多个预设且已校准的形变配置下采集导频观测；每个用户贡献一个矩阵—向量块，耦合其对角参考阵列响应与形变相关相位，第三模态向量为已知导频乘以复信道增益。据此构建导频约束的结构化 BTD 估计器，交替最小二乘更新同时利用已知导频方向与对角空间因子；以未形变配置设定列尺度约定，并用首元素单位化归一化将剩余块尺度归给信道增益；再将恢复因子匹配到校准的空间—形变流形，得到物理角度与配置相关信道。文中还给出了条件最小二乘更新唯一性的秩条件，并区分其与全局因子、物理角度可辨识性，总结训练、相干时间与计算量需求。
AI.result: 仿真表明：在测试设置下可实现准确的三维（二维角度+信道）恢复；与刚性面板对比总导频符号开销相同；随形变分集增大，导向矢量估计改善；用户负载或导频相关性上升时性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 多形变配置下的结构化 BTD 可有效利用 FIM 的形变分集完成多用户上行角度与信道联合估计，且不增加导频开销；其性能受用户数与导频相关性的限制，秩条件与可辨识性需分别分析。

title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出基于MPPI的测试时框架，将多分支预测分析与经验驱动自适应结合，使LLM智能体在部署中通过想象候选动作后果并借助双分支经验记忆自我改进。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需在部署中与环境交互并改进决策，但如何联合"预见未来结果"与"利用累积交互经验"支持决策仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 受Model Predictive Path Integral控制启发：每步生成多个候选动作，用世界模型想象其结果以避免真实执行；因语言环境无显式动态与代价，对预测结果从任务进展与风险两方面评估，并以MPPI式权重聚合代价指导决策；引入双分支经验记忆，规划分支改进候选生成与动作选择，世界模型分支改进下一观测预测。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与ScienceWorld上、三种骨干模型上实验，方法整体性能强劲，并验证了经验引导预测控制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 经验引导的预测控制在LLM智能体测试时决策中有效，前瞻想象与经验记忆可协同提升决策与预测能力；代码将公开。

title: CALLIOPE: Private Insights into AI Use, Without Embeddings
summary: We introduce CALLIOPE, a top-down framework for discovering topic hierarchies in large corpora of unstructured data (e.g., LLM conversations), while supporting differential privacy (DP). Unlike traditional and even recent LLM-augmented approaches that ultimately rely on clustering vector embeddings, our framework leverages LLM capabilities directly for the entire pipeline. Experiments demonstrate that this approach provides better utility over existing (embedding-based) methods in the DP setting, especially in the high privacy regime. We evaluate the quality of CALLIOPE outputs using a variety of traditionally studied clustering metrics, as well as some novel utility metrics that we introduce.

AI.tldr: 提出CALLIOPE框架，直接利用LLM在差分隐私（DP）约束下从大规模无结构语料（如LLM对话）中发现主题层次结构，性能优于基于嵌入的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有主题层次发现方法（包括近期LLM增强方法）最终仍依赖对向量嵌入进行聚类，在DP设置下效用受限，尤其在高隐私预算（强隐私）情形下表现不佳。
AI.method: 采用自顶向下的LLM驱动流水线，全程直接调用LLM能力完成主题层次发现，而非依赖嵌入聚类，并在框架中支持差分隐私。
AI.result: 实验表明在DP设置下CALLIOPE相比基于嵌入的现有方法具有更高效用，在高隐私保护程度下优势尤为明显；同时使用传统聚类指标及新提出的效用指标进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM直接驱动整条流水线的自顶向下框架是在DP约束下发现主题层次的有效途径，为隐私保护下的无结构数据主题挖掘提供了新范式。

title: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Prompting
summary: This paper proposes Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought (RE-ZS-CoT), a prompting framework that systematically integrates domain-specific expert roles to enhance reasoning in large language models (LLMs) without task-specific examples. We assess two versions of our approach. In the first version, static role selection, we evaluate eight predefined expert roles across arithmetic, commonsense, and reading comprehension benchmarks to determine their impact on reasoning performance. In the second version, dynamic role selection, each model autonomously selects the single most suitable role for each benchmark, enabling adaptive task-role alignment without manual specification. Across 20 LLMs and seven benchmarks, RE-ZS-CoT frequently surpasses zero-shot and zero-shot-CoT baselines, achieving performance improvements of up to 44 percentage points. The results reveal a strong correspondence between static and dynamic versions; the benchmarks where static roles yielded improvements were almost always those where dynamic roles also outperformed baselines, though static selection achieved peak performance. Ablation studies further show that unconventional roles degrade performance, underscoring the necessity of task-role alignment. The framework's scalability is validated across model sizes (2b-14b parameters), with smaller models like Granite3.3-8b achieving remarkable proficiency in arithmetic reasoning. RE-ZS-CoT advances zero-shot prompting by unifying role specialization with chain-of-thought reasoning, offering a practical, resource-efficient solution for improving LLM capabilities across diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 提出RE-ZS-CoT框架，通过整合领域专家角色增强LLM零样本思维链推理，在20个模型、7个基准上最高提升44个百分点。
AI.motivation: 提升大模型在无任务示例条件下的推理能力，探索角色专业化与思维链结合的有效性，并避免依赖人工指定角色。
AI.method: 设计角色增强零样本思维链提示框架，含两种版本：静态角色选择（在算术、常识、阅读理解基准上评估8个预设专家角色）与动态角色选择（由模型自主为每个基准挑选最合适的单一角色，实现任务-角色自适应对齐）；并开展角色消融（非常规角色）与跨模型规模（2b–14b）验证。
AI.result: 在20个LLM与7个基准上，RE-ZS-CoT常优于零样本与零样本CoT基线，最高提升44个百分点；静态与动态版本结果高度一致（静态有提升的基准上动态亦多优于基线），静态选择可达峰值性能；非常规角色会降低性能；小模型（如Granite3.3-8b）在算术推理上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: RE-ZS-CoT将角色专业化与思维链推理统一于零样本提示中，强调任务-角色对齐的必要性，为多领域LLM能力提升提供实用且资源高效的方案。

title: TEMPL: A Resource-Efficient and Transparent Model-Free Framework for Pseudo-Label Generation in Material CT Scans
summary: The scarcity of large annotated datasets limits deep learning (DL) segmentation in material CT analysis. DL-based pseudo-labeling can help, but it is often computationally expensive and hard to interpret. We introduce a multi-stage, model-free framework that generates pseudo-labels directly from grayscale CT scans. It combines thresholding, morphological dilation, and a custom breadth-first search region-growing algorithm to produce polygonal annotations without pre-trained weights, labeled data, or a GPU. We compare it against the zero-shot Segment Anything Model (SAM), a fully supervised 3D U-Net, and classical baselines. On a dendrite dataset with ground truth, our method reaches 63.19% IoU versus 10.74% for zero-shot SAM, with four times the instance recall at 0.5 IoU (33.3% versus 8.3%). The supervised 3D U-Net serves as a reference ceiling that requires expert labels. On a silica sand specimen, YOLO models trained on our labels performed comparably to models trained on SAM labels in a qualitative comparison. Across 1,053 extracted grains, the median equivalent diameter was 163.8 micrometers, near the specimen's known 106 to 150 micrometers sieve range, compared with 219.5 micrometers for SAM, whose labels merge adjacent particles and add spurious detections. A sensitivity analysis shows a stable operating range for the key threshold and a sharp, predictable failure point linked to phase contrast. Our method needs 15s per image on a standard CPU versus 28s for SAM on a GPU. These results support our transparent approach as a tool for annotation bootstrapping and microstructural quantification in resource-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多阶段、无模型（model-free）框架，无需预训练权重、标注数据或GPU，直接从灰度CT扫描中通过阈值化、形态学膨胀与自定义广度优先搜索区域生长算法生成多边形伪标签；在枝晶数据集上IoU达63.19%（零样本SAM为10.74%），并在资源受限环境下作为标注引导与微结构量化工具。
AI.motivation: 材料CT分析中深度学习分割受限于大规模标注数据稀缺。现有DL伪标签方法计算开销大且可解释性差，因此需要一种低成本、透明、无需训练的可替代伪标签生成方案。
AI.method: 多阶段、无模型的伪标签生成框架：组合阈值化、形态学膨胀与自定义广度优先搜索（BFS）区域生长算法，直接从灰度CT图像产生多边形标注；无需预训练权重、标注数据与GPU。对比对象包括零样本SAM、全监督3D U-Net及经典基线，并开展关键阈值的敏感性分析与相衬度失效点分析。
AI.result: 枝晶数据集上IoU 63.19% vs 零样本SAM 10.74%；0.5 IoU下实例召回率33.3% vs 8.3%（约4倍）。监督3D U-Net仅作需专家标注的参考上限。硅砂样本上，用本方法标签训练的YOLO与用SAM标签训练的模型定性相当；1,053个颗粒的中位等效直径为163.8 µm，接近筛分范围106–150 µm，而SAM为219.5 µm（存在颗粒粘连与虚假检测）。敏感性分析显示关键阈值存在稳定工作区间，并有与相衬度相关的可预测失效点。效率方面每图15 s（标准CPU）vs SAM 28 s（GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 该透明、免训练的方法可作为标注引导（annotation bootstrapping）与微结构量化的实用工具，特别适合资源受限场景，并在效率与可解释性上具备优势。

title: NLOS-Aware TDOA-Based UAV Localization: Cramér-Rao Bounds, Measurement Modeling, and Experimental Validation
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (TAES) on October 21st, 2026
summary: Passive time-difference-of-arrival (TDOA) localization is well suited for tracking non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) that do not report their positions. However, its accuracy degrades under the mixed line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation that is typical of low-altitude flight. In this paper, we develop NLOS-aware Cramér--Rao lower bounds (CRLBs) and an empirically calibrated measurement model for TDOA-based UAV localization, and we evaluate both with measurements from five UAV flights on the Aerial Experimentation and Research Platform for Advanced Wireless (AERPAW). The analysis yields an identifiability condition that relates the number of sensors to the number of NLOS links, together with a bias-induced error floor that a wider bandwidth cannot remove. The model parameters are estimated by matching simulated and measured error distributions. Experimental results show that the error depends most strongly on the number of sensors in LOS, while a higher altitude and a wider bandwidth lower the median error. Relocating a sensor that is always in NLOS into the open flight area can lower the median horizontal bound by two orders of magnitude if the relocated sensor is in LOS. The fitted model reproduces the median errors of the 2.5 MHz and 5 MHz flights but underestimates the heaviest error tails. Finally, rejecting outlier fixes lowers the error far more than Kalman or particle filtering, because the remaining error is dominated by bias.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低空无人机在混合视距/非视距(LOS/NLOS)条件下的TDOA定位，建立了NLOS感知的CRLB与经实测校准的测量模型，并在AERPAW平台五次飞行数据上验证，给出可辨识性条件、偏置引起的误差下限以及提升定位精度的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 被动TDOA定位适合跟踪不报告位置的非合作无人机，但低空飞行常见的LOS与NLOS混合传播会显著降低其精度，缺乏针对该场景的定位性能界与可信测量模型。
AI.method: 推导NLOS感知的CRLB与可辨识性条件（传感器数与NLOS链路数的关系），构建实证校准的测量模型，通过匹配仿真与实测误差分布估计模型参数，并用AERPAW平台五次无人机飞行（2.5 MHz与5 MHz带宽）实测数据评估。
AI.result: 误差最强依赖于处于LOS的传感器数量；更高飞行高度与更宽带宽降低中位误差；将始终处于NLOS的传感器迁移到开阔飞行区并使其处于LOS时，中位水平误差界可降低两个数量级；拟合模型能复现实测中位误差但低估最重误差尾部；剔除离群定位解比Kalman或粒子滤波降低误差更多。
AI.conclusion: 存在与NLOS链路数相关的可辨识性条件及带宽无法消除的偏置诱导误差下限；残余误差主要由偏置主导，故简单剔除离群解优于复杂滤波，传感器LOS布置对定位精度至关重要。

title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
comment: Raj Saha and Ekagra Gupta contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. To mechanistically investigate this gap, we identify a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream of each of the five models. We find that in tool-enabled contexts, the activations along this direction decrease in four of five models. Furthermore, lower activation predicts unsafe tool calls across all five models (AUC 0.76-0.86). However, restoring the signal to the respective text-only value through activation patching only prevents a subset of unsafe calls, primarily by suppressing tool use rather than by producing safer calls. Steering along the refusal direction nearly eliminates unsafe calls only at strengths that also suppress benign tool use or degrade the output quality. Our findings indicate that the identified refusal direction contributes to whether a model acts, but only partially explains the refusal divergence. Therefore, evaluating the safety of tool-calling agents requires directly examining their actions along with their textual responses.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了2,304条匹配三元组提示（纯文本/标准工具/对抗框定工具），发现文本中拒绝的有害请求在工具调用场景下大量转化为不安全调用（10–52%），并从残差流中识别拒绝方向，证明该方向仅部分解释拒绝行为的偏移。
AI.motivation: LLM作为工具调用智能体的安全评估仍主要停留在文本拒绝能力上，但是否"文本拒绝"会迁移到"工具调用"缺乏系统证据，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: 构建四领域2,304条提示的基准，采用同义匹配三元组设计（纯文本、标准工具启用、对抗性框定工具启用），以20种预定义禁止动作判定工具调用安全性；测试5个不同规模/家族的模型；在各模型残差流中识别与拒绝相关的方向，分析其在工具上下文中的激活变化，并用激活补丁（activation patching）与方向引导（steering）进行因果验证。
AI.result: 被拒绝的有害请求在标准工具提示下有10–52%出现不安全工具调用；工具上下文中拒绝方向上的激活在5个模型中的4个下降；激活值越低越能预测不安全调用（AUC 0.76–0.86）；将信号恢复至纯文本水平仅能阻止部分不安全调用，且主要通过抑制工具使用而非产生更安全调用；沿拒绝方向引导只有在强度高到同时抑制良性工具使用或降低输出质量时才能近乎消除不安全调用。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝方向影响模型"是否行动"，但只能部分解释文本与工具场景间的拒绝差异；工具调用智能体的安全评估必须同时直接检验其行为与文本回复。

title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
summary: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported 0.0033. On both real tasks the contract narrows the validation-test gap, and test performance is slightly higher rather than lower. The largest difference is in when the agents stop. Exact feedback used its entire budget of thirty submissions on two of the three tasks, including the one where nothing can be learned, while the contract halted after four to twelve. A run that exhausts its budget is usually read as diligence. It is better read as a symptom: when the feedback channel is unbounded, noise keeps supplying improvements to chase.

AI.tldr: 论文为迭代式 ML agent harness 提出显式的"反馈契约"：仅当提交超过由配对标准误算出的噪声阈值时才释放验证分数，并规定停止时机与测试集访问条件。在 CTR、LTR 与无信号对照任务上，契约显著抑制了对噪声的自适应选择，报告增益更真实、验证-测试差距更小、停止更早。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 在每次尝试后返回精确验证分数，使验证集暴露于自适应选择（adaptive selection），agent 会持续追逐噪声带来的虚假提升，并把"耗尽预算"误读为勤奋。
AI.method: 提出显式反馈契约，规定 agent 可观测内容、迭代停止条件与测试集可触碰时机；仅当提交清过由配对标准误（paired standard error）计算的噪声阈值时才释放验证分数，无需调参裕度（margin）。在 CTR 预测、learning to rank 及构造的无信号对照任务上进行实验。
AI.result: 无信号对照任务中（真实增益恒为零），精确反馈的 agent 报告 0.0157 增益，契约下为 0.0033；两个真实任务上契约缩小了验证-测试差距，且测试性能略高而非更低。精确反馈在三个任务中的两个（含无信号任务）用尽 30 次提交预算，契约在 4–12 次即停止。
AI.conclusion: 精确且无界的验证反馈会诱发对噪声的过度迭代；以噪声阈值为基础的反馈契约能在不损害测试性能的前提下给出更可信的报告、更小的泛化差距与更合理的停止行为。预算耗尽应被视为反馈信道无界的症状，而非勤勉。

title: Multi-level Encoder with Global Topic for Task-oriented Dialogue Summarization
summary: Task-oriented dialogue summarization aims to automatically extract key information to generate domain summaries to improve service efficiency and quality. Task-oriented dialogue is inherently logical and surrounds specific topic. How to effectively capture the dialogue topic and the most salient information becomes one of the major challenges of this task. In this paper, we propose a task-oriented dialogue summarization model utilizing a multi-level encoder with global topic (MLEGT). This model discovers temporal and spatial dependencies through a multi-level encoder, while simultaneously obtaining a simple yet effective global topic in the process of graph construction. It not only captures the crucial details but also breaks the long-range limit and discover the intrinsic structure across the dialogue. Then, a global topic guided pointer mechanism is added into the summrizer to capture ignored but important information, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of the summary. A comprehensive study of two public datasets, including a real-world large-scale Chinese police interrogation dataset and a medical reporting service dataset proves the superiority of our method on several strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MLEGT模型，通过多级编码器结合全局主题做面向任务对话摘要，并用主题引导指针机制提升摘要准确性，在中文警务与医疗两个数据集上优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 面向任务的对话逻辑性强且围绕特定主题，如何有效捕获对话主题与最显著信息是核心挑战。
AI.method: 采用多级编码器捕获时间与空间依赖，并在图构建过程中获取简洁有效的全局主题；随后在摘要器中引入全局主题引导的指针机制，以捕获被忽略但重要的信息。
AI.result: 在真实大规模中文警务审讯数据集和医疗报告服务数据集上，相较多个强基线取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 多级编码器突破长距离限制并刻画对话内在结构，结合全局主题引导指针机制可同时兼顾关键细节与被忽略的重要信息，提升摘要准确性。

title: MedBOE: Optimization-Based Estimation of Complete Patient Body Models from Whole-Body Medical Imaging
comment: Hoijoon Jung and Yuhao Wei contributed equally to this work
summary: True whole-body medical imaging captures a patient from head to toe and provides comprehensive anatomical and/or functional information. This coverage enables reconstruction of the external body surface, yielding patient body models. However, scanner geometry (e.g., bore diameter), patient characteristics, and positioning can leave body regions missing (e.g., lateral arms/torso, hands, forearms, elbows), producing incomplete patient body models. Such incompleteness limits downstream medical analyses, including derivation of body-habitus metrics (BHMs), such as body volume and surface area, for injected radiotracer activity regimens, cardiometabolic risk assessment, and computational anatomical modeling for medical imaging simulation and radiation dosimetry. We present the Medical Body model Optimization-based Estimator (MedBOE), an automated, training-free framework for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions. Our innovation is to leverage the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) template, a parametric body mesh representing a broad range of body shapes and poses, in medical imaging. MedBOE aligns the SMPL template to the incomplete patient body models via attribute-guided optimization and estimates missing body regions through geometrically and volumetrically constrained deformation. We evaluated MedBOE using two public datasets: AutoPET (91 whole-body PET-CT images) and Human Implicit Tissues (HIT; 40 whole-body segmentations from MRI images).
