MedBOE achieved the best overall volumetric and geometric performance among evaluated methods. BHMs derived from MedBOE were within 2% error, suggesting low percentage errors for downstream analyses. MedBOE offers an automated, training-free method for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的MedBOE框架，利用SMPL参数化人体模板，通过属性引导优化与几何/体积约束变形，从缺失部分体区的全身医学影像中估计完整患者身体模型。
AI.motivation: 全身影像因扫描仪孔径、患者体型与摆位等原因常缺失侧臂、手、前臂、肘等区域，导致患者身体模型不完整，进而限制体积、表面积等体型指标（BHMs）及剂量学、仿真建模等下游分析。
AI.method: 将SMPL参数化人体网格模板引入医学影像：先以属性引导优化将模板对齐到不完整患者体模型，再通过几何与体积约束的形变估计缺失体区；方法自动化、无需训练。在AutoPET（91例全身PET-CT）与HIT（40例MRI全身分割）两个公开数据集上评测。
AI.result: 在体积与几何精度上整体优于对比方法；由MedBOE导出的BHMs误差在2%以内，表明下游分析误差较低。
AI.conclusion: MedBOE为存在缺失体区的全身影像提供了一种自动、免训练的完整身体模型估计方案，可支撑体型指标计算及临床与剂量学下游应用。

title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
summary: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $τ^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.

AI.tldr: 提出 PerMIT 记忆架构，通过有限接口与门控确认机制为智能体持久记忆提供可证明的完整性保证，并实现社区级共享与协同扩展。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆是注入与投毒的重要且基本无防护的攻击面，同一风险也限制了智能体间的记忆共享。
AI.method: 在“仅用户键入内容与门控确认值可信”的显式信任假设下，将不可信环境派生值的释放与使用限制在有限记忆接口上，保留多轮规划与工具选择；在该接口上提出两条完整性定理并用 Lean 4 机器验证；每次确认是对确切内容的记录裁决，背书可跨用户累积。
AI.result: Trojan Hippo 上自验证与轻量验证器下攻击成功率为零；证明并在仿真中印证共同扩展性：社区扩大时投毒晋升风险与误驱逐良性知识风险下降而人均验证成本不升；τ²-bench 上最多 90 个自主智能体建立共享知识库且无直接记忆注入被晋升，知识显著提升新智能体在留出任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: PerMIT 将威胁模型下所有攻击归约为单一可审计的门控决策，为安全记忆共享与测试时自我改进提供了可行路径。

title: Towards Realistic Models of Change: A Causal Perspective on Decision-Making and Dynamical Systems
comment: PhD thesis, University of Pisa (National PhD Program in Artificial Intelligence), 2026. 175 pages
summary:
While statistical learning has made remarkable progress in recent decades, driven by large datasets and data-driven protocols that have transformed scientific practice, it still faces a key limitation: it struggles to generalize beyond the data it has seen, often failing under distribution shift. Causality offers a promising solution: causal models focus on the underlying mechanisms of change rather than surface-level associations, enabling robust reasoning under external interventions. This allows systems not only to learn from data, but also to reason about hypothetical scenarios, adapt to new environments, and inform better decisions. This thesis explores how these approaches can inform each other, in two parts.
  The first part examines algorithmic recourse, that is, identifying which changes an individual can make to overturn an unfavorable decision. We propose an alternative perspective to the established framework, arguing for a more realistic cost function, a reformulation of the problem in causal terms, and the inclusion of a temporal dimension in policy evaluation.
  The second part focuses on dynamical systems, extending the notions of causal interventions and effects to discrete and continuous stochastic processes. We show that the equilibria of these processes, and how they change following an intervention, can be linked to Structural Causal Models (SCMs), viewed as compressed representations of the underlying temporal dynamics. We argue for the relevance of such temporal causal models, since in real-world scenarios actions take time to produce their effects.
  The common goal of both parts is practical: the utility, robustness, and trustworthiness of these models depend critically on their ability to realistically represent the underlying phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨统计学习与因果推断的相互促进，分两部分：一是从更现实代价、因果化重构与时间维度改进算法追索（algorithmic recourse）；二是将因果干预与因果效应推广到离散与连续随机过程，把过程均衡及其干预后变化与结构因果模型（SCM）相联系。
AI.motivation: 统计学习依赖大数据与数据驱动范式，虽进展显著，但在分布偏移下泛化能力不足。因果模型关注变化的底层机制而非表层关联，有望支持干预下的稳健推理、反事实推理与环境适应，因此需要研究两类方法的互补。
AI.method: 第一部分针对算法追索：提出替代性视角，采用更贴近现实的代价函数，将问题重构为因果形式，并在策略评估中引入时间维度。第二部分针对动力系统：将因果干预与因果效应概念扩展到离散与连续随机过程，并把过程的均衡态及其在干预下的变化与SCM关联，将SCM视为底层时间动态的压缩表示。
AI.result: 论文给出两方面的分析性结果：算法追索可在更现实的代价与因果框架下被重新表述，并纳入时间维度评估；随机过程的均衡态及其干预后变化可由SCM刻画，从而为时间因果建模提供依据，尤其适用于行动效果存在时滞的现实场景。
AI.conclusion: 两部分共同目标具有实践性：模型的效用、稳健性与可信度关键取决于其能否真实刻画底层现象；因果与统计学习应相互借鉴，时间因果模型对现实决策尤为重要。

title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.

AI.tldr: 连续扩散语言模型"全程不逐步离散化"的原则带来隐性代价：词汇长尾坍缩。作者提出免训练方法 GRAFT，将"离散选择"嫁接回冻结模型，恢复稀有词比例与整体词频分布。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型（如 ELF）在并行生成中从不逐词离散化，仅最后一步把嵌入转成文本，其自身消融实验认为这是达到自回归级质量的关键。作者要检验该原则是否牺牲了词汇多样性，尤其是稀有词（长尾）分布。
AI.method: 首先做实证诊断：以留出的人类文本为基准，对比 ELF（105M–652M 参数）与同规模 GPT-2 的词频分布，并扫描各采样器设置；进而分析机理，指出去离散化步骤时每一步都是"候选嵌入的平均"，稀有候选与竞争同一位置的常见词平均后被常见词吞没，而自回归解码规则是"采样一个候选"而非平均。基于此提出 GRAFT：一种免训练方法，在模型尚未定夺时先锁定平均值本会丢弃的稀有词，再以这些承诺为约束从头重生成整条序列；并在 LangFlow 这一独立连续 dLLM 上验证泛化性。
AI.result: ELF 在常见词上与人类频率几乎一致，但最稀有词仅达人类频率的 0.30x，且该差距从 105M 到 652M 参数不收敛，现有采样器设置均无法弥合；同规模 GPT-2 仅凭解码规则即可在 0 到高于人类频率之间调节。GRAFT 在三个 ELF 规模与 LangFlow 上把稀有词占比从人类的 0.42–0.77x 提升到 0.82–1.10x（相对增益 34%–109%），并使整体词频分布更接近人类，ELF-B 上改善 2.7x、LangFlow 上 12x。
AI.conclusion: "无逐步离散化"并非纯粹收益，而是以词汇长尾坍缩为代价；该缺陷源于平均式更新而非规模或采样设置。GRAFT 证明只需在推理阶段补回缺失的离散选择，即可在不重训练的前提下显著修复词频分布，提示连续 dLLM 需在架构或解码层面显式引入离散决策机制。

title: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent. However, T2I models are usually optimized for single-image quality which comes at a cost of multi-image diversity, limiting this exploration. Diversity is also contextual: one user wants variations in background, while another wants them in artistic style, and the same user may later want variations in clothing. The generated images should differ along whatever axis the user cares about. In this paper, we introduce T-DIG, a text-conditioned diversity framework for image generation and editing. T-DIG is an iterative framework comprising multiple modules that lets users type prompts, inspect default generations, request variations using natural language, and continue refining outputs until they're satisfied. At its core, T-DIG uses an LLM policy that produces K axis-conditioned prompts or edit instructions for a frozen generator or editor. We train this policy with GRPO using a text-conditioned diversity reward and alignment penalties. Because the image generator remains frozen, T-DIG applies to open-weight, distilled, and proprietary models. We also release the first dataset for text-conditioned prompt diversity in image generation, with the training and validation splits built from human-written axes and a test set drawn from real user interactions with T-DIG. T-DIG far exceeds baselines in improving text-conditioned diversity, while preserving base-prompt alignment across a variety of metrics and human judgements. We show that user-directed diversity exploration can be added to a wide range of image generation models, open and closed, without the need to access their weights. Website: https://image-study.org/t-dig/

AI.tldr: T-DIG是一个文本条件化的多样性框架，通过LLM策略为冻结的生成/编辑模型生成K个沿用户指定轴（如背景、风格、服装）差异化的提示或编辑指令，并用GRPO结合文本条件多样性奖励训练，在保持基础提示对齐的同时显著提升多图多样性。
AI.motivation: T2I平台通常每个提示返回多张图供用户探索不同视觉解释，但模型按单图质量优化，牺牲了多图多样性。且多样性是上下文相关的：不同用户、不同时刻希望变化的轴不同（背景、艺术风格、服装等），需要生成图像沿用户关心的轴差异化。
AI.method: 提出T-DIG迭代式框架：用户输入提示、查看默认生成、用自然语言请求变化并持续细化。核心是用LLM策略为冻结的生成器或编辑器产出K个轴条件化提示/编辑指令；用GRPO训练该策略，奖励由文本条件多样性奖励与对齐惩罚构成。由于生成器冻结，方法适用于开放权重、蒸馏及闭源商用模型。同时发布首个文本条件化提示多样性数据集（训练/验证集来自人工撰写的轴，测试集来自T-DIG真实用户交互）。
AI.result: 在多种指标与人工评测中，T-DIG在提升文本条件化多样性方面远超基线，同时保持基础提示对齐；并证明无需访问模型权重即可为各类开源与闭源图像生成模型添加用户导向的多样性探索能力。
AI.conclusion: 用户导向的多样性探索可作为模型无关的外挂模块加入广泛的图像生成模型；冻结生成器+策略优化的范式大幅降低适配成本，并为文本条件多样性提供了首个公开数据集。

title: A Transfer Learning-Driven Methodology for Efficient and Sustainable Indoor Localization Using VLC
summary: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation. However, conventional localization techniques struggle in dynamic environments. These methods depend on extensive, frequent data collection and environment-specific calibration, limiting scalability, interoperability, and effective use of prior research while imposing significant energy penalties that hinder practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose an energy-efficient transfer learning (TL) based approach for visible light communication based indoor localization. Our method leverages TL to tackle environmental variability, including lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles that typically degrade localization performance, while simultaneously reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches. We also introduce a novel model efficiency (ME) metric, designed to integrate localization accuracy, energy efficiency, data efficiency, and transfer gain into a single evaluative measure for comprehensive optimization. Evaluations on a real-world dataset collected from a BOSCH factory demonstrate that our model achieves a 47% improvement in localization accuracy compared to a conventional model that does not utilize TL, and achieves up to 67.5% ME with TL models, compared to only 10.4% in conventional models under high-noise conditions. These results underscore the potential of our approach to deliver a highly efficient and scalable indoor localization system suitable for energy-constrained industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向可见光通信室内定位的节能迁移学习方法，并引入"模型效率"(ME)综合指标。
AI.motivation: IoT设备协同使室内定位成为工业自动化关键环节，但传统定位方法依赖大量频繁数据采集与环境特定标定，难以适应动态环境，可扩展性、互操作性差且能耗高。
AI.method: 基于可见光通信的迁移学习定位方案，用以应对光照波动与物理遮挡等环境变化，同时降低计算开销与能耗；并提出融合定位精度、能效、数据效率与迁移增益的单一"模型效率"(ME)度量。
AI.result: 在BOSCH工厂实测数据集上，相比未使用迁移学习的传统模型定位精度提升47%；高噪声条件下TL模型ME最高达67.5%，而传统模型仅10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可提供高效、可扩展的室内定位系统，适用于能量受限的工业应用场景。

title: AgentPolicyForge: From Executable Environments to Policy Benchmarks and Adaptive Guards
summary: Customized agent deployments define policies over tools, resources, and execution conditions. Providing these policies in the task agent's prompt does not reliably prevent violations. Training a guard requires examples of tool calls that comply with or violate those policies. We introduce AgentPolicyForge, a framework that uses executable environments to construct policy benchmarks and iteratively train policy guards. With this framework, we construct PolicyGym, a dataset across ten policy families using 698 scenarios for training data generation and 254 separate held-out scenarios for human-reviewed test sets. Tool calls are executed and their outcomes recorded to help determine whether they comply with the policy. Every violating case uses a permitted tool, requiring checks of arguments, resources, and context rather than tool identity alone. The case construction process supports iterative guard training: an attacker generates requests using retrieved strategies, and the guard is fine-tuned on balanced, environment-verified examples. Training improves policy enforcement even with a fixed archive. Updating the archive further reduces in-domain attack success compared with keeping it fixed. We compare policy-aware task agent self-regulation with a trained policy guard. On PolicyGym, the final guard-based configuration achieves a 40-44% relative reduction in attack success rate and fewer benign rejections than policy prompting alone.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentPolicyForge框架与PolicyGym数据集，基于可执行环境构造策略违规样本并迭代训练策略守卫，显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 定制化agent部署需在工具、资源和执行条件上施加策略约束，但仅将策略写入任务agent的提示词无法可靠阻止违规；训练守卫又缺少合规/违规工具调用的标注样本。
AI.method: 构建AgentPolicyForge：利用可执行环境生成策略基准并迭代训练策略守卫。据此构建PolicyGym，覆盖十个策略族、698个场景用于训练数据生成、254个独立留出场景构成人工审核测试集；实际执行工具调用并记录结果以判定合规性。所有违规案例均使用许可工具，因此需检查参数、资源与上下文而非仅靠工具身份。构造流程支持迭代训练：攻击者利用检索到的策略生成请求，守卫在平衡且经环境验证的样本上微调。
AI.result: 在PolicyGym上，最终基于守卫的配置相较仅策略提示实现攻击成功率40–44%的相对下降，且良性请求误拒更少；即使档案固定也能提升策略执行，更新档案可进一步降低域内攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 可执行环境驱动的违规样本构造与迭代守卫训练，优于依赖任务agent自我约束或单纯策略提示的方案。

title: A Mechanistic Study of Automated Failure Attribution in LLM-based Agentic Systems
summary: Agentic systems have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks by enabling multiple interacting large language model (LLM)-based agents to collaborate and execute subtasks in parallel. However, this collaborative structure introduces new challenges for reliably evaluating and diagnosing system failures, particularly failure attribution: tracing a system's execution to identify the agent step responsible for an incorrect final outcome. Because manually performing this task is time- and labor-intensive, recent work has turned to LLMs as judges to automate the process, referred to as automated failure attribution (AFA). These approaches assume that a sufficiently capable model can infer the failing step directly from an interaction transcript. In practice, however, direct prompting often performs poorly, which motivates follow-up work that explores various ways to improve AFA performance, including alternative prompting strategies and inference-time interventions. In this paper, we examine a more fundamental question: whether this weak behavioral performance reflects a genuine capability limitation. Using linear probes applied to internal activations, we uncover a significant \emph{knows-but-won't-say gap:} models encode sufficient information to attribute a failure correctly but fail to explicitly output the responsible step. Building on this finding, we propose \emph{grafting}, a simple manual intervention that exploits knowledge already encoded in the model to improve AFA performance without requiring ground-truth labels at inference time. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLMs and benchmark settings demonstrate that grafting consistently outperforms direct-prompting approaches, underscoring the potential of leveraging latent model knowledge for more reliable failure attribution. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/mi4afa.

AI.tldr: 本文通过线性探针揭示LLM在失败归因任务上存在"知道但不说"的差距，并提出grafting干预方法利用模型已编码的潜在知识提升自动失败归因性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作系统的失败归因（AFA）依赖LLM作为评判者，但直接提示效果差，已有工作多从提示策略与推理干预入手。作者追问更根本的问题：这种弱表现是否反映真实的能力局限，还是模型其实已具备归因信息却未能输出。
AI.method: 对模型内部激活施加线性探针，探测其是否编码了正确的失败步骤信息；基于发现提出grafting——一种简单的手工干预，将模型中已编码的知识加以利用以改进AFA，且推理时无需真实标签；在多个LLM与多种基准设置上进行评估。
AI.result: 线性探针显示模型内部激活含有足以正确归因失败的信息，但显式输出失败步骤的能力不足，即存在显著的"知道但不说"差距（knows-but-won't-say gap）；grafting在多个模型和基准设置上一致优于直接提示方法。
AI.conclusion: AFA的弱表现主要是表达能力/读出问题而非能力缺失，利用潜在模型知识可提升失败归因的可靠性，为多智能体系统的诊断与评测提供新思路。

title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
summary: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across model families. We propose and test a hypothesis as to why: while human language is optimized for successful communication, AI-generated text is increasingly optimized for other goals like math, code, and reasoning, in which there is a pressure for \textit{information density} rather than successful communication. We provide a proof-of-concept for this hypothesis by fine-tuning a language model under a length penalty, which leads to a divergence from human-like linguistic behavior. Our findings highlight the axes of misalignment between linguistic processing demands in humans and LLMs, and point toward possible remedies.

AI.tldr: AI生成的文本在语用难度相关心理语言学特征上显著偏离人类写作，其根源在于模型优化目标从"成功交流"转向"信息密度"。
AI.motivation: 近期普遍感受是AI生成文本越来越难理解，但缺乏系统的实证量化与成因解释。
AI.method: 构建跨领域AI生成文本新语料，测量与人类加工难度相关的心理语言学特征（宾语关系从句、长句法依存、低频n-gram等）；与往返翻译改写及人类写作对比；覆盖九个前沿及准前沿模型并分析模型族差异；提出"信息密度优先"假设，并通过长度惩罚微调语言模型进行概念验证。
AI.result: 相较往返翻译改写，AI文本更频繁使用高难度特征；相较人类写作，九个模型均更多使用无生命主语配生命动词及低频n-gram，多数模型依存更长、名词堆叠更多、对话中缩减宾语关系从句更多，且模型族间差异显著；长度惩罚微调可使模型语言行为偏离人类模式。
AI.conclusion: AI文本与人类语言加工需求存在多轴错位，成因在于优化目标转向信息密度而非交流效率；该发现为改进模型的语言可理解性指明潜在方向。

title: Enhancing Cross-Grade Generalization in Banana Variety Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformers and Knowledge Self-Distillation
summary: In recent years, automated fruit classification systems have become a more critical component in precision agriculture for efficient yield estimation, quality control, and supply chain optimization. However, they still face significant challenges under varying quality, fruit maturity, illumination, texture degradation, morphological attributes, domain shift, and post-harvest handling conditions. In this study, we address the challenging issue of cross-grade banana variety classification. This is a real-world setting where models that have been trained on specific quality grades must generalize to unseen grades to handle significant domain shift. Under a rigorous Leave-One-Grade-Out evaluation protocol, we present a thorough comparative analysis of CNNs, ViTs, and dual-stream hybrid architectures using a large-scale dataset of 31,678 banana images with three varieties and three quality grades. Specifically, to address the drawbacks of single-paradigm frameworks, we present a dual-stream Swin ResNet hybrid framework enhanced with KL-divergence-based self-distillation to align probabilistic feature representations across the CNN and Transformer streams. Comprehensive experimental analyzes show that the presented hybrid framework with KL-divergence based self-distillation achieves better overall performance, i.e., it attains a mean accuracy of 81.25% and significantly surpasses CNN and Transformer baseline models. Qualitative analysis further confirms that the hybrid framework in this study improves discriminative feature transferability, improves attention localization, and stabilizes optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对跨等级香蕉品种分类（训练于特定品质等级、需泛化到未见等级）的域偏移问题，基于31,678张香蕉图像（3品种×3品质等级）在Leave-One-Grade-Out协议下系统比较CNN、ViT与双流混合架构，提出融合KL散度自蒸馏的双流Swin-ResNet混合框架，平均准确率达81.25%，显著优于CNN与Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 自动化水果分类在精准农业中日益重要，但在品质差异、成熟度、光照、纹理退化、形态属性、域偏移及采后处理等条件下仍面临显著挑战。已有单范式框架（纯CNN或纯Transformer）存在固有缺陷，且模型在特定品质等级上训练后难以泛化到未见等级，跨等级场景下的域偏移问题尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 构建大规模香蕉数据集（31,678张图像，3个品种、3个品质等级），采用严格的Leave-One-Grade-Out评估协议模拟真实跨等级泛化。系统对比CNN、ViT与双流混合架构，并提出双流Swin-ResNet混合框架，引入基于KL散度的自蒸馏机制，对齐CNN流与Transformer流的概率特征表示，以缓解单范式框架的不足。
AI.result: 所提带KL散度自蒸馏的混合框架取得最佳整体性能，平均准确率为81.25%，显著超越CNN与Transformer基线模型。定性分析进一步表明该框架提升了判别性特征的可迁移性、改善了注意力定位效果，并稳定了优化过程。
AI.conclusion: 双流Swin-ResNet混合架构结合KL散度自蒸馏能够有效应对跨等级香蕉品种分类中的域偏移问题，验证了CNN与Transformer特征互补及跨流表示对齐的价值，为精准农业中的自动化水果分类提供了可行方案。

title: Cross-Area Transfer Learning for VLC-based Indoor Localization with a Transfer Efficiency Score
summary: Indoor localization systems are critical for Industry-4.0 applications. Visible Light Communication (VLC)-based systems offer advantages such as immunity to electromagnetic interference, high accuracy, and energy efficiency, but their performance is hindered by environmental variability across deployment areas. This paper presents a transfer learning (TL) framework for VLC-based indoor localization that enhances cross-area robustness while reducing data requirements. Using real-world measurements from four distinct areas of a Bosch manufacturing facility, we show that fine-tuning a deep neural network (DNN) pre-trained on source area data with only 40% of target-area measurements recovers 97% of full-data performance, thereby reducing the amount of target data needed. We further introduce the Transfer Efficiency Score (TES), a composite metric that identifies the most effective source models for transfer without exhaustive evaluation. Guided by TES, the framework selects the best source model, yielding localization errors as low as 40.9 cm with success rates above 86%. Validation on an unseen area confirms its generalization capability, with a 3.28 cm mean error achieved using the TES-selected source model. Overall, the proposed framework provides a scalable and data-efficient pathway for industrial VLC localization, substantially reducing deployment costs and computational burden while maintaining high accuracy in diverse and dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 提出面向VLC室内定位的迁移学习框架，用源域预训练DNN+少量目标域数据微调实现跨区域鲁棒定位，并提出迁移效率评分TES以筛选最优源模型。
AI.motivation: 工业4.0室内定位中，VLC系统虽具抗电磁干扰、高精度、能效高等优势，但不同部署区域的环境差异导致性能下降，且每个新区域重新采集标注数据成本高。
AI.method: 基于博世制造工厂四个真实区域的实测数据，先用源区域数据预训练DNN，再用目标区域少量测量数据微调；提出复合指标TES（迁移效率评分），在无需穷举评估的情况下识别最有效的源模型。
AI.result: 仅用40%目标域数据微调即可恢复97%的全数据性能；经TES选出的最优源模型定位误差低至40.9 cm，成功率超86%；在未见区域验证泛化能力，平均误差3.28 cm。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为工业VLC定位提供可扩展、数据高效的路径，在多样动态环境下保持高精度的同时显著降低部署成本与计算负担。

title: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
summary: Radiation treatment planning requires balancing competing objectives to satisfy clinical criteria while accommodating physicians' preferences. This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound AI system that integrates DRL-based automated treatment planning with LLM-based conversational plan refinement for proton PBS therapy. A policy network trained using PPO first generates multiple plans without human intervention, from which one is selected as the target plan and the others serve as references for subsequent refinements. For challenging cases requiring further adjustments, an LLM-based multi-agent system enables plan refinement through natural language interactions. The system comprises a planning agent that recommends evidence-supported adjustments, a chatbot providing a unified conversational interface, and an evaluation agent that retrieves clinical metrics and identifies constraint violations. To enhance domain-specific reasoning, the planning agent based on Qwen3-14B is designed to justify its recommendations using evidence from previously generated plans and post-trained on task-specific data using SFT and GRPO. The framework was trained and evaluated using 21 patients with H&N cancers, with 5 PPO-generated plans per patient. Of these, 50 plans were selected for instruction-guided refinement. Compared with the base LLM, the post-trained Qwen3-14B demonstrated improved instruction-following, information retrieval and domain-specific reasoning capabilities. The resulting adjustments more effectively improved user-prioritized objectives while limiting deterioration in competing objectives, yielding more clinically appropriate trade-offs in patient-specific plan refinement. The proposed compound AI system provides a user-friendly planning platform, offering a promising approach to personalized proton PBS treatment planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个证据驱动的多智能体复合AI系统，将基于DRL（PPO）的质子PBS自动放疗计划生成与基于LLM的自然语言对话式计划精修相结合，经SFT与GRPO后训练的Qwen3-14B规划智能体在21例头颈癌患者数据上实现了更符合临床偏好的个性化计划调整。
AI.motivation: 放疗计划需在临床标准和医生偏好之间权衡多个相互冲突的目标；纯自动化DRL规划缺乏针对疑难病例的灵活人机交互与偏好表达能力，而通用LLM缺乏放疗领域的循证推理能力，因此需要将二者优势结合的复合系统。
AI.method: 1）用PPO训练策略网络，无需人工干预为每位患者生成多个候选计划，选一个作为目标计划、其余作为参考；2）构建LLM多智能体系统支持自然语言精修：规划智能体（给出有证据支持的建议）、聊天机器人（统一对话接口）、评估智能体（检索临床指标并识别约束违背）；3）规划智能体基于Qwen3-14B，利用既往生成计划的证据为建议提供依据，并用任务特定数据经SFT和GRPO进行后训练；4）在21例头颈癌患者、每人5个PPO计划上训练与评估，其中50个计划用于指令引导的精修。
AI.result: 与基座LLM相比，后训练的Qwen3-14B在指令遵循、信息检索和领域推理能力上均有提升；其产生的调整更有效地改善用户优先目标，同时抑制竞争目标的恶化，在患者个性化计划精修中形成更符合临床的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该复合AI系统提供了一个用户友好的计划平台，为实现个性化质子PBS放疗计划提供了有前景的途径。

title: When Do Gaussian Priors Fail? A Latent Geometry Investigation of RL Fine-Tuning
summary:
Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline.
  We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). A three-source decomposition localises the amplification to the learned policy (zero ODE-solver contribution, bounded anchor mismatch); the coverage plateau is an unconditional benefit of mode-separating priors that no amount of RL capacity recovers. The remedy is conditional: a non-Gaussian prior is necessary precisely when the latent geometry would fall into overlap and the task is coverage-sensitive. A machine-checked theory skeleton supports the KL pricing structure - a divergent compactness tax under a Gaussian prior versus a finite assignment fee under a mixture - and the position-versus-plateau distinction delimits what is finite-resource from what requires changing the prior.

AI.tldr: 隐扩散模型默认在VAE潜空间置高斯先验；在RL微调下该先验存在结构性缺陷：KL项惩罚模态分离与紧致，导致多模态数据压缩重叠，RL放大重叠并使崩溃边界β_c大幅上升；真实丙氨酸二肽分布上高斯先验VAE在β_c=0.224崩溃，混合先验在0.00316崩溃，差距71倍。通过干预验证中介变量d_min/(2σ_0)，得出"非高斯先验仅在潜几何重叠且任务对覆盖敏感时必要"的条件性结论。
AI.motivation: 指出潜扩散模型"普遍使用高斯先验"这一默认做法的结构性局限：标准VAE的KL项不仅忽略模态结构，还主动"征收"分离与紧致的代价，使ELBO最优解把多模态数据压缩为重叠潜表示；RL微调进一步放大该重叠，导致崩溃边界远超变分尺度，从而需要明确何时必须更换先验。
AI.method: (1) 理论：分析KL的"定价结构"——高斯先验下的发散式紧致税 vs 混合先验下的有限分配费，并给出机器可检验的理论骨架；(2) 真实数据实验：在丙氨酸二肽Boltzmann分布上比较高斯先验VAE与模态跟踪的高斯混合先验VAE的崩溃边界β_c；(3) 因果中介分析：识别单一几何中介量 d_min/(2σ_0)，通过"固定先验移动几何"与"匹配几何切换先验"两类受控干预做完全中介检验（先验标签系数0.995×，95% CI [0.79,1.25]）；(4) 三源分解定位放大环节（学习策略贡献为主，ODE求解器贡献为零，锚点失配有限）；(5) 覆盖平台实验。
AI.result: 高斯先验VAE在β_c=0.224崩溃，模态跟踪混合先验在0.00316崩溃，同一流程下相差71倍；该差距由单一几何中介 d_min/(2σ_0) 完全中介；放大效应定位于学习到的策略，ODE求解器零贡献、锚点失配有限；覆盖平台是模态分离先验的无条件收益，增加RL容量无法弥补。
AI.conclusion: 换用非高斯先验是有条件的补救：仅当潜几何落入重叠区且任务对覆盖敏感时才必要；"位置（崩溃边界）—平台（覆盖）"的区分划定了哪些问题可由有限资源解决、哪些必须通过改变先验解决。

title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
summary: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFEScore by 9.4% in unit generation given region sets and achieves 2.4 times the end-to-end binding F1. It also achieves leading report-generation results on Chest ImaGenome and PadChest-GR, using fewer than one-sixth as many parameters as large-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出RadCarve，直接从既有"陈述-区域"对应中的解剖区域集合定义生成单元，将单元形成与视觉证据选择统一，并以组合专用查询库联合预测单元存在性与区域组成，实现细粒度、可绑定视觉证据的报告生成。
AI.motivation: 将放射报告拆解为独立生成的单元可产生细粒度临床内容并绑定视觉证据，但现有方法的生成单元结构并非自然报告或其标注中直接指定的，引入了额外的建模妥协。
AI.method: RadCarve以现有陈述-区域对应中的解剖区域集合直接定义生成单元。其planner使用组合专用查询库（composition-specialized query banks）从图像联合预测单元存在性与区域组成，并依据当前成员预测聚合区域证据进行迭代精炼；generator在预测区域集合的联合视觉证据条件下独立生成每个单元的文本。
AI.result: 相比强基线，给定区域集的单元生成CXRFEScore提升9.4%，端到端绑定F1达到2.4倍；在Chest ImaGenome与PadChest-GR上取得领先的报告生成结果，参数量不足大规模基线的六分之一。
AI.conclusion: 以解剖区域集合作为生成单元可消除额外结构假设，实现单元形成与视觉证据选择的统一，在更少参数下获得更优的细粒度生成与绑定性能。

title: Single-Image Food Mass Estimators Do Not Transfer Their Gram Scale Across Datasets
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Code, set lists and model weights: https://github.com/yongshenglian/foodmass-transfer
summary: Estimating food mass from a photograph is central to image-based dietary assessment, but whether trained models transfer to new cameras and foods is unclear. We fine-tuned DINOv2-base on 2,253 weighed Nutrition5k dishes to predict mass from one RGB photograph and compared it with a zero-shot vision-language model, Qwen3-VL-32B, on Nutrition5k and three external datasets: ASA24 studio portions, ECUSTFD whole foods and Food Portion Benchmark meal trays. In domain, the fine-tuned model's mean absolute error was 24.8 g, less than half of Qwen's. On external datasets it did not beat Qwen. For a food it had never seen, it ranked portions by size, but no better than a count of food pixels. Its gram scale was wrong in two ways: it changed with how much of the scene the photograph showed, and it was off by a different factor for each food. Training on other foods or trays from the tested dataset cut the external error by 38 to 65%. DINOv2-large, a larger backbone trained on the same dishes, did not reduce the external error. One labeled photograph of the same food cut the model's ASA24 error to 28.3 g, better than that photograph achieved alone. Prediction intervals that held the true mass for 90% of Nutrition5k dishes held it for at most half of external photographs. Nutrition5k often photographed the same plate several times, so a random test split shared near-identical photographs with training and overstated accuracy. Single-image mass estimators therefore need labeled photographs from the setting where they are used.

AI.tldr: 该研究将DINOv2-base在Nutrition5k上微调用于单张RGB图像的食物质量估计，并与零样本Qwen3-VL-32B及三个外部数据集对比，发现域内误差24.8 g（不到Qwen的一半）但外部迁移失效：尺度随画面占比漂移、按食物类别系统性偏移，预测区间覆盖率从90%降至≤50%，且Nutrition5k重复拍摄导致随机划分高估精度。
AI.motivation: 基于图像的食物质量估计是图像化膳食评估的核心，但既有模型能否迁移到新相机与新食物尚不清楚；现有评估多依赖Nutrition5k域内随机划分，可能因同一餐盘重复拍摄而虚高精度。
AI.method: 在2,253份称重的Nutrition5k菜品上微调DINOv2-base，从单张RGB照片回归质量；以零样本Qwen3-VL-32B为对照，在Nutrition5k及ASA24 studio份量、ECUSTFD整体食物、Food Portion Benchmark餐盘三个外部集上评估；并用像素计数基线、DINOv2-large骨干、在外部数据上训练、单张标注照片适配及预测区间覆盖率进行诊断。
AI.result: 域内MAE 24.8 g，不到Qwen的一半；外部集上未优于Qwen。未见食物上可按大小排序份量，但不优于食物像素计数；克度尺度随画面视野范围变化，且每种食物偏移因子不同。用被测数据集的其他食物或餐盘训练可将外部误差降低38–65%；DINOv2-large未改善外部误差；同一食物一张标注照片将ASA24误差降至28.3 g，优于该照片单独使用。90%覆盖率的预测区间在外部照片上覆盖率至多50%。Nutrition5k同一餐盘多次拍摄使随机划分与训练集共享近同图像，高估精度。
AI.conclusion: 单张图像质量估计器存在严重的尺度与食物特异性偏移，缺乏跨域泛化与可靠不确定性；实际部署需要来自目标场景的标注照片，且评估须避免同盘重复拍摄的泄漏。

title: GenXR-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive XR Development
comment: 37 pages, 10 figures. Code available at https://github.com/whuang37/genxr-bench
summary: Coding agents are rapidly advancing from single-file generation to long-horizon repository-scale engineering, yet the evaluation of their capabilities to author interactive extended reality (XR) applications remains an open challenge. Unlike traditional software, XR applications operate within dynamic 3D physical environments where runtime robustness depends jointly on continuous user motion, spatial input, and environmental sensing. We introduce GenXR-Bench, the first benchmark for the end-to-end evaluation of coding agents in XR software development. GenXR-Bench contains 112 expert-authored tasks spanning 24 feature implementations, 21 bug repairs, and 67 application generation tasks. Held-out tests combine scripted and adaptive interactions with programmatic and visual assertions to evaluate core functionality and runtime behavior. GenXR-Bench's testing suite achieves 96.5% accuracy against blinded expert judgments of 124 candidate applications executed on consumer XR hardware. Evaluating 10 models on GenXR-Bench, we find that the strongest configuration achieves only 50.9% overall Pass@1. Failure analysis identifies recurring misunderstandings in asynchronous sensor lifecycles, physical grounding, and embodied interaction semantics. GenXR-Bench establishes a reproducible testbed for evaluating coding agents in the interactive and physically situated conditions of spatial computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GenXR-Bench，首个面向扩展现实（XR）应用开发的编程智能体端到端评测基准，包含112个专家编写任务与脚本化+自适应交互的隐藏测试，测试套件与专家盲评一致率达96.5%，而10个模型中最优配置仅达50.9% Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 编程智能体的能力已从单文件生成迈向长周期、仓库级工程，但对其编写交互式XR应用能力的评测仍然缺失。与传统软件不同，XR应用运行于动态三维物理环境，其运行时鲁棒性同时依赖连续用户运动、空间输入与环境感知，现有基准无法覆盖这些特性。
AI.method: 构建 GenXR-Bench：112个专家编写任务，涵盖24项功能实现、21项缺陷修复与67项应用生成；隐藏测试将脚本化交互与自适应交互相结合，并配合程序化断言与视觉断言，以评估核心功能与运行时行为；在消费级XR硬件上执行候选应用，并以专家盲评校验测试套件的有效性。
AI.result: 测试套件对124个候选应用的判定与专家盲评一致率达96.5%；在10个模型上评测，最强配置总体 Pass@1 仅为50.9%。失败分析揭示三类反复出现的误解：异步传感器生命周期、物理接地（physical grounding）以及具身交互语义。
AI.conclusion: GenXR-Bench 为在空间计算的交互性与物理具身条件下评测编程智能体提供了可复现的测试平台，并表明当前智能体在XR应用开发上仍存在显著能力缺口。

title: A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
summary: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbits. The index detects the isotropy of the critical points and quantifies the corresponding net topological contributions. Several examples, including softplus MLPs, Transformers, and equivariant neural networks, are presented to illustrate the computations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于等变度理论的拓扑对称指标，系统刻画神经网络损失景观中由架构与学习目标产生的对称性及其临界轨道。
AI.motivation: 神经网络损失景观维度极高，其全局结构难以理解；架构与学习目标带来的对称性提供了研究该结构的途径，但相关对称性及由其产生的临界轨道的系统刻画仍不完整。
AI.method: 建立拓扑对称指标（topological symmetry index），方法根植于等变度理论（equivariant degree theories）族，适用于任意网络架构，并包含可处理退化临界轨道的方法。
AI.result: 该指标能够检测临界点的各向同性（isotropy），并量化其相应的净拓扑贡献；通过 softplus MLP、Transformer 及等变神经网络等实例演示了计算过程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为解码网络损失景观对称性提供了通用工具，可推广至任意架构与退化临界轨道情形。

title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
summary: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.

AI.tldr: 提出TrainBridge，一种将GPU优化经验迁移到Ascend NPU训练的智能体方法，以GPU高度优化执行为参考提取优化意图指导NPU重写，并通过迭代profile精调，在四个负载上平均加速1.7x，27个Modded-NanoGPT记录上平均近2.0x。
AI.motivation: NPU训练程序中，算子融合等框架级编译优化仅部分生效，留下碎片化计算与可避免的执行开销；基于profiling的调优虽能缓解，但试错成本高。作者希望高效地把成熟GPU编译栈的优化经验迁移到NPU。
AI.method: TrainBridge采用agentic方式：以成熟GPU编译栈产生的高度优化执行作为任务特定参考，从中抽取"优化意图"，用于指导NPU程序重写；再通过迭代profiling对重写后的程序进一步精调。
AI.result: GPU→NPU迁移实验在覆盖LLM预训练、图像分类、视觉-语言训练的四个负载上平均1.7x加速；在27个Modded-NanoGPT speedrun记录（其GPU实现已高度优化）上平均加速接近2.0x。
AI.conclusion: 以GPU优化执行为参考、结合意图抽取与迭代profile的智能体式迁移，可有效提升NPU训练效率，且对已高度优化的GPU实现仍有显著增益。

title: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI: A Human-Curated Multimodal Dataset of AI-Generated Human-Centric Scenes Across Surveillance, Occupational Portraits, AI-Edited Images, and Short-Form Video
summary: We introduce HumanCentric-Scenes-AI, a human-curated dataset of 296 AI-generated stimuli that depict people across four contexts in which people encounter AI-generated media. The Surveillance subset contains 85 AI-generated CCTV-style images. The Occupations subset contains 128 AI-generated occupational portraits in a balanced paired design covering 64 occupations with one female and one male version of each. The AI-edited subset contains 27 real photographs in which a region was altered or replaced by a generative model. The Video subset contains 56 AI-generated short videos. We curated the images and videos manually over multiple rounds to make them as photorealistic as possible. For each stimulus we release the file, the generation prompt where recorded, and per-stimulus metadata. We report depicted-gender distributions from an initial set of 134 generations without a specified gender and compare them with U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics occupational gender shares. We report edit-region size and its association with zero-shot detection difficulty for the AI-edited subset. We report image-quality distributions for the Surveillance subset and subject-category coverage for the Video subset. HumanCentric-Scenes-AI is intended first for human-perception research, and also for calibration of AI-detection classifiers and bias analysis of generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文发布HumanCentric-Scenes-AI数据集，含296个AI生成刺激物，覆盖监控、职业、AI编辑、视频四类场景，并报告性别分布、编辑区域与检测难度关系等初步分析。
AI.motivation: 现有面向“人遇到AI生成媒介”这一真实情境的数据集不足，缺少经过人工多轮筛选、高逼真度、同时覆盖图像与视频且附带提示词与元数据的刺激物资源，难以支撑人类感知研究与检测器校准、生成模型偏见分析。
AI.method: 构建人工策划数据集HumanCentric-Scenes-AI：Surveillance子集85张CCTV风格AI图像；Occupations子集128张职业肖像，采用64职业×男女配对的平衡设计；AI-edited子集27张真实照片，其中局部区域被生成模型修改或替换；Video子集56段AI短视频。经多轮人工筛选提升逼真度，并为每个刺激物发布文件、生成提示词（如有记录）与逐刺激元数据。分析包括：在134次未指定性别的初始生成中统计所描绘性别分布并与美国劳工统计局职业性别占比比较；统计AI-edited子集的编辑区域大小及其与零样本检测难度的关联；报告Surveillance子集图像质量分布与Video子集主题类别覆盖。
AI.result: 初步分析给出：未指定性别生成中的性别分布及其与BLS职业性别份额的对照；AI-edited子集编辑区域大小与零样本检测难度的关联；Surveillance子集图像质量分布；Video子集主题类别覆盖情况。
AI.conclusion: HumanCentric-Scenes-AI主要面向人类感知研究，亦可用于AI检测分类器的校准与生成模型的偏见分析。

title: Inheritance as an Admission Test for LLM Prompt Merge Operators
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often improved by iterating until a fixed verifier is done. Once that verifier saturates, the loop has nothing left to climb. We instead score agents against the current population, and a frozen panel records whether anyone got better. The panel mean can rise inside the seeds by elimination alone. We therefore count a run as training only when its final mean beats the best generation-zero member. A merge is admitted only when the child moves toward the donor, past the child the same operator produces at zero dose, and the lower confidence bound on that movement reaches half the requested dose. That is the admission test. A detectable shortfall rejects the operator, and the test is otherwise undetermined. We keep realised fitness φas the selector and reference performance θas the unused ruler. Every measurement uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite on one negotiation task, and no fixed-oracle arm was run. In the open loop, tactic append grafts short donor rules and is admitted. Free rewrite moves only a third of the requested dose and is rejected. Template append pastes raw donor replies into the child. Its movement clears the bound on the first probe but not on the re-probe, and it is left undetermined. A held-out re-probe on the five situations the merge never saw confirms that both appends move, and it does not rescue free rewrite. Neither append rises with the dose. Constrained rewrite is admitted in the open loop and was not run in the closed loop, which changes only the operator. The population, the scores and the task stay fixed. No free-rewrite run beats the best generation-zero member. Every tactic-append run and every template-append run does. Sampled loop children keep that split. Free rewrite moves no further toward the donor, and both appends still clear the bound, by less than in the open loop.

AI.tldr: 提出以"种群相对评分+冻结评审面板"替代固定验证器的LLM智能体进化框架，并设计合并算子准入门槛（子代须朝供体方向移动、超过零剂量对照、且移动量置信下界达剂量一半）。在单一谈判任务上用gemini-3.1-flash-lite验证：战术追加被准入，自由重写被拒绝，模板追加不确定。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM智能体迭代依赖固定验证器，一旦验证器饱和（saturate）训练循环便无提升空间。同时，在种子上仅靠淘汰即可抬高面板均值，导致"伪训练"。因此需要构造不依赖固定预言机、且能区分真实改进与选择效应（selection effect）的评估与准入机制。
AI.method: （1）以当前种群相对评分选择器，冻结面板仅记录是否有人变好；仅当某次运行最终均值超过第0代最优成员时才计为"训练"。（2）合并准入检验：子代须朝供体方向移动、超过零剂量下同一算子产生的子代、且该移动量的置信下界达到请求剂量的一半；可检测的不足则拒绝，否则判为未定。（3）以realised fitness φ为选择器，reference performance θ为未使用标尺。（4）开环/闭环（仅改算子，种群、分数、任务固定）对比，并对合并未见的五个情境做留出重测，同时检验剂量单调性。全部测量使用gemini-3.1-flash-lite与单一谈判任务，未设固定预言机对照组。
AI.result: 开环中：战术追加（tactic append，嫁接简短供体规则）被准入；自由重写仅移动请求剂量的1/3，被拒绝；模板追加（拼接供体原始回复）首次探测通过界，重测未通过，判为未定。留出重测确认两种追加均有效，未能挽救自由重写。两种追加均不随剂量增大而增强。闭环中：约束重写被准入（未在闭环运行）；自由重写无一次超过第0代最优，而战术追加与模板追加的每次运行均超过，采样循环子代保持该分化；自由重写未进一步朝供体移动，两种追加仍通过界但幅度小于开环。
AI.conclusion: 固定验证器饱和问题可通过种群相对评分与严格的合并准入检验部分缓解；该检验能有效区分"朝供体定向移动"的算子（战术追加、约束重写）与无效算子（自由重写），并能稳定复现于留出情境与闭环采样。但模板追加的判定不稳定（首测通过、重测失败），且移动幅度与剂量无关，说明当前算子的可调性有限。结论受限于单一任务、单一模型、缺少固定预言机对照，普适性有待扩展验证。

title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code, pre-registrations and results: https://github.com/Aur-Shalev-Merin/lost-gradient-looped-transformers
summary: Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops. We measure how much of the weight gradient this throws away, exactly and for every k from one backward pass, on nine looped language models, and report three findings. First, on a trained model this lost gradient is set near the output: once the loop count is well above k, it barely changes with the loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops on the three models we tested, as a pre-registered test predicted for Parcae). Where the backward signal shrinks, $ρ^k$, with $ρ$ the signal's fitted shrink per loop, approximates it at moderate loop counts but overstates it at long ones, because the fitted $ρ$ drifts up as the fit takes in more loops. On Ouro the signal grows, and keeping two of four loops still loses 81% of the final output's gradient. Second, the lost gradient falls during fine-tuning, by 0.07-0.22 within 300 steps on three of four models, on held-out problems too. The fall is not just the read-out's share of the gradient; training only the layers outside the loop reproduced up to half of it, and it also falls under truncated training. So a trained model's value overstates what truncation removes later. Third, we could not show that it predicts the training cost of truncation better than rules that need no measurement: on two new models it tied Parcae's cost at the same k, in a test too small to separate them.

AI.tldr: 通过一次反向传播精确计算循环Transformer中"截断反向传播"丢弃的权重梯度，在9个循环语言模型上发现：训练后丢弃的梯度集中于输出附近且随循环数几乎不变，微调中该比例下降，且其并不能比免测量的规则更好地预测截断训练代价。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer复用同一层块多次，常仅对最后k次循环反传以节省显存/计算。已有工作未量化这种截断究竟丢掉多少权重梯度，以及该损失在不同k、不同训练阶段和不同模型上的行为，因此难以判断截断是否安全、可否用简单规则替代测量。
AI.method: 对9个循环语言模型，在一次反向传播中精确计算所有k对应的被丢弃梯度（而非近似或多次反传）；研究其随循环数变化、与ρ^k幂律拟合的比较（ρ为每循环信号收缩率）；在微调过程中（含held-out问题）追踪损失；做消融——仅训练循环外层的层、以及在截断训练下观察；并在两个新模型上对比基于测量的预测与免测量规则对截断训练代价的预测能力，其中一项为预注册检验（针对Parcae）。
AI.result: (1) 训练后的模型上，被丢弃的梯度集中在输出端：当循环数远大于k时几乎不随循环数变化（32→64循环变化约0.03，符合预注册预测）；ρ^k在中等循环数近似良好，但长循环下因拟合ρ随循环增加而漂移导致高估；Ouro上信号增长，保留4循环中的2个仍丢掉最终输出梯度的81%。(2) 微调中被丢弃梯度下降0.07–0.22（300步内，4模型中3个），held-out集同样；该下降不单是read-out份额——仅训练循环外层可复现至多一半，截断训练下也下降。(3) 预测截断训练代价方面，基于测量的指标与免测量规则打平（同k下与Parcae等价），检验样本过小无法区分。
AI.conclusion: 截断损失在训练好的模型上主要来自输出端且对长循环不敏感，但会随微调持续下降，因此用训练后模型测得的截断损失会高估后续截断的真实代价；同时该测量暂未证明能优于无需测量的经验规则，实际应用中对截断深度的选择宜谨慎，需更大规模检验。

title: LTEM: LLM-Friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown for Table Understanding and Generation
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Tables in real-world documents, including scientific papers, financial reports, and statistical summaries, frequently use merged cells, multi-level headers, and sectioned layouts. Yet the lightweight formats LLMs handle best (Markdown, CSV) cannot express these structures, while expressive formats (HTML, LaTeX) impose excessive token cost and parsing complexity. To enable systematic analysis of this trade-off, we introduce a taxonomy decomposing table structure into six atomic features (F1-F6) and corresponding complexity levels (L1-L6), and construct STB (Synthetic Table Benchmark), a controlled benchmark with 1,089 tables systematically distributed across complexity levels. Using this framework, we propose LTEM (LLM-friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown), a formally specified, minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes spans and hierarchical headers. Experiments across five state-of-the-art LLMs show that LTEM achieves accuracy comparable to HTML, offers a favorable accuracy-token trade-off relative to HTML and LaTeX, and produces substantially fewer invalid responses than LaTeX; for table generation, LTEM is comparable to MultiMarkdown though HTML is best. We release our taxonomy, benchmark, and format specification to support future research on LLM-table interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出表格结构六特征（F1-F6）与复杂度层级（L1-L6）分类体系，构建含1,089张表格的受控基准STB，并提出Markdown最小扩展格式LTEM以编码合并单元格与多级表头，在五个LLM上取得与HTML相当的准确率与更优的token效率。
AI.motivation: 真实文档中的表格常含合并单元格、多级表头与分区布局，但LLM最易处理的轻量格式（Markdown、CSV）无法表达这些结构，而表达力强的格式（HTML、LaTeX）token开销与解析复杂度过高，缺乏系统性分析该权衡的手段。
AI.method: 建立将表格结构分解为六个原子特征（F1-F6）及对应复杂度层级（L1-L6）的分类体系；据此构建受控合成表格基准STB（1,089张表，跨复杂度层级系统分布）；提出形式化定义的LTEM（LLM友好表格增强Markdown），作为Markdown的最小扩展，显式编码跨度与层次化表头；在五个SOTA LLM上进行表格理解与生成实验评估。
AI.result: 在表格理解任务上，LTEM准确率与HTML相当，相对HTML和LaTeX具有更优的准确率-token权衡，无效响应显著少于LaTeX；在表格生成任务上，LTEM与MultiMarkdown相当，而HTML表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: LTEM在保持低token开销与简单解析的同时具备表达复杂表格结构的能力，是有竞争力的折中方案；作者公开分类体系、基准与格式规范以支持后续LLM-表格交互研究。

title: Weakly Supervised Fish Segmentation through Point-Supervised Tracking and Motion-Informed Language
comment: Accepted to IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey, 7 pages
summary: Understanding the properties of fish populations is increasingly important. Analyzing fish length, width, and mass is integral to maintaining healthy stock in the aquaculture industry, while counting wild fish populations supports marine conservation and coastal reef restoration efforts. Deep learning-based segmentation models offer a promising means of obtaining such information at scale. Most of these models, however, require costly and time-consuming per-pixel segmentation labels for training, which can take up to two minutes per fish to annotate manually. To address this inefficiency, we propose a weakly supervised segmentation pipeline that requires only point-labeled data (one click per fish) to produce accurate segmentation masks. Our pipeline consists of four stages. First, a point-supervised tracker predicts point annotations for each frame. These points are then converted into motion-informed language expressions, which guide a language-conditioned segmentation model (LMPM++) to capture temporal consistency and produce candidate segmentation masks. Finally, optical flow and background subtraction are applied as post-processing filters to suppress noise from incorrect segmentations. Experiments on the DeepFish dataset show improvement in foreground mean intersection over union (mIoU) as compared to baseline models.

AI.tldr: 提出弱监督鱼类分割流水线，仅需每帧每鱼一次点击的点标注即可生成精确分割掩码，在 DeepFish 数据集上前景 mIoU 优于基线。
AI.motivation: 鱼类种群属性（体长、体宽、体重）分析对水产养殖与野生种群计数、海洋保护与珊瑚礁修复至关重要，而逐像素分割标注每条鱼耗时可达约两分钟，成本高、效率低，因此需要低标注成本的方案。
AI.method: 四阶段弱监督分割流水线：(1) 点监督跟踪器预测每帧的点标注；(2) 将点转换为运动信息的语言表达式；(3) 用语言条件分割模型 LMPM++ 依据表达式生成候选掩码以保持时序一致性；(4) 光流与背景减除作为后处理滤除错误分割噪声。仅需每鱼一次点击的点标签。
AI.result: 在 DeepFish 数据集上，前景平均交并比（mIoU）相较基线模型提升。
AI.conclusion: 点级弱监督结合语言条件分割与时序后处理可替代昂贵的逐像素标注，实现可扩展的鱼类分割。

title: GRAIL: From Saliency to Semantics in Time-Series Explanation
summary:
Explaining a time-series model requires both locating the evidence and extracting meaningful knowledge from it. Yet a single timestep is not a semantic unit: the meaningful patterns live across many samples, not in any one of them. Per-timestep saliency is therefore noisy, high-dimensional, and unstable. Existing methods address this by introducing fixed-size windows and treating them as independent players in a cooperative game. Evaluating a coalition of such players requires defining a ``baseline'' region, which prior work tackles with fixed counterfactuals (e.g., a flat line, noise, or a spectral surrogate). This choice frequently dominates the resulting explanation, obscuring the model's true decisions.
  To address these issues, we propose GRAIL, a region-based time-series explanation framework that uses domain-specific intervals, such as the P-wave and the QRS complex of an electrocardiogram (ECG) beat, as players. We describe each region with human-readable features and generate counterfactual baselines with an on-manifold conditional generator. Such a choice of players also admits non-temporal features: static covariates enter as singleton players attributed with the temporal regions on one scale, so a patient's tabular evidence (e.g., age, sex) is weighed directly against the signal. We attribute the predictions to the features via Owen values with common-random-number variance reduction. Experimental results on both synthetic and real data show that the proposed framework produces faithful and robust explanations, evaluated under matched on- and off-manifold operators, offering meaningful knowledge to domain experts.

AI.tldr: GRAIL提出了一种基于区域的时序模型解释框架，以领域特定区间（如ECG的P波、QRS波群）作为博弈参与者，结合人可读特征描述与流形上的条件生成反事实基线，并通过Owen值（含公共随机数方差缩减）将预测归因到特征，兼容静态协变量。
AI.motivation: 单时间步不构成语义单元，有意义的模式跨越多个采样点而非存在于单个点上，因此逐步显著性噪声大、维度高且不稳定。现有方法用固定大小窗口并视为独立参与者，评估联盟需定义“基线”区域，而固定反事实（平坦线、噪声、频谱替代）往往主导解释结果，掩盖模型真实决策。
AI.method: 以领域特定区间（如ECG心拍的P波与QRS复合波）作为博弈玩家；用人类可读特征描述每个区域，并用流形上的条件生成器生成反事实基线；允许非时序特征，静态协变量作为单点玩家，与时间区域在同一尺度上共同归因；通过Owen值与公共随机数方差缩减完成特征归因。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，在匹配的流形内与流形外算子评估下，该框架均产生忠实且稳健的解释，并为领域专家提供有意义的知识。
AI.conclusion: 区域级、领域语义驱动的玩家定义结合流形内条件基线，可有效缓解时序解释中的基线主导与不稳定问题，并统一处理信号与表格协变量的归因。

title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
summary: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient λ setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the reshaped weights do less damage, a plain gradient-norm penalty does not reproduce the effect, and a preliminary extension to three small language models shows the same tail shaping. With a BCH code over 1% of the weights the model then survives 300 progressive bit-search flips in every training seed and 500 in two of three, where three of four published defenses with the same code fail by 300 and WCAT falls to 75% at 500. The reshaped distribution also cuts the parity for a fixed guarantee 3.7 times and makes a sensitivity-ordered 8/6/4/3-bit format affordable, which stores ImageNet ResNet-50 at a 3.29-bit weight payload, 2.4 times smaller than INT8, above the accuracy of LSQ at 3 bits.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAN方法，通过复合正则项系统性地重塑训练模型的权重敏感度分布，缩小敏感尾部，从而提升模型对位翻转的鲁棒性并降低存储开销。
AI.motivation: 训练后网络的权重对模型精度的敏感度分布并不均匀：最敏感的1%权重承担了约五分之一的位翻转损害。该分布决定了模型的位翻转容错能力、纠错码需覆盖的权重比例以及每个权重所需的位数，而现有方案只能被动接受训练留下的分布，无法主动调整。
AI.method: 关键洞察是存储权重的敏感度等于其梯度与存储格式下翻转步长的乘积。LEAN在梯度与翻转步长两个因子上同时施加复合正则：一个范围项（range term）用于约束翻转步长，一个尾部项（tail term）用于降低最敏感权重的梯度，由单一系数λ控制分布移动的程度；可作为微调或训练最后若干轮实施，仅需10个epoch。
AI.result: 在9个视觉模型（ResNet-18/50、VGG-16在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet上）上，敏感尾部缩小5至13倍，精度损失在0.5个百分点以内；真实位翻转验证了重塑后权重损害更小，普通梯度范数惩罚无法复现该效果，并在3个小语言模型上初步显示出相同的尾部塑形。配合覆盖1%权重的BCH码，模型在全部训练种子下可承受300次渐进式位搜索翻转（两个种子达500次），而四个已发表同类防御中三个在300次即失效，WCAT在500次时降至75%。重塑分布还将固定保证下的校验开销降低3.7倍，并使按敏感度排序的8/6/4/3比特格式变得可行——ImageNet ResNet-50以3.29比特权重负载存储，比INT8小2.4倍，精度仍高于3比特的LSQ。
AI.conclusion: LEAN表明权重敏感度分布可被系统性调制而非被动接受，为位翻转容错、纠错码设计及混合精度存储格式提供了一个统一的优化视角，在鲁棒性与存储效率上均取得显著收益。

title: norregel: a preregistered benchmark of dated numeric values in Norwegian law
comment: 24 pages. Preregistrations, code and results: Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422302 (versions v1 10.5281/zenodo.23422303, v1.1 10.5281/zenodo.23432124, v1.2 10.5281/zenodo.23434782, 2.0 10.5281/zenodo.23437444, 2.1 10.5281/zenodo.23502580). Items are withheld
summary: norregel asks language models for numeric values in Norwegian statutes, regulations and parliamentary decisions (NOK amounts, percentages, multiples of the National Insurance basic amount (G) and age limits), each at a stated date. The 916 items were extracted mechanically from Lovdata's open data, and each carries the dated history of its provision, so an answer can be classed as correct, outdated, wrong or uninterpretable. We report a first and a second preregistered run on the same items. In the first run (five models, listed publicly only after local analysis), H1, that outdated answers are more frequent for values that took effect after a model's cutoff, could not be tested in substance, and H2 and H3 were inconclusive; Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 4.6 answered 46.7% and 40.2% of the 880 primary items correctly. The second run was preregistered and published before any of its calls, and eight models were analysed. Its pooled primary test supported H1 under the preregistered decision rule (d = 17.8 percentage points, 95% interval [7.7, 28.9], p = 0.0001). In the preregistered sensitivity analysis S8, which counts as outdated only the most recent value that differs from the key, d was 3.9 [-3.6, 12.7] (p = 0.1754), an interval that contains 0. H1 was supported in every other preregistered sensitivity analysis, but S8 is the only one that gives both groups one target value, so we do not regard the support for H1 as robust. The share of outdated answers equal to that most recent value (H2) was 56.1% [46.6, 65.0], an interval that contains 0.5, and the pooled test of a lower share correct in Nynorsk than in Bokmål (H3) was inconclusive. Several models, among them Haiku 4.5, gave mostly uninterpretable answers. Items and keys are withheld; item IDs, per-answer classes, code and results are on Zenodo.

AI.tldr: norregel 是一个评估语言模型在挪威法规中检索数值（NOK 金额、百分比、G 倍数、年龄限制）并给出指定日期答案的基准。两次预注册运行表明：主要检验支持"模型截止后生效的数值更易被答成过时值"（H1），但在唯一使两组目标值对齐的敏感性分析 S8 中该效应不成立，故作者认为 H1 不稳健；H2 与 H3 均无定论。
AI.motivation: 法规数值随时间频繁修订，模型需在指定日期下给出准确取值，而非训练语料中的旧值。现有基准缺乏带日期历史、可按正确/过时/错误/不可解释分类的机械抽取题目，故构建 norregel 以检验模型的"时间敏感"与"过时回答"问题。
AI.method: 从 Lovdata 开放数据机械抽取 916 道题（880 道主项），每题附带所涉条款的带日期修订历史，答案可分类为 correct / outdated / wrong / uninterpretable。进行两次预注册运行（首次五模型、仅本地分析后公开模型名；第二次在任何调用前预注册并公开，分析八个模型），主检验 H1（截止后生效的数值更常被答为过时），并进行多项预注册敏感性分析（含 S8）、H2（过时答案等于最近一版数值的比例是否等于 0.5）与 H3（Nynorsk 正确率低于 Bokmål）。
AI.result: 第一次运行中 H1 实质性无法检验，H2、H3 无定论；Opus 5.5 与 Sonnet 4.6 分别答对 880 主项的 46.7% 与 40.2%。第二次运行按预注册判定规则支持 H1：d = 17.8 个百分点，95% 区间 [7.7, 28.9]，p = 0.0001；但在敏感性分析 S8（仅将最近一版不同数值计为过时）中 d = 3.9，区间 [-3.6, 12.7]，p = 0.1754，包含 0。H1 在其余预注册敏感性分析中均获支持，但 S8 是唯一令两组具有同一目标值的设定。H2 为 56.1% [46.6, 65.0]，区间包含 0.5；H3 合并检验无定论。多个模型（含 Haiku 4.5）多数回答不可解释。
AI.conclusion: H1 的实证支持依赖于过时值的操作化定义，在唯一等价的 S8 设定下效应消失，因此不宜视为稳健结论；H2 未能拒绝 0.5，H3 无定论。题目与键未公开，仅发布条目 ID、逐答案分类、代码与结果（Zenodo）。

title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa
summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.

AI.tldr: OccJEPA 将遮挡视为掩码，利用预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器补全被遮挡的目标 token，再以轻量解码头输出 amodal 掩码，实现确定性、比扩散方法快 33.5 倍且更准确的视频 amodal 分割。
AI.motivation: 视频 amodal 分割需要每帧目标的完整掩码（含被其他物体遮挡的部分）。现有最佳方法基于微调的视频扩散模型，需大量去噪步数和额外深度网络，且每次采样结果不一致。作者观察到 JEPA 系自监督视频世界模型的训练任务——从可见时空区域预测被掩码区域的表示——与遮挡补全高度相关，故提出"遮挡即掩码"。
AI.method: OccJEPA（Occlusion-as-masking JEPA）：将目标可见掩码未覆盖的 token 丢弃，由预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器填补，再由轻量 head 将观测特征与预测特征解码为 amodal 掩码。模型为确定性输出，无需深度网络与多步扩散采样。
AI.result: 相比扩散式 SOTA 快 33.5 倍且更准确：在 SAIL-VOS、TAO-Amodal（含留出测试划分 +4.00 AP50，及 SAM2 跟踪的可见掩码）与 Kubric 上均更优。控制实验表明增益源自预测器的预训练权重而非容量，在 87M 至 1.85B 参数的世界模型上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 将遮挡显式建模为掩码补全，并复用视频世界模型的预训练表示预测能力，是视频 amodal 分割的高效且确定性替代方案；性能增益主要来自预训练权重而非模型规模。

title: AutoFraming: Synthesizing Dynamic Frames of C Code with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in synthesizing formal specifications from source code. However, existing approaches primarily focus on functional contracts and loop invariants, while largely neglecting frame conditions, which specify the memory locations that may or may not be modified during execution and constitute an essential part of formal specifications. To address this limitation, we propose an LLM-based approach for synthesizing ACSL frame specifications alongside functional contracts from C code. Our approach analyzes code property graphs (CPGs) to extract frame-relevant information from the input code and leverages this information to guide the LLM in generating accurate frame conditions. The resulting specifications capture both region-separation constraints and data dependencies that govern variable modifications. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. On a benchmark of 84 ACSL-compliant functions from non-trivial real-world systems, our method successfully synthesizes error-free frame specifications for 92.9% of the functions, representing a 179% relative improvement over state-of-the-art techniques. On a second benchmark consisting of 51 functions, the success rate increases from 80.4% to 96.1%. Furthermore, when integrated as an auxiliary component into existing LLM-based ACSL-synthesis frameworks, our approach improves frame-specification generation performance by up to 61.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的方法，从C代码中同时合成功能契约与ACSL frame(框架)条件；利用代码属性图(CPG)提取与frame相关的信息来引导LLM生成准确的frame规格，在84个函数基准上达到92.9%无错率（相对SOTA提升179%），并入现有框架可带来最高61.9%的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的形式规格合成工作主要关注功能契约和循环不变式，普遍忽视frame条件（即执行期间可能/不可被修改的内存位置），而frame条件是形式规格的重要组成部分，导致生成规格不完整。
AI.method: 提出LLM驱动的ACSL frame规格合成方法：对输入C代码构建并分析代码属性图(CPG)，从中抽取与frame相关的信息（如区域分离约束、数据依赖、变量修改行为），并将这些结构化信息作为提示引导LLM生成准确的frame条件，与功能契约一并输出。
AI.result: 在来自真实非平凡系统的84个符合ACSL的函数基准上，为92.9%的函数合成无错frame规格，相对SOTA提升179%；在含51个函数的第二基准上成功率由80.4%提升至96.1%；作为辅助组件集成进现有LLM-based ACSL合成框架时，frame规格生成性能最高提升61.9%。
AI.conclusion: 将代码属性图分析与LLM生成相结合，可有效弥补frame条件合成的空白，生成同时刻画区域分离约束与数据依赖的高质量frame规格，且具备良好的可集成性与泛化性。

title: Actually, All Learnable Distribution Classes Are Privately Learnable
summary: We show that every class of distributions that is learnable up to arbitrarily small target error in total variation distance with finitely many samples is also learnable under ($\varepsilon, δ$)-differential privacy up to arbitrarily small target error with finitely many samples. This proves a conjecture of Ashtiani. Previous work by Bun, Kamath, Mouzakis, and Singhal [arXiv:2402.00267] gave a weak refutation of this conjecture, showing that this implication is not true when learnability is defined with respect to a fixed target error. In contrast, we show that, under the standard definition of learnability, the conjecture is true.

AI.tldr: 该文证明：在全变差距离下、允许任意小目标误差且样本数有限的分布类可学习性，蕴含其在(ε,δ)-差分隐私下同样可学习，从而证实了Ashtiani的猜想。
AI.motivation: Bun, Kamath, Mouzakis与Singhal的工作对Ashtiani猜想给出了弱反驳，表明若以"固定目标误差"定义可学习性，则该蕴含关系不成立。作者旨在澄清在标准可学习性定义下猜想是否成立。
AI.method: 理论分析：在标准可学习性定义（允许任意小目标误差、有限样本）下，构造性地将任意TV距离下有限样本可学习的分布类转化为(ε,δ)-差分隐私可学习的算法。
AI.result: 在标准定义下，该蕴含关系成立；此前的弱反驳仅在"固定目标误差"这一非标准定义下有效，二者并不矛盾。
AI.conclusion: Ashtiani猜想在标准可学习性定义下为真；研究结论对定义细节高度敏感，需明确区分"任意小目标误差"与"固定目标误差"两种定义。

title: Understanding Target Probability Reuse in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.

AI.tldr: 研究投机解码中目标模型并行验证树状草稿token后产生的下一token分布能否用于指导下一轮树的选择，发现复用该分布需要代价，并据此提出基于"当前上下文单独计算的目标分布"的第一token分支重排与采样策略，提升期望接受率与解码速度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码用目标模型并行验证一棵草稿token树，但验证得到的下一token分布通常被丢弃，未被用于决定下一轮构建哪棵树。作者希望厘清：这一分布能否被"精确复用"来指导下一轮树选择，以及若不能无损复用，是否存在可行的近似利用方式以提升效率。
AI.method: (1) 理论分析：对无约束目标模型，证明精确复用需分布基于下一轮完整上下文计算；刻画保留该分布须牺牲已接受token的情形，并给出该损失跨解码轮持续的条件。(2) 实验策略：在当前上下文单独计算目标分布，用于对第一token分支重排（替代草稿排序），以及在分配树前先从该分布采样第一token，再扩展树。(3) 在六个目标模型上评估，并与"草稿排序"及"预选树剪枝"基线比较，同时考察目标前向与独立草稿生成重叠时的解码速度。
AI.result: 重排第一token分支可提升期望接受率，在树预算较小时尤为明显；先按该分布采样第一token再分配树，即使在平均树规模相同的条件下也优于对预选树剪枝；当单独的目标前向与独立草稿生成重叠执行时，两种选择规则解码速度快于草稿排序。
AI.conclusion: 在树分配之前就让目标概率可用，可使投机解码更高效。说明目标验证产生的分布虽不能被精确无代价复用，但以当前上下文单独计算并用于第一token层面的分支选择与采样，是可行且有效的近似方案。

title: ReSeg: Retraining-free segmentation of abdominal organs via generalizable semantic representation learning
summary: Abdominal organ segmentation is essential in modern medical applications. While existing deep learning approaches demonstrate promising performance, their heavy reliance on large-scale image data raises concerns over generalization capability and privacy risks. This motivates the development of generalizable segmentation training paradigms based on domain-randomized image synthesis, facilitating generalization across unseen real image domains. However, existing paradigms either suffer from limited segmentation performance when applied to abdominal organs, or require dataset-specific finetuning. To address these limitations, we propose ReSeg, a novel two-stage retraining-free framework for domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation. At the first stage, our organ-agnostic synthetic data-driven pretraining approach exploits semantically and visually diverse synthetic images generated by a dedicated data engine to optimize a Generalizable Semantic Representation Network (GSRNet). The network is thereby capable of learning semantic features robust against variations in anatomical structure, imaging contrast, resolution and spatial context, which provide universal representation capabilities that serve as a foundation for segmentation learning. Subsequently, in the second stage, we continue to train an Organ-specific Encoder-decoder Segmentation Network (OESNet), whose encoder is initialized with the pretrained weights. This training process is facilitated by another dedicated data engine, which generates diversified visual images while strictly retaining the inherent spatial layout of abdominal organs. Comprehensive evaluation on seven abdominal organ segmentation datasets across three different modalities including CT, MRI, and PET demonstrates that ReSeg consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while eliminating the need for real training images.

AI.tldr: ReSeg：一种无需真实训练图像、免微调的两阶段域随机合成数据重训练框架，实现跨模态零样本腹部器官分割。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习腹部器官分割高度依赖大规模真实图像，存在泛化性差与隐私风险；已有基于域随机化合成图像的训练范式在腹部器官上分割性能有限或需数据集特定微调。
AI.method: 两阶段重训练免微调框架：第一阶段用专用数据引擎生成语义与视觉多样的合成图像，预训练器官无关的通用语义表征网络GSRNet，学习对解剖结构、成像对比度、分辨率与空间上下文变化鲁棒的语义特征；第二阶段以GSRNet权重初始化OESNet编码器，并由另一数据引擎在严格保留器官空间布局前提下生成多样化视觉图像进行训练。
AI.result: 在CT、MRI、PET三种模态共七个腹部器官分割数据集上评估，ReSeg一致优于现有SOTA方法，且无需任何真实训练图像。
AI.conclusion: 以合成数据驱动的两阶段"器官无关预训练+器官特定分割"范式可在零真实数据条件下获得强域泛化能力，为隐私敏感的医学分割提供可行路线。

title: Does Every Instance Count Equally? Order Effects in LLM Multi-Instance Processing
summary: Users increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to analyse collections of independent inputs, such as product reviews or social media posts, and return a single aggregated answer. This setting requires multi-instance processing (MIP), where a model combines information from multiple instances into one prediction. We study a task in which the model must infer a binary label for each instance, and identify the most frequent label among the full instance set. The correct answer should be invariant to instance order. By evaluating fifteen LLMs across five datasets and seven instance order patterns, with each instance set held fixed across patterns, we find substantial order sensitivity. Accuracy can differ by about 90 percentage points between the best and worst order patterns, with models generally more accurate when majority-label instances appear at the start than when they appear in the middle or at the end. For subsets of models, available reasoning traces and gradient-based attribution reveal uneven emphasis across positions. Traces disproportionately mention early instances, while attribution scores are generally higher near the beginning and end than in the middle. These results show that instance order can systematically bias aggregated predictions, highlighting the need to evaluate MIP across different input arrangements.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM多实例聚合任务中的实例顺序敏感性：15个模型×5数据集×7种顺序模式下准确率可差约90个百分点，多数标签实例靠前时更准。
AI.motivation: 用户越来越多地让LLM分析一组独立输入（如评论、社媒帖子）并给出单一聚合答案，这类多实例处理（MIP）任务要求答案与实例顺序无关；但模型是否存在顺序偏置尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建任务：对每个实例推断二值标签，并识别全集中的多数标签。固定实例集不变，仅改变排列，评估15个LLM、5个数据集、7种顺序模式；辅以推理轨迹（reasoning traces）与基于梯度的归因分析内部关注分布。
AI.result: 存在显著顺序敏感性，最佳与最差顺序模式准确率相差约90个百分点；多数标签实例位于开头时准确率普遍高于位于中部或末尾。部分模型的推理轨迹不成比例地提及早期实例，梯度归因显示首尾位置的得分高于中部。
AI.conclusion: 实例顺序会系统性偏置聚合预测，破坏答案的顺序不变性；MIP评测应在多种输入排布下进行。

title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. Our analysis further disentangles these two effects and shows both theoretically and empirically that the full RL-IF estimator can often be well approximated using the optimization effect alone. Building on this observation, we develop RINSE, a practical data filtering method for online RL. Experiments on standard control benchmarks and an RLHF-style toxicity-mitigation setting show that RINSE improves training efficiency and final performance over standard PPO and local attribution baselines. These results suggest that RL-IF provides a practical and principled framework for understanding and improving online RL.

AI.tldr: 该论文将在线强化学习中的数据归因形式化为轨迹级留一法量 RL-LOO，并提出一阶估计器 RL-IF，同时分离出优化效应与策略采样效应；基于"优化效应即可近似完整估计"的发现，作者提出数据过滤方法 RINSE，在控制任务与 RLHF 式毒性缓解任务上优于 PPO 与局部归因基线。
AI.motivation: 在线RL对训练经验质量高度敏感，理解单条训练样本的贡献对经验选择与策略解释至关重要。现有在线RL数据归因方法只关注单轮训练内的局部影响，忽略了跨多轮在线更新产生的非局部数据影响，缺乏刻画样本对下游目标长期影响的工具。
AI.method: 1) 将在线RL数据归因形式化为轨迹级留一法量 RL-LOO，度量某训练样本在后续在线更新发生后对下游目标的影响；2) 推导一阶估计器 RL-IF，使影响同时通过优化效应与策略诱导的采样效应传播，并在平滑性假设下给出近似精度理论保证；3) 理论分析分离两种效应，证明并实证完整 RL-IF 常可由优化效应单独良好近似；4) 据此设计实用数据过滤方法 RINSE。
AI.result: 在标准控制基准与 RLHF 式毒性缓解设置上的实验表明，RINSE 相比标准 PPO 及局部归因基线，在训练效率与最终性能上均有提升；理论与实证结果一致显示优化效应已能较好近似完整 RL-IF。
AI.conclusion: RL-IF 为理解和改进在线RL提供了实用且有原则的框架：跨轮次的非局部影响可被高效一阶估计，且其核心贡献来自优化效应，从而支撑了简单有效的数据过滤实践。

title: C$^2$U in RAG: Compositional Concept Unlearning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation can expose unwanted concepts through retrieved evidence even when the generator is moderated. We study query-side concept suppression with a fixed encoder and document index. Compositional Concept Unlearning (C$^2$U) routes a profile-derived direction through an augmented atom bank, adding only a bounded edited-minus-original delta to the raw query. Across five datasets, four encoders, and three seeds, the validation-selected configuration reduces pooled binary target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points with non-positive control degradation and target-exposure changes. Under the evaluated query transforms, it suppresses target density without increasing budgeted control-query exposure. Separately, ArXiv four-concept composition improves over an averaged-direction comparator after independent validation gates and first-use test evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出查询侧概念抑制方法 C²U，在固定编码器与文档索引下通过增广原子库路由画像方向、仅向原始查询叠加有界增量，在五数据集、四编码器、三种子上使目标概念池化二进制 Hit@5 降低 4.25 个百分点，且控制概念无恶化。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）即使生成器已受约束，仍可能通过检索到的证据泄露不期望的概念。作者因此转向"查询侧"的概念抑制，且要求不动编码器和文档索引，以便在不重训、不重建索引的低成本条件下控制概念暴露。
AI.method: 方法为 Compositional Concept Unlearning（C²U）：从用户画像导出方向向量，经由增广的原子方向库（atom bank）进行组合路由，得到编辑方向；只把"编辑后减原始"的有界 delta 加到原始查询嵌入上，避免整体替换查询语义。实验覆盖 5 个数据集、4 种编码器、3 个随机种子，配置经验证集选择；另设平均方向基线作对照，并采用独立验证门控与首次使用即测试的评估协议。
AI.result: 验证集选出的配置使池化二进制目标 Hit@5 下降 4.25 个百分点，控制查询的退化非正（即未变差），目标暴露指标亦呈预期变化。在 ArXiv 四概念组合场景中，经独立验证门控与首次使用测试评估后，C²U 优于平均方向对照。
AI.conclusion: 在固定编码器和索引的前提下，C²U 能以查询侧有界扰动有效降低目标概念在检索结果中的密度，且不增加受预算约束的控制查询暴露；组合路由相对简单平均方向具有额外收益，为 RAG 的概念治理提供了轻量、可插拔的方案。

title: UNIVERS: Learning UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis for generalizable one-shot landmark localization
summary: One-shot landmark localization in volume scans with varying fields of view (FOVs) is challenging. While existing self-supervised learning methods have shown promising performance, they rely on contrastive learning built upon augmented views of the same image, which inherently limits their generalization in cross-modality scenarios. This motivates research on cross-modality embedding learning using paired multi-modality images. However, existing methods suffer from not only limited training data, but also the requirement of multi-stage iterative training. To address these limitations, we propose UNIVERS, an end-to-end trainable framework that learns UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis. Our framework leverages diverse pseudo-data synthesized from organ shape templates, with randomization applied to semantic layout, visual appearance, FOV, and spatial pose. Coupled with cross-domain discriminative voxel-wise contrastive learning, this domain randomization strategy forces the network to disregard domain-specific biases and learn features that are robust against variations in imaging contrast, resolution, and spatial context. Consequently, the trained model enables one-shot landmark localization in multi-modality volume scans with arbitrary FOVs. In this study, the efficacy of the proposed method is demonstrated by applying it to the task of localizing the adrenal glands, which are paired, small, and irregular endocrine organs. In particular, comprehensive experiments are conducted on three challenging adrenal gland datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that UNIVERS consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) one-shot landmark localization approaches, with particularly prominent advantages in cross-modality scenarios. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Kendra9999/UNIVERS.

AI.tldr: 提出UNIVERS，一种端到端可训练框架，通过随机合成伪数据学习通用体素级嵌入，实现任意FOV多模态体积扫描的一次性关键点定位。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法依赖同一图像增强视图的对比学习，跨模态泛化受限；利用配对多模态图像的跨模态嵌入学习又受限于训练数据少且需多阶段迭代训练。
AI.method: 基于器官形状模板合成多样化伪数据，对语义布局、视觉外观、FOV和空间位姿进行随机化；结合跨域判别式体素级对比学习，构成域随机化策略，迫使网络忽略域特有偏置。
AI.result: 在三个挑战性肾上腺数据集上验证，UNIVERS持续优于SOTA一次性关键点定位方法，在跨模态场景中优势尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 域随机化合成数据结合体素级对比学习可学习对成像对比度、分辨率和空间上下文变化鲁棒的特征，端到端实现多模态任意FOV下的一次性关键点定位。

title: Context-Augmented, Session-Calibrated Blood Pressure Tracking from Photoplethysmography
summary: Objective.To distinguish the contributions of acquisition context and photoplethysmography (PPG) to session-calibrated blood pressure (BP) tracking.Approach. The original comparison used three repeats of five-fold participant-level cross-validation in 653 AuroraBP participants, excluding calibration-labelled prediction targets. Matched analyses separated context and PPG and removed elapsed-time terms. Later exploratory follow-ups retained PPG, accelerometer signals and three initial cuff readings. Separate studies evaluated pulse-rate fusion and an intraoperative VitalDB model. Main results.The original wearable-state model achieved participant-level mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.697/6.139 mmHg for systolic/diastolic BP (SBP/DBP). Added context reduced MAE by 0.436/0.126 mmHg (97.5% intervals 0.305-0.573/0.053-0.200). In the matched factorial without the external PPG prior, PPG improved on calibration, time and protocol-provided posture/activity by 0.214/0.135 mmHg; removing time left the DBP interval including zero. Standard PPG descriptors contributed, but additional nonlinear/attractor benefit was not established.
