In a separate follow-up series, a sensor-history ensemble achieved 7.299/5.445 mmHg versus its static-rich reference's 7.363/5.470, small gains of 0.064/0.025 mmHg. Larger DBP errors did not improve uniformly. Quality-weighted fusion reduced pulse-rate MAE from 3.985 to 3.690 beats per minute. VitalDB MAEs remained 15.375/8.833 mmHg despite small PPG gains. Significance. The contribution is a calibrated evaluation framework with explicit controls, reproducible feature-cache-to-results analyses and retained negative findings. The sensor-history gain is exploratory after repeated dataset reuse. Independently estimated wearable states, complete raw-signal reproduction of the supplied richer features, external transfer and clinical adequacy remain unestablished.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个带显式对照的校准评估框架，用于区分采集上下文与PPG对会话校准血压追踪的贡献，并系统报告了小幅增益与阴性结果。
AI.motivation: 已有可穿戴血压追踪常将采集上下文、光电容积脉搏波（PPG）与时间流逝等因素混淆，难以判断增益真正来源；作者希望厘清各自贡献并建立可复现的评估基准。
AI.method: 基于AuroraBP 653名参与者，采用重复三次的五折参与者级交叉验证，排除以校准标注为预测目标；构建匹配的因子分析分别隔离上下文与PPG，并移除耗时项；后续探索性分析保留PPG、加速度信号与三次初始袖带读数；另评估脉搏率融合与术中VitalDB模型。
AI.result: 原始可穿戴状态模型SBP/DBP的MAE为7.697/6.139 mmHg；添加上下文使MAE降低0.436/0.126 mmHg（97.5%区间0.305–0.573/0.053–0.200）。无外部PPG先验的匹配因子分析中，PPG相对校准、时间及协议提供的体位/活动改善0.214/0.135 mmHg，移除时间后DBP区间含零。标准PPG描述子有贡献，但额外非线性/吸引子收益未确立。传感器历史集成达7.299/5.445 mmHg，较静态丰富参考的7.363/5.470仅改善0.064/0.025 mmHg，DBP较大误差未普遍改善。质量加权融合将脉搏率MAE从3.985降至3.690 bpm。VitalDB MAE仍为15.375/8.833 mmHg。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是带显式对照、可复现特征缓存到结果流程并保留阴性结果的校准评估框架；传感器历史增益属数据集反复使用后的探索性发现。独立估计的可穿戴状态、所提供丰富特征的完整原始信号复现、外部迁移与临床充分性均尚未确立。

title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
summary: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, SST consistently reduces forgetting while improving generalization to related tasks. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, SST improves average final performance on streamed domains by 2.53 to 5.75 points over sequential post-training. It also lowers max-drop forgetting in all evaluated settings, with the largest reduction from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream, while substantially recovering the OOD degradation induced by sequential updates.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill Schema Transport (SST)：将新领域知识转译进模型已有的技能空间，把知识更新从“轨迹记忆”变为“程序复用”，在持续域适应中显著减轻灾难性遗忘并提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有缓解灾难性遗忘的方法普遍把遗忘归因于模型漂移过大，因而通过保留旧输出、回放旧数据或正则化参数/表征变化来约束更新、使模型贴近旧状态。作者认为这种"拉回旧状态"的思路有局限，转而主张把新领域知识翻译到模型已有的知识空间中，让陌生知识通过熟悉流程被学习。
AI.method: SST 是后训练框架：将每类样例抽象为"技能模式"(skill schema)，保留其核心操作、依赖关系与验证步骤，剥离领域特有的表层形式；再把新样例重构为可复用流程的实例，使知识更新由对轨迹的记忆转变为对程序的复用。
AI.result: 在两个 3B 指令微调骨架上，流式域平均最终性能较顺序后训练提升 2.53–5.75 分；所有设置下均降低最大下降型遗忘，Qwen-3B MATH 流上由 42.41 降至 7.10 分，并显著恢复顺序更新导致的 OOD 退化。
AI.conclusion: 以“转译进已有技能空间”替代“约束回旧状态”的思路有效：SST 在持续域适应中同时实现更少遗忘与更强泛化，为缓解灾难性遗忘提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Binary Labels: Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Safety with Prompt-Level Rubrics
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 24 tables. Dataset will be publicly released at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/DiagSafe
summary: Current LLM safety benchmarks predominantly rely on binary safe or unsafe labels, lacking explanatory depth and suffering from low consistency across automated judges. To address this, we introduce DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that moves beyond binary classification by employing prompt-level rubrics. Grounded in globally applicable AI safety policies, each rubric provides explicit criteria along two dimensions: safety, which targets concrete harms with specific exemptions to suppress false positives, and usefulness, which independently evaluates instruction fulfillment. To ensure a robust and realistic evaluation, we construct a bilingual (English-Chinese) benchmark grounded in a comprehensive 84-label safety taxonomy, consisting of two subsets: DiagBase, which covers single- and multi-turn prompts with direct harmful queries and template-based jailbreaks, and DiagAttack, which embeds harmful intents into complex instruction-following tasks to form challenging instruction attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiagSafe significantly enhances the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, achieving 95.34% agreement with human annotations -- substantially higher than the 69%-87% achieved by the baselines -- and high inter-judge consistency (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.864). Furthermore, applying our framework reveals that leading LLMs differ markedly in their unsafe rates, and each model also exhibits unique vulnerabilities along different dimensions. In addition, we observe that models are particularly susceptible in Chinese and multi-turn contexts. Ultimately, DiagSafe provides a reliable and explainable tool for auditing and optimizing LLM alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiagSafe，一个基于 prompt-level rubric 的诊断式 LLM 安全评测框架，将二元安全标签升级为安全性与有用性两维度可解释评分，并构建中英双语基准（DiagBase、DiagAttack），显著提升 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工标注的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 安全基准多依赖 safe/unsafe 二元标签，缺乏解释深度，且自动化评判者之间一致性低，难以支撑细粒度安全审计与对齐优化。
AI.method: 以全球适用的 AI 安全政策为依据，为每个 prompt 设计 rubric，含两维度：安全性（针对具体危害并设豁免条款以抑制假阳性）与有用性（独立评估指令完成度）；基于 84 类安全分类体系构建中英双语基准，含 DiagBase（单/多轮直接有害查询与模板化越狱）与 DiagAttack（将有害意图嵌入复杂指令跟随任务形成指令攻击）。
AI.result: DiagSafe 使 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工标注一致性达 95.34%，显著高于基线的 69%–87%，评判者间一致性 Cohen's κ = 0.864；应用该框架发现主流 LLM 不安全率差异明显、各模型存在独特维度脆弱性，且在中英多轮语境下尤为易受影响。
AI.conclusion: DiagSafe 提供了可靠且可解释的工具，可用于 LLM 对齐审计与优化。

title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Uncertain Forward Models
summary: Diffusion posterior samplers reconstruct signals by combining a pretrained diffusion prior with a measurement likelihood specified by a forward model and a noise model. Calibration and reference data can characterize uncertainty in the forward model's parameters, such as blur kernels or detector responses. Fixing these parameters at estimated values leaves their uncertainty out of the likelihood, and parameter errors are thus absorbed into the reconstruction. We introduce an uncertainty-aware likelihood (UAL), a Gaussian approximation to the marginal likelihood obtained by integrating over the uncertain parameters. For each candidate signal, UAL propagates parameter uncertainty into a structured measurement covariance, reducing the quadratic penalty along residual directions that parameter variation can explain. Existing samplers can use UAL in their data updates while retaining their pretrained diffusion priors and sampling schedules. Under a fixed Gaussian nuisance model, we bound likelihood error from linearization and average divergence between the exact marginal and UAL posteriors. We compare samplers with and without UAL across six inverse problems spanning Gaussian and motion deblurring, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and fluorescence microscopy, and find improvements in reconstruction and ensemble prediction. UAL reduces geometric mean MSE by 9% to 20% across samplers in the main Gaussian-deblurring setting and by 51% to 92% in motion deblurring when non-blind samplers use the population-mean kernel. In motion deblurring, DAPS and PnP-DM with UAL also give 6.2 to 6.4 dB higher ensemble-mean PSNR than published BlindDPS and Fast Diffusion EM. On the ablation set, UAL outperforms trace-matched isotropic inflation for PnP-DM in both deblurring tasks; in motion deblurring, it also exceeds the best-tested fixed scalar data weighting by 3.3 dB for PnP-DM and 4.2 dB for DAPS in average PSNR.

AI.tldr: 提出不确定性感知似然（UAL），将前向模型参数不确定性积分进似然，得到带结构化协方差的高斯近似边际似然，可直接嵌入现有扩散后验采样器，在六类逆问题上显著改善重建与集成预测。
AI.motivation: 扩散后验采样器通常把模糊核、探测器响应等前向模型参数固定为估计值，使参数不确定性未进入似然，参数误差被吸收进重建结果。
AI.method: 将不确定参数积分掉，用高斯近似构造边际似然（UAL），为每个候选信号生成结构化测量协方差，在参数变化可解释的残差方向上减弱二次惩罚；保留原预训练扩散先验与采样日程，仅替换数据更新项；并在固定高斯冗余模型下给出线性化似然误差及精确边际后验与UAL后验平均散度的界。
AI.result: 在6种逆问题（高斯/运动去模糊、CT、MRI、超声、荧光显微）上均提升重建与集成预测：高斯去模糊设置下几何平均MSE降低9%–20%，运动去模糊中非盲采样器使用总体均值核时降低51%–92%；运动去模糊中DAPS与PnP-DM+UAL的集成平均PSNR比BlindDPS和Fast Diffusion EM高6.2–6.4 dB；消融中优于迹匹配的各向同性膨胀，并超过最优固定标量数据加权（PnP-DM 3.3 dB、DAPS 4.2 dB）。
AI.conclusion: UAL是一种即插即用的似然修正，能有效传播前向模型参数不确定性，兼具理论保证与跨任务实证收益。

title: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"轨迹级分歧"分析框架，将可见推理轨迹的结构相似性、顺序一致性与整体相似性分解度量，发现整体嵌入相似度会系统性高估多语种推理一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有对多语种大模型的评测多只测最终答案一致性或整体响应相似度，无法判断不同语言的用户是否得到可比的支持性证据；可见推理轨迹在验证、教育与安全审计中日益重要，因此需要轨迹级的评测视角。
AI.method: 构建轨迹级分歧框架，将推理轨迹视为结构化序列，把一致性分解为结构相似性、顺序一致性和整体相似性，并进行成对校准以支持跨语言比较；在3个推理基准、7种语言、6个前沿大模型上评测，辅以句子编码器与步骤切分稳健性检验、两组以英语为锚的双语标注者盲评研究，以及同语言对照实验。
AI.result: 整体嵌入余弦相似度基线系统性高估一致性：整体相似度前四分位的样本中有52.1%–67.3%未进入结构相似度前四分位；该分离现象在不同句子编码器和步骤切分下稳定存在；双语标注者的人类判断与结构相似性一致而非与整体基线一致；同语言对照显示分歧水平具有语言特异性，同一问题改写后的两条英文轨迹比英文轨迹与其跨语言对应轨迹更一致。
AI.conclusion: 答案级与整体相似度评测会显著高估多语种解释性产物的一致性，可靠的 multilingual 部署需要采用轨迹级评测。

title: Minimax-Optimal Predictive Flow Matching under Distribution Drift
summary: Flow matching learns a generative velocity field by regression, but under distribution drift a field must be deployed before the current data arrive. We study this predictive problem for a fixed, possibly nonconvex, neural class, with dynamic regret against the best represented field of each round. We propose DyProd-FM, which refits flow matching on dyadic historical prefixes and selects among the fits with a sleeping Prod master. Without knowing any drift budget, it attains regret $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_ω+1,1+\sqrt{TΩ}\})$ in the relative velocity risk variation $Ω$ and $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_μ+1,1+T^{1/3}V_μ^{2/3}\})$ in the target-law variation $V_μ=\sum_t W_2(μ_{t+1},μ_t)$, up to approximation and fitting costs. Matching lower bounds for fixed classes show that both rates are optimal in $T$ and in the budgets up to logarithmic factors. Prior optimal dynamic-regret guarantees rely on a convex decision set with strongly convex or exp-concave losses, whereas our class may be nonconvex and no curvature in its parameters is assumed. The target-law rate rests on a second-order link between the two variations, which the base noise of flow matching provides.

AI.tldr: 论文研究分布漂移下流匹配（Flow Matching）的预测部署问题，提出DyProd-FM：在二进历史前缀上重拟合流匹配，并用sleeping Prod主算法选择，在未知漂移预算下获得近优动态遗憾。
AI.motivation: 流匹配通过回归学习生成速度场，但分布漂移时必须在当前数据到达前就部署模型。已有最优动态遗憾保证依赖凸决策集与强凸/指数凹损失，而流匹配的神经类可能非凸且参数上无曲率假设，缺乏相应理论。
AI.method: 针对固定（可能非凸）神经类，以每轮最佳可表示场为基准定义动态遗憾。DyProd-FM在二进（dyadic）历史前缀上重拟合流匹配，并以sleeping Prod主算法在各拟合间选择；无需已知漂移预算。分析基于相对速度风险变化Ω与目标律变化V_μ=∑_t W_2(μ_{t+1},μ_t)两种预算，并利用流匹配基噪声建立二者间的二阶联系。
AI.result: 在Ω上达到Õ(min{N_ω+1, 1+√(TΩ)})，在V_μ上达到Õ(min{N_μ+1, 1+T^{1/3}V_μ^{2/3}})的遗憾（忽略逼近与拟合代价）。固定类的匹配下界表明两速率在T与预算维度上（至多对数因子）最优。
AI.conclusion: 在非凸、无参数曲率假设的流匹配类上实现了接近最优的动态遗憾，突破了对凸决策集与强凸/指数凹损失的依赖；目标律速率依赖流匹配基噪声提供的前述二阶联系。

title: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
summary: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC——一个基于人物设定的长历史、覆盖文本/图像/视频/音频的全模态长期记忆基准（923问），并配套冻结问题、读者、提示与预算的诊断协议，将端到端得分分解为表征、检索、传递、读取四阶段的失效定位。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆基准多为文本+图像，或只报告单一端到端分数，无法定位证据在表征、检索、传递或读取过程中究竟于何处丢失；同时全模态记忆缺少对空间、时间、韵律等真实信号的可控构造与因果验证。
AI.method: 构建923个问题，基于11–24轮会话的人物化历史，涵盖文本、图像、视频与音频；刻意构造空间、时间与韵律信号而非装饰性媒体，其中空间信息经最强因果验证、标注韵律经选择器级验证；并设计匹配诊断协议：固定问题、读取器、提示与预算，仅对表征、检索、传递三个环节做干预，实现匹配分解。
AI.result: 匹配分解显示：表征损失具有模态依赖性；即便给定g﻿old证据，残余的读取损失仍占主导；拒答（abstention）在控制条件下依然薄弱，强可答得分与拒答失败并存。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC将全模态记忆评测从排行榜式打分转变为对写入、检索、传递、读取各环节失效的诊断工具。

title: From Canon to Nikon: Camera Domain Shift and Potential Equity Implications in Retinal AI
summary: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness, yet access to regular screening remains limited worldwide. AI offers a scalable approach, but its performance can be sensitive to image quality and acquisition conditions. In a Brazilian cohort of 8,524 patients, retinal images acquired with the Nikon NF5050 were more than twice as likely to have inadequate image quality compared with those acquired with the Canon CR-2, despite refurbished Canon systems costing more than twice as much as Nikon systems. This potential cost-quality trade-off highlights an important consideration for the reliability of AI systems deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. Using a frozen pretrained retinal foundation model, we systematically evaluate whether camera-associated performance differences persist across 12 retinal disease classification tasks, four input resolutions, and five downstream classifiers. We find that camera-associated performance differences vary substantially across tasks, and that neither higher input resolution nor classifier choice consistently mitigates cross-camera variation. These findings identify camera platform as a potentially overlooked source of performance variability, with implications for the safety and reliability of retinal AI when deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. We release all source code, evaluation scripts, and per-task results on GitHub to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 在8,524名巴西患者的队列中，Nikon NF5050采集的视网膜图像质量不达标的风险是Canon CR-2的两倍以上，尽管翻新Canon系统价格是Nikon的两倍多。作者使用冻结的预训练视网膜基础模型，在12个疾病分类任务、4种输入分辨率和5种下游分类器下系统评估相机平台相关的性能差异，发现差异随任务显著变化，且提高分辨率或更换分类器均无法稳定消除跨相机差异。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变是可预防性失明的主要病因，但全球范围内定期筛查的可及性有限，AI被视为可扩展的解决方案。然而AI性能对图像质量和采集条件敏感，而实际部署中成像系统异质性强，相机平台这一潜在变异来源可能被忽视，亟需量化其对AI可靠性与安全性的影响。
AI.method: 基于巴西8,524名患者队列，比较Nikon NF5050与Canon CR-2两套相机的图像质量不合格率及成本。采用冻结的预训练视网膜基础模型作为特征提取器，系统改变三类因素：12个视网膜疾病分类任务、4种输入分辨率、5种下游分类器，评估相机相关的性能差异是否持续存在。全部代码、评估脚本与逐任务结果开源。
AI.result: Nikon NF5050采集图像的图像质量不合格概率是Canon CR-2的两倍以上，而翻新Canon系统成本亦为Nikon系统的两倍以上，构成成本—质量权衡。跨12个任务、4种分辨率和5种分类器的评估显示，相机相关性能差异在不同任务间变化显著；更高的输入分辨率与分类器的选择均不能一致地缓解跨相机变异。
AI.conclusion: 相机平台是被忽视的性能变异来源，存在显著的成本—质量权衡；分辨率与分类器调优无法可靠消除跨相机差异。因此在异质成像系统部署视网膜AI时，需将相机平台纳入安全性、可靠性与基准评估的考量，并通过开源基准促进可复现评测。

title: GRAM: Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging via Subspace Alignment
summary: Merging different models into a single model is highly desirable for multi-task deployment, particularly in regulated domains like healthcare. In such settings, models are often locally fine-tuned due to strict data privacy policies, necessitating that aggregation operates exclusively on the fine-tuned weights. Existing methods apply a uniform merge across all tasks, ignoring the geometric relationships among their learned subspaces. When task updates occupy misaligned subspaces, projecting them onto a shared low-rank basis discards task-relevant directions, a failure mode named \emph{subspace interference}. Through this study, we show that the per-task projection error of a merged model is governed by the principal-angle alignment between each task and the shared subspace, so that grouping geometrically compatible tasks provably reduces this error within each group. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging (GRAM)}, which uses the principal-angle geometry of task vectors to decide which tasks should be merged together and then performs a standard SVD-based merge within each coalition; the pipeline requires only the fine-tuned weights at merge time. With only one additional model ($\nK{=}2$), GRAM significantly mitigates subspace interference and consistently outperforms prior merging methods across language understanding (GLUE with Flan-T5), 8-task CLIP vision, and medical instruction tuning (Qwen2-7B-Instruct with four English/Chinese medical LoRAs).

AI.tldr: 提出分组式秩感知模型合并方法GRAM，利用任务向量间的主角度几何关系决定任务分组，再在组内做SVD合并，仅需微调权重即可缓解"子空间干扰"，在GLUE、8任务CLIP视觉与医学指令微调上一致优于先前方法。
AI.motivation: 多任务部署需要把多个模型合并为单一模型，尤其在医疗等受监管领域，因数据隐私限制模型只能本地微调，聚合必须仅基于微调后的权重。现有方法对所有任务施加统一合并，忽略了各任务学习子空间之间的几何关系；当任务更新处于不对齐子空间时，将其投影到共享低秩基会丢弃任务相关方向，即"子空间干扰"问题。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明合并模型的逐任务投影误差由各任务与共享子空间之间的主角度对齐程度决定，从而证明将几何兼容的任务分组可降低组内误差。据此提出GRAM：以任务向量的主角度几何作为分组判据，决定哪些任务应合并在一起，然后在每个任务联盟内执行标准的基于SVD的合并流程；整个流水线在合并时只需微调权重。
AI.result: 仅额外引入一个模型（K=2）时，GRAM即显著缓解子空间干扰，并在语言理解（GLUE + Flan-T5）、8任务CLIP视觉、以及医学指令微调（Qwen2-7B-Instruct搭配四个中英文医学LoRA）上一致优于现有合并方法。
AI.conclusion: 任务子空间的几何对齐性是模型合并误差的关键因素，基于主角度进行分组合并能在极低开销（K=2）下有效抑制子空间干扰，为隐私受限场景下的多任务部署提供了理论与实证兼备的合并方案。

title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
summary: In this paper, we study continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the state follows an unknown stochastic differential equation but only a fixed off-policy batch of discrete-time transitions is available. Standard discrete-time Q-learning becomes problematic as the sampling interval shrinks, because differences between action values vanish. Continuous-time alternatives, such as Deep Advantage Updating and martingale q-learning, preserve the action signal but jointly learn a value function and an action-dependent critic. Building on the PhiBE-Q formulation (arXiv:2606.21925), we develop a model-free PhiBE policy iteration (PhiBE-PI) framework that uses a single state-action critic while preserving the continuous-time action-ranking scale. At each iteration, the framework learns the critic directly from sampled increments and uses it to improve the policy. The same batch is reused throughout, without explicitly estimating the drift or diffusion. We further develop an implementation under linear function approximation and establish a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee for the learned policy. Our analysis quantifies how errors from time discretization, function approximation, and finite-sample policy evaluation propagate through policy iteration. It accounts for the dependence of successive policies on the reused data, so the guarantee does not require a fresh batch at each iteration. Moreover, we identify a bias-variance trade-off: smaller sampling intervals improve the approximation to the continuous-time problem but can increase statistical error at a fixed sample size. Thus, finer time discretization does not necessarily lead to better policy performance.

AI.tldr: 提出无模型的 PhiBE 策略迭代（PhiBE-PI）框架，用单一状态-动作评价器在连续时间强化学习中保持动作排序尺度，并给出基于线性函数逼近的端到端次优性保证。
AI.motivation: 仅给定固定的离策略离散时间转移批次、状态服从未知随机微分方程时，采样间隔缩小会使离散时间 Q-learning 中动作价值差消失；Deep Advantage Updating 与 martingale q-learning 等连续时间方法虽保留动作信号，却需联合学习价值函数与动作相关评价器，结构复杂且依赖新数据。
AI.method: 在 PhiBE-Q 表述基础上构建模型无关的 PhiBE-PI：每轮迭代直接从采样增量学习单一状态-动作评价器并据此改进策略，全程复用同一批次数据，不显式估计漂移或扩散项；给出线性函数逼近下的实现，并分析时间离散化误差、函数逼近误差与有限样本策略评估误差在策略迭代中的传播，且保证考虑相邻策略对复用数据的依赖性。
AI.result: 建立了学习策略的局部端到端次优性保证，且不要求每轮迭代使用全新批次数据；同时识别出偏差-方差权衡：在固定样本量下，减小采样间隔虽更贴近连续时间问题，却会增大统计误差，因此更细的时间离散化未必带来更优的策略性能。
AI.conclusion: PhiBE-PI 以单一评价器保留连续时间动作排序信息，并在离线复用数据条件下具备理论可证的性能界；实践上需权衡采样间隔的离散化偏差与统计方差。

title: Let Agents Design How They Search: Automatic Interface Optimization for Agentic Search
summary: Agentic search depends on the interface through which a language-model agent accesses and explores a corpus. Existing interface designs are fixed by hand and applied unchanged to every corpus, although effective designs may depend on the corpus. We introduce SearchWeaver, a framework for automatic search interface optimization guided by downstream search performance. A proposer uses execution trajectories and task rewards to jointly revise corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions. This pro cess optimizes what information is prepared in advance, which operations tools perform, and which decisions remain with the search agent. With GPT-5.4-nano, the optimized interfaces improve answer accuracy from 71.6% to 78.4% on BrowseComp-Plus and average nDCG@10 from 45.7 to 55.0 across four BRIGHT subsets over Direct Corpus Interaction. These findings highlight the value of jointly optimizing corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions to develop effective search interfaces.

AI.tldr: SearchWeaver：以搜索任务表现为反馈，用提议器自动协同优化语料工件、可执行工具与使用指令，为智能体检索自动构建搜索接口。在GPT-5.4-nano下，BrowseComp-Plus准确率由71.6%提升至78.4%，BRIGHT四子集平均nDCG@10由45.7提升至55.0。
AI.motivation: 智能体式检索（agentic search）高度依赖语言模型智能体访问与探索语料的接口，但现有接口均由人工固定设计、且对所有语料一视同仁地复用；而有效接口设计可能依语料而异，因此需要按语料自动优化接口。
AI.method: 提出SearchWeaver框架，以下游检索性能为优化信号。由提议器（proposer）利用执行轨迹与任务奖励，联合修订三类接口要素：语料工件（预先准备的信息）、可执行工具（工具承担的操作）、使用指令（留给搜索智能体的决策）。该过程同时决定"预先准备什么信息、工具执行哪些操作、哪些决策交由智能体"。
AI.result: 使用GPT-5.4-nano，相比Direct Corpus Interaction基线：BrowseComp-Plus答案准确率从71.6%升至78.4%；BRIGHT四个子集平均nDCG@10从45.7升至55.0。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化语料工件、可执行工具与使用指令，是以任务表现为导向构建高效搜索接口的有效路径，且接口应随语料自适应而非手工固定。

title: DriftNeRF: Cross-Ray Density Drifting for Sparse-View Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) synthesize photorealistic novel views from dense image collections, but degrade sharply when few views are available. We attribute a specific, measurable defect to the objective itself: the rendering loss is a sum over independent rays and contains no term comparing densities that different rays assign to the same region of space, so nearby 3D points can settle on contradictory densities while every training pixel is reproduced correctly. We make this quantity explicit by measuring cross-ray density disagreement directly during training, and show that it stays high in vanilla NeRF, falls only incidentally under frequency-based regularization, and moves together with held-out quality in the sparse regime. We then close the gap with DriftNeRF, a drop-in regularizer that instantiates the drifting-field template on density samples: a masked exponential kernel aggregates densities from nearby points on other rays into a stop-gradient consensus target, and the resulting drifting field penalizes unsupported disagreement while leaving agreed-upon boundaries intact. The regularizer reads only sampled positions, ray identifiers, and predicted densities, so it requires no pretrained model, external geometry, or additional images, and transfers across field parameterizations. On NeRF-Synthetic it reduces residual disagreement by an order of magnitude, and across NeRF-Synthetic, DTU, and LLFF it improves 3-view PSNR over the strongest MLP-NeRF baseline by 0.42-0.65 dB and remains competitive with sparse-view Gaussian pipelines under a matched protocol without their depth, flow, or covisibility preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 论文将稀疏视角NeRF的退化归因于渲染损失缺乏跨射线密度一致性约束，提出DriftNeRF正则项直接惩罚跨射线密度不一致，在NeRF-Synthetic、DTU、LLFF上提升3视图PSNR 0.42–0.65 dB。
AI.motivation: NeRF在稠密视角下可合成逼真新视图，但少视角时质量急剧下降。作者将这一缺陷归因于目标函数本身：渲染损失是对独立射线的求和，不含任何比较不同射线对同一空间区域所赋密度的项，因此相邻3D点可能收敛到相互矛盾的密度，而每个训练像素仍被正确复现。
AI.method: 作者在训练中直接测量跨射线密度不一致（cross-ray density disagreement）以使该量显式化；随后提出DriftNeRF——一个即插即用正则项，将drifting-field模板实例化于密度采样：用掩码指数核对其他射线上邻近点的密度进行聚合，形成带stop-gradient的共识目标，从而惩罚无支撑的不一致，同时保留已达成一致的边界。该正则项仅依赖采样位置、射线标识与预测密度，无需预训练模型、外部几何或额外图像，并可跨场参数化迁移。
AI.result: 跨射线密度不一致在原始NeRF中持续偏高，在频率类正则下仅偶然下降，且在稀疏情形下与留出视图质量同步变化；在NeRF-Synthetic上，DriftNeRF将残余不一致降低一个数量级；在NeRF-Synthetic、DTU、LLFF上，3视图PSNR较最强MLP-NeRF基线提升0.42–0.65 dB，并在匹配协议下与稀疏视角高斯方法保持竞争力，且无需其深度、光流或共视预处理。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏视角NeRF的退化源于渲染损失的跨射线密度不一致缺陷；DriftNeRF以轻量的drifting-field密度正则直接闭合该缺口，通用性强、无额外输入依赖，并显著改善稀疏视角重建质量。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
summary: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley-Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. On that split Huxley-Gödel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley-Gödel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自改写代码代理（self-rewriting coding agent）如何提前选择待扩展的候选脚手架编辑，并通过线性读出模型验证其搜索与选择策略的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自改写代理在编辑被评测前就必须决定扩展哪个提议编辑，且搜索最终只返回一个代理，因此需要一种在未评测状态下预测编辑质量并作出选择的方法。
AI.method: 对每个运行拟合一个线性读出，用父代steering-split解出率与提议diff的八个坐标作特征，训练数据为96条脚手架编辑及16实例fit split上的四次评测标签，随后冻结系数。HumanEval+留48实例、Polyglot留64实例作为steering split，用其评分父代并维护四节点档案；Huxley-Gödel Machine选择依据已评测节点的steering计数做Thompson采样抽取父代并扩展其提议的子代，最终返回steering解出数最大且最早被评测的节点。
AI.result: GPT-4o十二次运行得到节点在HumanEval+留出集上达87.0%（父代率消融84.2%）；同一划分上Huxley-Gödel Machine选择85.1%，根脚手架81.2%，校准最优编辑82.8%。Claude Sonnet 4.5为86.6%，Huxley-Gödel Machine选择86.5%，父代率消融85.3%，校准最优编辑85.1%。
AI.conclusion: 基于线性读出与Thompson采样的选择策略在HumanEval+与Polyglot留出集上均优于根脚手架、校准最优编辑及父代率消融，表明冻结系数的轻量预测模型可有效指导自改写代理的编辑选择。

title: Query Feedback and Teaching for Stable and Certifiable Language Generation
summary: Language generation in the limit studies whether a learner observing an enumeration of an unknown target language can eventually generate only valid, previously unseen elements. We study stability, introduced by Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Velegkas (2025), which requires the generator's infinite output set to eventually remain unchanged, and introduce the stronger notion of certifiability, which requires the generator to determine from its observations that its current output is valid. Drawing on teaching sets in learning theory, we introduce a hierarchy of teaching dimensions for generation under three increasingly strict success criteria: correctness, stability, and certifiability. These dimensions measure the minimum number of selected examples whose appearance guarantees the corresponding success condition. We also study stability and certifiability in the membership-query model of Charikar and Pabbaraju (2025). We characterize stable and certifiable generation, both with and without query feedback, and establish their relationships with uniform generation and identification in the limit. In particular, we give a finite-witness characterization of stable generation, analogous to Angluin's tell-tale characterization of identification, resolving a gap left open by Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Velegkas (2025). We further compare these generation notions with identification in the limit and contrast their teaching requirements on well-studied language families, including regular and erasing pattern languages.

AI.tldr: 本文在"极限语言生成"框架下研究稳定性并引入更强的可认证性，借助教学维度刻画三种成功准则，并在成员查询模型下给出稳定生成的有限见证刻画。
AI.motivation: Kalavasis等人(2025)提出的稳定性只要求生成器无限输出集合最终不变，但未刻画其有限见证特征，且缺乏"生成器能否自行确认输出有效"这一更强要求的系统研究；同时成员查询模型下的稳定性与可认证性尚未被刻画。
AI.method: 引入可认证性概念；借鉴学习理论中的教学集，定义正确性、稳定性、可认证性三级成功准则下的教学维度层级（最小选定样本数使出现后保证对应成功）；在Charikar与Pabbaraju(2025)的成员查询模型（含/不含查询反馈）中刻画稳定与可认证生成，并与一致生成、极限辨识建立关系。
AI.result: 刻画了含与不含查询反馈情形下的稳定与可认证生成；给出稳定生成的有限见证刻画，类比Angluin的tell-tale刻画，填补了Kalavasis等人的空白；厘清稳定/可认证生成与一致生成、极限辨识的关系，并在正则语言族与擦除模式语言族等上比较各生成概念的教学需求。
AI.conclusion: 教学维度层级为生成的成功准则提供了定量刻画，可认证性严格强于稳定性；稳定生成具有与极限辨识tell-tale类似的有限见证特征，且不同生成概念在教学复杂度上差异显著。

title: Intergroup Bias Predicts Expressions of Social Judgment and Empathy in the r/AmITheAsshole Reddit Community
summary: People share and understand others' experiences differently based on their social identities; often, people empathize more when the other person belongs to their ingroup compared to an outgroup. While this intergroup empathy gap is well-studied in social psychology, it remains unclear how it manifests in naturally occurring online social interactions. To this end, we measure how commenters express social judgments, as an indirect outcome of their understanding towards the posters, and empathy in text, based on whether commenters share the poster's gender or are of similar ages. We focus on posts where the poster self-reports these demographics, and analyze 126,716 comments associated with 36,163 posts from 18,111 commenters in r/AmItheAsshole, while controlling for commenter and poster group identities, post features (topic, length, and score), and both commenter- and post-level variance. Our results show that when commenters and posters are ingroup, in either gender or age, commenters are more likely to provide a Not the Asshole verdict and show greater text-based understanding as measured by LLMs. We also observe that older commenters behave differently from younger ones. Furthermore, in a subset of posts where the gender and age of the other party in the conflict are explicitly mentioned, we find that commenter-poster ingroup effects are moderated by the group relationships between the poster and the other party when commenters make social judgments. Our work highlights the importance of intergroup context and social group nuances in understanding online discourse.

AI.tldr: 基于 r/AmItheAsshole 的 12.7 万条评论，发现评论者与发帖者在性别或年龄上同属内群时，更倾向给出 NTA 判决并表现出更高的文本共情，且该效应受发帖者与冲突对方的群际关系调节。
AI.motivation: 社会心理学已充分记录"群际共情鸿沟"（对内群共情强于外群），但该现象在自然发生的在线社交互动中如何表现尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以评论者对发帖者的社会判断（是否给予 Not the Asshole 判决）作为理解的间接结果，并用 LLM 测量文本共情；聚焦发帖者自报性别与年龄的帖子，分析 r/AmItheAsshole 中 18,111 名评论者对 36,163 个帖子的 126,716 条评论，控制评论者与发帖者的群体身份、帖子特征（话题、长度、分数）及评论者级与帖子级方差。
AI.result: 当评论者与发帖者在性别或年龄上同属内群时，更可能给出 NTA 判决，LLM 度量的文本理解程度也更高；年长评论者的行为与年轻评论者不同；在冲突对方性别与年龄被明确提及的子集中，评论者—发帖者内群效应在作社会判断时受到发帖者与冲突对方群体关系的调节。
AI.conclusion: 群际情境与社会群体细微差异对理解在线话语至关重要。

title: PhyMo: Learning Physical Dynamics with Accurate and Continuous Motion from Multi-View Videos
summary: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: PhyMo：从多视角视频学习动态3D场景，用运动感知轨迹表示避免外观捷径，并用带双向运动学连续性约束的连续运动演化模块实现几何忠实插值与连续外推。
AI.motivation: 从多视角视频恢复动态3D场景的几何、外观与物理运动状态很重要但困难。核心难题是外观具有欺骗性：仅靠渲染监督时，模型可通过改变颜色或不透明度来补偿不准确的形变，从而拟合观测图像，而非恢复真实的几何与运动。该问题在快速或局部复杂运动场景中尤为严重——错误轨迹在观测帧上仍可生成合理图像，但导致重建不可靠、未来预测不连续。
AI.method: 提出PhyMo框架：(1) 运动感知轨迹表示（Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation），促使模型从形变中恢复准确运动，而非依赖外观捷径解释观测到的运动；(2) 连续运动演化模块（Continuous Motion Evolution），引入双向运动学连续性约束，促进位移、速度、加速度在时间上的一致性演化。
AI.result: 在四个动态场景基准上取得最先进性能，并实现几何忠实的插值与连续的运动外推。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦外观与运动的建模方式，并施加运动学连续性约束，可有效缓解渲染监督下的外观捷径问题，获得更可靠的动态重建与可用的未来运动预测。

title: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
summary: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respects the printed median, interval and event count. We propose StochIKM, a stochastic algorithm that digitizes the figure with a vision-capable language model and uses the high-fidelity definition as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets. A solution is guaranteed to exist whenever the figure has been read correctly, so a failure indicts either the published figure or its digitization. In simulation and in 79 arms from published oncology trials, StochIKM reproduces the published risk tables and medians more closely than LLM-improved IPDfromKM, a high-impact alternative.

AI.tldr: 提出StochIKM：用视觉语言模型数字化KM曲线，以显式高保真定义（严格复现风险表、曲线误差在图像分辨率内、满足中位数/区间/事件数）为约束的随机算法，返回一组"可采纳"的个体患者数据集，而非单一数据集。
AI.motivation: KM图重建IPD是二次分析time-to-event证据的重要手段，但现有方法各自宣称高保真、却仅以自己碰巧达成的某几项一致性来评判；且图到数据的映射非双射，返回单一数据集掩盖了不确定性。
AI.method: 显式定义保真度：可采纳数据集须精确复现风险表、数字化曲线误差不超过图像分辨率、并符合印刷的中位数、区间与事件数；StochIKM用视觉语言模型数字化图形，将该定义作为约束的随机算法，输出可采纳IPD集合；只要图形读取正确则解必然存在，失败即可归因于图形或数字化环节。
AI.result: 仿真及79个已发表肿瘤试验组中，StochIKM对风险表与中位数的复现优于LLM改进版IPDfromKM。
AI.conclusion: 以约束形式刻画保真度并把非唯一性显式化为数据集集合，使重建结果可验证、失败可归因，性能优于现有方法。

title: The Data Differentiator Framework (DDF): Quantifying Marginal Data Value with Information-Theoretic and Game-Theoretic Measures in an Agentic Evaluation Pipeline (SDSAE)
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Primary cs.AI; cross-listed cs.LG and stat.ML
summary: In data-rich enterprises the hard question is not whether a candidate dataset is good in isolation, but whether it adds information beyond what the organization already holds, and whether that increment is worth its price. We present the Data Differentiator Framework (DDF), a composite scoring method for candidate data assets that combines (i) a mutual-information-based redundancy penalty against the existing portfolio, (ii) a cost-normalized, significance-gated marginal utility score derived from an ablation study, and (iii) explicit governance inputs (trust, identity resolution quality, strategic weights) set by the business. The framework is executed by a staged pipeline, the Strategic Data Sourcing Agent Ecosystem (SDSAE), that short-circuits expensive model-retraining steps for assets failing governance or redundancy gates. Conceptually, the DDF extends the relevance-minus-redundancy principle of mRMR feature selection from the feature level to the asset level, and adds cost normalization, a statistical significance gate, and governance terms that per-sample valuation methods such as Data Shapley do not model. We validate the framework on the public credit-card fraud benchmark (284,807 transactions) with five constructed candidate assets spanning the redundancy spectrum. Only the genuinely differentiated asset passes the significance gate ($Δ$AUC = +0.0029, DeLong $p = 1.4\times 10^{-9}$, Holm-corrected $p = 7.2\times 10^{-9}$) and receives an acquire recommendation (DDS = +0.663); the fully redundant asset scores lowest (DDS = -0.135). The recommendation is stable across 19 of 22 admissible strategic-weight configurations and across all decision thresholds in [0.15, 0.66]. We state clearly which quantities in the case study are computed from data and which are simulated governance inputs, and we discuss the design limits of a single-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出Data Differentiator Framework (DDF)复合评分方法，衡量候选数据集相对已有数据组合的增量信息与性价比，并经SDSAE分级流水线门控执行；在信用欺诈基准上仅真正差异化资产通过显著性门（ΔAUC=+0.0029）并获得采购推荐。
AI.motivation: 企业面对候选数据集时真正的难题不是其单独质量，而是它是否带来超出既有数据组合的增量信息，以及该增量是否值其成本。
AI.method: DDF将mRMR的相关性减冗余原则从特征级扩展到资产级，融合三部分：(i) 基于互信息的相对现有组合的冗余惩罚；(ii) 由消融研究导出的成本归一化、显著性门控的边际效用分；(iii) 业务设定的治理输入（可信度、实体解析质量、战略权重）。执行由分级流水线SDSAE完成，对未通过治理或冗余门控的资产短路昂贵的模型重训练步骤。
AI.result: 在公开信用卡欺诈基准（284,807笔交易）与覆盖冗余谱的五个构造候选资产上验证：仅真正差异化资产通过显著性门（ΔAUC=+0.0029，DeLong p=1.4×10⁻⁹，Holm校正p=7.2×10⁻⁹），获得采购推荐（DDS=+0.663）；完全冗余资产得分最低（DDS=-0.135）。推荐在22个可接受战略权重配置中的19个以及[0.15, 0.66]内所有决策阈值下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: DDF相较Data Shapley等逐样本估值方法补充了成本归一化、统计显著性门与治理项；文中明确区分由数据计算量与模拟治理输入量，并讨论了单数据集评估的设计局限。

title: Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models have emerged as an alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel token generation. However, standard masked diffusion language models use a shared noise schedule across positions without explicitly encoding which positions should be resolved first. Many tasks exhibit a natural priority among positions: document titles and section headings can guide the generation of body text, while Sudoku cells determined directly from the initial clues can help resolve more difficult cells. To incorporate this notion of priority (or hierarchy) among token positions, we introduce the Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Model (HMDLM), which augments each token position with a hierarchy level available as part of the training data, and requires zero or minimal additional annotations. It factors generation into two passes: the first predicts a hierarchy distribution over masked positions, the second predicts token distributions conditioned on it. Giving each hierarchy level its own noise schedule induces a soft, controllable preference for revealing higher-priority positions earlier while keeping decoding fully parallel. Our formulation is mathematically grounded, and we re-derive the forward and reverse processes and the NELBO for this factorization. Our evaluation shows that for the task of language generation on LM1B, HMDLM reduces perplexity by more than 1.5 points over Anchored Diffusion Language Model (ADLM), a recently proposed strong diffusion baseline; on WikiHow, we see a drop in perplexity of up to 4.4 pts on ADLM and up to 7 pts against MDLM. An LLM judge on WikiHow prefers HMDLM generations (the two variants combined) more than $2\times$ as often as the baseline. On the task of solving Sudoku puzzles requiring multi-step reasoning, it improves solution accuracy by up to $8.6\%$ absolute points over existing diffusion baselines.

AI.tldr: HMDLM 为每个 token 位置引入层级标签，并用两阶段分解与按层噪声调度实现"高优先级位置先解码"的并行生成。
AI.motivation: 标准掩码扩散语言模型对所有位置使用统一噪声调度，无法显式编码哪些位置应优先解析；而许多任务天然存在位置优先级（如标题引导正文、数独中由初始线索直接确定的格帮助推理难格）。
AI.method: 为每个 token 位置附加层级级别（来自训练数据，几乎无需额外标注）；将生成分解为两遍：第一遍在掩码位置上预测层级分布，第二遍以此为条件预测 token 分布；给每个层级配置独立噪声调度，从而在完全并行解码下形成对高优先级位置优先揭示的软性、可控偏好。论文重新推导了该因子化下的前向/反向过程与 NELBO。
AI.result: LM1B 语言生成上，困惑度比 ADLM 降低 1.5 点以上；WikiHow 上比 ADLM 最多降 4.4 点、比 MDLM 最多降 7 点；LLM 评判在 WikiHow 上偏好 HMDLM（两变体合计）的频次超过基线的 2 倍；需多步推理的数独任务上，求解准确率较现有扩散基线最高提升 8.6 个绝对百分点。
AI.conclusion: 引入层级位置先验并与噪声调度耦合，可在保持并行解码的同时显著提升掩码扩散语言模型的生成质量与结构化推理能力，且理论推导完备、标注成本低。

title: WaFIR: Wavelet-Fourier Mixture-of-Experts with Subband-Adaptive Routing for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Blind all-in-one image restoration must adapt a shared model to heterogeneous and sometimes mixed degradations without a task label at test time. We introduce WaFIR, a decoder module that decomposes features into Haar subbands, summarizes each subband with a compact Fourier descriptor, and routes it to prompt-conditioned spectral modulation experts. Unlike image-level frequency conditioning, WaFIR makes routing decisions at the subband level, enabling frequency-specific processing while retaining the task context learned by the backbone. Under a unified training and evaluation protocol for denoising, deraining, and dehazing, WaFIR improves average PSNR over the three tasks by 0.48 dB over the PromptIR baseline and by 0.38 dB over the recent Up-Restorer. Matched-capacity and routing controls show that the gain is not explained by additional parameters alone. On unseen noise intensities, descriptor-based routing is more robust than a discrete label-conditioned alternative and remains on par under compound degradations, while routing analyses show stable subband-dependent expert use across degradation types. These results support subband frequency structure as an interpretable complement to prompt-based conditioning for blind image restoration. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WaFIR/README.md

AI.tldr: 提出WaFIR解码器模块，将特征分解为Haar子带、用紧凑傅里叶描述子表征并以子带级路由到提示条件化的频谱调制专家，在盲一体化图像复原中平均PSNR优于PromptIR与Up-Restorer。
AI.motivation: 盲一体化图像复原需在无任务标签的测试条件下用共享模型处理异构甚至混合退化。现有提示（prompt）条件化多在图像级进行频率条件，难以针对不同频段做差异化处理。
AI.method: WaFIR为解码器模块：将特征经Haar小波分解为子带，对每个子带提取紧凑傅里叶描述子，再依据描述子路由至提示条件化的频谱调制专家；路由决策在子带级而非图像级，从而兼顾频率特异处理与主干学到的任务上下文。统一训练与评估协议覆盖去噪、去雨、去雾。
AI.result: 三任务平均PSNR较PromptIR基线提升0.48 dB，较近期Up-Restorer提升0.38 dB；等容量与路由消融表明增益并非仅来自额外参数；在未见噪声强度下，描述子路由比离散标签条件化更鲁棒，复合退化下性能相当；路由分析显示不同退化类型下子带依赖的专家使用稳定。
AI.conclusion: 子带频率结构可作为基于提示条件化的可解释补充手段用于盲图像复原。

title: NormTune: Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Reasoning-Intensive Tasks
summary: Full fine-tuning has achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks, but it often requires substantial GPU resource consumption. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative for reducing this cost, yet we observe a substantial performance gap on reasoning-intensive tasks. In this paper, we present three key observations showing that this gap is closely associated with norm-related under-adaptation, where PEFT produces markedly smaller weight-update norms than full fine-tuning. Based on these observations, we propose Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (NormTune), a simple yet effective strategy that adaptively strengthens insufficiently updated layers according to their weight-update norms. Extensive experiments show that NormTune consistently enhances multiple PEFT methods across challenging reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025. Moreover, NormTune-enhanced rank-256 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA achieve performance comparable to S1 full fine-tuning, with respective average gains of 2.17\%, 0.93\%, and 3.00\% over this baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出NormTune，通过检测并放大权重更新范数不足的层来缓解PEFT在推理任务上的欠适应问题，显著缩小与全量微调的差距。
AI.motivation: 全量微调在推理密集型任务上效果好但GPU开销大；PEFT虽省资源，却在推理任务上存在明显性能差距。作者观察到该差距与"范数相关欠适应"有关：PEFT产生的权重更新范数显著小于全量微调。
AI.method: 提出三条关键观察作为依据，在此基础上设计NormTune：依据各层权重更新范数自适应地增强更新不足（范数偏小）的层，是一种简单通用的策略，可即插即用地结合多种PEFT方法（如LoRA、Bone、MoRA）。
AI.result: 在S1K-1.1上训练，rank-8 LoRA、Bone、MoRA结合NormTune后，在AIME 2024、MATH 500、GPQA、AIME 2025上平均准确率分别提升24.24%、11.33%、16.21%；rank-256配置下三者达到与S1全量微调相当的性能，平均分别高出2.17%、0.93%、3.00%。
AI.conclusion: 范数欠适应是PEFT推理性能差距的重要成因；NormTune以低开销方式有效弥合该差距，使PEFT在保持参数效率的同时逼近甚至超越全量微调。

title: Auditing Conformal Prediction for Language Models Under Inference-Time Model Shift
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class experimental axis in CP evaluations for language-model systems.

AI.tldr: 论文指出语言模型CP评估中的"匹配协议"缺陷，形式化"推理时模型漂移"并实证其破坏覆盖率保证。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型保形预测（CP）评估通常采用匹配协议，即校准与部署使用相同的后训练推理配置（量化模式、推理温度等）。但实际部署中，为满足显存、吞吐或服务策略约束，推理配置常与校准不同。作者认为这暴露了当前CP评估协议的局限。
AI.method: 将上述现象形式化为"推理时模型漂移"（inference-time model shift）：由推理配置而非输入—标签分布变化所导致的保形分数分布变化；并从理论上刻画其如何在任务分布与已训练模型不变的情况下破坏split-conformal的可交换性。随后在8个语言模型、4个有限标签基准、12种推理配置上进行实证评估。
AI.result: 匹配评估会显著高估部署时的覆盖率，且该效应在模型与数据集间呈现异质性。
AI.conclusion: 推理配置应作为CP评估中的一等问题（first-class experimental axis）予以报告；呼吁改进语言模型CP的评估协议。

title: Credit Where Credit Is Due: Contrastive Attribution Topology Search for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: An LLM multi-agent system (MAS) is only as good as the agents it chooses to trust: its accuracy and cost hinge on its topology, meaning which agents are included and how they communicate. A single task score, however, does not reveal which agents help or hinder performance. We propose Contrastive Attribution Topology Search (CATS), which searches for compact teams within a fixed supergraph of specialized agents. An LLM attributer compares execution traces across candidate topologies and assigns credit to individual agents. CATS uses these credits to update supergraph edges while progressively pruning weak edges and agents, yielding a small team for deployment. With small open-weight models and matched candidate evaluations, CATS improves mean accuracy on BigCodeBench by 5.3 percentage points over score-only heuristic search while using 54\% fewer deployment tokens. On MBPP, CATS matches the strongest baselines with fewer tokens than the other searches. In a HotpotQA prompt-poisoning stress test, CATS excludes all adversarially prompted agents in all three runs, whereas random search retains some at comparable accuracy. Per-agent credit thus supports both team optimization and the pruning of potentially harmful agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Contrastive Attribution Topology Search（CATS），用 LLM 归因器对候选拓扑的执行轨迹做对比归因，把信用分配给单个 agent，并据此更新超图边、逐步剪枝弱边与弱 agent，从而在固定 agent 超图中搜索出紧凑可部署团队。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统的准确率与成本取决于其拓扑（包含哪些 agent、如何通信），但单一任务分数无法揭示哪些 agent 有益、哪些有害，因此需要能对 agent 级贡献进行归因并据此优化团队的方法。
AI.method: CATS 在固定的专用 agent 超图上搜索紧凑团队；由 LLM attributer 比较不同候选拓扑的执行轨迹，为单个 agent 分配信用；再用这些信用更新超图边，并渐进剪枝弱边和弱 agent，最终得到小规模部署团队。实验中采用小型开放权重模型并做匹配的候选评估。
AI.result: BigCodeBench 上平均准确率较仅用分数启发式搜索提升 5.3 个百分点，部署 token 减少 54%；MBPP 上以少于其他搜索的 token 匹配最强基线；在 HotpotQA 提示投毒压力测试中，三次运行均排除所有被对抗性提示的 agent，而随机搜索在相当准确率下仍保留部分此类 agent。
AI.conclusion: 逐 agent 信用既能支撑团队优化（提升准确率、降低 token 成本），也能剪除潜在有害的 agent，说明归因驱动的拓扑搜索是构建可靠且经济的 MAS 的有效途径。

title: Two for One: Privileged Learning for Resource-Constrained Screening
summary: Machine learning systems are often developed under data-rich conditions but deployed when only incomplete information is available. A natural example arises in colour fundus photography (CFP), where both eyes are commonly imaged because they can provide complementary information for ocular disease assessment. Prior approaches that exploit bilateral information either fuse both eyes in a single model or use knowledge distillation to compress a dual-eye teacher into a lightweight student that still requires both images at test time. However, bilateral acquisition may not always be feasible. We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image. Experimental results show consistent improvements in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve over conventional monocular training, with the largest gains observed for left-eye images for the detection of age-related macular degeneration (0.931 vs. 0.966) and diabetic retinopathy (0.789 vs. 0.836).%, while requiring only a single-eye image at inference. By enabling models to benefit from bilateral information during training while requiring only a single-eye image at inference, our approach may support more reliable deployment in resource-constrained clinical and screening environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种特权学习（privileged learning）框架：训练时教师模型利用双眼CFP图像，学生模型仅以单眼图像为输入学习迁移双侧知识；推理时学生只需单眼图像，即可获得优于常规单眼训练的AUC表现。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统常在数据丰富条件下开发，却在信息不完整时部署。CFP中双眼成像可提供互补信息辅助眼病评估，但现有方法要么在单一模型中融合双眼、要么用知识蒸馏压缩为仍需双眼输入的轻量学生；而临床上双侧采集并非总可行，故需一种训练可利用双眼信息、推理仅需单眼的方法。
AI.method: 特权学习框架：教师模型在训练阶段可访问双侧CFP图像，学习蕴含双眼信息的表征；学生模型以单眼图像为输入，通过知识蒸馏迁移教师的双侧知识。推理阶段学生仅依赖单眼图像，无需对侧图像。
AI.result: 相较常规单眼训练，AUC稳定提升；提升最大的是左眼图像——AMD检测0.931 vs. 0.966，DR检测0.789 vs. 0.836，且推理仅需单眼图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中利用双侧信息、推理时仅需单眼图像，该方法有助于在资源受限的临床与筛查环境中实现更可靠的部署。

title: LaVGuard: Selective Decoding for Contextual Value Drift
summary: A content-safe response can still promote priorities that conflict with its task: an assistant may demand compliance when asked to preserve autonomy. We study contextual value drift as a task-relative decoding problem with an explicit allowance for change. LaVGuard separates an authorized ten-dimensional profile from a frozen estimate of the values expressed in the visible prefix. A profile-relative density gate selects when to evaluate candidate continuations; their signed progress determines a logit tilt constrained by both changed-position and cumulative-KL budgets. We establish local surrogate improvement, pathwise budget feasibility, and a bound on response-distribution change. Profile conditioning raises boundary TPR at 5% FPR from .58 to .72. At the same .12 mean intervention ratio, the selection study reports risk-safety scores of .88 for LaVGuard and .72 for position-matched edits. The resulting interface makes task priorities actionable while keeping the extent of intervention explicit and bounded.

AI.tldr: LaVGuard将“情境价值漂移”建模为任务相关的解码问题，通过带预算约束的logit调整引导助手在保持任务优先级的同时显式、有界地改变价值表达。
AI.motivation: 内容安全的回答仍可能传递与任务相冲突的优先级（如被要求维护自主性时却要求服从）。作者希望把这种“情境价值漂移”作为任务相关的解码问题来处理，并对价值改变给出显式、可控的许可。
AI.method: 方法将授权的十维价值画像与可见前缀中价值表达的冻结估计分离；用画像相对的密度门（density gate）决定何时评估候选续写；根据候选续写的有符号进展（signed progress）确定logit倾斜，并同时受改变位置预算与累积KL预算约束。
AI.result: 理论上给出局部代理改进、逐路径预算可行性与响应分布变化上界。实验中，画像条件化将5% FPR下的边界TPR从0.58提升至0.72；在相同0.12平均干预比例下，风险-安全得分为0.88（LaVGuard）对0.72（位置匹配编辑）。
AI.conclusion: 该接口使任务优先级可操作，同时让干预的程度保持显式且有界。

title: Multi-Objective Protein Optimization via Modular Diffusion Steering
summary: Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs. Discovering these sequences is challenging because the design space is combinatorially large and experimental campaigns often permit only a few rounds of batched measurements. We introduce \textit{MODS}, a modular framework for multi-objective protein optimization via inference-time diffusion steering. For each proposal, MODS samples augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and a fitness-surrogate ensemble member to define a scalar steering reward. Varying the weights directs generation toward different objective tradeoffs, while varying ensemble members diversifies the predictions used for guidance. Because MODS expresses multi-objective acquisition through scalar rewards, it can be paired with different diffusion models and compatible steering procedures. After each evaluation batch, MODS updates the surrogates without retraining the generative model. We evaluate MODS on six protein optimization tasks using predictive oracles trained on experimental assay data, with two diffusion models and two steering procedures. MODS achieves competitive final hypervolume across all six tasks with both diffusion models, and substantially outperforms the best evaluated baseline on several tasks. Our results demonstrate a flexible and effective approach to multi-objective protein optimization with limited feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出MODS：基于推理时扩散引导的多目标蛋白质优化模块化框架，通过采样增强Chebyshev标量化权重与代理模型集成成员生成标量引导奖励，在六个任务、两种扩散模型和两种引导流程上取得有竞争力的最终超体积。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质工程常需同时改善多个性质，需寻找代表有用适应度权衡的高性能序列；但设计空间组合爆炸，且实验轮次与批测量次数极为有限，多目标优化困难。
AI.method: MODS为模块化框架：每次提议时采样增强Chebyshev标量化权重与适应度代理集成中的一个成员，构造标量引导奖励；权重变化引导生成趋向不同目标权衡，集成成员变化增加引导预测多样性；将多目标采集函数表达为标量奖励，故可搭配不同扩散模型与兼容的引导流程；每批评估后仅更新代理模型，不重训练生成模型。
AI.result: 在六个蛋白质优化任务上（预测oracle基于实验测定数据训练），使用两种扩散模型与两种引导流程评估；MODS在全部六个任务、两种扩散模型下均取得有竞争力的最终超体积，并在若干任务上显著优于最佳基线。
AI.conclusion: MODS是一种在有限反馈下进行多目标蛋白质优化的灵活且有效的方法。

title: Asking What a Director Sees Can Change What Vision-Language Models Choose
summary: Vision-language models are now routinely tested on theory of mind: whether they can work out what another person sees, knows, and means. A common design asks the model to report that perspective and then to act for the person, and reads a correct report beside a wrong action as a failure to use the perspective. That reading rests on a quiet assumption: that asking for the report leaves the action unchanged. We show that it does not. In a rendered Director Task, a partition hides the largest block from a director who asks for "the largest block". Asking first which blocks the director can see raises the share of replies that choose this hidden block by 12 to 88 percentage points on six GPT models and by 17 on Qwen3.8-27B, even though the models mostly report correctly which blocks the director sees. Reasoning traces and prompt rewordings suggest why: the question shifts how the request is read, from the director's view toward the model's own. When the prompt states what the director knows and refers to, fewer than 1% of replies pair a correct report with a hidden-block choice. Any evaluation that elicits a perspective report before the action it scores needs a baseline without the question, and we deliver one: paired prompts that differ only in that question, a design any perspective-taking benchmark can adopt.

AI.tldr: 先询问视角报告会改变模型随后的行动选择，因此"报告正确+行动错误=视角使用失败"的评测推断不成立；需配对基线。
AI.motivation: 现有心智理论（ToM）评测常用"先让模型报告他人视角、再让其代为行动"的设计，并把"报告正确但行动错误"判为未能使用视角信息。这隐含假设：提问式报告不改变行动。本文检验该假设。
AI.method: 构建可见版Director Task：隔板遮挡最大积木，导演请求"最大的积木"。设置配对提示（仅差是否先提问"导演能看到哪些积木"），在6个GPT模型与Qwen3.8-27B上比较选择隐藏积木的比例；辅以推理轨迹与提示改写分析。
AI.result: 先提问使选择隐藏积木的比例上升12–88个百分点（6个GPT模型），Qwen3.8-27B上升17个百分点，尽管模型多能正确报告导演可见的积木。若提示直接陈述导演所知与所指，报告正确却选隐藏积木的比例低于1%。
AI.conclusion: 视角提问会把请求的理解从导演视角转向模型自身视角，构成对后续行动的干扰效应；凡在评分行动前引出视角报告的评测都需无提问的配对基线，本文提供了可推广的配对提示设计。

title: DGCM-SSFA: Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulation and Sparse Strip Frequency Attention for Efficient 3T-to-7T MRI Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing high-fidelity 7T MRI from routinely acquired 3T scans offers a practical pathway to enhanced neuroimaging without the prohibitive cost of ultra-high-field scanners. While existing deep learning approaches have achieved promising results, state-of-the-art methods typically rely on either large-scale architectures exceeding 45 million parameters or computationally intensive ensemble strategies, limiting their practicality in resource-constrained clinical environments. In this work, we propose a compact multi-domain attention framework, termed DGCM-SSFA, that achieves competitive synthesis quality with only 11M parameters. The proposed architecture integrates two complementary modules into a U-Net Transformer backbone. First, a Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulated Feature Modulator (DGCM) is embedded at multiple hierarchical levels to enhance local edge and texture details through Sobel-guided spatial attention and depthwise frequency-aware channel attention with cross-branch gating. Second, a Sparse Strip Frequency Attention (SSFA) module at the bottleneck captures global spatial context via strip-pooled attention with near-linear complexity, while simultaneously performing FFT-based spectral modulation in the frequency domain. These two modules operate synergistically with the backbone's native channel attention, forming a triple-granularity feature refinement pipeline. Extensive experiments on the UNC and BNU 3T-to-7T MRI datasets across T1w and T2w modalities demonstrate that DGCM-SSFA achieves strong structural fidelity, attaining an SSIM of 0.8431 on BNU T2w---approaching the best benchmark value of 0.8624---and 0.8100 on BNU T1w, while using substantially fewer parameters than Transformer-based alternatives such as ResViT (123.4M) and FS-RWKV (45.4M).

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑的多域注意力框架DGCM-SSFA，仅11M参数即可从常规3T MRI合成高保真7T MRI，结构保真度接近大规模基准方法。
AI.motivation: 7T MRI成像质量高但成本高昂难以普及，而现有3T到7T合成的深度学习方法依赖超过45M参数的大规模架构或计算密集的集成策略，难以在资源受限的临床环境部署。
AI.method: 在U-Net Transformer骨干中集成两个互补模块：其一为多层级嵌入的双粒度交叉调制特征调制器（DGCM），通过Sobel引导的空间注意力与深度可分离的频率感知通道注意力并结合跨分支门控，增强局部边缘与纹理细节；其二为瓶颈处的稀疏条带频率注意力（SSFA），利用条带池化注意力以近线性复杂度捕获全局空间上下文，同时进行基于FFT的频域谱调制。二者与骨干原生通道注意力协同，构成三重粒度特征细化流程。
AI.result: 在UNC与BNU的3T→7T MRI数据集上、涵盖T1w与T2w模态，DGCM-SSFA取得较强结构保真度：BNU T2w上SSIM为0.8431（最优基准为0.8624），BNU T1w上为0.8100；参数量显著低于ResViT（123.4M）与FS-RWKV（45.4M）等Transformer方法。
AI.conclusion: 多域注意力设计可在仅11M参数下实现与大规模模型接近的3T→7T合成质量，证明高效紧凑架构在资源受限临床场景中具备实用潜力。

title: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
summary: Frontier black-box Large Language Model (LLM) agents are proficient at long-horizon reasoning and precise action generation. However, when it comes to a specific agentic task, they have no internalized knowledge of how that particular environment unfolds. A world model offers a natural remedy, providing the agent with environment specific knowledge by foreseeing how the environment will respond to the action it is about to take. Prior world models for LLM agents mainly predict next observations at each step, which is costly and often uninformative because individual observations provide limited task-relevant guidance and not every step requires call for foresight. This raises a key question: what a world model should predict and when should it be invoked for agentic tasks? Our pilot study suggests that world model guidance is most useful when it anticipates pitfalls within a bounded multi-step future. Motivated by this, we introduce Pitfall Anticipation World Model (PAWM), which selectively intervenes when a potential pitfall arises and predicts the impending failure to steer the agent away from it. PAWM is trained in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic data labeled with agent pitfalls, followed by GRPO co-training with a black-box LLM to further optimize it in the target environment. PAWM improves Claude Sonnet 4.5 performance by 24.3% on ScienceWorld and 7.7% on WebArena-Lite, outperforming a range of baselines. These results demonstrate that PAWM provides an effective form of world model guidance for black-box LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pitfall Anticipation World Model（PAWM），一种面向黑盒 LLM 智能体的世界模型：它仅在潜在陷阱出现时选择性介入，通过预测即将发生的失败来引导智能体规避错误，而非逐步预测下一观测。
AI.motivation: 前沿黑盒 LLM 智能体虽擅长长程推理与精确动作生成，但缺乏对特定任务环境演化方式的内化知识。已有的世界模型多在每步预测下一观测，代价高且信息量有限（单步观测指导性弱，并非每步都需要预见）。作者据此提出核心问题：世界模型应预测什么、何时调用。预实验表明，在有界多步未来内预见陷阱时指导最有效。
AI.method: PAWM 采用选择性介入机制：当出现潜在陷阱时触发，并预测即将发生的失败以规避。训练分两阶段：先在带有智能体陷阱标注的合成数据上做监督微调（SFT），再与黑盒 LLM 进行 GRPO 协同训练，以在目标环境中进一步优化。
AI.result: PAWM 在 ScienceWorld 上使 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的性能提升 24.3%，在 WebArena-Lite 上提升 7.7%，优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，PAWM 为黑盒 LLM 智能体提供了一种有效的世界模型指导形式：聚焦于有界未来内的陷阱预见与选择性介入，兼顾效率与指导性，显著提升智能体在具体环境中的任务表现。

title: Is 2:4 Sparsity Still Worth It? Semi-Structured Sparsity versus Quantization in LLM Inference
summary: NVIDIA tensor cores have supported 2:4 semi-structured sparsity since Ampere, and the pattern composes with quantization. When the two are combined, the practical question is which step to take next: from a given precision, add 2:4 sparsity or drop to the next lower precision? We compare the two at equal bits, with sparsity metadata counted, and at equal nominal tensor-core tiers, over all six GEMM operands of a transformer layer, with kernels measured on three GPU generations and online pruning and quantization included. Our results show that as long as a lower precision is available, adding 2:4 is the worse step, both less accurate and slower, because the energy that 2:4 discards from each group of four along the hardware-forced axis does not shrink with bits, while quantization error does. Once quantization reaches the lowest precision the hardware supports, 2:4 still speeds up linear layers by 1.3--1.7\x{}, and on an H100 a retrained 2:4 model served in FP8 by vLLM reaches 27\% higher prefill throughput than the dense FP8 model, with GSM8K accuracy on par. Its quality has to be won back by retraining, however, which restores perplexity long before reasoning; on Blackwell, whose sparse FP4 uses a pairwise 4:8 pattern, the loss is larger and our retraining budget did not recover it.

AI.tldr: 在等比特与等张量核档位两种口径下比较"加2:4稀疏"与"降精度"两种压缩步骤，结论是只要还有更低精度可选，加2:4总是更差的一步（既更不准也更慢）；当量化已到硬件最低精度后，2:4仍可提速1.3–1.7×并提升FP8服务吞吐27%，但质量需靠重训练追回，且Blackwell的4:8稀疏FP4损失更大。
AI.motivation: NVIDIA Ampere以来张量核支持2:4半结构化稀疏，且该模式可与量化复合。实际部署中面临一个决策问题：给定某一精度，下一步应当加2:4稀疏，还是降到下一档更低精度？该问题此前缺乏在统一口径下的系统比较。
AI.method: 在"等比特（计入稀疏元数据开销）"与"等标称张量核档位"两种公平口径下，覆盖Transformer层全部六个GEMM操作数，在三个GPU代际上实测kernel，并将在线剪枝与量化纳入流程，直接对比"加2:4"与"降精度"两条路径。
AI.result: 只要存在更低精度可用，加2:4在精度与速度上均劣于降精度；原因在于2:4沿硬件强制轴上每组4元素所丢弃的能量不随比特降低而缩小，而量化误差随比特下降而缩小。当量化已达硬件最低精度时，2:4使线性层提速1.3–1.7×；在H100上，重训练后的2:4模型经vLLM以FP8部署，prefill吞吐较稠密FP8模型高27%，GSM8K精度相当。Blackwell的稀疏FP4采用4:8成对模式，损失更大，给定重训练预算未能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 压缩路径应优先选择降精度而非加2:4稀疏；高稀疏比应与具体硬件原生模式（如Blackwell的4:8/FP4）联合设计；稀疏带来的质量代价需通过重训练弥补，且重训练可先恢复困惑度而推理能力恢复滞后，说明评估需分阶段、分任务进行。

title: OSynth: A Longitudinal, Context-Sensitive Evaluation of Meeting Understanding
summary: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OSynth——一个大规模合成"仿真组织"会议数据集（570 小时会议音频及配套工件与潜在真值状态），用于克服真实会议语料在规模、领域覆盖与上下文可用性上的不足。
AI.motivation: 会议记录助手日益部署在具备纵向上下文（日历元数据、历史会议、邮件、幻灯片、说话人注册）的场景中，但现有会议语料规模小、领域覆盖窄、缺乏配套上下文，难以支撑更好的上下文感知会议理解系统研发。
AI.method: 构建合成组织模拟数据：生成 570 小时会议音频，并同步产出关联工件（如日历、邮件、幻灯片、说话人信息等）以及可查询的潜在真值状态；随后开展两项评估——人类评分者在 150–300 词片段上做真实会议与 OSynth 会议的成对辨别；以及在多种 SOTA LLM 上比较有无额外上下文时在实体敏感维度上的表现。
AI.result: 人类仅以 56% 准确率区分 OSynth 会议与真实会议转写，接近随机水平，表明合成会议具有较高真实性；在多个 SOTA LLM 上，引入额外上下文在若干实体敏感维度带来显著提升，同时暴露了现有方法在上下文利用上的局限。
AI.conclusion: OSynth 可作为开发上下文感知会议理解系统的有效资源；其高真实性（人类辨别接近随机）与上下文敏感性实验表明其兼具生态效度与诊断价值，可弥补真实会议语料在规模与上下文方面的缺口。

title: From Augmentation to Synthetic Evidence: Evaluating Generated Chest Radiographs at Dataset Intake
summary: A generated chest radiograph can be useful as declared augmentation, but the same image becomes unsupported evidence when submitted as the record of a real examination. We study this problem by separating three questions: whether an image passes an automated quality check, whether an origin classifier flags it as generated, and whether a trusted record supports the claimed acquisition. In our experiments, Qwen selects up to 20 images from pools of 1,000 existing Cheff-identified or SynthCheX candidates. A receiver evaluates quality with MedGemma and predicted origin with a classifier on frozen DINOv3 features. Quality-based selection raises quality passes from 12 to 19 of 20 for Cheff-identified images and from 8 to 17 for SynthCheX. We find no evidence that selection improves passage through both checks: no selected Cheff-identified image passes both, while uniform, quality, and quality-constrained surrogate selection produce 2, 1, and 2 SynthCheX passes. On unprocessed test images, the origin classifier flags 4,677 of 5,000 SynthCheX images, but it also misclassify 110 of 2,297 NIH (real) images and 568 of 957 genuine images from another collection as fake. Our results further show that JPEG compression reduces SynthCheX-versus-NIH AUROC from 0.987 to 0.841. Even without processing, 152 SynthCheX images pass both pixel checks. These checks can filter submissions, but they cannot verify an acquisition claim. We strongly advocate that source and intended use must be recorded and checked separately for admission of chest radiographs in medical datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文区分"自动化质量检查""生成来源分类器""可信记录支持采集成因"三个层次来研究合成胸片问题，发现质量检查与来源检测均无法验证图像是否为真实采集，即便未处理也有152张SynthCheX同时通过两项像素级检查，且在真实图像上存在显著误判。
AI.motivation: 生成胸片作为声明式数据增强是有益的，但同一图像被当作真实检查记录提交时即为无支撑证据。现有流程往往混淆"通过质检""被识别为生成""被可信记录支持"三者，缺乏对检测手段能否验证采集成因的系统性检验。
AI.method: 实验分三步：(1) Qwen 从含1000张候选的 Cheff-identified 池与 SynthCheX 池中各最多选20张；(2) 由接收方用 MedGemma 评估质量，并用基于冻结 DINOv3 特征训练的起源分类器预测来源；(3) 比较均匀选择、质量选择与质量约束替代选择三种策略，并考察 JPEG 压缩影响与跨数据集误判率。
AI.result: 质量导向选择将 Cheff-identified 的质检通过数由12/20提升至19/20，SynthCheX 由8/20提升至17/20；但无证据表明选择能同时通过两项检查：所选 Cheff-identified 图像无一同时通过，SynthCheX 在均匀、质量、质量约束替代三种策略下分别仅2、1、2张通过。未处理测试图像上，起源分类器在5000张 SynthCheX 中标出4677张，却将2297张 NIH 真实图像误判110张、另一数据集957张真实图像误判568张；JPEG 压缩使 SynthCheX-vs-NIH 的 AUROC 从0.987降至0.841；即便未经处理，仍有152张 SynthCheX 同时通过两项像素检查。
AI.conclusion: 像素级检查可过滤部分提交，但无法验证采集成因。作者强烈主张在医学数据集中纳入胸片时，必须单独记录并核查来源与预期用途。

title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rollout refresh, the shared policy generates both a privileged Teacher trajectory and a problem-only Student trajectory. A pairwise preference objective uses privileged Teacher trajectories to improve Student learning, while the reversed preference uses the Student's behavior to shape future Teacher supervision under the privileged condition. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show that TeachBack consistently improves Student performance over existing OPSD methods and related baselines.

AI.tldr: TeachBack：面向on-policy自蒸馏的双向偏好学习框架，通过学习"教师应如何教"来提升学生模型
AI.motivation: 发现OPSD中教师虽能借助特权信息生成高准确率轨迹，但准确率不等于适合学生学习：直接给出完整参考解会诱导教师产生被参考解条件化的缩短式推导，省略了无特权信息下必需的探索、验证与自我纠错过程。
AI.method: 通过控制注入提示的参考推理后缀长度与改变提示风格来塑造教师的生成行为，在保持教师准确率相当的前提下鼓励教师探索与重新求解、降低对参考解的依赖。每次rollout刷新时，共享策略同时生成含特权的教师轨迹与仅含题目的学生轨迹；成对偏好目标一方面用教师轨迹改进学生，另一方面反向偏好以学生行为塑造未来特权条件下的教师监督。
AI.result: 在数学与逻辑推理任务上，TeachBack 相对现有 OPSD 方法及相关基线稳定提升学生模型表现。
AI.conclusion: 教师轨迹的"可用性"而非仅"正确性"是自蒸馏的关键，双向偏好学习可同时优化学生学什么与教师怎么教。

title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
summary: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. It outperforms the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index and 10.5 p.p. in normalized mutual information on the industry-standard WM-811K dataset. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of WaferHDC for continuous and open-world wafer defect analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于超维计算的开放在线晶圆缺陷发现框架WaferHDC，实现无需重训练的动态缺陷检测与聚类。
AI.motivation: 传统晶圆缺陷分析依赖离线、封闭世界分类器，无法检测连续制造过程中新出现的未知缺陷模式。
AI.method: 采用以记忆为中心的超维计算架构：先对正常空间分布建模，再在无标签、无预设类别数条件下，将复发失效动态分组为紧凑超维向量的持久缺陷记忆，内存空间随新缺陷模式动态扩展，无需重训练静态分类器或归档全部原始晶圆历史。
AI.result: 在行业标准WM-811K数据集上，调整兰德指数较最强在线基线提升13.3个百分点，归一化互信息提升10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: WaferHDC在连续、开放世界晶圆缺陷分析中具有有效性，可支撑制造过程中的在线缺陷发现。

title: Signals and Queries: Token-Efficient Agentic Context Discovery
summary: User-facing LLM agents must identify which behavioral policies apply at each turn, but evaluating every policy with an LLM is costly. We introduce Signals and Queries (S&Q), a lightweight first-stage relevance filter developed for Parlant 4.0 that removes at least 30% of candidate policies before downstream evaluation while preserving high recall. For each policy, an LLM generates activating examples and hard negatives offline. An independent logistic classifier trained on their embeddings then predicts relevance using embeddings and vector dot products, with no per-turn LLM calls. This shifts expensive relevance evaluation to a smaller candidate set, while allowing each policy's classifier to be updated independently. Evaluated against 9,144 LLM-judge relevance labels covering 254 $τ^2$-bench conversation prefixes and 36 airline policies, S&Q achieves higher precision than top-K and cosine-threshold retrieval at every evaluated recall level, with consistent results across two embedding providers. These findings support inexpensive, per-policy classification as a practical first stage for reducing downstream evaluation workload in customer-facing agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Signals and Queries (S&Q)，一种用于 Parlant 4.0 的轻量级第一阶段相关性过滤器，在保持高召回的同时过滤掉至少 30% 的候选策略，从而减少下游 LLM 评估开销。
AI.motivation: 面向用户的 LLM agent 需在每轮判断哪些行为策略适用，但用 LLM 逐条评估所有策略代价高昂，需要廉价的前置筛选来缩小候选集。
AI.method: 离线阶段由 LLM 为每个策略生成激活示例与难负例；基于其嵌入训练独立的逻辑回归分类器；在线阶段仅用嵌入与向量点积预测相关性，无需每轮 LLM 调用；各策略分类器可独立更新。
AI.result: 基于 254 个 τ²-bench 对话前缀与 36 条航空政策的 9,144 条 LLM 评判相关性标签评估，S&Q 在每个召回水平上的精确率均优于 top-K 与余弦阈值检索，且在两种嵌入提供方下结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 低成本的逐策略分类可作为实用的一阶段过滤器，有效降低客户面向 agent 的下游评估负担。

title: SICAF: Time-Varying Focus Bottleneck for Self-Supervised Event-Based Optical Flow with Spiking Neural Network
summary: Event-based optical flow estimation achieves high temporal resolution and dynamic range by exploiting asynchronous events, while self-supervised learning provides an effective solution to the absence of ground-truth labels. Spiking neural networks (SNNs), as brain-inspired models, process information through asynchronous spikes, naturally aligning with optical flow events. However, the temporal irregularity across event streams hinders the compact extraction of spatiotemporal features, while the absence of explicit labels leads to spurious correlations, thereby increasing redundancy within latent representations. In this paper, we propose a novel 'Compactly Compress, Time-varying Focus' training strategy. We present SICAF (Spikes Information Compression And Focus) framework that formulates the learning process as a constrained optimization with temporal modulation. It encourages self-supervised SNNs to extract compact latent representations while preventing over-compression that would discard temporal saliency. To better enable feature selectivity across time steps, we design an estimator with learnable temporal attention, achieving context awareness with cross-time dependencies. Experimental results on several datasets demonstrate that SICAF achieves state-of-the-art performance in self-supervised SNNs, with a 8.14% improvement in AEE on the MVSEC dataset and a 13.49% increase in robustness under white-box adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出SICAF框架，将自监督脉冲神经网络（SNN）的光流学习建模为带时间调制的约束优化，通过信息压缩与时间聚焦的联合策略提升稀疏时空特征质量，在MVSEC等数据集上取得自监督SNN的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机光流估计依赖自监督学习弥补标签缺失，SNN通过异步脉冲与事件流天然对齐；但事件流的时间不规则性阻碍紧凑时空特征提取，缺乏显式标签又导致伪相关，使潜在表示冗余度升高。
AI.method: 提出"Compactly Compress, Time-varying Focus"训练策略，即SICAF（Spikes Information Compression And Focus）框架：将学习过程形式化为带时间调制的约束优化，促使自监督SNN提取紧凑潜在表示并防止过度压缩丢失时间显著性；设计具有可学习时间注意力的估计器，实现跨时间依赖的上下文感知与时间步间的特征选择性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上达到自监督SNN的最优性能：MVSEC数据集AEE提升8.14%，白盒对抗攻击下鲁棒性提升13.49%。
AI.conclusion: 信息压缩约束与时间聚焦机制能够协同缓解事件流的时空不规则性与标签缺失带来的表示冗余问题，为自监督脉冲光流估计提供有效范式。

title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models
summary: Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. We further show how these allocation disparities affect the recovery of multiple correct choices under probability thresholding. Decision-model probabilities can rank correct choices, but a probability threshold does not identify the set of correct choices.

AI.tldr: 论文考察三个决策模型（Jev、Liquid d1、GPT-6 Luna Decisions）在三个数据集（MetaTool、HotpotQA、ECtHR）上的概率分配与阈值化行为，发现模型虽能正确排序所有正确选项，但其概率分布不能通过阈值识别正确选项集合。
AI.motivation: 模型提供方强调输出概率的可靠性，但以往校准评估仅针对单一正确选项的任务，无法说明多正确选项场景下概率的可靠性，因此需要系统研究概率分配与阈值化的实际表现。
AI.method: 在三个数据集上评估三个决策模型的概率分配：一是在模型将全部正确选项排在所有干扰项之上的选项列表中，统计正确选项概率低于均匀概率 1/n 的比例；二是向模型提供同一正确选项的五份完全相同副本，测量副本间概率差异（平均差距）；三是分析概率阈值化对多正确选项召回的影响。
AI.result: 在正确选项完好排序的列表中，28%–50% 的列表至少有一个正确选项概率低于 1/n；五份相同正确选项副本间概率平均差距达 17–79 个百分点；概率分配差异进一步影响阈值化下多正确选项的恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型概率可用于对正确选项排序，但概率阈值无法用于识别正确选项集合；单一正确答案下的校准结论不能推广到多正确答案情形。

title: Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering
comment: 36 pages, 6 tables and 2 figures in the main text, 8 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/iceslice0/transformer-to-dnn
summary: Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores.
