Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from $N^2$ to $Nk$ per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for $k\le8$, on Pythia-70M.

AI.tldr: Transformer块可精确编译为通用DNN，仅需固定仿射映射、路由及square/sigmoid/inverse-sqrt等逐元素算子，无需Transformer专用算子；top-k注意力下用尾部质量估计替代尾部丢弃可获无偏MMSE估计，查询聚类可将每头分数计算从N²降至Nk。
AI.motivation: 当前Transformer被当作特殊模型类部署：NPU为其加入专用注意力与归一化算子，量化依赖Transformer专用算法。作者意在说明这种特殊性并非计算所必需，从而支持通用算子与通用量化。
AI.method: 将含attention、LayerNorm与GELU MLP的每个Transformer块精确编译为通用深度网络（固定仿射映射、路由、square/sigmoid/inverse-sqrt，GELU或其sigmoid近似）。分析表明无activation-activation乘积时，每个变换式编译对每头密集分数至少需N²次标量非线性求值；仅保留该一种算子即可消除开销，其逐元素形式配合sigmoid与inverse-sqrt已足够。对可交换尾部分数的top-k注意力，证明精确或条件均值尾部质量给出注意力分布的无偏最小均方误差估计，而tail drop条件有偏。查询或agent聚类时由质心先选key，将每头分数数从N²降至Nk。
AI.result: 在DeiT-Tiny、MambaIRv2-Light与Pythia-70M上，编译模型在全key时与参考模型一致，标准训练后量化可直接适用；精确尾部质量估计优于tail dropping，在DeiT-Tiny上以一半key数取胜，在Pythia-70M上k≤8时取胜。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的计算不强制专用算子，可精确落地为通用DNN并以通用PTQ量化；尾部质量估计与质心选key分别改善精度-效率权衡。

title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees: Emergent Agreement from Individual Conversations
summary: As LLM agents interact in the wild and shape each other's decisions, understanding how they converge toward agreement becomes important. We study this in multi-turn conversations where two LLMs discuss subjective matters, can agree or disagree, and may change their stances. Using a linear classifier on individual conversation activations, we identify an internal representation of agreement. We find that it varies substantially across turns and conversations and does not reliably track external agreement at the individual conversation level. We therefore move beyond the representation of agreement in individual conversations, by aggregating the agreement representation across conversations. Externally, this aggregate view reveals a simple structure: when pooled across conversations, agreement can be predicted well with a Markov process, with agreement at each turn being a direct function of agreement at the previous turn. Similarly, when internal agreement is aggregated, it couples with the external Markov agreement through a power-law mapping, exposing Markovian dynamics in internal representations. Additionally, we find that after a change of stance, models express agreement externally before their internal representations reflect the same shift. These results reveal a joint structure between internal and external agreement that emerges only when internal features are aggregated across conversations. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees.

AI.tldr: 研究两个LLM多轮对话中的"一致性（agreement）"，发现单对话内部一致性表征不稳定，但在跨对话聚合后呈现马尔可夫结构与幂律耦合。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在真实环境中相互交互并影响彼此决策，理解它们如何趋于一致（agree）十分重要，但此前缺乏对内部表征与外部行为一致性关系的系统刻画。
AI.method: 让两个LLM就主观话题进行多轮讨论，可同意或不同意并可改变立场；在单对话激活上训练线性分类器以识别"一致性"的内部表征；进而跨对话聚合该表征，并与外部一致性对比，用马尔可夫过程与幂律映射建模。
AI.result: 单对话层面内部一致性表征随轮次与对话大幅波动，无法可靠追踪外部一致性；聚合后外部一致性可由仅依赖上一轮的马尔可夫过程很好预测，内部聚合一致性通过幂律映射与外部马尔可夫一致性耦合，显示内部表征的马尔可夫动力学；立场改变后，模型外部先表达一致，内部表征随后才反映该转变。
AI.conclusion: 内部与外部一致性的联合结构只有在对内部特征进行跨对话聚合时才显现，提示需要"见森林而非见树木"的分析视角；代码已开源。

title: RiO-DETRv2: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Modeling Meets Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer
summary: RiO-DETR is the first real-time end-to-end transformer for oriented object detection, yet further localization gains require a more expressive box representation. Although distributional regression has succeeded in horizontal DETRs, extending it to oriented detection introduces geometry-misaligned boundary modeling and topology-inconsistent orientation refinement. We present RiO-DETRv2, a geometry-aware uncertainty modeling framework for real-time oriented object detection. To resolve the geometry mismatch, Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement represents box boundaries as probability distributions in an object-aligned coordinate system and progressively refines them across decoder layers. For better orientation topology consistency, we introduce Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement that transitions from global periodic search to local fine-grained estimation. Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning further aligns classification, boundary and angular refinement with complete-OBB localization quality. Together, these designs improve localization without compromising efficiency, achieving a better balance between speed and accuracy. Specifically, RiO-DETRv2-l/x achieves 53.7/54.1 mAP50-95 on DOTA, outperforming RiO-DETR-l/x by 1.2/1.5 points with nearly unchanged computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/RicePasteM/RiO-DETRv2.

AI.tldr: 提出RiO-DETRv2，一个面向实时旋转目标检测的几何感知不确定性建模框架，在几乎不增加计算成本的情况下提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: RiO-DETR作为首个实时端到端旋转目标检测Transformer，受限于框表征表达能力，进一步提升定位需要更强表征；而将分布回归从水平检测迁移到旋转检测时，会出现几何错位的边界建模与拓扑不一致的角度细化问题。
AI.method: 三项设计：1）Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement（OABDR），在目标对齐坐标系中将框边界表示为概率分布，并跨解码器层逐步细化，解决几何错位；2）Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement（CLARR），由全局周期搜索过渡到局部精细估计，保证角度拓扑一致性；3）Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning，将分类、边界与角度细化与完整OBB定位质量统一对齐。
AI.result: RiO-DETRv2-l/x 在 DOTA 上取得 53.7/54.1 mAP50-95，较 RiO-DETR-l/x 分别提升 1.2/1.5 点，计算开销基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 所提设计在不牺牲效率的前提下改进定位性能，实现速度与精度更优的平衡。

title: From Scores to Safe Sets: Exact Safety--Constrained Decoding for Medication Recommendation
summary: Recent generative medication recommendation systems ultimately produce sets of drugs, but drug--drug interaction (DDI) constraints depend on the set as a whole. A natural post-hoc approach is to first predict medications and then locally repair interacting pairs by removing one drug at a time. We ask whether this local repair step itself introduces avoidable error. Using fixed medication scores from FLAME's frozen classifier on MIMIC-III, we compare increasingly strong local repair strategies with an exact global decoder while holding the scores, output size, and DDI constraint fixed. The global decoder jointly selects the highest-scoring feasible medication set using mixed-integer linear programming. Across validation and test splits, global decoding consistently achieves higher Jaccard similarity than greedy repair, degree-aware repair, and degree-aware repair strengthened with exhaustive 1-swap local search. Its advantage is small under loose DDI constraints and becomes larger as the constraint tightens; on the test split it reaches +0.0064 Jaccard over the strongest local baseline at the strict DDI operating point. The finding also holds across a fine accuracy--DDI sweep at matched realized DDI exposure and under three score representations. At the strict setting, global decoding retains more true-positive medications while removing more false positives. These results show that medication recommendation is not only a representation-learning problem: even with a frozen clinical model, how its scores are converted into a constrained medication set can materially affect the final prediction.

AI.tldr: 在冻结FLAME分类器得分的前提下，用混合整数线性规划（MILP）做全局解码求解DDI约束下的最优药物集合，并与贪心、度感知、度感知+1-swap局部搜索等局部修复策略对比；全局解码在各设置下Jaccard均更高，且DDI约束越紧优势越大。
AI.motivation: 生成式药物推荐最终输出的是药物集合，而DDI约束作用在集合整体而非单个药物上。常见的后处理做法是先预测药物、再逐对删除其中一个药物来局部修复冲突。作者质疑这一局部修复步骤本身是否引入了本可避免的误差，即"表示学习之外"的解码环节是否被忽视。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定FLAME冻结分类器在MIMIC-III上的药物得分、输出集合大小与DDI约束。将全局解码形式化为混合整数线性规划，联合选择得分最高且满足DDI约束的可行集合；对照基线为贪心修复、度感知修复、度感知修复+穷举1-swap局部搜索。在验证/测试划分、细粒度精度–DDI扫描（匹配实际DDI暴露）、三种得分表示下比较。
AI.result: 全局解码在验证与测试集上Jaccard一致性优于所有局部基线；DDI约束宽松时优势较小，约束收紧后优势扩大，测试集严格DDI工作点下较最强局部基线提升+0.0064 Jaccard。严格设置下全局解码保留更多真阳性药物、去除更多假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 药物推荐不仅是表示学习问题：即便模型完全冻结，如何将得分转换为满足约束的药物集合（解码方式）也会显著影响最终预测，局部修复存在可避免的误差，全局约束优化是更优的后处理范式。

title: Unit-Aware Differentially Private Quantum Machine Learning for Clinical and Wearable Health Data
summary: Clinical registries and wearable sensors support early health-risk assessment, yet models trained on these records may leak sensitive information when released. Differential privacy (DP) bounds this leakage by injecting noise whose total magnitude grows with the number of trainable parameters, a cost especially severe for small health cohorts. This motivates parameter efficient models including quantum machine learning (QML), whose variational circuits can represent complex decision boundaries with few trainable parameters. It raises a question: at matched input dimensionality and privacy budget, does a quantum model retain more utility than a classical one? We investigate this question on three clinical cohorts and one wearable cohort, treating each clinical record or participant as a privacy unit. We compare capacity-matched quantum, multilayer perceptron, and logistic regression models across five privacy budgets and five seeds. The quantum model leads on three clinical cohorts by up to 0.104 ROC AUC averaged across budgets; however, trails on the wearable cohort, where the small number of participants requires substantial noise. No difference survives Holm correction across 24 tests, so these results indicate a trend rather than a quantum advantage. An analytic gradient bound shows that lower clipping thresholds can improve utility by reducing noise despite clipping bias. Finally, an experiment on IBM quantum computer (ibm_fez, a 156-qubit superconducting processor) using eight fixed test cases yields mean absolute probability errors of 0.046 (private) and 0.063 (non-private) relative to simulation, supporting the feasibility of inference on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/DP-QML-Health.

AI.tldr: 在三个临床队列和一个可穿戴队列上，以匹配容量与隐私预算比较量子（QML）、MLP与逻辑回归的差分隐私效用；量子模型在三个临床队列上领先（最多0.104 ROC AUC），但可穿戴队列落后，且经Holm校正后无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 临床注册数据与可穿戴传感器支持早期健康风险评估，但发布在这些记录上训练的模型可能泄露敏感信息。差分隐私（DP）能限制泄露，但其噪声总量随可训练参数数量增长，对样本量小的健康队列代价尤为严重。这促使采用参数高效模型，如变分量子电路，可在少量可训练参数下表达复杂决策边界。由此提出问题：在输入维度与隐私预算匹配的条件下，量子模型是否比经典模型保留更多效用？
AI.method: 在三个临床队列和一个可穿戴队列上开展实验，以每条临床记录或每位参与者作为隐私单元。比较容量匹配的量子模型、多层感知机（MLP）与逻辑回归，覆盖5个隐私预算与5个随机种子（共24项检验）。辅以解析梯度上界分析裁剪阈值对效用与噪声的影响，并在IBM 156比特超导处理器ibm_fez上以8个固定测试用例进行推理验证。
AI.result: 量子模型在三个临床队列上跨预算平均领先最多0.104 ROC AUC；但在可穿戴队列上落后，因参与者数量少需注入大量噪声。经Holm校正后24项检验均无显著差异，结果仅为趋势而非量子优势。解析梯度上界表明，较低裁剪阈值可通过降低噪声提升效用，尽管存在裁剪偏差。硬件实验相对模拟的平均绝对概率误差为0.046（隐私）与0.063（非隐私），支持NISQ硬件上推理的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效的量子模型在DP约束下于小样本临床队列中呈现潜在效用优势，但证据尚不显著，不能宣称量子优势；裁剪阈值可作为调节噪声-偏差权衡的有效手段；NISQ硬件已具备承载隐私推理的可行性。代码已公开。

title: Policy Central: Detecting Conflicts, Redundancy, and Similarity in Deployed Police Policy
summary: Policy Central is a deployed system that helps police departments find relationships between sections of their written policy: whether two sections conflict, are redundant, are merely similar, or are different. We describe the system and compare two architectures. Retrieve-Judge, a retrieve-then-classify pipeline, runs as a cheap library-wide health signal; Screen-Confirm, a screen-then-confirm cascade, is a selective audit of the documents a reviewer chooses, checking them exhaustively against one another. On a 302-pair benchmark drawn from one department's ~84 real policy documents, given each pair Screen-Confirm reaches 0.795 aggregate recall and 0.885 on Conflict, so current models judge well. Finding the pair is the hard part: Retrieve-Judge's composed recall falls to 0.457, and Screen-Confirm recovers 0.472 (0.615 on Conflict). Today these pairs are found by reading the whole library, nearly 20,000 sections, checked against one another and re-checked after every revision. A scan that returns half of them in minutes, at low cost, and can be re-run on demand changes the economics of policy review even before recall improves.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍已部署系统Policy Central，用于发现警局书面政策条文间的关系（冲突、冗余、相似、不同），并比较Retrieve-Judge与Screen-Confirm两种架构。
AI.motivation: 全库约2万条政策条文需两两比对并在每次修订后复检，人工通读成本极高，需要低成本、可按需重跑的自动化扫描以改变政策审查的成本结构。
AI.method: 对比两种架构：Retrieve-Judge为"检索-判定"的检索后分类流水线，作为全库廉价健康信号；Screen-Confirm为"筛选-确认"级联，对审查者选定文档做穷尽式互检。基于某部门约84份真实政策文件构建302对基准评测。
AI.result: 给定候选对时Screen-Confirm聚合召回0.795、Conflict类0.885，说明模型判定能力已较强；候选对发现才是难点：Retrieve-Judge组合召回降至0.457，Screen-Confirm为0.472（Conflict类0.615）。
AI.conclusion: 逐对判定已较可靠，瓶颈在候选对检索；分钟级、低成本、可重跑的半召回扫描即可显著改善政策审查的经济性，且早于召回提升即已产生价值。

title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds. This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions. To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers. The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching. LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes. LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision. We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary. Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Firefly-zoo/LocalAgent-main.

AI.tldr: 提出 LocalAgent 协同智能体框架，结合通用 MLLM 全局推理与轻量专用验证器（LEV），用于细粒度实例级一致性核验，平均准确率较最强 CoT-RFT 基线提升 4.9%，且仅在 12.13% 样本上调用验证器。
AI.motivation: MLLM 在通用视觉理解上进展迅速，但在细粒度实例级一致性验证（判断两图是否同一物理物体，跨视角、光照、背景变化）上仍表现不佳。该任务既需全局语义感知，又需精确核查细微局部证据——语义相似物体可能仅在小块可疑区域不同。
AI.method: 1) 协作式智能体框架：通用 MLLM 先做全局推理，定位可疑局部区域，再委派给 Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) 工具包；2) LEV 含 Local Appearance Consistency (LAC)���估计光照与颜色变化下的外观相似度）与 Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC，估计视角变化下的空间对应关系），返回结构化标量证据供 MLLM 融合决策；3) 引入 auxiliary-capped RFT 策略，以答案正确性为主导、辅助工具使用与格式信号为受限辅助项，使策略学会何时需要验证。
AI.result: 平均准确率较最强 CoT-RFT 基线提升 4.9%；仅在 12.13% 样本上调用验证器；同时保留底层 MLLM 的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 将全局语义推理与局部专用验证器结合的智能体化范式，可有效提升实例级细粒度一致性核验，并借助按需调用的验证机制与辅助受限 RFT 在精度、效率与通用能力保持之间取得平衡。

title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to run experiments, yet benchmarks rarely measure whether those experiments improve the decisions they are meant to inform. We introduce CrashGym, a deterministic, replayable limit-order-book simulator in which an agent must choose between a deleveraging intervention and a liquidity backstop for a market about to suffer a shock-triggered crash. Before committing, the agent may query intervention experiments in a laboratory realization of the market. Its choice is then scored on an independently seeded target realization in which the simulator executes every feasible intervention, so regret relative to the best intervention is computed by directly simulating every alternative on the same target repeats, with no human or model-based judging. The simulator implements each amplification channel---persistent price impact, liquidity withdrawal, margin-driven liquidation, and an evolving strategy mix---as an explicit mechanism that can be switched on in stages. In a prospectively specified study on 24 newly sampled worlds, laboratory access reduces the mean regret of the one deployment with a complete record (Luna) from 8.878 to 3.785, a paired reduction of 5.092 utility units (nominal 95% world-bootstrap interval: 1.028--9.507), or 57.4% of the OBSERVE-ONLY mean. Prospective comparisons for two further deployments are incomplete; in a separate exploratory study, mean regret is lower with laboratory access for all four deployments evaluated. A laboratory whose strategy mix evolves endogenously yields no established advantage over one with a fixed mix. CrashGym thus measures the value of experimentation as avoided decision loss and lets simulator detail be judged by the decisions it supports.

AI.tldr: 提出CrashGym：一个确定性、可回放的限价订单簿模拟器，用于测量智能体在冲击性崩盘场景中"先做实验再做决策"的实验价值。实验表明，实验室访问使Luna部署的平均后悔值从8.878降至3.785。
AI.motivation: 现有基准很少衡量智能体所做的实验是否真正改善了其目标决策。本文希望将"实验的价值"形式化为决策损失的减少量，并据此评判模拟器细节设计的合理性。
AI.method: 构建CrashGym确定性可回放限价订单簿模拟器：智能体须在"去杠杆干预"与"流动性兜底"之间选择，且可先在实验室实现中查询实验。选择在独立随机种子的目标实现上评分，模拟器对每个可行干预逐一执行，通过在同一目标重复上直接模拟所有替代方案计算相对最优干预的后悔值，无人工或模型评判。四类放大机制（持续价格冲击、流动性撤出、保证金驱动的强制平仓、演化中的策略组合）均可分阶段独立开启。
AI.result: 在24个新采样世界的前瞻性研究中，实验室访问将唯一具有完整记录的部署（Luna）的平均后悔值从8.878降至3.785，配对减少5.092个效用单位（名义95%世界自助法区间1.028–9.507），相当于OBSERVE-ONLY均值的57.4%。另两个部署的前瞻性比较数据不完整；在独立的探索性研究中，四个部署在具备实验室访问时平均后悔值均更低。内生化演化策略组合的实验室相较固定策略组合未显示确定优势。
AI.conclusion: CrashGym将实验价值度量为避免的决策损失，并使模拟器细节可依其支撑的决策质量来评判。

title: From Weather to Enhanced Weathering: Weather Foundation Models for Carbon Dioxide Removal at Operational Scale
comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Sydney, Australia. Workshop: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
summary: Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) is a carbon removal solution with the potential to remove gigatons of CO$_2$ per year, but quantifying that removal today requires dense soil sampling and laboratory analysis. We evaluate five weather Foundation Models (FMs) as frozen encoders feeding lightweight decoders, under a leave-one-field-out protocol on 5,192 chronosequences from 264 fields across Brazil and the US. To our knowledge, this is the first holistic evaluation of weather FMs for ERW and the largest evaluation on operational ERW data. We find that across weather FMs, representations transfer to ERW: our best model, TerraNova-ERW, built on Aurora 1.5, positively orders measurements within fields it has never seen. Zero-shot prediction of a new field's mean removal is not yet feasible, and we attribute this to data scale: the same architecture excels on $\sim$$10^5$ natural-weathering sequences, anchoring the scale we expect ERW data must reach. Few-shot prediction, blending the model with a few samples per field, is supported today: TerraNova-ERW recovers over 60% of the highest-removal fields with two samples per field, roughly halves the samples needed to estimate a field's mean removal, and can cut sampling on our densest fields by 28-98%.

AI.tldr: 该文首次系统评估天气基础模型（FMs）用于增强岩石风化（ERW）碳去除量化的可行性，基于264个田间地块、5192条时间序列数据，采用留一地交叉验证，构建TerraNova-ERW模型。
AI.motivation: ERW有望每年去除数十亿吨CO₂，但当前量化去除量依赖密集土壤采样与实验室分析，成本高、效率低，亟需低成本且可靠的替代量化手段；同时天气基础模型在ERW任务上的迁移能力尚属未知。
AI.method: 将五种天气基础模型作为冻结编码器，接轻量解码器；在巴西与美国264个地块、5192条时间序列上采用留一地（leave-one-field-out）协议评估；最佳模型TerraNova-ERW以Aurora 1.5为骨干。开展零样本、少样本（每地块少量样本混合）分析，并与约10⁵条自然风化序列上的表现对照。
AI.result: 基础模型表征可迁移至ERW：TerraNova-ERW在未见地块内能正确排序测量值。零样本预测新地块平均去除量尚不可行，归因于数据规模不足（同架构在约10⁵条自然风化序列上表现优异）。少样本预测已可用：每地块仅2个样本即可召回60%以上的高去除地块，将估计地块平均去除量所需样本量减半，在最密集地块上可减少28%–98%的采样量。
AI.conclusion: 天气基础模型对ERW具备表征迁移能力，但零样本量化受数据规模制约；少样本混合策略是当前可落地的方案，可显著降低土壤采样成本；同时界定了ERW数据需达到约10⁵量级才能支撑可靠预测的规模预期。

title: ChronoSynth: Constraint-Aware Question Synthesis over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected. Experiments on CRONQUESTIONS and MultiTQ demonstrate state-of-the-art generation performance, with ablations supporting the contributions of its components.

AI.tldr: 提出ChronoSynth框架，将时序知识图谱问句生成建模为"约束保持的图到问句"问题，用显式时序意图状态、模式记忆检索与校验反馈抑制时序语义漂移，在CRONQUESTIONS和MultiTQ上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 时序知识图谱问句生成中，有效问句必须同时保持答案域、时间条件、参照事件与时序顺序等约束；现有KGQG方法与提示基线虽能生成流畅问句，却会改变这些条件，导致"时序语义漂移"。
AI.method: ChronoSynth为记忆增强、约束感知的生成框架：(1) 构建Temporal Intent State显式化目标问句语义；(2) 从索引化模式记忆中检索类型兼容的问句模式；(3) 将模式适配到输入图并生成问句；(4) 对生成结果进行校验，检测到有依据的不一致时以校验反馈引导修订。
AI.result: 在CRONQUESTIONS与MultiTQ上取得最先进的生成性能，消融实验支持各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以约束保持为核心的显式时序意图建模、模式记忆与校验—修订回路可有效缓解时序语义漂移，为时序KGQG提供一种可解释、可验证的生成范式。

title: Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention and Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion for Video Action Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling (MMM 2027)
summary: In video action detection, modeling the temporal dependencies in continuous video streams is crucial. Previous methods based on deep neural networks can perform frame-level video recognition tasks. However, these methods struggle to model dynamic temporal patterns, facing challenges such as redundant frame information, difficulty balancing global and local features, and insufficient fusion of visual and textual features. To address these issues, we propose a video temporal attention module based on the Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention, which aggregates continuous temporal sequences into feature representations across diverse temporal scales while efficiently reducing redundancy. We also introduce a Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion module that leverages cross-attention at both latent and standard feature levels, achieving fine-grained fusion between video and textual features to enhance semantic alignment and feature interaction. Experimental results across multiple video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods achieve superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度潜在时序压缩注意力（MSL-TCA）与时序-文本交叉注意力融合（VTC-AF）两个模块，缓解视频动作检测中帧信息冗余、全局/局部特征失衡及视觉-文本融合不足的问题，在多个视频识别基准上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 连续视频流中的时序依赖建模至关重要。现有深度网络方法虽能完成帧级视频识别，但难以刻画动态时序模式，具体表现为：帧信息冗余、全局与局部特征难以平衡、视觉与文本特征融合不充分。
AI.method: 1) 视频时序注意力模块：基于多尺度潜在时序压缩注意力，将连续时序序列聚合为多种时间尺度上的特征表示，同时高效降低冗余；2) 视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块：在潜在特征层与标准特征层两个层面引入交叉注意力，实现视频与文本特征的细粒度融合，增强语义对齐与特征交互。
AI.result: 在多个视频识别基准上，所提方法相较现有方法取得更优性能，验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度潜在时序压缩与双层交叉注意力融合可有效提升时序建模与跨模态对齐能力，并具备良好的泛化性。

title: ARCANA: A Benchmark for Abstraction and Analogical Reasoning
summary: Analogical reasoning is widely considered a fundamental component of human intelligence. Few benchmarks are designed to explicitly test far analogical reasoning - reasoning between domains that are superficially dissimilar yet share deep relational or structural similarities. In this work, we introduce an analogical reasoning benchmark called Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy (ARCANA). The tasks of ARCANA require performing far analogical mappings from real-world objects or physical phenomena to abstract grid-based transformations, different from the well-known ARC-AGI benchmark which primarily emphasized innate human priors. We validate ARCANA through a human study, demonstrating that humans solve these tasks reliably. In contrast, evaluations across a range of large language models show a distinct performance gap compared to humans, revealing systematic failure modes that remain challenging for current models. To address this gap, we propose ConceptSIR, a reasoning framework based on concept slippage, introspection, and reflection. Experiments demonstrate that ConceptSIR enables standard LLMs to solve several challenging ARCANA tasks that were unsolved by direct prompting in our evaluation. Overall, our results suggest that far analogical reasoning remains an open problem for contemporary LLMs. All the materials are available at sites.google.com/view/arcanacogtest. The complete codebase, including benchmark, and ConceptSIR, is publicly available at https://github.com/density-11/arcana-test. All ARCANA data and task instances can be accessed and explored at https://arcanacogtest.org/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出远类比推理基准 ARCANA，要求将真实世界物体/物理现象映射为抽象网格变换，并通过人类实验验证可解性；LLM 表现显著落后于人类，作者进一步提出基于概念滑移、内省与反思的 ConceptSIR 框架以提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准较少显式测试"远类比推理"（表层差异大但共享深层关系/结构相似性的跨域推理）；且 ARC-AGI 主要考察先天人类先验，缺少对抽象映射能力的针对性评测。
AI.method: 构建 ARCANA 基准：任务需将真实世界对象或物理现象进行远类比映射到抽象网格变换；通过人类被试研究验证任务可靠性；评测多种 LLM；并提出 ConceptSIR 推理框架（概念滑移 concept slippage + 内省 + 反思）。
AI.result: 人类能稳定解决 ARCANA 任务；多种 LLM 与人类存在明显性能差距，呈现系统性失败模式；ConceptSIR 使标准 LLM 解决若干直接提示无法解决的困难任务。
AI.conclusion: 远类比推理对当代 LLM 仍是未解问题；ConceptSIR 是有效的初步改进方向；基准、代码与数据均已公开。

title: How Does Orthogonalization Adapt to the Neural Network Hessian Structure? A Gradient Self Outer-Product Analysis at Initialization
summary: Muon orthogonalizes a weight matrix's momentum before each step, and on neural networks this simple preconditioner beats AdamW in a wide range of tasks. Existing analyses explain Muon within general optimization frameworks or on a few specific models, and many of them view orthogonalization as a preconditioner. Since the Hessian is the optimal preconditioner under a quadratic approximation of the loss, these works leave a basic question open: what makes orthogonalization suited to the Hessian of a neural network? Prior work shows that the layer-wise Hessian of a neural network is row-block diagonally dominant, and Muon's implicit preconditioner, the Kronecker product $(\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top)^{1/2}\otimes\mathbf{I}$ with $\mathbf{V}$ the momentum, has the same row-block structure exactly when $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ is diagonally dominant. Diagonal dominance of $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ has been observed in language models, but why a neural network produces it has not been explained. This work provides a quantitative asymptotic theory for neural networks at initialization, and points out the intuition that the overparameterization of the weight matrices drives the diagonal dominance. We analyze $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{G}\mathbf{G}^\top]$, which equals $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top]$ at initialization, in four canonical models: symmetric matrix factorization, deep linear networks, two-layer ReLU networks, and single-layer linear attention. In each case the diagonal entries outgrow the off-diagonal ones at explicit rates as the hidden dimensions grow; for the query, key and value weights of attention the off-diagonal vanishes altogether. Simulations of the four models and experiments on language models at initialization confirm the predicted scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文为Muon优化器提供了初始化下的定量渐近理论：证明过参数化驱动梯度二阶矩 $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{G}\mathbf{G}^\top]$ 的对角占优，从而解释Muon的正交化为何匹配神经网络的分层Hessian结构。
AI.motivation: Muon在众多任务上优于AdamW，但已有分析要么停留在通用优化框架，要么只针对少数特定模型，且普遍把正交化仅视为预条件子。由于Hessian是二次近似下的最优预条件子，一个基本问题悬而未决：是什么使正交化契合神经网络的Hessian？已知分层Hessian具有行块对角占优结构，而Muon的隐式预条件子 $(\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top)^{1/2}\otimes\mathbf{I}$ 恰好在 $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ 对角占优时具备同样的行块结构；语言模型中已观测到该性质，但缺乏成因解释。
AI.method: 建立神经网络在初始化处的定量渐近理论。由于初始化时 $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top]=\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{G}\mathbf{G}^\top]$，作者分析梯度二阶矩 $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{G}\mathbf{G}^\top]$，在四种典型模型上推导对角元与次对角元的显式增长率：对称矩阵分解、深层线性网络、两层ReLU网络、单层线性注意力（其中注意力Q/K/V权重的非对角项完全消失）。并辅以四类模型的数值模拟及语言模型初始化实验验证。
AI.result: 四种模型中，随隐藏维度增大，对角元以显式速率超过非对角元；对注意力的query、key、value权重，非对角项趋于零。四个模型的仿真与语言模型初始化实验均证实了所预测的缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 权重矩阵的过参数化是 $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$（即梯度二阶矩）对角占优的成因，这使Muon的正交化预条件子在结构上与神经网络的块对角占优Hessian相匹配，从而为Muon的有效性提供了原理性解释。

title: B-CARE: Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking
summary: Stance classifiers make errors that can be costly to identify under limited human-review budgets. Prioritizing potentially incorrect predictions remains challenging, particularly across heterogeneous base models. We introduce B-CARE (Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking), a prediction-blind framework for identifying high-risk stance predictions. Given only a target and text, a fixed LLM verifier assigns ordinal evidence scores to all candidate stance labels without observing the base model's prediction or confidence. B-CARE constructs a comparative risk score by contrasting the strongest alternative-class evidence with the evidence supporting the predicted class. The resulting classwise evidence profile can be reused across multiple base models without training a separate error detector or calibrating risk scores. We evaluate B-CARE on four stance benchmarks and three heterogeneous base LLMs, covering 12 dataset-model settings and 5,206 unique test instances. Evaluation includes error-ranking discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC), selective prediction (E-AURC), and review effectiveness (ErrorCapture at fixed review budgets). B-CARE achieves a mean AUROC of 0.735 and a mean AUPRC of 0.524, capturing 41.06% of errors within the highest-risk 20% of predictions. Although B-CARE does not uniformly outperform strong confidence-based baselines, it provides a reusable, complementary evidence signal for prioritizing potentially incorrect stance predictions across heterogeneous models.

AI.tldr: 提出B-CARE：一种"预测盲"（prediction-blind）框架，仅凭目标与文本，由固定LLM验证器对所有候选立场标签给出序数证据打分，通过对比最强替代类证据与预测类证据构造比较风险分数，可跨多个基模型复用，无需训练错误检测器或校准。
AI.motivation: 立场分类器的错误在有限人工审核预算下代价高昂，需优先识别潜在错误预测；而跨异构基模型统一排序风险尤为困难，且现有方法通常依赖模型置信度或需针对每个模型单独训练/校准。
AI.method: B-CARE（Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking）：固定LLM验证器在不观察基模型预测与置信度的情况下，对目标-文本对的所有候选立场标签赋序数证据分；以最强替代类证据减去预测类证据得到比较风险分；所得类级证据画像可跨多个基模型复用。
AI.result: 在4个立场基准、3个异构基LLM（12个数据集-模型设置、5,206个唯一测试样本）上评测，指标含AUROC/AUPRC、选择性预测E-AURC与固定审核预算下的ErrorCapture；平均AUROC 0.735、AUPRC 0.524，在风险最高的20%预测中捕获41.06%的错误。未全面超越强置信度基线。
AI.conclusion: B-CARE虽不普遍优于置信度基线，但提供了一种可复用、与置信度互补的证据信号，可用于跨异构模型优先审核潜在错误的立场预测。

title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
summary: We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. Against off-the-shelf inpainting baselines, ROCOCO is the strongest method by a wide margin when no occlusion mask is given, and is competitive with mask-supervised inpainting when one is, achieving best on full-image error and second only to LaMa on the occluded region, while using a completer of $7.7$M parameters against LaMa's $51$M and Stable Diffusion's $860$M.

AI.tldr: ROCOCO：基于流匹配与UNet掩码预测的曲线特征遮挡补全生成模型，无需先验遮挡掩码。
AI.motivation: 环境障碍物遮挡导致曲线特征（如道路、血管、线状物体）不完整，需要补全；现有修复方法通常依赖先验的遮挡掩码（特权信息），且大模型参数开销高。
AI.method: 采用流匹配（flow matching）生成模型对遮挡区域进行曲线特征修复；额外训练UNet掩码预测模型，仅凭被遮挡的观测即可识别需修复区域，从而消除对先验遮挡信息的依赖。
AI.result: 在程序化生成的测试用例上验证各组件；在大型公共曲线物体数据集上验证完整流程。无掩码条件下，ROCOCO大幅优于现成修复基线；有掩码监督时具竞争力——全图误差最优，遮挡区域误差仅次于LaMa；补全器仅7.7M参数（LaMa 51M、Stable Diffusion 860M）。
AI.conclusion: ROCOCO以极小参数量实现了强竞争力的曲线特征遮挡补全，且无需先验遮挡掩码，具备实用性与效率优势。

title: Same Probabilities, Different Advice: Gain-Loss Framing Effects in High-Stakes LLM Decision Support
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support consequential decisions, yet their reliability under equivalent representations of uncertainty remains unclear. Existing work has documented prompt sensitivity, cognitive biases, and confidence miscalibration, but it is still unknown whether high-stakes advice changes when the same probability is expressed through complementary gain and loss frames. We introduce FrameBench-HPS, a controlled benchmark of 2,880 prompts derived from 240 high-stakes scenarios across healthcare, finance, education/career, and legal/consumer-rights domains. Across seven LLMs, gain-loss framing changes the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups, with most changes involving uncertainty rather than direct reversals. Human evaluation confirms corresponding shifts in perceived risk and directiveness. Robustness experiments show that framing effects persist under conversational paraphrases and exceed ordinary repeated-generation variability. Probability canonicalization substantially reduces framing sensitivity, identifying probability representation as a practical target for improving consistency in high-stakes LLM decision support.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FrameBench-HPS 基准，检验大语言模型在高风险决策建议中对等价增益/损失框架的敏感性，发现框架效应普遍存在，且概率规范化可显著缓解。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益用于支持高风险决策，提示敏感性、认知偏差与置信度失准已被记录，但"同一概率以互补的增益/损失框架表达时，建议是否改变"仍未知；这关系到不确定性表征下模型可靠性。
AI.method: 构建 FrameBench-HPS：240 个高风险情景（医疗、金融、教育/职业、法律/消费者权益四个领域）× 互补增益/损失框架，共 2,880 条受控提示；对 7 个 LLM 测试建议类别变化，辅以人类评估感知风险与指令性，并进行对话式改写鲁棒性实验与概率规范化实验。
AI.result: 32.4% 的完整提示组中建议类别因增益-损失框架而改变，多数变化表现为不确定性层面的偏移而非直接反转；人类评估证实感知风险与指令性随之变化；框架效应在对话式改写下仍存在且超出常规重复生成变异；概率规范化显著降低框架敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 增益-损失框架效应在高风险 LLM 决策支持中稳健存在，概率表征是可操作的改进目标，概率规范化有助于提升建议一致性。

title: SSMCGM-Stream: A Streaming State-Space Model for Personalized Diabetes Management
comment: Accepted to AI4Science and GenAI4Health NeurIPS 2026 workshops
summary: Continuous glucose monitoring supports diabetes management but requires forecasting models that are accurate, interpretable, and efficient enough for real-time deployment. We present SSMCGM-Stream, a streaming state-space model that maintains a personalized hidden state updated with each incoming glucose reading to provide constant-time forecasting, physiologically structured counterfactual reasoning, and interpretable forecasts through hidden-state attribution. Built on this foundation, SSMCGM-Agent delivers risk-aware, natural-language decision support by translating forecasts, explanations, and counterfactuals into grounded recommendations through a guarded language-model interface. Evaluated on the T1DEXI cohort, SSMCGM-Stream achieves forecasting performance comparable to strong neural baselines while substantially reducing computational cost, enabling continuous on-device diabetes decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出流式状态空间模型 SSMCGM-Stream 及其决策支持系统 SSMCGM-Agent，用于连续血糖监测的实时、可解释、可反事实推理的血糖预测与建议生成。
AI.motivation: 连续血糖监测需要既准确、又可解释且能在设备端实时部署的预测模型；现有强神经网络基线通常计算开销大、缺乏生理结构与反事实推理能力。
AI.method: SSMCGM-Stream 维护一个随每条新血糖读数更新的个性化隐藏状态，实现常数时间预测；采用生理学结构化的反事实推理，并通过隐藏状态归因提供可解释预测。在其上构建 SSMCGM-Agent，经带防护机制的语言模型接口把预测、解释与反事实转换为风险感知的自然语言建议。
AI.result: 在 T1DEXI 队列上，预测性能与强神经基线相当，同时显著降低计算成本，支持设备端连续糖尿病决策支持。
AI.conclusion: 流式状态空间建模可在保持预测精度的同时兼顾效率与可解释性，为实现实时、可解释、风险感知的糖尿病决策支持提供可行路径。

title: Don't Stop Long-Context Continual Pre-Training Too Early: An Empirical Scaling Law
summary: Long-context continual pre-training (LCCP) is widely used to improve long-context capability, but how its benefits scale with the number of tokens used for LCCP remains unclear. We investigate this question through modeling, monitoring, and validating the benefits of scaling LCCP. First, we establish an empirical additive power law relating long-context performance to model size and the respective token budgets of short-context pre-training and LCCP. Experiments across five model scales and more than one hundred short- and long-context budget configurations show that the fitted law reproduces the observed trends and extrapolates well to held-out model scales. Second, we introduce \textsc{Constant-Last4}, a training and observation protocol that averages the four most recent consecutive checkpoints from a constant-learning-rate run to enable stable monitoring along a single extensible training trajectory. Under this protocol, the same scaling-law form fits well and accurately predicts the LCCP performance trajectory of a 1.22B-parameter model trained on approximately 100B LCCP tokens. Finally, downstream evaluations along this trajectory show continued improvements in long-context performance, with no clear sign of saturation within the evaluated range. These gains persist after both 128K context extension and supervised fine-tuning, with benefits extending to long-context understanding and agentic tasks. Together, these results argue for continuing to scale LCCP rather than stopping early: its gains are stably observable along an extensible trajectory, quantitatively predictable, and transferable to downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长上下文持续预训练（LCCP）的收益如何随token规模扩展，建立了关联长上下文性能与模型规模、短上下文预训练预算及LCCP预算的经验加性幂律，并提出Constant-Last4监测协议以稳定追踪单条可扩展训练轨迹；结果表明收益可预测、可持续增长且可迁移到下游任务，支持继续扩大LCCP规模。
AI.motivation: LCCP被广泛用于提升长上下文能力，但其收益随所用token数量如何扩展尚不明确，导致难以判断应投入多少LCCP预算、是否应提前停止。
AI.method: (1) 建模：构建经验加性幂律，将长上下文性能表示为模型规模、短上下文预训练token预算与LCCP token预算的函数，覆盖5个模型规模与100余种短/长上下文预算组合，并检验拟合、趋势复现与对未参与拟合的模型规模的外推能力；(2) 监测：提出Constant-Last4协议，在恒定学习率训练中对最近4个连续checkpoint取平均，沿单条可扩展轨迹稳定观测；(3) 验证：用同一幂律形式预测1.22B参数模型在约100B LCCP token上的性能轨迹，并进行下游评测，包括128K上下文扩展与监督微调后的长上下文理解与agentic任务。
AI.result: 拟合的经验加性幂律能够复现所观测趋势，并对留出的模型规模外推良好；Constant-Last4协议下同一幂律形式拟合良好，可准确预测1.22B模型在约100B LCCP token上的性能轨迹；下游评测显示长上下文性能在评估范围内持续提升、无明显饱和迹象，且在128K上下文扩展与SFT后收益依然保持，并延伸至长上下文理解与agentic任务。
AI.conclusion: LCCP的收益沿可扩展训练轨迹稳定可观测、可定量预测，并能迁移到下游任务，因此应继续扩大LCCP规模而非过早停止。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了紧凑型grounding VLM在物理对抗补丁下的鲁棒性，提出统一指标cASR，并将失败划分为omission、substitution、displacement三类。结果表明VLM可与目标检测器一样脆弱，失败模式主要由输出格式而非架构族决定，且substitution/displacement更危险、不易被下游察觉。
AI.motivation: VLM正被快速部署到边缘端安全关键系统，但其物理对抗鲁棒性缺乏系统研究；同时VLM与传统检测器输出形式差异大，缺乏公平比较的方法论。
AI.method: 在"人身上佩戴对抗补丁是否逃脱检测"这一统一结果上对比代表性模型；引入条件攻击成功率cASR（仅在匹配灰色遮挡物下模型仍能定位的图像上统计），并将失败划分为omission（无框）、substitution（框落在补丁上）、displacement（框落在两者之外）三类；在分布偏移下进一步分析失败模式转移。
AI.result: 紧凑grounding VLM的物理对抗脆弱性可与目标检测器相当；失败模式主要与模型输出格式相关而非架构族；三类失败中仅omission可被下游系统察觉，substitution与displacement会返回高置信度、格式良好的框；分布偏移下，原本以omission为主的VLM会转向更多displacement/substitution失败。
AI.conclusion: grounding VLM可能继承检测器的脆弱性，并存在采用更危险失败模式的可能，需在边缘部署中重视其物理对抗风险评估。

title: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
summary: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

AI.tldr: 提出Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP)，用预训练LLM作为结构化世界模型的外生组件预测不确定的作业到达，结合afterstate分解与短情景rollout进行动态调度，显著降低加权拖期。
AI.motivation: 动态调度需在线派工同时预判未来作业到达，在非线性拖期目标下，短视决策会累积下游成本；核心难点在于未来作业到达具有不确定性。
AI.method: 采用afterstate分解，将已知确定性车间转移与不确定外生作业到达分离，使LLM仅通过紧凑信念表示预测后者；构建AWMP，将信念条件的进化式派工策略与短情景rollout结合；并引入surprise触发的刷新机制（仅当新到达偏离预测足够大时才查询LLM）与在线残差自校准（以近期预测误差为条件应对非平稳到达）。
AI.result: 在多种到达分布下，相较8种经典优先派工规则中的最优者，AWMP在动态job-shop上降低加权拖期6-21%，在柔性job-shop基准上降低22-46%。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为结构化世界模型的外生预测模块，配合分解与选择性查询机制，在动态调度中实现有效的预测性派工，具有跨基准的稳健收益。

title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks. AttnDA improves detection performance across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains challenging regardless of classifier choice. A covariance ablation further shows that removing inter-head correlation structure substantially contributes to performance, with complex covariance assumptions causing significant degradation on cross-domain data. These results indicate that the attentional distraction signal underlying focus-score-based detection does not transfer reliably to agentic environments, and that learned linear classifiers over head-level attention features offer improved detection performance, provided training data from the target deployment domain is available.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在真实的智能体间接提示注入（IPI）场景下评估 Attention Tracker，发现其“数据集无关”的检测主张不成立；提出 AttnDA（对逐头 focus score 向量使用 Fisher LDA 分类器）以替代标量阈值，在跨四个基准的评估中提升检测性能，但向 AgentDojo 的迁移仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: Attention Tracker（Hung et al., 2025）声称通过监控注意力在用户任务 token 与数据 token 间的分布、以标量 focus score 阈值实现数据集无关的 IPI 检测，但该结论尚未在真实智能体环境中检验；作者旨在验证其假设在 AgentDojo 这类长结构化工具输出场景下是否成立。
AI.method: 在 AgentDojo 基准上复现评估 Attention Tracker；提出 AttnDA，将标量阈值替换为基于逐头 focus score 向量的 Fisher 线性判别分析分类器；在覆盖四个基准的跨数据集设定下对比两者，并进行协方差消融实验以考察头间相关结构的影响。
AI.result: 在智能体环境中，长结构化工具输出破坏了 Attention Tracker 所依赖的注意力假设，使其在 AgentDojo 上多数模型族的检测接近随机水平；AttnDA 在智能体与工具集成类基准上提升检测性能，但迁移至 AgentDojo 仍困难；协方差消融表明移除头间相关结构对性能有实质贡献，而复杂协方差假设在跨域数据上导致显著退化。
AI.conclusion: focus score 检测所依赖的“注意力分散”信号难以可靠迁移至智能体环境；在具备目标部署域训练数据的前提下，基于头级注意力特征的学习型线性分类器可获得更优的检测性能。未来方向包括域自适应与更鲁棒的特征表示。

title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
summary: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以记忆为中心的持续学习（MCCL）框架，主张应以外在行为改进而非检索准确率来评判智能体记忆，并给出三维分类法、双环生命周期、评估协议与记忆扩展框架。
AI.motivation: 基于基础模型的自主智能体虽具备推理、规划与工具使用能力，但固定权重与上下文长度限制使其难以在长期部署中从经验中持续学习；现有外部记忆系统多为被动检索缓存，仅以能否召回事实或历史交互为评价标准，记忆能否驱动真正的持续学习仍是开放问题。
AI.method: MCCL包含三部分：(1) 三轴分类法，按状态存储位置（substrates）、形态（assets）、管理方式（policies）组织记忆，并定义双环生命周期——内环更新记忆状态，外环依据任务反馈优化管理策略；(2) 评估协议，衡量干扰下的保持、对变化的适应与任务迁移，以区分真实行为增益与单纯的上下文扩张；(3) 记忆扩展框架，建模非参数化与参数化记忆下智能体性能随经验、存储容量与计算预算的扩展规律。
AI.result: 摘要未给出实验数据；所提出的评估协议可将行为性持续学习增益与上下文扩充带来的假性提升相区分，扩展框架则刻画了性能与经验量、存储容量及计算预算之间的 scaling 关系。
AI.conclusion: 论文将智能体记忆从被动查表重新定位为持续学习机制，为构建可自我改进的自主智能体提供了一条有原则的路径。

title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
summary: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.

AI.tldr: NeuralSRender：基于视频扩散DiT的仿真到真实视频翻译框架，通过G-buffer几何先验注入与两阶段LoRA适配，在几何一致前提下提升合成视频真实感，仅1.45%参数开销，显著提升下游感知性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知受限于高质量标注视觉数据稀缺；仿真器可规模化产数据，但合成视频真实感不足，导致真实场景感知性能下降。现有sim-to-real翻译需在真实感提升与源场景几何一致性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 基于预训练视频扩散Transformer（DiT）；用轻量projector注入G-buffer的几何与材质先验，LoRA实现参数高效适配。两阶段训练：第一阶段用带精确G-buffer的合成视频学习G-buffer条件控制；第二阶段用带估计G-buffer的真实视频适配真实外观，此时冻结projector与第一阶段LoRA，仅训练额外LoRA以抑制估计噪声干扰。另构建GenReal大规模驾驶视频数据集（合成+真实视频及对应G-buffer）。
AI.result: 仅引入1.45%参数开销，可在24GB显存的消费级GPU上训练。真实感提升且几何一致性具竞争力。用翻译视频替代原始仿真渲染训练感知模型，nuImages检测AP50由35.1升至40.6，Cityscapes分割mIoU由32.4升至40.8。
AI.conclusion: NeuralSRender以极小参数代价实现几何一致的仿真到真实视频翻译，有效缓解合成数据真实感瓶颈，并直接转化为下游检测与分割性能提升；配套数据集GenReal与开源代码/权重支持后续研究。

title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
summary: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers. Across five spatial-reasoning benchmarks, SpatialBrain improves on direct answers from the same backbone on four and ties on the fifth. Component comparisons, experience-coverage curves, and traced resource decisions characterize how the framework accumulates and uses these resources.

AI.tldr: SpatialBrain是一个在固定视觉语言骨干前提下，通过分离"场景证据"与"推理经验"、并跨任务块积累经验来提升空间推理的框架，在五个基准中四个优于同骨干直接回答、一个持平。
AI.motivation: 空间推理不仅是调用几何工具，更需判断何时直接观察足够、何时需重建、测量或变换参考系。作者希望让模型保留关于这类决策的经验，同时不微调视觉语言骨干。
AI.method: 核心是区分"关于场景的证据"与"关于如何推理的经验"。3DFusionMemory将当前场景观测融合为可查询的空间关系；Spatial Skill Library提供可复用工具流程；Spatial Cognition将任务条件与"何时及如何使用记忆与技能"的经验关联。完成的轨迹被抽象为过程记录，并在任务块之间进行整合，使后续决策可借鉴先前执行，而不迁移场景坐标或参考答案。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理基准上，SpatialBrain相对同一骨干的直接回答在四个基准上提升、第五个持平；组件对比、经验覆盖曲线与资源决策追踪刻画了框架积累与使用这些资源的方式。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆、技能与认知经验模块化并跨任务块整合，可在不改变骨干模型的情况下持续增强空间推理决策能力，且经验可泛化而不依赖场景坐标或答案迁移。

title: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO)，利用 Doob h-变换实现生成式策略（扩散/流模型）的无似然强化学习微调，统一支持 PPO、GRPO 等策略改进规则，并在 MuJoCo 上取得强表现。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流策略表达能力强，但其动作似然不可解析求解，导致 PPO、GRPO 等主流策略优化方法无法直接使用。作者希望在不显式计算似然的前提下，对这类生成式策略进行 RL 微调。
AI.method: 将策略改进与生成式策略学习解耦：(1) 先学习一个轻量级的比率模型（ratio model）表示期望的策略更新；(2) 再通过条件漂移匹配（conditional drift matching），把经比率倾斜（ratio-tilted）的目标策略蒸馏进生成式策略。该框架统一适用于扩散与流策略，并兼容 PPO、GRPO 等策略改进规则。
AI.result: 理论上证明实用的条件漂移匹配目标与理想的 Doob 漂移匹配目标梯度等价；并证明所诱导的扩散过程求解一个端点约束的随机最优控制问题，从而实现实现期望策略倾斜所需的最小能量修正。在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，DoobPO 优于有竞争力的扩散与流策略基线。
AI.conclusion: DoobPO 为生成式策略的 RL 微调提供了一条有理论依据且实用的路径：通过 Doob h-变换实现无似然策略优化，兼具统一性与最优性保证，并在实证中验证了有效性。

title: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

AI.tldr: 提出OnQ低比特恢复流程，结合on-policy蒸馏与逐候选动态KL，解决低比特LLM长程推理能力退化与无法及时终止的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有QAT方法在固定响应序列上用全精度模型监督量化学生模型，导致两个问题：(1) 训练前缀与学生生成时实际遇到的前缀不匹配，轨迹偏差随响应变长而累积；(2) 在学生自身前缀上存在下一token候选的欠预测与过预测，且在高熵前缀处分布错配更频繁，因而低比特模型在长程推理任务上表现差且难以在合理token预算内终止。
AI.method: OnQ流程：先做分块（block-wise）校准；随后由量化学生模型自行生成响应，并在其自身前缀上接受全精度教师的监督（on-policy蒸馏）；同时采用逐候选Dynamic KL，依据每个候选的教师-学生概率比对前向KL与反向KL加权，以平衡对欠预测和过预测的纠正。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B的2-bit与3-bit精度下，OnQ在九项基准平均分上最优，长程推理基准提升最大；2-bit时在所有模型规模、所有基准上均优于全部基线，Qwen3-8B平均分较最强基线提升10.26分；响应更短、截断更少、重复性错误更少。
AI.conclusion: 将on-policy蒸馏与候选级Dynamic KL结合，可有效缓解训练-生成轨迹偏差与分布错配，显著恢复低比特LLM的长程推理能力并改善生成效率，为低比特量化恢复提供了有效范式。

title: DetM-Tracker: Deterministic and Memory-Efficient VIS for Autonomous Industrial Inspection
summary: Autonomous industrial inspection requires strictly deterministic real-time inference under tight memory and computational constraints. However, existing Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) models suffer from prohibitive scaling: dense temporal memory grows with spatial resolution and sequence length, while fixed-capacity decoders fail to exploit the inherent sparsity of industrial scenes, creating a practical memory wall on resource-constrained edge platforms. We present DetM-Tracker, a streamlined VIS framework for autonomous industrial inspection, where target objects often exhibit highly similar appearance under constrained "micro" fields of view. DetM-Tracker eliminates architectural redundancy through three synergistic components: (1) Compact Scalar Memory, which condenses high-dimensional instance features into four-scalar descriptors, reducing temporal memory complexity from $O(T \cdot N \cdot R)$ to $O(T \cdot \hat{N})$. This mechanism effectively compresses frame-level representations into a bank of active instances, where $R$ denotes resolution, $N$ and $\hat{N}$ represent global and window-specific instance counts, respectively and $T$ the temporal window size; and (2) Dynamic Instance Channels, which adaptively allocate query capacity according to the actual number of visible objects; and (3) Entropy-Gated Skip Connection, which concentrates computational budget on high-uncertainty spatial regions to refine object boundaries in a single forward pass without auxiliary refinement heads. Our approach effectively bridges the gap between modern VIS models and the practical demands of industrial edge deployment, reducing inference latency by approximately 20$\times$ and VRAM consumption by 6$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art dense-feature baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出面向自主工业巡检的轻量视频实例分割框架DetM-Tracker，通过紧凑标量记忆、动态实例通道与熵门控跳跃连接消除架构冗余，将时序记忆复杂度由O(T·N·R)降至O(T·N̂)，推理延迟降低约20倍、显存占用降低6倍。
AI.motivation: 自主工业巡检要求严格确定性实时推理且受内存与算力约束；现有VIS模型存在密集时序记忆随分辨率与序列长度增长、固定容量解码器无法利用工业场景固有稀疏性，导致边缘平台上的“内存墙”。同时工业“微观”视野下目标外观高度相似，给区分带来挑战。
AI.method: 三个协同组件：(1) 紧凑标量记忆（Compact Scalar Memory），将高维实例特征压缩为四标量描述子，把帧级表示压缩为活动实例库，记忆复杂度由O(T·N·R)降至O(T·N̂)；(2) 动态实例通道（Dynamic Instance Channels），按可见目标实际数量自适应分配查询容量；(3) 熵门控跳跃连接（Entropy-Gated Skip Connection），将算力集中于高不确定性空间区域，在单次前向中细化目标边界，无需辅助细化头。
AI.result: 相比最先进的密集特征基线，推理延迟降低约20倍，显存（VRAM）消耗降低6倍，同时缓解了现代VIS模型与工业边缘部署实际需求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: DetM-Tracker以轻量化设计在严格内存与实时约束下实现确定性VIS推理，适用于目标外观高度相似、视野受限的工业巡检场景，为VIS模型的边缘落地提供了可行路径。

title: AgentMonopoly: Behavioral Patterns and Persona Control in LLM Agents
summary: How do LLM agents' strategies differ, and how much can instructions to adopt a persona change their behavior over a game? We study these questions with AgentMonopoly, an environment where agents communicate, buy and trade properties, and make decisions that affect later turns. We compare models from four families, each at two sizes, in games with identical models, different sizes of the same family, or different families. We also assign one agent a persona, a description of how it should behave, intended to change a tendency observed in games without that persona. The tested models differ in how often they trade, waive rent, and manage cash and properties. Larger models do not consistently win more games. Persona instructions change the words agents use and some of their actions, but the changes do not always match the role across all decisions. These results show why persona following should be assessed through actions and outcomes as well as language. As our findings are conditional on the tested checkpoints, prompts, and five seeds per configuration, the open-source nature of AgentMonopoly provides the experimental infrastructure for further extending these comparisons. Our code is available at https://github.com/SuELS-Group/Agent_Monopoly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentMonopoly 环境，在含谈判、交易与跨轮次决策的桌游博弈中比较四个模型家族、两种规模 LLM 智能体的策略差异，并检验人格(persona)指令对行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对 LLM 智能体在长程、有状态、涉及经济交易与沟通的多轮博弈中的策略差异与人格遵循度的系统刻画，且人格效果多以语言表现而非行为与结果衡量。
AI.method: 构建 AgentMonopoly 多轮交易环境；对 4 个模型家族各取 2 个规模，在"同模型对局、同家族不同规模对局、跨家族对局"三类配置中各跑 5 个随机种子；并给某一智能体注入人格描述（源自无该人格对局中观察到的行为倾向），对比其语言与行动。
AI.result: 各模型在交易频率、是否豁免租金、现金与地产管理上存在明显差异；更大规模模型并不稳定获得更高胜率；人格指令改变了用词及部分行动，但改变在不同决策上并不一致地符合所设定角色。
AI.conclusion: 人格遵循度应同时通过行动与结果评估，而非仅看语言；结论受限于所测 checkpoint、提示与每配置 5 个种子的条件；AgentMonopoly 开源为后续扩展比较提供实验基础设施。

title: Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective
summary: Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling. However, we find that current tokenization strategies inherently introduce spectral distortions, forcing the learned representations to diverge from the true underlying patterns such as trend, periodicity, and seasonality, thereby impairing model performance. Through theoretical analysis from a frequency perspective, we derive the boundary conditions under which such distortions occur. To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data. TimeFT obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling. The method is parameter-free, incurs negligible computational complexity, and can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers. Our extensive experiments on diverse tasks such as forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection demonstrate that TimeFT consistently and significantly improves performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TimeFT：基于频域分块、频移与Nyquist采样的无参数、近无失真时间序列分词器，可即插即用替代现有分词器。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列分词（将序列切分为子序列）策略会引入频谱失真，使学习到的表示偏离趋势、周期性、季节性等真实模式，损害模型性能。
AI.method: 从频率视角进行理论分析，推导失真发生的边界条件；据此设计TimeFT，通过频域划分（frequency-domain partitioning）、频移（frequency shifting）与Nyquist采样获得token，方法无参数、计算开销可忽略、可作为现有tokenizer的即插即用替代。
AI.result: 在预测、分类、异常检测等多类任务上的大量实验表明，TimeFT能持续且显著地提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 时分域分词必然带来频谱失真，从频域出发构建分词器可在几乎无额外代价下消除该失真，为时间序列建模提供通用且有效的分词基础组件。

title: ECHO: Emergent Common-Mode Hidden Offsets Drive Vocabulary Collapse in Preference Optimization
summary: Preference optimization can improve every ranking metric while building a hidden, shared representation shift that the relative loss barely sees, one that can eventually destroy generation. We trace this failure to the common-mode offset, a shared directional shift in the model's hidden states that appears across token positions, prompts, and both chosen and rejected responses. Because it moves chosen and rejected representations together, the relative ranking loss barely reacts to its accumulation. As this offset grows, it projects onto the output layer to form a vocabulary well, elevating a single token's probability until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse. The isolated offset alone reconstructs the vocabulary well, injecting the learned offset into an untreated base model recreates the collapse where norm-matched random directions do not, and masking this common component from the loss prevents the well in our flagship setting. Under the per-token ranking loss we study, the same collapse appears in 14 of 17 base-model lineages and under full-parameter fine-tuning. Moreover, the offset is not merely an artifact of collapse, since it is already present in textbook DPO and SimPO runs that form no well. Textbook DPO keeps it weakly aligned with any single vocabulary direction even with three times our base budget. Trained from base models for that budget, however, full-parameter SimPO drives it into collapse on both Llama-2 and Llama-3.1, and the same kind of offset grows, without a well, from a public SFT checkpoint under the official SimPO recipe. Across 17 UltraFeedback runs, the better a run ranks held-out responses, the less often two public reward models prefer its samples to the base model's. These findings expose a blind spot in standard ranking metrics and introduce a representation-level signal that can warn of generation collapse before it occurs.

AI.tldr: 偏好优化在提升各项排序指标的同时，会在隐状态中积累一种共享方向偏移（common-mode offset），该偏移几乎不影响相对排序损失，却会投影到输出层形成"词汇阱"，最终导致生成崩溃。
AI.motivation: 标准排序指标（如相对偏好损失、胜率）看似能全面评价偏好优化，但作者发现模型可能在排序指标改善的同时发生生成能力崩溃。作者希望找出这一"指标盲区"背后的机制，并提供一个可在崩溃发生前预警的表示层信号。
AI.method: 定义并追踪"共模偏移"：跨token位置、跨prompt、跨chosen与rejected响应的隐状态共享方向位移。通过实验验证：隔离偏移注入未训练基座模型复现崩溃（而范数匹配的随机方向不能）；将该共模分量从损失中屏蔽可阻止词汇阱形成；在17个基座模型谱系、全参数微调、DPO/SimPO等设置下考察偏移与崩溃的关系；并用两个公开奖励模型对17次UltraFeedback运行的样本与基座模型比较。
AI.result: 在所研究的逐token排序损失下，17个基座模型谱系中有14个出现同样崩溃，全参数微调下亦如此；孤立偏移可单独重建词汇阱；屏蔽共模分量可在旗舰设置中阻止词汇阱。偏移并非崩溃的副产物——教科书式DPO与SimPO（未形成词汇阱）中已存在该偏移，DPO即使预算扩大到三倍也仅让偏移与单一词汇方向弱对齐；全参数SimPO在Llama-2与Llama-3.1上在该预算下均崩溃；官方SimPO配方下从公开SFT检查点也出现同类偏移（但无阱）。17次运行中，排序留出响应越好的运行，其样本被两个公开奖励模型判为优于基座模型的频率反而越低。
AI.conclusion: 共模偏移揭示了标准排序度量的盲点：相对损失对chosen与rejected共同位移不敏感，因而无法预警生成崩溃。该偏移可作为表示层诊断信号，在生成崩溃发生前给出预警。

title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucially, this recomputation enables shorter attention windows during idle-time prefill, substantially reducing prefill cost while improving accuracy. Experiments across three SVU frameworks and five streaming and offline benchmarks demonstrate accuracy gains of up to 3.9 pp. On RVS-Ego, FrameBlend reduces per-frame prefill FLOPs by over 20% and total processing time by 14-59% for retrieval-based frameworks, including the cost of query-time recomputation. These results demonstrate that a simple change in how contextualization is distributed between idle time and query time can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off for SVU.

AI.tldr: 提出FrameBlend，一种免训练的即插即用方法，通过查询时对选定视频token进行选择性KV重计算，解决流式视频理解中预填充阶段上下文受限导致的上下文错配问题，在提升精度的同时降低预填充开销。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解要求视频-LLM连续处理视频并低延迟回答。现有方法在空闲时预填充帧进KV缓存、查询时复用，但为限制无界流的逐帧计算而限制预填充上下文，造成上下文错配：受限上下文既可能缺少为视频token正确提供语境所需的信息，又仍含有与最终查询无关的信息，而该查询在预填充时未知。
AI.method: FrameBlend为即插即用、无需额外训练的方法：查询时使用与查询相关的上下文对选定的视频token重新预填充，并用重算的KV替换其缓存KV。重算使得空闲预填充阶段能采用更短的注意力窗口，从而大幅降低预填充成本。
AI.result: 在三个SVU框架、五个流式与离线基准上，精度最高提升3.9个百分点。在RVS-Ego上，对基于检索的框架，逐帧预填充FLOPs降低超20%，总处理时间减少14–59%（含查询时重计算成本）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文构建在空闲时与查询时之间重新分配，可改善SVU的精度-效率权衡，说明简单的机制改动即可同时提升精度与效率。

title: From Prompts to Posteriors: Can LLM Agents Perform Bayesian Inference in Context?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied across the scientific discovery pipeline, from synthesizing literature to generating hypotheses to informing experimental design. A unifying principle behind these tasks is the need to continuously update beliefs as evidence accumulates, for which Bayesian inference provides a natural framework. However, existing work assumes that LLMs cannot carry out principled Bayesian belief updating in context, instead relying on simplifications and heuristics. To challenge this assumption, we present a principled evaluation of Bayesian reasoning capabilities in LLMs, analyzing both the model's internal consistency as well as its ability to recover an externally determined posterior. Specifically, we build an evaluation framework spanning qualitative epistemological examples to probe probabilistic coherence, quantitative benchmarks of Bayesian inference capabilities, and analyses of the impact of non-Bayesian updates on downstream task performance. Across different scenarios, we find that LLMs generally violate Bayes' rule when updating their beliefs in context. However, when equipped with modern reasoning abilities and code execution capabilities, their performance drastically improves, enabling even the close approximation of analytically intractable posteriors. Our evaluation shows that current LLMs with access to appropriate tools could already be used to make complex belief updates in scientific discovery, enabling rapid acceleration of the efficiency and scale of AI-powered scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在上下文中进行贝叶斯信念更新的能力，发现模型普遍违反贝叶斯法则，但结合现代推理能力与代码执行后性能显著提升，甚至能逼近解析不可解的后验。
AI.motivation: LLM已被广泛用于科学发现流程（文献综述、假设生成、实验设计），这些任务的共性是需要随证据累积持续更新信念，而贝叶斯推断是天然框架。然而现有研究普遍假设LLM无法在上下文中进行有原则的贝叶斯更新，只能依赖简化与启发式，本文旨在挑战这一假设。
AI.method: 构建了一个原则性评估框架，包含三个层次：（1）定性的认识论案例，用于考察概率一致性；（2）贝叶斯推断能力的定量基准；（3）非贝叶斯更新对下游任务性能影响的分析。评估同时关注模型内部一致性以及能否恢复外部给定的后验分布。
AI.result: 在不同场景下，LLM在上下文中更新信念时普遍违反贝叶斯法则；但当模型具备现代推理能力与代码执行能力时，性能大幅改善，甚至能对解析上不可解的后验给出接近的近似。
AI.conclusion: 具备合适工具访问能力的当前LLM已可用于科学发现中的复杂信念更新，有望加速AI驱动科学发现的效率与规模。

title: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
summary: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the first two layers, the n-gram table, the sparse-attention indexer and the multi-token prediction head frozen. We optimize host offload, gradient accumulation and the kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention and the gated residual stream. In the full-model development study, non-padding training throughput increases from approximately 395 tokens/s/GPU in the initial 32K-token configuration to 4,438 tokens/s/GPU in the optimized 131K-token configuration, with hardware matmul throughput (aka without considering the cost of attention components) increasing from approximately 20 to 213 TFLOPs/GPU. A controlled cumulative study on an 8-layer model further quantifies the contributions of individual optimizations. Together with three inference nodes, the system supports a live SWE RL run with a target batch of 1,024 trainable rollouts and a 131,072-token context limit. Over steps 5-15, an iteration takes 22.4 minutes on average, with bounded entropy and trainer-sampler mismatch KL. These results highlight the importance of tailoring RL training to the model's architecture, memory layout and kernel requirements, rather than relying only on general-purpose RL infrastructure.

AI.tldr: FlashNext-RL：针对 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（注：疑为 Qwen3-Next 类架构，原文如此）的单模型 RL 训练优化框架，基于 prime-rl，用 vLLM 做 SWE rollout；在单台 8×B200 上以 BF16 全量 48 层训练（冻结前两层、n-gram 表、稀疏注意力 indexer 与 MTP 头），通过 host offload、梯度累积及 MoE/稀疏注意力/门控残差核优化，将非 padding 吞吐从约 395 提升至 4,438 tokens/s/GPU（131K 上下文），matmul 吞吐约 20→213 TFLOPs/GPU；配合三台推理节点支持 1,024 条可训练 rollout、131K 上下文的在线 SWE RL，step 5–15 平均每迭代 22.4 分钟。
AI.motivation: 长程 agentic RL 既需高效 rollout 生成，又需长序列训练；但该模型的显存需求与专有算子使现有开源实现难以支撑，故需面向具体架构定制训练优化，而非仅依赖通用 RL 基础设施。
AI.method: 基于 prime-rl 构建模型专用训练框架 FlashNext-RL，rollout 侧用 vLLM 生成 SWE 轨迹；单 8×B200 节点做 BF16 全量 48 层训练，冻结前两层、n-gram 表、稀疏注意力 indexer 与多 token 预测头；实施 host offload、梯度累积优化，并针对 MoE、稀疏注意力和门控残差流编写专用 kernel；另用 8 层模型做受控累计消融以量化各项优化贡献。
AI.result: 全模型开发实验中，非 padding 训练吞吐从初始 32K 配置的约 395 tokens/s/GPU 提升至优化后 131K 配置的 4,438 tokens/s/GPU；matmul（不含注意力组件开销）吞吐由约 20 升至 213 TFLOPs/GPU。系统配合三台推理节点支撑目标 batch 1,024 条可训练 rollout、131,072 token 上下文上限的在线 SWE RL；step 5–15 平均迭代耗时 22.4 分钟，熵与 trainer–sampler 失配 KL 均保持有界。
AI.conclusion: 面向模型架构、显存布局与 kernel 需求的定制化优化是长序列 agentic RL 训练可行的关键，通用 RL 基础设施不足以单独胜任这一任务。

title: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
summary: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user's framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE) 框架，基于社会渗透理论，用预设的自我披露轨迹检验模型在"当前披露匹配"条件下如何受先前披露历史影响，揭示了对话智能体关系性行为的路径依赖。
AI.motivation: 对话智能体日益用于社会情感支持，而自我披露是随时间展开的过程；但现有评估多考察孤立的对话状态。自然对话中披露历史与当前披露相互混杂（confounded），难以分离各自效应，因此需要一个能控制当前披露、仅操纵披露轨迹的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出TraDE框架：以社会渗透理论为基础，预先设计披露轨迹，在匹配当前披露深度（matched current disclosure）的条件下，评估前序披露历史如何塑造模型行为，从而将"轨迹"与"当前状态"解耦。
AI.result: 在多个模型与关系行为基准上，深度匹配的披露会因先前轨迹不同而引发不同回应，尤其体现在模型是接受还是挑战用户的框架上；差异与"累积的深层披露暴露量"相关，而非单一脆弱时刻或披露顺序；且在披露回落至浅层后仍持续数轮。在ESConv语料上，多个行为维度上模型与人类支持者偏离最一致之处出现在用户"收回/回撤"披露时，而非敞开心扉时。
AI.conclusion: TraDE提供了系统化手段，可暴露孤立状态评估所遗漏的、依赖历史的关系性行为，为对话智能体情感支持能力的评估提供新视角。

title: DisasterRoute: Evidence-Guided Dual-System Routing for Visual Disaster Question Answering
summary: Visual question answering from low-altitude UAV imagery must deliver timely and accurate judgments to support disaster response under limited edge computing resources. Routine questions may be answered through direct decisions, whereas more challenging questions may benefit from step-by-step reasoning. However, existing research primarily focuses on improving models' visual understanding and generative reasoning capabilities, with limited exploration of efficient direct decision-making and its adaptive coordination with generative reasoning. We develop Disaster-S1 based on a vision-language model adapted to the disaster domain. Trained for option discrimination, it outputs a probability distribution over answer options in a single multimodal forward pass for fast decision-making. We further propose DisasterRoute, a dual-system routing framework that combines prediction confidence with disaster evidence to decide whether to accept the initial answer or invoke the disaster reasoning model DisasterVL for review. By allocating inference computation on demand, the framework retains the efficiency of direct decision-making and improves overall question-answering accuracy through selective review. Experiments on DisasterBench show that Disaster-S1 achieves superior accuracy with low latency, while DisasterRoute further improves accuracy through selective review at substantially lower latency than full reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出快速选项判别模型Disaster-S1与双系统路由框架DisasterRoute，在低空无人机灾害视觉问答中兼顾低延迟与高精度。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机影像视觉问答需在边缘算力受限下及时准确地支撑灾害响应。常规问题可直接决策，难题需逐步推理；但现有研究多聚焦视觉理解与生成式推理能力提升，对高效直接决策及其与生成式推理的自适应协同探索不足。
AI.method: 基于面向灾害领域适配的视觉语言模型构建Disaster-S1，以选项判别为训练目标，在单次多模态前向中输出答案选项概率分布以实现快速决策；并提出双系统路由框架DisasterRoute，融合预测置信度与灾害证据，判断是接受初始答案还是调用灾害推理模型DisasterVL进行复核，从而按需分配推理算力。
AI.result: 在DisasterBench上，Disaster-S1以低延迟取得更优准确率；DisasterRoute通过选择性复核进一步提升准确率，且延迟显著低于全量推理。
AI.conclusion: 直接判别式决策与选择性生成式推理相结合，可在边缘资源受限场景下实现效率与精度的有效折中，为灾害视觉问答提供按需计算的可行范式。

title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
summary: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. It also establishes the first PSK values of twenty-three further boards, eleven of which were unsolved under any rules. Superko changes game-theoretic values: 4x7, a full-board win under basic ko, is worth only 12 points under PSK, and we pinpoint the move at which the previously published optimal line fails. Unlike earlier solutions of empty Go boards, we release the solver source together with the command line and outcome of every run behind our values and measurements, so that all reported values can be reproduced.

AI.tldr: 提出并行深度优先的证明数求解器 Sanko，在位置超级劫（PSK）规则下健全地恢复置换表、静态死活识别与安全着法剪枝，16分钟解出5x5围棋，并首次给出23个棋盘PSK值。
AI.motivation: 位置超级劫禁止重现任何历史全局局面，是书面中国规则及计算机围棋常用规则，但几乎所有已解围棋棋盘都在更简单的基本劫规则下计算。PSK使合法性依赖全局历史，破坏置换表（图-历史交互问题）、静态死活识别与安全着法剪枝这三大使求解可行的工具，因此求解困难。
AI.method: Sanko为并行深度优先证明数（PN）求解器。核心是一个廉价的证明迁移定理：除非证明获胜方必须构造的某个局面已在当前路径上出现过，否则已存储的证明在新路径上依然有效。据此在PSK下健全地恢复置换表、静态死活识别与安全剪枝。
AI.result: 六线程16分钟证明5x5围棋（此前最优需六进程5.25小时），单台192线程机器约1.5分钟；另取得23个棋盘的首次PSK值，其中11个在任何规则下均未解。超级劫改变博弈论值：4x7在基本劫下为全盘胜，PSK下仅值12点，并定位了已发表最优着法序列首次失效的具体着法。
AI.conclusion: PSK可在不牺牲健全性的前提下高效求解，显著加速并扩展可解棋盘范围，同时改变棋局理论值与既有最优解。作者开源求解器及每次运行的命令行与结果，保证所有报告值可复现。

title: Local and Sparse Kernel Operator Learning for Incompressible Flows: An Operator Lagrange Formulation
