summary: We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows. It builds on our earlier property-preserving kernel method, whose global output reconstruction and dense operator regression scale poorly. Our method replaces the global output reconstruction by local divergence-free interpolants with divergence-free polynomials of any degree, solved in parallel on the GPU. These interpolants are divergence free, periodic on periodic domains, and, with a multiscale kernel, approach Kolmogorov statistics under refinement. A compactly supported kernel, positive semidefinite in any input dimension, makes the operator regression sparse. Its support radius, and hence the sparsity, is fitted to data, and optional affine polynomials in the input capture global trends. Operator Lagrange weights join the two. They cost one sparse solve per new input and act on the training fields before the output reconstruction, so their local coefficients are never formed. We show that, unlike direct evaluation, Lagrange evaluation does not amplify solve errors by the cancellation among spatial coefficients. On ten fluid benchmarks, validation selects sparse matrices nearly everywhere, with densities that mostly decrease as the training set grows, and affine augmentation lowers the error by more than an order of magnitude for forced isotropic turbulence. These sparse models are at least as accurate as our earlier dense method and more accurate than neural operators. Lagrange evaluation is as accurate as direct evaluation with local output reconstructions, and up to nearly three orders of magnitude more accurate with global ones. We also present GPU timings and storage.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种局部稀疏核方法，用于学习不可压缩流动的解算子，通过局部无散插值、拟合稀疏半径的紧支撑核与算子Lagrange权重，实现GPU并行、性质保持且精度优于神经算子与作者此前的稠密核方法。
AI.motivation: 作者此前的保性质核方法存在两处可扩展性瓶颈：全局的输出重构和稠密的算子回归在大规模问题上代价过高。
AI.method: 用任意次数的无散多项式构造局部无散插值替代全局输出重构，并在GPU上并行求解；插值保持无散性与周期域周期性，配合多尺度核可逼近Kolmogorov统计。回归端采用在任意输入维数下半正定的紧支撑核使算子回归稀疏，支撑半径（即稀疏度）由数据拟合确定，并可选用输入仿射多项式捕捉全局趋势，二者通过算子Lagrange权重耦合。Lagrange权重对新输入只需一次稀疏求解，并作用于训练场之后再做输出重构，因此不显式形成局部系数。
AI.result: 理论上证明Lagrange求值不像直接求值那样因空间系数间相消而放大求解误差。在10个流体基准上，验证选择几乎处处稀疏的矩阵，密度大体随训练集增大而下降；仿射增广在强迫各向同性湍流上使误差降低一个数量级以上。模型精度不低于此前稠密方法且优于神经算子；Lagrange求值在使用局部输出重构时与直接求值精度相当，在使用全局重构时精度可高出近三个数量级。文中还给出GPU计时与存储开销。
AI.conclusion: 局部稀疏核方法在保持无散、周期等流动性质的同时解决了原稠密框架的可扩展性问题，兼具稀疏性、高精度与GPU高效性，是可替代神经算子的有竞争力方案。

title: A KAN-based Non-linear Factorization for Embedding Layer Compression
comment: 18th International Conference on Statistical Analysis of Textual Data (JADT 2026)
summary:
Among existing embedding compression approaches, low-rank factorization provides a simple and mathematically principled solution by approximating the embedding matrix with a reduced-rank decomposition. However, its practical effectiveness is often limited, as the resulting linear bottleneck constrains representational capacity. To overcome these limitations, we propose an enhanced factorization scheme that increases expressive power by introducing learnable non-linear projections within the compressed embedding layer. Our method is inspired by the Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (KAN) paradigm, which replaces fixed linear transformations with learnable univariate functions. Despite promising results in other domains, applications of KANs in NLP remain scarce and have so far been largely limited to final or task specific layers, rather than core representational components such as embedding layers.
  We evaluate the proposed approach by integrating the compressed embedding layer into the Skip-gram framework and comparing it against a standard low-rank baseline under matched parameter budgets on the Word Analogy and Semantic Similarity benchmarks. We further introduce an effective initialization strategy from a pre-trained, uncompressed embedding layer. The behavior of the model is analyzed both immediately after initialization and after a brief post-initialization refinement phase, considering training with the standard Skip-gram objective as well as variants augmented with distillation from the original embedding layer. Overall, our results show that augmenting low-rank factorization with learnable non-linear projections effectively mitigates the limitations of linear bottlenecks, yielding more faithful compressed embeddings under fixed dimensionality and suggesting a promising direction for embedding layer compression beyond purely linear methods.

AI.tldr: 在低秩分解压缩嵌入层中引入受KAN启发的可学习非线性单变量投影，以缓解线性瓶颈的表达力限制；在Skip-gram框架下配合预训练嵌入初始化，于固定参数预算下取得优于线性低秩基线的压缩嵌入质量。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入压缩方法中，低秩分解虽简洁且有数学依据，但其线性瓶颈严重限制表示能力，导致实际压缩效果不佳。同时KAN类方法在NLP中应用稀少，且多限于末端或任务特定层，尚未用于嵌入层这类核心表示组件。
AI.method: 提出增强分解方案：在压缩嵌入层内部引入可学习非线性投影，以Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks思想用可学习单变量函数替代固定线性变换。将压缩嵌入层集成进Skip-gram框架，在参数预算匹配条件下与标准低秩基线对比；并提出从预训练未压缩嵌入层进行初始化的策略，在Word Analogy与Semantic Similarity基准上，分别在初始化后即时状态和短程后初始化精调阶段进行评估，涵盖标准Skip-gram目标及加入原始嵌入层蒸馏的变体。
AI.result: 在固定维度与匹配参数预算下，非线性投影增强的低秩分解优于线性低秩基线，压缩嵌入更忠实于原始嵌入；蒸馏变体与初始化策略进一步改善行为。
AI.conclusion: 用可学习非线性投影增强低秩分解可有效缓解线性瓶颈的局限，为超越纯线性方法的嵌入层压缩提供了有前景的方向。

title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

AI.tldr: 提出Think-Capture：先由查询定位任务关键物体、再按需获取几何的query-conditioned框架，借助3D工具包与符号化3D状态抽象，并用分层GRPO训练VLM判断何时依赖工具几何、何时回退到视觉线索。
AI.motivation: VLM在2D识别上表现优异，但在稀疏视角下难以保持一致的3D空间关系，遮挡与视角变化时易产生空间幻觉。现有方法通常对全部帧做稠密几何融合，计算与上下文开销大，且使模型盲目依赖并不完美的几何估计器。
AI.method: 1) 查询条件化：先识别任务关键物体，再按需获取其几何；2) 3D工具包将零样本分割掩码提升到统一坐标系；3) Symbolic 3D State Abstraction将物体与相机状态压缩为结构化文本；4) 分层GRPO在几何"有帮助"与"误导"的样本上训练VLM，学习何时使用工具证据、何时回退视觉线索。
AI.result: Think-Capture-4B在MindCube-Tiny达54.4%（较骨干+21.5）、MMSI-Bench位置子集39.1%（+7.9）、ViewSpatial 42.8%（+5.2）；在坐标与掩码扰动下保持鲁棒；完整系统可装入单张24 GB GPU，并作为Agibot G1上的异步高层推理器运行。
AI.conclusion: 按需几何获取＋符号化状态抽象＋分层GRPO的策略选择训练，可在低算力开销下显著缓解VLM的3D空间幻觉，并具备扰动鲁棒性与真实机器人平台部署可行性。

title: MERP: A Latent-Bottleneck Framework for Robust Multi-Modal Multi-Label Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal multi-label emotion recognition is important for affect-aware systems, but models trained with complete text, visual, and acoustic streams often degrade sharply when some streams are unavailable at deployment. We address this train-test gap by learning a compact representation that preserves emotion-specific evidence from any available subset of modalities. We propose the Multi-modal Emotion Recognition Perceiver (MERP), which maps the joint sequence into a fixed-size latent bank, thereby keeping repeated reasoning independent of raw input length; it extracts label-specific evidence before and after latent reasoning and aligns the two levels through reconstruction. MERP further uses positive and negative class prototypes, a noise-gated feature enhancer with frequency-shaped perturbations during training, and confidence-aware class-wise fusion to strengthen separability, reduce sensitivity to missing inputs, and combine complementary predictors. Under 20 percent test-time random modality drop, MERP achieves micro-F1 scores of 0.563 on CMU-MOSEI and 0.780 on M3ED, exceeding the strongest evaluated baselines by 0.004 and 0.005, respectively; in the severe CMU-MOSEI audio-only setting, it retains 0.473 micro-F1 versus 0.022 for LDDU. These results show that fixed latent reasoning provides a practical, testable route to robust multimodal emotion recognition without requiring missing-modality examples during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Creative-zcx/MERP.

AI.tldr: 提出MERP（多模态情感识别Perceiver），将联合序列映射到固定大小潜变量库，使推理独立于原始输入长度，在任意可用模态子集下保持情感证据，应对测试时模态缺失。
AI.motivation: 多模态多标签情感识别中，模型用完整文本、视觉、声学流训练，但部署时部分模态缺失会导致性能急剧下降，需解决训练-测试间的模态可用性差距。
AI.method: MERP将联合序列映射为固定尺寸潜变量库；在潜变量推理前后提取标签特定证据并通过重构对齐两个层次；引入正负类原型、带频域扰动且噪声门控的特征增强器，以及置信度感知的类级融合。
AI.result: 20%测试时随机模态丢弃下，CMU-MOSEI微F1为0.563、M3ED为0.780，分别超最强基线0.004和0.005；CMU-MOSEI仅音频严苛设置下保持0.473微F1（LDDU为0.022）。
AI.conclusion: 固定潜变量推理为鲁棒多模态情感识别提供了实用且可验证的路径，且训练时无需缺失模态样本。

title: Dissimilarity-Based Markov Decision Processes for Stabilizing State Distributions
comment: 44 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables. Xun Shen, Yuepeng Wang, and Daniyal Sajedi-Hosseini contributed equally. Under review at TMLR
summary: Reinforcement learning for stochastic systems typically optimizes expected cumulative rewards, while reliable and repeatable behavior also depends on how the state distribution evolves over time. Optimizing expected return alone does not guarantee that this distribution converges to a desired target or remains stable. This paper develops a theoretical framework for learning policies that stabilize state distributions. We formulate the problem as a Dissimilarity-based Markov Decision Process (DMDP), in which the policy acts on the current state distribution and the objective measures its dissimilarity to a target distribution. We establish sufficient conditions under which the optimal policy makes the target distribution asymptotically stable. To support policy learning, we introduce a finite-dimensional representation of distributions and show how stability guarantees for its parameter dynamics extend to the underlying state distributions. We further develop certificates for the learned policies, including their deployment using estimated distribution parameters. These results quantify how learning and estimation errors affect the guarantees and identify conditions under which learned policies retain asymptotic stability. For practical implementation, we combine distribution estimates and target-dependent rewards with PPO and SAC. A computable example on a linear system illustrates the proposed theoretical certificates. Furthermore, experiments on a HalfCheetah task demonstrate the benefits of distribution feedback and explicit target matching for regulating the velocity distribution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Dissimilarity-based MDP (DMDP) 框架，学习使状态分布收敛并稳定到目标分布的策略，并给出稳定性充分条件、有限维表示与策略证书，最后用 PPO/SAC 在 HalfCheetah 上验证。
AI.motivation: 标准 RL 仅优化期望累积回报，无法保证状态分布在时间上的收敛性或稳定性；可靠、可重复的行为需要状态分布趋向并保持于目标分布。
AI.method: 将问题建模为以当前状态分布为策略作用对象、以与目标分布的相异性为目标的 DMDP；建立使目标分布渐近稳定的最优策略充分条件；引入分布的有限维参数表示，将参数动态的稳定性保证扩展到真实状态分布；推导学习与估计误差下的策略证书（含用估计分布参数部署的情形）；实践中结合分布估计与目标相关奖励，嵌入 PPO 与 SAC。
AI.result: 给出学习/估计误差对保证的定量影响及保持渐近稳定的条件；在线性系统上给出可计算的证书示例；HalfCheetah 实验表明分布反馈与显式目标匹配有助于调节速度分布。
AI.conclusion: 以分布相异性为目标的学习框架可在理论条件与误差界下提供状态分布稳定性的可验证保证，并在连续控制任务中体现分布反馈的实际收益。

title: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. A dynamic verifier revises only the evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur and retains all other checks. Using DynaWeave, we collect 2,095 verified interaction trajectories across 36 environments and use them for supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models. Experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show that DynaWeave achieves consistent improvements in overall performance across all three evaluated model sizes, increasing the task completion rate on CostBench by 67.34 percentage points and even exceeding the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview on ToolMaze. These results support dynamic scenario synthesis as a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave.

AI.tldr: 提出DynaWeave框架，将静态任务自动合成为可验证的动态场景（引入外生事件），并据此构建2,095条轨迹对Qwen3.5进行SFT，在Gaia2、CostBench、ToolMaze上一致提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的训练环境除智能体自身动作外基本静态，而真实环境中的外部事件（其他用户、服务或突发状况）会使进行中的计划失效，导致智能体缺乏应对动态变化的能力。
AI.method: DynaWeave自动化合成框架：为每个任务生成相关的外生事件，涵盖任务需求变化、环境状态变化与外部信息变化；用有向无环图（DAG）建模事件间依赖，并由执行引擎在智能体交互过程中激活事件；动态验证器仅修改受实际发生事件影响的评估检查项，其余检查保持不变。
AI.result: 在36个环境中收集2,095条经验证的交互轨迹用于Qwen3.5监督微调；在Gaia2、CostBench、ToolMaze三个基准上，三个模型规模均取得一致的总体性能提升，CostBench任务完成率提升67.34个百分点，ToolMaze上甚至超过Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview。
AI.conclusion: 动态场景合成是训练智能体适应变化环境的可行且有效途径。

title: Encoded but Unused: Bounding the Sources of VLM Errors
summary: In this paper, we investigate why vision-language models (VLMs) produce errors by decomposing them into two sources: visual-representation failures, in which the visual evidence required for the correct answer is not encoded, and visual-utilization failures, in which this evidence is encoded but not successfully used. We propose to estimate the visual-utilization failure rate using lightweight probes and derive theoretical bounds on the true rate that account for probe imperfections. We introduce VELens (Visual Evidence Lens), a rank-based probe that traces visual evidence for both a target object and its ground-truth attribute, such as color, material, or shape, across VLM layers. We evaluate VELens on over 6,000 images using LLaVA-1.6-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Our method achieves ROC-AUC scores of 0.95 and 0.91, respectively, and outperforms alternative probes in both low-resource and unseen-attribute settings. Using it to diagnose errors, we estimate that visual-utilization failures account for 84.4% of LLaVA errors and 70.0% of Qwen errors, with conservative lower bounds of 77.5% and 61.0%, respectively. Overall, our study identifies visual utilization as the dominant bottleneck in VLMs and suggests that a central opportunity for improvement lies in developing better mechanisms to locate, route, and use the visual information they already encode.

AI.tldr: 论文将VLM错误分解为"视觉表征失败"与"视觉利用失败"，用轻量探针VELens估计并给出考虑探针缺陷的理论下界，发现视觉利用失败是主要瓶颈（LLaVA占84.4%，Qwen占70.0%）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多笼统讨论VLM的错误，却未区分错误究竟源于视觉信息未被编码，还是已被编码但未被有效利用，导致改进方向不明。作者希望量化这两类失败的相对贡献。
AI.method: 提出VELens（Visual Evidence Lens）：一种基于排名的轻量探针，同时追踪目标物体及其真值属性（颜色、材质、形状）的视觉证据在VLM各层的分布；用探针估计视觉利用失败率，并推导考虑探针不完美性的真实失败率理论界；在6000+图像上评估LLaVA-1.6-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-7B，覆盖低资源与未见属性设定。
AI.result: VELens在LLaVA-1.6-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-7B上ROC-AUC分别达0.95和0.91，在低资源与未见属性设定下均优于对比探针。诊断显示视觉利用失败占LLaVA错误的84.4%（保守下界77.5%）、占Qwen错误的70.0%（保守下界61.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 视觉利用而非视觉表征是VLM的主导瓶颈；提升方向在于开发更好的机制来定位、路由并使用模型已编码的视觉信息。

title: Events, Not Pixels: Where World Models Get the Return Wrong
summary: World models are increasingly used for planning, where a planner ranks candidate actions by returns imagined by the model. However, these models are judged mainly by how well they render frames, even though a visually faithful rollout can still assign the wrong return. To identify where this mismatch arises, we introduce a transition-level diagnostic that replaces imagined transitions with real ones and measures the reduction in return error against a budget-matched random control. Our analysis yields two findings. (1) Event transitions, the few steps where a reward is earned or an episode ends, are rendered as well as other steps (median pixel-error ratio 0.85), yet restoring them removes a median of 70% of the return error. In contrast, restoring transitions with the largest MSE, SSIM or LPIPS error removes less than a random choice. Across the 44 Atari-100k model--collection pairs that pass our reliability checks, including three released families, event patches outperform random patches in 39 (sign test p=1.4 x 10^{-7}), with a median gain of +44 percentage points. (2) The remaining error is structured: a complementary patch separates errors at true events from those elsewhere, while an eight-step timing tolerance recovers few events missed by our deterministic models. This structure also guides repair: a rule recorded before four repair outcomes were known predicts when a diffusion model repairs these failures. Event patches improve plan ranking, and the same concentration appears on control tasks with rare reward events.

AI.tldr: 论文提出过渡级诊断方法，发现世界模型的回报误差高度集中在"事件过渡"（获得奖励或回合结束的少数步），而非视觉重建质量最差的步；以事件补丁替换随机补丁可中位挽回约70%回报误差，并可用于修复模型与改进规划排序。
AI.motivation: 世界模型常用于规划，规划器依据模型"想象"的回报对候选动作排序；但模型评估主要看渲染帧的质量，而视觉忠实的rollout仍可能给出错误回报，二者存在错配。论文旨在定位这种错配发生在哪些过渡步上。
AI.method: 提出过渡级诊断：将想象的过渡替换为真实过渡，量化回报误差的下降量，并与预算匹配的随机对照比较。分两部分分析：(1) 比较"事件过渡"（获得奖励或回合结束的步）与其他步的像素误差，并对比以最大MSE/SSIM/LPIPS误差选出的过渡；(2) 用互补补丁区分真事件处与别处的误差，采用八步时间容差检验漏检事件，并在四个修复结果已知之前记录的规则上预测扩散模型修复效果。实验覆盖44个通过可靠性检查的Atari-100k模型–数据集对，含三个已发布模型族。
AI.result: 事件过渡的渲染质量与其他步相当（像素误差比中位0.85），但恢复这些过渡可消除中位70%的回报误差；而恢复MSE、SSIM或LPIPS误差最大的过渡，效果不如随机选择。44个模型–数据集对中39个上事件补丁优于随机补丁（符号检验 p=1.4×10⁻⁷），中位增益+44个百分点。剩余误差具有结构性：互补补丁能分离真事件处与别处误差，八步时间容差可找回少量被确定性模型漏检的事件；预先记录的规则可预测扩散模型何时能修复此类失败。事件补丁还能改善规划排序，且该集中现象在奖励事件稀疏的对照任务上同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 视觉保真度不能代表回报保真度，回报误差集中于少数事件过渡步；基于事件过渡的诊断既能揭示误差结构，又能指导模型修复与规划排序改进，并可推广到其他奖励稀疏的任务。

title: Better Policies, Worse Verifier Audits
summary: Verifier stacks increasingly sit inside post-training and test-time compute loops. We study a specific control loop: a component verifier is evaluated on fresh policy outputs against the full success label and refreshed when that aggregate score falls. For a conjunctive target $y = F \wedge M$, its on-policy AUC is $(1-q)A_{\mathrm{own}} + qA_{\mathrm{cross}}$, where $q = \Pr[F=1 \mid y=0]$. As the policy masters $F$, $q$ can rise toward one, removing weight from $F$-failures and rewarding information about $M$. We call this on-policy audit collapse. We derive a sharp identified set, a complete-erasure threshold, and the exact point at which the audit can prefer a worse component verifier; its population optimum is the full-outcome predictor, not the component oracle. An exact oracle exhibits the collapse, a natural multi-label text control shows inversion can select a head with lower canonical $F$-AUC at the observed failure mixture, and a prediction-registered ECG study shows that acting on the audit can reduce off-policy $F$-AUC, transfer the damage to an unseen generator, and increase downstream constraint violations. Preserving own-failure support prevents the damage. Matching label-complexity bounds and a controlled-mixture audit give the corresponding repair: audit the component on its own failures, and keep those failures in the refresh distribution.

AI.tldr: 研究验证器"on-policy审计崩溃"：当策略在合取目标的一个子任务F上进步时，在线聚合分数会错误地奖励F失败样本的判别信息，导致刷新出更差的组件验证器。
AI.motivation: 验证器正被嵌入后训练与测试时计算回路中，按新策略输出上的聚合成功率来评估和刷新组件验证器。作者想说明这种控制回路在合取目标y=F∧M下存在系统性失效。
AI.method: 对合取目标建立解析理论：给出on-policy AUC分解(1-q)A_own+qA_cross，q=Pr[F=1|y=0]；推导锐利的可识别集、完全擦除阈值以及审计恰好偏好更差组件验证器的临界点。再用精确oracle模型、多标签文本对照实验和预测注册的心电图(ECG)研究验证。
AI.result: 理论证明审计的总体最优是全体结果预测器而非组件oracle。实验显示：精确oracle出现崩溃；多标签文本中反演会选出在观测失败混合下规范F-AUC更低的头；ECG研究中依据审计行动会降低off-policy F-AUC、把损害迁移到未见的生成器，并增加下游约束违反。保留own-failure支撑可防止损害。
AI.conclusion: 应对组件验证器在其自身失败样本上审计，并将这些失败样本保留在刷新分布中；这给出与标签复杂度界及受控混合审计一致的修复方案。

title: Omnilingual-MsASR: Benchmarking Multimodal, Multilingual, Long-Form Multi-Speaker ASR of Omni Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio and video understanding. However, existing models struggle with long-form, multi-speaker videos, especially in understanding the entire video and recognizing who says what and when. To characterize the capability limit of current omni LLMs and guide future model development, we introduce Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form Multi-speaker Automatic Speech Recognition (MsASR) covering six languages, recordings up to 30 minutes, and scenarios with up to 20 speakers. Omnilingual-MsASR provides parallel audio and video inputs to evaluate models' cross-modal consistency and their ability to exploit complementary cues across modalities. Extensive evaluations of leading omni-modal LLMs reveal substantial performance bottlenecks, while their tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%. These findings highlight fine-grained temporal localization, speaker disambiguation, and cross-modal synergy as key challenges for future omni-modal foundation models. Our work is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-MSpeaker.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Omnilingual-MsASR，一个面向长时、多说话人视频的多语言多模态基准，覆盖6种语言、最长30分钟录音、最多20位说话人，通过并行音视频输入评估全模态大模型的跨模态一致性与互补线索利用能力，评测显示现有模型存在明显瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在音视频理解上进展显著，但在长时、多说话人视频中仍难以完成"谁在何时说了什么"的整段理解；为刻画当前全模态模型的能力上限并指导后续模型开发，需要专门的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Omnilingual-MsASR基准，面向长时多说话人自动语音识别（MsASR），包含6种语言、最长30分钟录音、最多20名说话人的场景；同时提供对齐的音频与视频输入，以评测模型的跨模态一致性及其利用跨模态互补线索的能力；并对主流全模态大模型进行广泛评测，采用tcpWER等指标度量。
AI.result: 对领先全模态大模型的评测揭示出显著性能瓶颈，其tcpWER常超过100%，表明模型在长时多说话人场景下识别与说话人归属能力严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度时间定位、说话人消歧与跨模态协同是未来全模态基础模型的关键挑战；该基准可作为诊断与推动模型发展的工具。

title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
summary: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了7个可本地部署的视觉语言模型（VLM）在人体中心热成像数据上的表现，发现模型能识别粗粒度活动类别，但在细粒度动作、事件时间线重建、拒答（abstention）及物体幻觉方面存在显著缺陷，简单的热输入预处理与推理增强收益有限。
AI.motivation: 热成像相机可在黑暗中感知人类活动，且相比RGB相机泄露的可识别外貌信息与环境细节更少，适合低光与隐私敏感场景。随着为RGB图像开发的VLM被集成到具身系统用于场景理解与高层规划，热传感有望将活动感知拓展到此类场景；然而VLM在热成像人体活动理解及人机交互中的失效模式尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上评估7个可本地部署的VLM（含面向物理AI与机器人的模型）。设计三类诊断任务：细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建、对无依据答案的拒答能力。以配对RGB录制作为性能参照；并通过控制变量（帧采样、热输入呈现方式、推理过程）检验误差是否可被缓解。
AI.result: 模型能识别宽泛的活动类别，但对咳嗽、打喷嚏、打哈欠等细粒度动作识别困难；事件时间线生成不准确，并会幻觉出涉及物体的动作；简单的热输入预处理与额外推理仅带来有限且依赖具体模型的增益；即便给出明确指令，各模型的拒答行为差异较大。
AI.conclusion: VLM在热成像人体活动理解上存在系统性失效模式，其拒答行为不稳定限制了实际机器人应用中的可靠性；热传感用于HRI的VLM部署仍需更强的细粒度感知、时序理解与校准能力。

title: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
summary: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and PersonaMem-v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem.

AI.tldr: 提出PreCoMem，一种受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架，将记忆表示为对用户状态的置信度加权信念，用Effective Surprisal信号驱动三阈值门控的MAINTAIN/PROFILE/CORRECT更新，在多个长程对话基准上取得SOTA并有效区分真实信念漂移与瞬时噪声。
AI.motivation: 长程对话代理需在保持用户记忆稳定以支持个性化的同时适应用户真实变化。现有记忆系统要么追加每条观测、要么用启发式规则覆盖旧条目，导致瞬时噪声与真实信念漂移难以区分。
AI.method: 受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架PreCoMem：记忆表示为关于用户状态的置信度加权信念；核心信号Effective Surprisal结合语义偏离与矛盾证据，并在检索弥散、不可靠时对其降权；基于该信号的双阈值门控将每轮对话映射为三种确定性更新之一——MAINTAIN强化被支持的信念，PROFILE将模糊线索存为低置信度假设，CORRECT对可靠被反驳的事实进行软衰减；PROFILE阶段充当显式"等待室"，避免对噪声证据过早承诺。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S和PersonaMem-v2上取得一致的SOTA准确率；新构建的DiMoBench验证PreCoMem能适应非平稳信念漂移且不对噪声过度反应。
AI.conclusion: 置信度加权信念+有效惊奇度门控的巩固机制可有效平衡记忆稳定性与适应性，代码已开源。

title: Gate Initialisation versus Recurrent Dropout and Zoneout in Learning Long Dependencies: A Controlled Study of LSTM and GRU Networks on Synthetic Tasks
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SyntaxSpirits/rnn-gradient-reach and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23285386
summary: Dropout and zoneout are routinely added to long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks, but, to our knowledge, their placements have not been crossed with gate initialisation in a factorial design, and it is not known whether early gradient propagation tells which runs will learn long dependencies. We trained one-layer LSTMs and GRUs on the adding problem and on delayed recall in a factorial grid of 720 runs, crossing conventional and chrono gate initialisation with up to six recurrent regulariser placements at one rate each, with pre-specified follow-ups, and recorded how sensitive the final hidden state was to the input at every lag. Because both tasks supply fresh or exhaustive training data, the study measures the regularisers' effects on optimisation and does not assess generalisation from a finite training set. At lengths chosen to make conventional initialisation difficult, all 360 chrono-initialised runs reached the validation criterion within 5000 updates, as did 119 of 120 unregularised runs with a horizon about four times too short or too long, whereas conventionally initialised networks learned slowly or did not reach the criterion within the budget at the longer lengths. Under conventional initialisation, dropout generally delayed learning and zoneout helped only in some conditions. The early input sensitivity added little to predicting which conditions learn once the early validation loss was modelled per task, architecture and initialisation. Within conditions, a flatter early decay went with the seeds that learned, but in a pre-specified test the association was modest (concordance 0.61), condition-dependent and not robust to resampling seeds. The results support chrono initialisation, even with a rough horizon, on such tasks.

AI.tldr: 该文用720组因子化实验，交叉门初始化、dropout/zoneout位置与速率，在adding problem和delayed recall上考察LSTM/GRU长程依赖学习，并检验早期梯度敏感度能否预测学习成败。
AI.motivation: dropout与zoneout在LSTM/GRU中常被使用，但其位置与门初始化（传统 vs. chrono）从未以因子设计交叉检验；同时不清楚早期梯度传播信息能否预先判断哪些设置最终能学到长程依赖。
AI.method: 在一层LSTM与GRU上，于adding problem和delayed recall任务构建720次运行的因子网格：交叉2种门初始化（传统、chrono）与最多6种循环正则化放置（各单一速率），并设预先规定的后续实验；在每个滞后处记录最终隐状态对输入的敏感度；任务提供新鲜或穷尽训练数据，故只评估正则化对优化的影响，不评估有限训练集上的泛化。
AI.result: 在使传统初始化困难的序列长度下，全部360个chrono初始化运行均在5000次更新内达到验证标准；horizon约短/长约四倍时，120个无正则化运行中有119个达标；传统初始化在较长长度下学习缓慢或超预算失败。传统初始化下dropout普遍延迟学习，zoneout仅在部分条件下有益。按任务、结构和初始化建模早期验证损失后，早期输入敏感度对预测学习成败的增益很小；条件内更平缓的早期衰减与能学习的种子相关，但预先设定的检验中该关联较弱（一致性0.61）、依赖条件且对种子重采样不稳健。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在此类任务上采用chrono初始化，即使horizon估计较粗糙也有效；早期输入敏感度不宜作为稳健的学习成败预测指标。

title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniSimulator 训练框架，通过五维行为导向推理 schema、真实用户行为数据筛选与教师模型蒸馏推理轨迹，提升小 LLM 在短视频平台场景中的用户模拟预测能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为交互系统的通用用户模拟器潜力巨大，但用户模拟性能上限受制于模型推理范式：原生思维链易退化为浅层模式匹配，无法充分建模真实用户决策背后的行为因素。
AI.method: 构建五维度结构化 schema 组织行为导向推理；从真实用户行为场景中精选数据；引入教师模型按该 schema 生成高质量推理轨迹，使小模型学习与行为相关的推理模式而非表层行为相关性。基于 200 名真实用户三个月历史交互轨迹，构建 9,881 条高质量训练实例，人均约 50 条蒸馏样本。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B 平均分提升 34.33%，性能与 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 具有竞争力，并支持更小规模的自托管部署。
AI.conclusion: 学习结构化的行为导向推理模式是通向可扩展、高保真 LLM 用户模拟的有前景方向。

title: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution
summary: One-step generative models enable fast text-guided image editing, yet they often introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain unchanged. Temporal aggregation stabilizes editing fields across noise levels, but leaves their spatial allocation insensitive to local variations in reliability. Consequently, temporal stability alone does not ensure spatially consistent editing. To address this lim- itation, we propose ER-Chord, a training-free and inversion-free framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution. Our key insight is that agreement between editing fields at neighboring noise levels provides a local reliability signal for allocating editing strength. We formulate this allocation as an equal-energy op- timization that redistributes control energy according to local reliability while preserving the original editing directions and total control energy. This formu- lation admits a unique global solution that can be efficiently computed using existing field evaluations, requiring no additional denoiser calls. Experiments on two benchmarks, PIE-Bench and TEdBench, demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art one-step editing baselines, achieving superior source preservation alongside consistent gains across multiple generative backbones.The project page is at https://github.com/Peizeli1/ER-Chord.

AI.tldr: 提出ER-Chord：一种免训练、免反演的一步生成图像编辑框架，利用相邻噪声级编辑场之间的一致性作为局部可靠性信号，通过等能量优化将控制能量按可靠性空间重分配，在保持编辑方向与总能量的同时显著提升源图像保真度。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型虽能快速进行文本引导图像编辑，但常对不应改变的区域产生非预期修改。现有的时间聚合方法仅在各噪声级上稳定编辑场，却使空间分配对局部可靠性变化不敏感，因此时间稳定性本身不足以保证空间一致的编辑效果。
AI.method: 核心洞见是相邻噪声级的编辑场之间的一致性可提供局部可靠性信号，用以分配编辑强度。作者将该分配表述为等能量优化问题：在保持原始编辑方向和总控制能量的前提下，按局部可靠性重分配控制能量；该问题具有唯一全局解，可基于已有场评估高效求解，无需额外去噪器调用。整个框架免训练、免反演。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench与TEdBench两个基准上，相比最先进的一步编辑基线，方法在源图像保持方面更优，并在多种生成骨干网络上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠时间聚合不足以保证空间一致性；引入基于邻级一致性的局部可靠性信号并进行等能量重分配，是一种无需训练与反演、计算开销低的通用改进方案，且可跨骨干网络迁移。

title: RubricOpt: Self-Revision of Semantic Rubrics for Preference Optimization
summary: A model's failures can reveal gaps in the behavioral criteria guiding its training. We introduce RubricOpt, a framework that lets a policy revise these criteria within preference optimization. The policy diagnoses its own rubric-free outputs, retains requirements already covered by the rubric, and edits clauses that leave recurring failures unaddressed. A shared semantic representation connects task demands, preference-data contrasts, and rubric clauses, while a deterministic gate checks evidence references and fixed semantic anchors. The rubric then guides Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) during training, with preference pairs, labels, and the objective held fixed, and is removed at evaluation. Our analysis relates the local effect on rubric-free success to semantic alignment and a residual beyond the measured factors. Experiments on capability and open-ended generation benchmarks show that rubric conditioning can improve outcomes over ordinary DPO, with gains and regressions varying across models and datasets. A matched continuation isolates the contribution of revision from additional training and finds mixed incremental effects for the tested edit, whose feedback overlaps the evaluation set. RubricOpt thus brings the behavioral specification itself into the policy's feedback loop.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubricOpt 框架，让策略在偏好优化过程中依据自身失败诊断来修订行为准则（rubric），并仅在训练期用其条件化 DPO、评估时移除。
AI.motivation: 模型失败可暴露其训练所依据行为准则的缺口，但准则通常由外部固定，未进入策略自身的反馈回路。作者希望把"行为规范本身"变成可被策略修订的对象。
AI.method: 策略先对无 rubric 输出做自诊断，保留已被覆盖的要求，改写仍未被解决的条款；用共享语义表示连接任务需求、偏好数据对比与 rubric 条款，并用确定性门控校验证据引用与固定语义锚点。修订后的 rubric 在训练中条件化 DPO，偏好对、标签与目标函数保持不变，评估时移除 rubric。另设匹配续训对照，以区分"修订"与"额外训练"的贡献。
AI.result: 能力类与开放式生成基准上，rubric 条件化可优于普通 DPO，但增益与回退随模型和数据集而异；匹配续训对照显示该编辑的增量效果混合，且其反馈与评估集存在重叠。理论分析将 rubric 对无 rubric 成功率的局部效应分解为语义对齐项与超出被测因素的残差项。
AI.conclusion: RubricOpt 将行为规范纳入策略的反馈闭环，但收益不稳定、且存在反馈与评测重叠的混淆风险，说明"自修订准则"是可行但尚未稳健的方向。

title: ART-MPG: Autoregressive R/T Manifold Path Guiding
summary: Specular chains concentrate important transport in small regions of path space and the structure depends on chain topology. We introduce ART-MPG, a compact neural model that samples chain length, an autoregressive reflection/transmission (R/T) string, and a direction from a topology-conditioned four-component von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mixture. We extend the repeated trial weighting in Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) by conditioning retry sampling on both chain length and the sampled R/T string, accounting for its known mass outside the stochastic re-hit trials. For a fixed proposal and target chain, this preserves the ideal expectation while reducing the expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance compared with retries conditioned on chain length alone. We distinguish the formal unbiasedness result from the capped and clamped renderer used in experiments. We evaluate fourteen scenes across a range of samples per pixel (SPP) against existing online and offline rendering algorithms. Our method consistently produces lower mean squared error at equal SPP than the online and offline baselines, with lower standard deviation across runs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ART-MPG，一种拓扑条件化的紧凑神经模型，采样链长、自回归 R/T 字符串与 vMF 方向混合，并改进 MPG 的重试加权，在 14 个场景等 SPP 下 MSE 更低、方差更小。
AI.motivation: 镜面链（specular chains）将重要传输集中在路径空间的狭小区域，且其结构依赖链的拓扑；需要兼顾链长与反射/透射序列的拓扑结构来高效引导采样。
AI.method: ART-MPG：紧凑神经模型，依次采样链长、自回归生成的反射/透射（R/T）字符串，以及由拓扑条件化的四分量 von Mises-Fisher 混合分布采样的方向。同时扩展 Manifold Path Guiding 中的重复试验加权：重试采样同时以链长和已采样的 R/T 字符串为条件，并计入随机重命中试验之外已知的质量。
AI.result: 对固定 proposal 与 target 链，在保持理想期望的前提下，相比仅以链长条件化的重试，降低期望重试次数与倒数估计器方差；实验中正式无偏性结论与所用的截断/夹紧渲染器被明确区分。在 14 个场景、多种 SPP 下，等 SPP 时 MSE 持续低于在线与离线基线，且跨运行标准差更小。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑条件化的神经引导与更强的重试加权可有效降低镜面链渲染的误差与方差，优于现有在线与离线方法。

title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
comment: Preprint under review. 39 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables; Online Resource 1 appended (9 pages). Dataset and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22678484
summary: Codes of professional ethics guide and restrict specialists, who increasingly work with assistants built on large language models. Such an assistant can breach the user's code, or help the user breach it, without the user noticing. Evaluations reporting broad categories of harm cannot show how often this happens or which provision is breached. TenetBench pairs 3,433 requests conflicting with clauses of fifteen Russian-language professional codes with benign twins that differ only in the legitimacy of what is asked. An automated pipeline generates the tasks from the text of a code, so the corpus grows with every code added and a provision yields new tasks on every run. It also produced tasks and human-validated verdicts from two English codes of other jurisdictions. In human validation of the frozen pipeline, specialists rated 0.995 of the conflicting tasks plausible, and the model judge agreed with the adjudicated label at Gwet's AC1 of at least 0.894 on 1,860 elements. We evaluated fourteen model and reasoning-mode combinations on whether they produce the conflicting text, decline or warn. Eleven of the fourteen produce conflicting content on most such requests, mostly without a warning, and nearly three warnings in four accompany conflicting content. The models that conform more do so by declining while still serving the legitimate twin, and enabling reasoning halved the refusals of two models. We hope the dataset and pipeline will help evaluate how language models observe professional norms and let diagnostic datasets be built for particular professions and organisations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TenetBench：将3,433条与15份俄语职业伦理准则条款相冲突的请求与其"良性孪生"（仅合法性不同）配对，用自动流水线从准则文本生成任务，并评估14种模型/推理模式组合是否产出冲突内容、拒绝或警告。结果显示11/14的模型在多数冲突请求上直接产出冲突内容且多无警告，约四分之三的警告与冲突内容同时出现。
AI.motivation: 职业伦理准则约束使用大语言模型助手的专业人士，但助手可能在用户未察觉时违反准则或协助用户违规。现有评估仅报告宽泛的危害类别，无法说明违规发生频率及具体违反哪一条款，因此需要条款级、可扩展的诊断基准。
AI.method: TenetBench将3,433条与15份俄语职业伦理准则条款冲突的请求与仅"请求合法性"不同的良性孪生请求配对。自动化流水线从准则原文生成任务，每新增一份准则即扩充语料，每次运行可为同一条款生成新任务；该流水线亦对两份其他司法辖区的英文准则生成了任务与人工验证标签。冻结流水线的人工验证中，专家判定0.995的冲突任务具有合理性；模型裁判与裁定标签在1,860个要素上的Gwet's AC1不低于0.894。随后在14种模型与推理模式组合上评估其是否产出冲突文本、拒绝或警告。
AI.result: 14种组合中有11种在多数冲突请求上产出冲突内容，且多为无警告；近四分之三的警告伴随冲突内容出现。更"合规"的模型主要靠拒绝实现，同时仍能服务良性孪生请求；启用推理使两个模型的拒绝率减半。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与流水线可用于评估语言模型对职业规范的遵守程度，并支持为特定职业与组织构建条款级诊断数据集；同时揭示当前模型在无警告情况下违反伦理条款的普遍风险，推理模式并不必然提升合规性。

title: CRAB: Cuboid-based Representation for As-built BIM from Point Clouds
summary: As-built BIM reconstruction from point clouds demands semantic, volumetric, parametric, and editable building components, beyond 2D layouts or planar abstractions. Yet existing scan-to-BIM pipelines often rely on handcrafted rules, heuristic optimization, or manual correction, while learning-based methods fall short of recovering wall thickness, opening geometry, and component-level BIM structure. We introduce CRAB, a BIM-ready cuboid reconstruction framework that encodes walls, doors, windows, beams, and columns as compact architectural cuboids with IFC-compatible semantics and parameters. CRAB bridges point clouds and editable BIM by combining ProposalNet, which predicts coarse component cuboids, with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry, predicts structural relationships, and enables automatic structural correction and human-guided editing. To address limited cuboid-level supervision, we extend Structured3D with component-wise cuboid annotations and construct cuboid-based procedural scenes. Experiments show CRAB surpasses floor plan and plane-based alternatives in component completeness, geometric accuracy, and generalization. For interior wall thickness estimation, CRAB achieves a mean error of 2.80 cm, with 79.50% of matched walls within 3 cm. The project page is available at https://vcc.tech/research/2026/CRAB.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAB框架，将点云直接重建为以建筑长方体（墙、门、窗、梁、柱）表示的、带IFC兼容语义与参数的可编辑BIM模型。
AI.motivation: 现有scan-to-BIM流程依赖手写规则、启发式优化或人工修正，学习类方法难以恢复墙体厚度、开口几何与构件级BIM结构，缺乏语义、体量、参数化且可编辑的构件输出。
AI.method: ProposalNet预测粗略构件长方体；AssemblyNet为关系感知的Flow Matching模型，用于几何细化、结构关系预测，并支持自动结构修正与人工引导编辑；同时扩展Structured3D的构件级长方体标注并构建基于长方体的程序化场景以缓解监督不足。
AI.result: 在构件完整性、几何精度与泛化性上优于平面图与平面基方法；内墙厚度估计平均误差2.80 cm，79.50%的匹配墙体误差在3 cm以内。
AI.conclusion: CRAB能够从点云生成语义化、参数化、可编辑的构件级BIM模型，验证了长方体表示与关系感知生成模型在scan-to-BIM中的有效性。

title: An Exact 93-Move Solution to a Nonlocal Crystal-Exchange Puzzle
summary: We determine the minimum number of directional commands needed to solve alevel of Order of the Sinking Star, modeled as a crystal-exchangepuzzle on an 11*11 board. A command swapsthe player with the nearest crystal in the selected row or column, regardlessof distance; only an empty ray permits an ordinary unit walk. Two gates admitthe player to the exit exactly while all sixteen crystals occupy their targetcells. We give an explicit 93-command solution and exclude every shortersolution by an exact, cost-bounded breadth-first search. The search representsa position by its seventeen occupied cells and one active cell. Its admissibleheuristic partitions command costs between a compressed core abstraction andresidual motion, strengthened by a necessary activation detour and a cornervisit condition. The completed computation retained 605,349,215 occupied setsand 1,863,925,136 states. We prove the reductions and pruning conditions,describe the exact storage scheme, and provide source code, execution logs,and a reproduction driver. The result is a computer-assisted proof for thespecified instance, with an explicit implementation trust boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文确定《Order of the Sinking Star》某一关卡（11×11晶体交换谜题）所需方向指令的最少数量为93步：给出显式93步解，并用代价有界广度优先搜索排除所有更短解，形成对该具体实例的计算机辅助证明。
AI.motivation: 该关卡此前缺乏严格的最优性结论，仅有玩家经验性解。作者希望把一个游戏关卡的最优步数问题形式化，并给出可验证的、带有明确实现信任边界的严格最优性证明。
AI.method: 将关卡建模为11×11棋盘上的晶体交换谜题：指令使玩家与所选行/列中最近晶体交换（不论距离），仅空射线允许普通单格行走；两座门在16颗晶体全部就位时开放。给出显式93步解；用精确的、代价上界受限的BFS排除更短解。状态表示为17个被占据格加1个活动格。可采纳启发式把指令代价分解为压缩核心抽象与残余运动，并用必要的激活绕行与角落访问条件加强。保留605,349,215个占据集合与1,863,925,136个状态。
AI.result: 得到93步显式解；代价有界BFS完整运行并排除所有不超过92步的解，搜索规模达605,349,215个占据集合、1,863,925,136个状态。作者证明了约简与剪枝条件的正确性，给出精确存储方案，并提供源代码、执行日志与复现驱动。
AI.conclusion: 结论为该指定实例的最优解恰为93条指令，构成带明确实现信任边界的计算机辅助证明；方法论（压缩抽象+残余运动的可采纳启发式、必要的绕行与角落条件、代价有界搜索）可推广至同类交换谜题的最优性验证。

title: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
summary: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair obligation can force a change in a learning channel, while acquired features can make new protected repairs feasible or reduce the minimum coefficient cost of existing ones. We characterize joint admissibility and response reachability, and give a finite supervised-learning construction in which the two operations together produce a favorable response absent from either operation alone. We implement protected head repair and fixed-capacity LoRA renewal in Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, under replay and output distillation. Across two training trajectories differing in seed and within-task example order, the coordinated policy achieves higher teacher-forced Exact than either separate policy in all four comparisons. It also has the lowest macro NLL under both learning rules on the second trajectory. The implementations realize structure-conditioned self-regulation within specified information and action constraints: accessible state readouts and arrived evidence guide repairs and structural renewals, and ordinary learning continues from the modified state.

AI.tldr: 论文提出纤维调控理论（FRT）与纤维获取理论（FAT），刻画隐藏学习结构的动力学及其相互约束，并在Qwen2.5-32B上实现受保护头修复与定容量LoRA更新的协同策略，实验显示协同策略优于单一策略。
AI.motivation: 学习器当前的预测并不能充分决定其后续如何学习，需要研究隐藏学习结构的动力学，以及修复现有功能与获取可训练结构两类操作之间的相互制约关系。
AI.method: 提出FRT（描述已有功能的受保护修复及修复后剩余可用的学习响应）与FAT（描述可训练结构的形成与更新，区分中性安装、学习信号接入与额外功能方向）；刻画二者的联合可采纳性与响应可达性，并给出有限监督学习构造，使两种操作的协同产生单一操作无法产生的有利响应。在Qwen2.5-32B上以AdamW实现受保护头修复与固定容量LoRA更新，配合回放与输出蒸馏。
AI.result: 在两条训练轨迹（种子与任务内样本顺序不同）上，协同策略在全部四组对比中教师强制Exact均高于任一单独策略；在第二条轨迹上，两种学习规则下均取得最低宏平均NLL。
AI.conclusion: 实现可在指定信息与动作约束下完成结构条件化的自我调节：可访问的状态读出与已到达的证据指导修复与结构更新，常规学习从修改后的状态继续进行。

title: A Strong MoE Is All You Need for Process Supervision
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用MoE模型中专家路由（routing）作为原生过程监督信号，构建路由置信度并衍生RoCo-Rethink（重生成低置信步骤后续轨迹）与RoCo-PRM（自动标注并蒸馏为独立PRM），在多种MoE架构与推理任务上均优于基线且具强迁移性。
AI.motivation: 多步推理的过程奖励模型（PRM）需要细粒度过程标签，但可靠的过程标签获取是核心瓶颈：现有方法依赖人工标注、基于rollout的估计或辅助验证器，代价高或不稳定。作者希望找到一种模型架构自身天然暴露的过程监督来源。
AI.method: 观察到MoE的专家路由统计可提供与输出logit置信度相当的内在过程置信信号。据此将总体路由质量、head级路由质量与步内路由变化组合为路由置信度；RoCo-Rethink据此定位置信度最低的推理步骤并无条件地选择性重生成其后续轨迹；RoCo-PRM则用强MoE以路由导出的步骤分数自动标注推理轨迹，并蒸馏为独立PRM。
AI.result: 在多种MoE架构与多样化推理任务上，RoCo-Rethink与RoCo-PRM均稳定优于强基线；RoCo-PRM在模型架构与任务间具备良好迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 专家路由不仅是计算调度机制，更可作为架构原生的过程监督来源，为推理过程提供细粒度置信度信号，支撑测试时重生成与PRM训练。

title: Clinical radar heart sounds with echocardiographic phenotypes of ventricular dysfunction and valvular disease
summary: Radar heart sounds capture cardiac mechanical activity without contact, while echocardiography characterizes ventricular and valvular function. Paired measurements connect these signals to structural heart disease, yet such data remain sparsely represented in public resources. Here we present 537 radar heart-sound recordings paired with one echocardiographic report for each of 162 patients. The cohort covers three overlapping phenotypes: left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) below 50%, regional wall-motion abnormality and at least moderate valvular regurgitation, present in 38, 43 and 39 patients, respectively. Original complex signals, processed radar heart sounds and temporal quality segmentation support signal-to-phenotype analysis. Technical validation retains 95.93% of signal duration and confirms reproducible waveform reconstruction. Patient-level five-fold evaluation achieves a mean outer-test AUROC of $0.770\pm0.138$ for reduced LVEF, identifying mechanical information associated with ventricular systolic dysfunction. This resource supports research linking non-contact cardiac mechanical signals to echocardiographic structural and functional phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 该工作发布了一个配对数据集：162名患者的537条雷达心音记录，每条均配有一份超声心动图报告，覆盖LVEF降低、室壁运动异常与中重度瓣膜反流三种表型，并验证了信号质量与LVEF降低的可分性（AUROC 0.770±0.138）。
AI.motivation: 雷达心音可非接触式捕捉心脏机械活动，超声心动图可刻画心室与瓣膜功能，二者配对测量有望将非接触信号与结构性心脏病关联；但此类配对数据在公共资源中极为稀缺，限制了相关研究。
AI.method: 构建配对数据集：162例患者、537条雷达心音录制，每条对应一份超声报告；队列涵盖三种重叠表型（LVEF<50%、节段性室壁运动异常、至少中度瓣膜反流，分别38/43/39例）。数据提供原始复数信号、预处理后雷达心音及时间质量分段。技术验证评估有效信号时长保留率与波形重建可重复性；采用患者级五折交叉验证进行信号—表型分析。
AI.result: 技术验证保留95.93%的信号时长，波形重建可重复。患者级五折评估中，LVEF降低检测的平均外层测试AUROC为0.770±0.138，表明非接触心音中包含与心室收缩功能障碍相关的机械信息。
AI.conclusion: 该资源为研究非接触式心脏机械信号与超声心动图结构和功能表型之间的关联提供了支撑，填补了公开配对数据的空白。

title: Parallel Thinking for Large Language Model with Path Diversity
summary: Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. However, we identify that parallel thinking via Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically suffers from the mode collapse of reasoning paths, where parallel thinking trajectories degenerate into similar ones. This homogeneity undermines the fundamental motivation of parallel thinking, that is, maintaining multiple hypotheses concurrently to prevent premature loss into a suboptimal solution. In this paper, we propose Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach for parallel thinking designed to encourage path diversity. DPT rewards the model to develop distinct reasoning strategies by penalizing the prefix similarity of parallel thinking paths, thereby enhancing a more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space. We conduct various experiments and analyses across multiple reasoning benchmarks to demonstrate the effectiveness of DPT. Results show that DPT successfully outperforms previous parallel thinking methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance over baselines. We validate path diversity as a key element to improve parallel thinking. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaruQian/DPT.

AI.tldr: 提出Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT)，一种强化学习方法，通过惩罚并行思维路径的前缀相似度来鼓励路径多样性，缓解并行思维中的模式坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: 基于强化学习的并行思维存在"推理路径模式坍缩"问题，多条并行轨迹退化为相似路径，破坏了并行思维"同时维持多假设以避免过早陷入次优解"的核心动机。
AI.method: DPT在RL训练中对并行思维路径的前缀相似度施加惩罚，奖励模型发展出彼此不同的推理策略，从而更充分地探索推理空间。方法简洁而有效。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上的实验与分析表明，DPT优于已有并行思维方法，取得相对基线的SOTA性能，并验证路径多样性是提升并行思维的关键要素。
AI.conclusion: 路径多样性是并行思维有效性提升的关键；通过惩罚前缀相似度的简单RL设计即可显著改善并行思维的探索质量与最终性能。

title: Distilling Multi-Teacher Scoring Principles for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types. Recent unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors provide complementary scoring signals, yet deploying them as an ensemble preserves the inference and maintenance cost of every individual detector. We study whether heterogeneous teacher detectors can be distilled into a single lightweight detector in the unsupervised setting, where no anomaly labels are available to define a shared target. AnoMix addresses this by extracting weak pairwise supervision from the training-set anomaly scores of frozen teachers. It normalizes each teacher score sequence independently and trains the student with CoRank, a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision through teacher consensus. Across seven benchmark datasets, AnoMix successfully integrates complementary teacher scoring principles into a single deployable model, improving over individual detectors and static score ensembles while using a compact student with under 80k parameters on the benchmark settings. A zero-shot variant further shows that the distilled ranking signal transfers to unseen datasets and can outperform large pretrained time-series foundation models for anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: AnoMix 通过从多个异构教师检测器的无监督分数中提取成对弱监督，用 CoRank 排名蒸馏目标训练单个轻量学生检测器，实现多教师互补信号整合。
AI.motivation: 单一无监督时序异常检测器各有不同的异常打分原理，难以覆盖所有异常类型；集成多检测器虽能获得互补信号，却需承担每个检测器的推理与维护成本。因此在无异常标签、没有共享目标可定义的条件下，探索能否将异构教师检测器蒸馏进单一轻量检测器。
AI.method: 对每个冻结教师模型的训练集异常分数序列独立归一化，从中提取弱成对监督信号；以 CoRank 多教师排名蒸馏目标，借助教师间共识将教师分数差转化为成对监督，训练学生模型。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上，AnoMix 将互补的教师打分原理整合进单一可部署模型，优于各单独检测器与静态分数集成，且学生模型在基准设置下参数量不足 80k；零样本变体显示蒸馏出的排名信号可迁移到未见数据集，并可超过大型预训练时序基础模型的异常检测表现。
AI.conclusion: 无需异常标签即可通过排名蒸馏将多教师检测器的互补能力压缩至轻量学生模型，兼顾性能与部署成本，并具备跨数据集迁移潜力。

title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.

AI.tldr: 本文直接检验"时间推理可分解为时间算术与时间语义两模式"这一广泛假设，发现该二分法缺乏实证支持：同模式内跨数据集迁移极小，且真正驱动基准表现的是知识而非定量/逻辑推理。
AI.motivation: 时间推理被普遍假设分为时间算术（日期时间计算）与时间语义（时序与因果理解）两模式，这一二分法决定了基准设计、模型训练与进展度量，但其经验效度从未被直接检验。
AI.method: 提出两条证据线：(1) 迁移检验——在基准标注为算术或语义的子集上微调，考察同模式内是否产生可迁移增益；(2) 基于认知需求的模型评估，考察实际驱动基准性能的能力维度。
AI.result: 微调主要带来数据集特定增益（+6.8 至 +23.1 个百分点），而同模式内跨数据集迁移仅为 −3.2 至 +1.1 个百分点；作为时间算术与时间语义代理的定量推理与逻辑推理并非主要驱动因素，知识才是。
AI.conclusion: 现有时间推理基准并未清晰实现算术—语义区分，其本质更多是奖励模型记忆"时间通常如何运作"的知识，而非可迁移的时间推理能力。

title: Certified Abstention for Provably-Unidentifiable Index-Phase Recovery in Image Registration
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21502909
summary: Image registration underpins measurement across scanning, camera, and microscopy imaging, yet a fundamental question is rarely posed: when is the sample-to-position map recoverable at all, and when does any estimator that reports a position necessarily fabricate one? We show that in reference-perturbed sampled imaging, where samples are localized through a perturbed reference, position fidelity (where samples land) and phase fidelity (which reference index becomes each block's origin) are logically independent: no policy acting on position information alone can guarantee phase fidelity. We derive a tight resolution threshold separating recoverable from provably-unidentifiable registration, and a recovery framework that certifies identifiable regions--recovering them exactly--while abstaining on provably-unidentifiable regions rather than hallucinating structure. On a deployed scanning system we measure a direction-bimodal registration offset consistent with the theory. Against classical and learned restoration baselines, certificate-free offset estimators fabricate structure on the unidentifiable regime, whereas the certified method abstains rather than fabricating. Finally, the certified-abstention mechanism carries across scanning, rolling-shutter, and cryo-electron-microscopy imaging--declining rather than fabricating on the regime it flags--though how completely it abstains and how tightly it bounds kept-region risk stay modality-specific (at extreme SNR the cryo-EM certificate abstains only partially): a structural-versus-statistical boundary in registration reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出参考扰动采样成像中"位置保真"与"相位保真"在逻辑上相互独立，推导出可恢复与可证不可辨识之间的紧致分辨率阈值，并给出可认证辨识区域、对不可辨识区域拒答而非伪造结构的配准框架。
AI.motivation: 图像配准支撑扫描、相机与显微成像中的测量，但"样本到位置映射何时根本可恢复、估计器何时必然伪造位置"这一根本问题鲜被追问；现有经典与学习方法在该不可辨识区会无证书地虚构结构。
AI.method: 在参考扰动采样成像设定下形式化位置保真与相位保真的独立性，证明仅依赖位置信息的策略无法保证相位保真；推导分离可恢复与可证不可辨识的紧致分辨率阈值，并构建带认证的恢复框架：对可辨识区域精确恢复，对可证不可辨识区域弃权。
AI.result: 在已部署扫描系统上测得方向双峰的配准偏移，与理论一致；相较经典与学习式恢复基线，无证书偏移估计器在不可辨识区伪造结构，而认证方法选择弃权；该认证弃权机制可迁移至扫描、卷帘快门与冷冻电镜成像，但弃权完整度与保留区域风险界为模态特异（极端SNR下cryo-EM证书仅部分弃权）。
AI.conclusion: 配准可靠性存在结构性—统计性边界：可辨识性由结构决定并可被认证，而弃权行为与风险界定属统计层面且依赖模态；认证而非伪造是可靠配准的核心原则。

title: From Association to Decision Value: Testing Paired Instruction Dependence for VLA Corpus Selection
summary: Choosing among robot demonstration corpora is a ranking problem: an upstream diagnostic must preserve which candidates produce better downstream policies, not merely correlate with average performance. We study paired instruction dependence, the rate at which a demonstrator changes its first decision when only the goal changes. Across 136 independently seeded quadruped-navigation corpora, predictions developed on 56 corpora are evaluated prospectively on 80 held-out corpora. The audit is reliable and associated with downstream paired correctness, and lowers mean absolute prediction error when added to a correctness-aware baseline, but the primary proper-log-score increment is +0.059 nats (95% corpus-bootstrap CI [-0.027, 0.133]) and the prespecified top-20% comparison does not establish an incremental selection gain. An exploratory response decomposition suggests a structural source of this predictive-ranking mismatch: under the tested predictor specification, separating both-correct and both-wrong responses yields larger held-out gains than their unsigned switch statistic. Seed-to-seed agreement indicates that the held-out endpoint retains recoverable rank signal. These results show that counterfactual response structure can be reliable and predictive while providing limited incremental decision value in this setting when compressed into an unsigned statistic, motivating diagnostics that preserve outcome-relevant structure and are validated against the decisions they are intended to support.

AI.tldr: 将配对指令依赖性（仅改变目标时示教者首个决策的翻转率）作为机器人示教语料库的上游诊断指标，在136个四足导航语料库上做前瞻性检验：诊断可靠且与下游配对正确率相关并能降低MAE，但作为排序诊断的增量决策价值有限。
AI.motivation: 选择机器人示教语料库本质是排序问题：上游诊断必须保留"哪个候选能产生更好下游策略"的排序信息，而不仅仅是与平均性能相关。作者因此检验一个对齐该目标的指标——配对指令依赖性。
AI.method: 定义配对指令依赖性为仅变更目标时示教者首个决策发生改变的比率。在136个独立随机种子的四足导航语料库中，用其中56个语料库建立预测，在80个留出语料库上做前瞻性评估；与正确率感知基线比较，使用proper log score与预设的top-20%选择比较，并做探索性响应分解。
AI.result: 审计指标可靠，并与下游配对正确率相关；加入正确率感知基线后降低平均绝对预测误差。但主要proper log score增量仅为+0.059 nats（95%语料库自助法CI [-0.027, 0.133]），预设的top-20%比较未能确立增量选择增益。探索性分解显示，在所用预测器设定下，将both-correct与both-wrong响应分离带来的留出增益大于无符号翻转统计量；种子间一致性表明留出端点仍保留可恢复的排序信号。
AI.conclusion: 反事实响应结构可以既可靠又具预测性，但在该设定下压缩为无符号统计量时增量决策价值有限。作者主张诊断指标应保留与结果相关的结构，并针对其意图支持的实际决策进行验证。

title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
summary: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $κ$ and error at most $α$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $α$ and gap $γ$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $κ$ is $K(1-κ)/(κγ^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feasible on the audit sample can pay a linear $K$ cost even when a square-root rate is possible. Reference-free testing reaches a smaller scale under constant-risk alternatives, whereas unknown heterogeneous risks can make the linear cost unavoidable. In simulations with $K=4$, the raw menu cost varies 7.7-fold between $κ=.5$ and $κ=.95$; after theorem-motivated normalization the endpoint values differ by approximately 5%. Held-out experiments with three VLM judges show positive exact-hiding windows in all 60 split-specific confidence-gate families, with 28/30 contracts chosen on audit-A remaining hidden on untouched audit-B. On a cleaner multi-annotator target, hiding is weaker and transfers in 3/10 resplits. Frozen image and multimodal classifiers show boundary behavior consistent with the IUT guarantee and strong power relative to practical certificates.

AI.tldr: 论文刻画了选择性分类器风险-覆盖率契约的审计样本复杂度：对 K 区间菜单的极小极大样本量为 K(1-κ)/(κγ²)（忽略对数因子），精确 IUT 可达该率，且下界在已知分数分布下仍成立。
AI.motivation: 反驳"存在某条预声明规则同时满足覆盖率≥κ、错误率≤α"这一存在性断言需排除菜单中每条规则，而 IUT 虽无需多重校正即可保证有效性，样本代价可能随菜单规模增长；此前缺乏对该代价的刻画及其与最优审计的比较。
AI.method: 理论：在小间隔、大菜单区间分析 IUT 与最优审计的极小极大样本复杂度，下界构造涵盖已知分数分布情形，上界推广至 VC 维为 d 的菜单；并分析"样本上任何规则看似可行即不拒绝"类保守程序的代价。实证：K=4 模拟、含三个 VLM 评判器的 60 个分拆特异性置信门族留出实验、冻结图像与多模态分类器实验。
AI.result: K 区间菜单的极小极大样本量为 K(1-κ)/(κγ²)（忽略对数因子），精确 IUT 达此率；拒绝即不拒绝的保守程序即使存在平方根率也可能付出线性 K 代价；无参考检验在常数风险替代下可达更小尺度，而异质未知风险使线性代价不可避免。模拟中原始菜单代价在 κ=.5 与 .95 间相差 7.7 倍，归一化后端点仅差约 5%；60 个族均有正的精确隐藏窗，28/30 契约在未触碰的 audit-B 上仍隐藏；更干净的多标注目标上隐藏更弱，仅 3/10 重分拆可迁移。
AI.conclusion: IUT 在该机制下是样本复杂度最优的审计方法，菜单丰富度带来的代价可由 (1-κ)/κ 归一化解释；隐藏现象在小风险目标下稳健但依赖目标噪声水平与不确定性结构，实际证书相对于理论保证具有较强功效。

title: Mitigating Query Shortcuts in Chain-of-Thought with Context-Aware Decoding
summary: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standard CoT. Furthermore, intervention analyses using ground-truth and random rationales reveal that RCD increases the behavioral dependence of final answers on the rationale content. Our findings suggest that contrastive decoding offers a simple, training-free approach to mitigating query shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 论文将上下文感知解码（CAD）迁移到CoT推理，提出"理由对比解码"（RCD），通过对比"有/无理由"条件下的下一词分布来放大理由驱动、抑制查询捷径，从而在无需训练的情况下提升答案准确率并增强答案对理由的行为依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现CoT生成的推理步骤（rationale）与最终答案之间并不存在强依赖：LLM可能依赖查询层面的捷径（query-specific shortcuts）而非真正的推理内容，导致"推理"流于形式。作者希望验证：一种已有的对比解码方法（CAD）在应用于CoT时，能否缓解这种捷径行为。
AI.method: 提出Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD)：对下一词分布做对比，比较"仅以查询为条件"与"查询+理由为条件"两种分布，提升因理由存在而概率上升的token权重。理论上将该解码规则解释为KL正则化的奖励最大化目标。实验覆盖5个推理基准，并设计以真实理由/随机理由进行干预的分析，测量答案对理由内容的行为依赖程度。
AI.result: 在5个推理基准上，RCD相对标准CoT提升了答案准确率；干预分析表明，使用真实理由与随机理由的对比显示RCD增强了最终答案对理由内容的行为依赖，即答案更"真正"地利用理由信息。
AI.conclusion: 对比解码是一种简单、免训练（training-free）的缓解查询捷径的手段，可使CoT的最终答案更依赖其推理理由。

title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
summary: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. Knowledge-base entries are required to be triggerable by evidence expressed in the fact schema. We built our system based on open source FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset and favour reproducible, edge-deployable models over large general purpose frontier models. We additionally release FAIRHiveText-1K dataset that turns FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset into interchangeable facts and text interpretation of the facts, making it easy for further LLM-based research into this area. We also propose a pathway to develop the grounded knowledge-base that will be helpful in providing interpretable and actionable reports from the facts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向蜂群健康的边缘可部署智能系统框架：从蜂巢脾照片出发，经目标检测提取巢房类别，蒸馏为结构化事实模式，生成受约束的事实文本，再由文本触发有依据的知识库给出可解释、可行动巡检报告。
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂维系约三分之一全球食品，但气候极端天气与病虫害变化使蜂群承压；及时评估蜂群强度、子脾面积、蜜粉储存与脾利用率对适应性管理至关重要，而人工检脾慢、成本高且依赖稀缺专家经验。
AI.method: 构建端到端流水线：1) 目标检测器识别具有生物学意义的巢房类别；2) 检测结果蒸馏为结构化事实模式（fact schema）；3) 将事实转为受约束的事实文本；4) 文本触发接地的知识库，输出解释与建议；知识库条目须由事实模式中的证据可触发。基于开源 FAIRHiveFrames-1K 数据集，优先采用可复现、边缘可部署模型而非大型通用前沿模型，并发布 FAIRHiveText-1K 数据集（事实与文本解释可互换），同时提出知识库构建路径。
AI.result: 搭建了完整管道与可互转的 FAIRHiveText-1K 数据集，验证了以检测—事实—文本—知识库的链路可从图像生成可解释、可操作的巡检报告，并为后续基于 LLM 的研究提供数据基础。
AI.conclusion: 以事实为中心、证据驱动知识库的设计可实现低成本、可解释、边缘可部署的蜂群巡检；未来重点是完善接地知识库，以支撑可操作报告的规模化生成。

title: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
summary:
Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term.
  We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates.
  We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.

AI.tldr: 提出一种合规的“自生成推理轨迹”蒸馏方案：以教师答案与上下文为输入，用学生模型家族风格重写推理链，经监督+对抗两阶段训练，在代码基准上优于教师自身思维内容。
AI.motivation: 前沿厂商对自家模型输出隐藏详细推理过程，只返回答案或短摘要，导致无法直接蒸馏思维链；已有"跨模型重放加密块"的恢复手段虽有效但违反服务条款，难以产品化。因此需要一个合规、可持续的替代路径。
AI.method: 输入为学生侧上下文与教师答案，自行生成推理轨迹，且采用学生自身模型家族的写作风格。训练分两阶段：先监督学习，再对抗训练——生成器学习由上下文与答案重建本家族真实推理轨迹，判别器（critic）学习判别推理轨迹的真实性；推理时对教师答案生成家族风格轨迹，并可由critic从4个候选中择优。
AI.result: 独立评判器给出的真实性（非正确性）得分：生成轨迹均值0.68，真实轨迹0.66，critic从4候选中挑出的达0.82。五个基准、其余条件固定下，通用任务上五个训练语料效果相当；代码任务上生成推理优于Fable 5自身思维内容。同5000题、同教师答案下，最终检查点HumanEval+提升3.7分、MBPP+提升7.1分，且MBPP+优势在每个检查点均保持。
AI.conclusion: 以学生家族风格自生成推理轨迹可作为被封闭思维链的合规替代蒸馏数据，且在代码任务上收益显著；作者推测原因在于家族风格的推理更易被学生模型学习。

title: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behaviors, and VRD-R, which reorganizes the latent space to geometrically isolate high-value generative trajectories from the FM-based behavior policy. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that VRD improves existing generative baselines across diverse continuous control and planning tasks on the D4RL, OGBench, and Minari benchmarks, especially over those multi-modal, non-expert datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD)，将离线RL中基于Flow Matching的行为策略蒸馏重塑为值引导的生成轨迹对齐问题，以解决分布外模式平均（OOD Mode Averaging）导致动作塌缩到无效区域的问题。
AI.motivation: 在离线强化学习中蒸馏基于Flow Matching（FM）的行为策略时，面对多模态数据集，标准蒸馏会不可避免地使策略在不同行为模式之间插值，从而使生成动作塌缩到无效的分布外（OOD）区域——即"OOD模式平均"问题。
AI.method: 将离线策略蒸馏重构为值引导的生成轨迹对齐问题，并采用动态耦合机制主动修正流动力学，显式解耦不同行为模式，干净地分离高价值动作。具体实例化两种互补算法：VRD-Q通过值分位数行为蒸馏统计性过滤低价值行为；VRD-R通过重组织潜空间，从基于FM的行为策略中几何地隔离高价值生成轨迹。
AI.result: 在D4RL、OGBench和Minari基准上的多种连续控制与规划任务中，VRD相较现有生成式基线取得提升，尤其在多模态、非专家数据集上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过值引导的轨迹对齐与模式解耦，VRD有效缓解了OOD模式平均问题，验证了将值信息融入生成式策略蒸馏的有效性，并在多模态离线数据场景下具备优越性。

title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出RCSD训练框架，用隐式偏好对与掩码损失对齐系统级接受长度目标，提升推测解码效率。
AI.motivation: 传统草稿模型依赖软标签蒸馏，强迫其拟合目标模型完整输出分布，包含高熵区域，导致接受率下降、早期拒绝风险上升；训练目标与推测解码的系统级目标（最大化接受长度）不一致。
AI.method: RCSD（Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding）：利用推测推理过程中自然产生的被接受/被拒绝序列构造隐式偏好对，并采用掩码损失避免惩罚与目标模型一致的token，实现持续学习式优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，平均接受长度较HASS提升35%，实际负载下端到端推理速度较HASS快1.35倍，且不损害生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 将草稿模型优化与系统级接受长度目标对齐可显著提升推测解码效率，RCSD为草稿模型训练提供了一种有效范式。

title: Latent space configuration for neural network finetuning, fast ranking, and embedding dimensionality reduction
summary: Finding K most similar elements for a query in a large gallery of neural network (NN) embeddings is essential in various areas of computer science and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. This paper proposes search algorithms for structured latent spaces (LS) of NNs which allow to speed up top K item retrieval owing to O(1) complexity small candidate gallery subset search. ArcFace-pretrained IResNet50 models are finetuned using Latent Space Configuration (LSC) methodology to obtain new distribution of embeddings with desired geometric properties. Applying the proposed algorithms to embeddings obtained from finetuned models leads to several times speed-up over baseline exhaustive search. Specifically, we report up to 3 times speed-up on GPU and 40% speed-up on CPU compared to the baseline method GPU speed. These results are obtained for the original and reduced numbers of LS dimensions. The results show that LS dimensionality reduction allows to further accelerate the search and even improve rank-N metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对神经网络嵌入库中Top-K相似检索问题，提出面向结构化潜在空间的快速搜索算法，通过O(1)复杂度的小候选子集筛选加速检索，并在微调后的嵌入上实现多倍加速。
AI.motivation: 在大型神经网络嵌入库中为查询寻找K个最相似元素是计算机视觉与AI工业应用的核心需求，但穷举搜索成本高，需要在不显著损失精度的前提下加速Top-K检索。
AI.method: 利用Latent Space Configuration (LSC)方法微调ArcFace预训练的IResNet50模型，使嵌入分布具备所需的几何性质；在此基础上设计针对结构化潜在空间的搜索算法，以O(1)复杂度构建小型候选库子集，从而缩小后续精确比较范围；并考察潜在空间降维的影响。
AI.result: 相较基线穷举搜索，所提方法在GPU上最高约3倍加速，在CPU上相比基线GPU速度约40%加速；在原始与降维的潜在空间维度下均取得上述结果，且降维可进一步加快搜索并甚至提升rank-N指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过LSC赋予嵌入可用的几何结构并结合候选子集筛选，可在保证甚至改善检索质量的同时显著加速Top-K相似元素检索，验证了结构化潜在空间用于高效检索的可行性与价值。

title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
comment: Accepted to the Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.

AI.tldr: 论文用受控消融实验比较四种文献检索语言智能体"外壳"（闭卷、单次检索、ReAct式自写查询、gold摘要oracle）在SciFact生物医学声明验证上的表现，发现检索而非推理是主要瓶颈：oracle准确率79-86%，而现实方案仅49-62%；闭卷模型引用PubMed ID大多存在但几乎不相关，说明"存在性校验"不足以保障科学智能体的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 检索型语言智能体已成为生命科学科研助手的标准组件，但关于其"外壳"（harness）中哪些环节真正起作用，缺乏受控证据。作者希望厘清工具使用、查询构造、检索质量与推理能力的各自贡献。
AI.method: 在生物医学声明验证数据集SciFact上进行受控消融，仅以实时PubMed API为工具，固定骨干模型与输出格式，比较四种harness：(1) 闭卷直接作答；(2) 以声明本身为查询的单次检索；(3) ReAct风格、自主编写PubMed查询的智能体；(4) 直接提供gold摘要的oracle；每种配置使用两个高效前沿骨干模型。另进行引用审计，用跨家族LLM评判器评估引用与声明的相关性。
AI.result: 朴素单次检索仅对6%的声明找到gold论文，且只是把过度自信的错误转为弃答，未提升准确率；模型自写查询使gold召回率提升三倍，判定准确率最高（62% vs 其他现实方案49-59%），但在当前样本量下差异不显著，且智能体仅用掉不到一半的检索预算。oracle设置下准确率达79-86%，显著高出17-24个百分点，表明检索是主要瓶颈。引用审计显示闭卷模型引用的PubMed ID几乎都存在（327/335），但跨家族LLM评审认为仅3/327与声明相关，而检索智能体产出的引用相关性达67%。
AI.conclusion: 检索（而非推理）是生物医学声明验证的核心瓶颈；让模型自主构造查询能显著改善检索召回。仅做ID存在性校验远不足以作为科学智能体的安全防护，须引入相关性审计。作者开源了代码、提示词与全部缓存的工具调用。

title: Causal world models under physical parameter shifts
summary: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.
