summary: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

AI.tldr: LiveAct 提出多智能体视频世界模型，通过异构动作接口（HAI）实现异构控制的独立、语义自适应建模，并迁移到块因果生成器实现高效流式生成，在智能体归属准确率与帧率上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型多假设单一受控智能体与任务专用动作接口，无法同时生成多智能体的联合视觉未来并解析从二进制游戏按键到连续机器人指令的异构控制。核心挑战有二：每个按智能体索引的动作流须独立控制其对应视觉实体；同一动作张量维度在不同任务中语义不同（如攻击、转向、机器人指令），模型需自适应其含义。
AI.method: 提出 LiveAct，以异构动作接口（HAI）为核心，含两个对应组件：面向独立控制的 Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation，使用语言驱动的空间门控与智能体专属注意力，将各动作流绑定到目标视觉智能体；面向异构控制的 Schema-Guided Action Adaptation，用语言描述每个控制变量，并将其语义 token 与同步数值调制融合。随后通过 teacher forcing 与 rollout-aware 分布匹配，将完整接口迁移至块因果生成器，实现高效流式生成并保留智能体专属控制与动作语义。
AI.result: 在覆盖游戏与多机器人操作共六个多源数据集上实例化，评估视觉质量、动作跟随、智能体归属与延迟。游戏与机器人操作下智能体归属准确率分别达 0.898 与 0.942，且不依赖智能体位置或身份裁剪；因果生成器在 512×448 分辨率下达到 17.70 FPS。
AI.conclusion: LiveAct 将多智能体视频世界建模分解为独立控制绑定与异构动作语义适配两个子问题，通过语言驱动接口统一处理，并可无损迁移至因果生成器，兼顾控制精度与流式生成效率，为多智能体交互式世界模型提供可行范式。

title: Charts as Epistemic Actions for Experience-Driven Agentic Data Analysis
summary: Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了 CHARTAGENT 框架（摘要中以占位符形式呈现为 \method{}），通过从条件化轨迹 rollout 中蒸馏两类经验（操作选择与验证、模态切换时机），在不更新模型参数的前提下让 ReAct 式数据分析智能体把图表作为内部认知动作使用；同时构建 PROBE 基准（200 个任务、四种匹配接口条件）揭示了"能读"与"愿用"之间的持续差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 ReAct 循环的数据智能体的中间推理几乎完全依赖文本，而人类分析师会在数字、表格与图表之间切换，借助视觉证据发现文本摘要易丢失的趋势与异常。作者由此提出核心问题：图表能否作为智能体推理循环中的内部认知动作（epistemic action），以及如何教会智能体使用它。现有工作关注智能体"能否读懂图表"，却忽视了"是否选择使用图表"这一决策层面的问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建 PROBE 探测套件：200 个受控任务、四种匹配的接口条件，用于分离"读取能力"与"模态选择偏好"；2) 提出 CHARTAGENT：在条件化轨迹 rollout 上蒸馏两类经验——一类记录如何选择与验证分析操作，另一类记录何时调用文本、图表或两者兼用；3) 用轨迹评判器（trajectory judge）对结果打分并为中间步骤打标签，并设置验证门控（validation gate），仅接纳能提升留出集性能的经验；4) 全程不修改模型参数，属于经验/上下文层面的学习。
AI.result: PROBE 实验显示：智能体从自生成图表中获得的表现与从数值输出中获得的表现相当，但仅提供绘图接口并不能转化为一致的使用行为；任务切片上，图表在时序、模式与异常推理上占优，文本在精确读数与条件验证上占优。CHARTAGENT 在三个留出基准、四个 LLM 骨干上，相较匹配基线提升了分析准确率与视觉证据质量，且从未绘图的骨干模型开始主动使用图表。
AI.conclusion: 图表可作为数据分析智能体的内部认知动作，其瓶颈不在于感知能力而在于模态选择策略；通过经验蒸馏加验证门控的免参数更新方法，可以可靠地塑造智能体的多模态推理行为，并泛化到未见骨干与基准。

title: Design and Tuning of Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization
summary: Designing effective multi-agent systems (MAS) remains a challenging and resource-intensive task. We propose a Bayesian Evolutionary Optimization framework for automatically discovering task-specific MAS topologies. The approach combines evolutionary operators to generate diverse workflow graphs with Bayesian optimization to focus cost intensive evaluations on promising candidates. In contrast to LLM-based candidate selection, our approach uses a graph-aware Gaussian Process and Expected Improvement to provide an explicit selection criterion during evolutionary search. We evaluate the method on BigCodeBench for code generation and on a tabular preprocessing benchmark using TabPFN. On BigCodeBench, evolved architectures achieve the highest overall performance among the evaluated agent systems. On temporal tabular datasets, optimized MAS preprocessing improves over the default TabPFN model on several tasks, while remaining competitive on IID datasets. Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of Bayesian selection for guiding evolutionary MAS search under expensive evaluation budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯进化优化框架，自动搜索任务特定的多智能体系统（MAS）拓扑结构。
AI.motivation: 设计有效的多智能体系统仍具挑战且资源消耗大，需要自动化发现任务特定的MAS拓扑。
AI.method: 结合进化算子生成多样化工作流图，并用贝叶斯优化（图感知高斯过程+期望改进EI）将昂贵评估集中于有潜力的候选；相较LLM式候选筛选，提供显式选择准则。
AI.result: 在BigCodeBench代码生成任务上，进化出的架构取得所评估智能体系统中的最佳整体表现；在TabPFN的时序表格预处理基准上，优化后的MAS预处理在多个任务上优于默认TabPFN，在IID数据集上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明贝叶斯选择在昂贵评估预算下引导进化式MAS搜索具有潜力。

title: ALIAS: Evaluating Performance and Memorization in LLM-Written TLA+ Specifications
comment: 19 pages (8 main + appendix), 6 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LUC-AI4FM/ALIAS
summary: Memorization inflates the benchmark scores of large language models (LLMs), since a model can reproduce answers it saw in training. Researchers test for it with consistent identifier renaming (CIR), which gives every identifier in a task a new name, and treat a lower score on the renamed task as evidence of recall. We test this method on the Temporal Logic of Actions Plus (TLA+) language, whose model checker acts as an oracle by confirming whether a renamed task preserves the exact behaviors of the original. Across 111 TLA+-Bench tasks, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28% to 18% and of GPT-5 from 9% to 7%. Most of this decrease comes from how the test grades, which requires exact names that most descriptions never state. Grading by behavior shrinks the decrease to about 3 percentage points for Opus 4.8 and to 0 for GPT-5. In two model families fine-tuned on disjoint halves of the tasks, renaming removes about half of the training gain in likelihood and costs 4.9 percentage points (Qwen) and 1.3 percentage points (Gemma) on unseen tasks. A lower score after renaming therefore mixes memorization, name-based grading, and the cost of new names.

AI.tldr: 论文以 TLA+ 模型检查器作 oracle，检验“一致重命名”（CIR）能否可靠衡量 LLM 的记忆化；结论是重命名后的分数下降混杂了记忆化、按名评分与处理新名字的成本。
AI.motivation: 现有研究用 CIR（给任务中每个标识符换新名）检测 LLM 对基准的记忆化，并把重命名后分数下降视为回忆证据；但该方法本身缺乏可验证的等价性保证，下降的来源也未加区分。
AI.method: 选用 TLA+（Temporal Logic of Actions Plus）语言，利用模型检查器作为 oracle，验证重命名后的任务是否保持原有行为的精确等价；在 111 个 TLA+-Bench 任务上比较重命名前后的正确率，并对比“精确名称评分”与“行为评分”；另在两族模型上于任务的不相交子集分别微调，考察重命名对训练增益的影响。
AI.result: 重命名使 Claude Opus 4.8 正确率由 28% 降至 18%，GPT-5 由 9% 降至 7%；改用行为评分后降幅分别收窄至约 3 个百分点和 0。微调实验中，重命名抹去约一半的似然训练增益，在未见任务上分别损失 4.9（Qwen）与 1.3（Gemma）个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 重命名后的分数下降并非纯粹的记忆化信号，而是记忆化、基于名称的评分偏差与新标识符处理成本三者混合的结果；评估记忆化应采用行为等价评分而非精确名称匹配。

title: LLMSeg: Training-Free Text-Prompted Image Segmentation with B-Splines
summary: Promptable segmentation models such as SAM 3 achieve remarkable open-vocabulary performance but require dedicated architectures, large-scale annotation engines, and task-specific training. We ask a different question: can a general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) segment images directly, without an added segmentation head, mask decoder, or training? We present LLMSeg, a training-free pipeline that turns a vision-capable LLM into a text-prompted image segmenter. LLMSeg decomposes segmentation into three LLM-driven stages. First, detect localizes all instances matching a free-form text query and describes their coarse morphology. Next, segment traces each instance using closed periodic B-splines confined to its detected box. These splines define an outer boundary and optional hole loops. Finally, refine iteratively proposes focus boxes around residual errors and retraces confined splines. The process ends when the mask stabilizes or the pass budget is exhausted. The output is a binary mask with inspectable intermediate geometry. We evaluate LLMSeg across ten referring and reasoning segmentation splits (ReasonSeg and RefCOCO/+/g). We also evaluate open-vocabulary instance segmentation (LVIS, COCO, and SA-Co), semantic segmentation, and zero-shot detection (ODinW13 and RF-100VL). With an off-the-shelf Gemini-3.7-Flash backend, LLMSeg is competitive with and often surpasses the specialist SAM 3 model on identical items. It reaches 71.5 cIoU on ReasonSeg val without additional segmentation-specific training. Backend model updates can improve accuracy without retraining the pipeline. The code is available at https://abdullahamdi.com/llmseg .

AI.tldr: LLMSeg 提出一种免训练流程，将通用多模态大语言模型直接用作文本提示图像分割器，无需分割头、掩码解码器或额外训练，性能可与专用模型 SAM 3 相当甚至超越。
AI.motivation: 现有可提示分割模型（如 SAM 3）虽具备出色的开放词汇能力，但依赖专用架构、大规模标注引擎和任务特定训练。作者由此提出反向问题：通用 MLLM 能否在无分割头、无解码器、无训练的条件下直接完成图像分割。
AI.method: 将分割分解为三个由 LLM 驱动的阶段：(1) detect：定位所有匹配自由文本查询的实例并描述其粗粒度形态；(2) segment：在检测框内用闭合周期 B 样条描绘每个实例，样条定义外边界及可选的孔洞环；(3) refine：围绕残余误差提出聚焦框并重新描绘受限样条，迭代至掩码稳定或预算耗尽。输出为带可检验中间几何的二值掩码。
AI.result: 在十个指代与推理分割划分（ReasonSeg、RefCOCO/+/g）上评测，并扩展至开放词汇实例分割（LVIS、COCO、SA-Co）、语义分割与零样本检测（ODinW13、RF-100VL）。使用现成 Gemini-3.7-Flash 后端时，LLMSeg 在相同条目上可与专用 SAM 3 竞争且常超越，ReasonSeg val 上达到 71.5 cIoU，且无需任何分割专用训练。
AI.conclusion: 通用 MLLM 无需改造即可作为分割器使用；后端模型升级可直接提升精度而无需重训流程，表明"模型能力驱动、几何表示解耦"的免训练分割范式具有可行性与可扩展性。

title: First Passage Attention
summary: Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. In synthetic experiments, one-layer FPA heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and FoX baselines fail on every seed. Scaling to a 110M-parameter language model, FPA matches FoX in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at $8\times$ the training length, even with its key--value cache compressed to about $25\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出 First Passage Attention (FPA)，将遗忘门从沿路径的单调累加改为路径极值（最深下降），使注意力能选择性擦除中间上下文同时保留更早的结构相关 token；FPA 将 FoX 作为特例，并在合成与 110M 语言模型实验中优于 softmax/FoX 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有带遗忘门的 softmax 注意力通过沿 key–query 路径累加衰减贡献实现遗忘，这种累加是单调的，因而无法在保留较早、结构相关 token 的同时选择性擦除中间上下文。
AI.method: 把路径求和改为路径极值：用一个学习到的标量场，依据该场在 key 到 query 区间内低于该 key 水平的最深"下降"（first passage / dip）按比例下调 key 的 logit。FoX 是其在特定设置下的特例；当标量场与 key 水平共享一条学习到的随机游走时，未受惩罚的"存活" key 自然构成栈结构。作者进一步给出表达能力分析：常数维 FPA 头可实现任意由后续下降所留下的 key 子集，而带位置偏置或 token 级遗忘门的 softmax 头需要与 key 数量成线性的头维度。
AI.result: 合成实验中单层 FPA 头收敛到目标 key 集合，而可比的 softmax 与 FoX 基线在所有随机种子上均失败；扩展到 110M 参数语言模型时，FPA 的困惑度与 FoX 相当，并唯一在 8 倍训练长度上实现完美的 passkey 检索，即使 KV cache 压缩至约 25%。
AI.conclusion: 以路径极值替代路径累加是一种更有效的遗忘机制，兼具理论表达优势（常数维即可实现任意存活子集）、长上下文外推能力与 KV cache 压缩兼容性。

title: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

AI.tldr: 针对RLVR（以GRPO为代表）引发的分布锐化问题，提出Flat-RLVR：在LLM后训练中通过锐度感知最小化搜索平坦奖励区域，使策略分布更平滑，在保持单次准确率的同时提升采样多样性。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽有效提升LLM推理能力，但会导致分布锐化——策略分布过度尖峰化，稀有但正确的轨迹被逐步压制，样本多样性下降。作者希望缓解这一副作用。
AI.method: 提出"平坦奖励最优"目标以平滑策略分布；理论上建立平坦奖励RLVR与分布锐化减轻之间的联系；实现上采用锐度感知最小化（sharpness-aware minimization）在LLM后训练中搜索平坦奖励区域，并与GRPO变体结合。
AI.result: 理论上证明了平坦奖励RLVR可减少分布锐化；实验上显示采样多样性提升，同时单次尝试准确率（single-attempt accuracy）得以保持。
AI.conclusion: Flat-RLVR通过追求平坦奖励最优，在采样效率与推理能力之间取得更优权衡，为缓解RLVR的分布锐化提供了一条有效途径。

title: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
summary: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challenge for agent evolution. Here we introduce DeepEvolve, a sustainable evolution agent system grounded in future event prediction, in which agents continuously interact with a dynamically evolving environment and improve by internalizing and externalizing the experience gained through these interactions. A living environment synthesizes verifiable tasks, and a recursive-evolution engine turns the reasoning trajectory behind each prediction back into capability: decoupling search from prediction adapts parameter-level evolution to the contamination-prone live environment, while distilling reusable skills lets the agent evolve from the limited live trajectories such an environment affords. On the external FutureX leaderboard, which evaluates predictions against real-world outcomes and is updated weekly, our self-improved forecaster ranked first across all systems over three consecutive weeks, achieving up to a 195% improvement in rating. On our synthesized evaluation, it ranked among the top three across four base LLMs, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 10.7 Bradley--Terry points. More broadly, these results suggest that a system built for self-improvement is best understood as an agent that co-evolves with a genuinely living, open-ended environment, pointing to a shift in AI from training static models on fixed data toward cultivating agents that grow stronger from their own experience, with such an open world as the indispensable basis of that growth.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepEvolve——一个基于未来事件预测的可持续进化智能体系统，通过与动态演化环境持续交互、将交互经验内化与外化，实现递归自我改进（RSI），并在实时榜单FutureX上连续三周排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统参数冻结、依赖外部更新，而理想系统应能从自身经验中持续提升（RSI）。但研究RSI缺乏同时满足"持续变化、客观可验证、自然有依据"的环境，这是智能体进化的根本挑战。
AI.method: 以未来事件预测为任务载体构建DeepEvolve：1）"活环境"合成可验证任务；2）递归进化引擎将每次预测背后的推理轨迹转化为能力，其中"搜索与预测解耦"使参数级进化适应易污染的实时环境，"可复用技能蒸馏"使智能体从有限的实时轨迹中进化。
AI.result: 在每周更新的真实结果评估榜单FutureX上，自改进预测器连续三周在所有系统中排名第一，评分提升最高达195%；在自建合成评测中，于四个基座LLM上均进入前三，最高超出最强基线10.7个Bradley–Terry分。
AI.conclusion: 自改进系统应被理解为与真正"活"的开放式环境共同进化的智能体，标志着AI从在固定数据上训练静态模型，转向培育能凭自身经验变强的智能体，而开放世界是这种成长不可或缺的基础。

title: CCG Diffusion: Combinatory Categorial Grammar-Driven Compositional and Syntactically Disambiguated Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. We propose CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that controls image generation using Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG). In CCG, the category of each word carries rich syntactic information: it specifies what the word combines with and what phrase it forms. Modification relations between words can therefore be read directly from a CCG parse. Moreover, prepositional phrase (PP) attachment ambiguity, a representative syntactic ambiguity, can be resolved simply by fixing the preposition's category. CCG Diffusion applies the same two CCG-based mechanisms, prompt rewriting and attention guidance, both to controlling attribute binding, spatial relations, and counts and to resolving PP ambiguity. On two architecturally different backbones, Stable Diffusion and Sana, CCG Diffusion achieves the highest scores among the compared methods in attribute binding and 2D spatial relations and significantly outperforms all of them in PP ambiguity resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 CCG Diffusion，用组合范畴语法（CCG）解析直接读出词语修饰关系并固定介词范畴来消解 PP 附着歧义，通过提示重写与注意力引导统一控制属性绑定、空间关系、数量及句法歧义生成。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型不显式接收提示的句法结构（谁修饰谁、短语如何附着），导致属性绑定错误、空间关系与数量描绘不准、句法歧义提示无法按意图解读。现有基于句法的控制方法主要解决属性绑定，对空间关系、数量和歧义解释控制有限；且依赖短语结构或依存语法，需额外规则或树约束才能提取修饰关系或指定句法解释。
AI.method: CCG Diffusion：免训练方法，采用 Combinatory Categorial Grammar（CCG）。每个词的范畴自带丰富句法信息，规定其与什么组合、形成什么短语，因此修饰关系可直接从 CCG 解析中读取；PP 附着歧义可通过固定介词范畴直接消解。基于同一套两种机制——提示重写（prompt rewriting）与注意力引导（attention guidance）——同时实现属性绑定、空间关系、数量的控制及 PP 歧义消解。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 与 Sana 两种架构不同的骨干上，CCG Diffusion 在属性绑定与 2D 空间关系上取得对比方法中最高分，在 PP 歧义消解上显著优于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: CCG 的范畴化句法信息可作为统一、免训练的文生图句法控制接口，无需额外规则或树结构约束即可同时处理属性绑定、空间关系、数量与 PP 附着歧义，且跨骨干架构有效。

title: Approximate Solomonoff Induction: On the Robustness of Learned Universal Predictors
summary: Why large language models trained via log-loss minimization over massive and diverse datasets exhibit broad capabilities and generalizable skills is not yet fully understood. Grau-Moya et al. (ICML 2024) offer a conceptual explanation through the lens of meta-learning: if sequence-generating environments $ν$ are drawn from a prior $w_ν$, minimizing population log-loss recovers the corresponding Bayesian mixture predictor $ξ=\sum_νw_νν$. In the idealized limit in which $w$ is a universal prior, the optimal predictor corresponds to Solomonoff universal induction. Practical machine learning algorithms, however, generally produce only \emph{approximately} optimal predictors. This raises a natural question: \emph{Does the prediction performance remain robust under approximation}? In this paper, we first provide a tight bound on the worst-case effect of approximation on prediction error. We show any predictor $ρ$ satisfying $D_{KL}(ξ\|ρ)\leq η$ retains bounded cumulative-expected-squared prediction error. However, while the Bayesian mixture predictor $ξ$ has error $O(\log(1/w_μ))$ in an environment $μ$, we establish a tight $Θ(η/w_μ)$ bound on the excess error of $ρ$ relative to $ξ$. Thus, approximation can substantially degrade performance in environments assigned small prior probability. In sharp contrast, when environments are averaged according to prior $w$, we prove that the excess prediction error is only $O(η)$. Furthermore, we establish a distribution-shift theorem for dominated shifts from a training prior $w$ to a test prior $w'$, interpolating our average-case and worst-case guarantees. Finally, we extend our robustness analysis to a finite-sampling setting relevant to learning universal predictors with neural networks and Transformers, where $D_{KL}(ξ\|ρ)$ could be unbounded. [For the full abstract, see the paper.]

AI.tldr: 本文研究「近似最优预测器」在贝叶斯混合/所罗门诺夫归纳框架下的鲁棒性：证明 $D_{KL}(\xi\|\rho)\le\eta$ 的预测器累积误差有界，但相对 $\xi$ 的额外误差存在紧的 $\Theta(\eta/w_\mu)$ 最坏界；按先验平均则为 $O(\eta)$，并给出分布偏移定理与有限采样扩展。
AI.motivation:
Grau-Moya 等（ICML 2024）用元学习视角把大模型能力解释为最小化总体对数损失即逼近贝叶斯混合预测器 $\xi=\sum_
u w_
u
u$，极端情形下对应 Solomonoff 通用归纳。但实际算法（SGD、有限数据、有限容量）只能得到近似最优预测器，已有理论未回答「近似是否会破坏预测性能的鲁棒性」，即误差如何随近似程度 $\eta$ 与先验质量 $w_\mu$ 变化。
AI.method: 以 $\xi$ 与任意预测器 $\rho$ 的 KL 散度 $D_{KL}(\xi\|\rho)\le\eta$ 刻画近似程度：(1) 推导近似对预测误差最坏影响的紧界，分析累积期望平方误差(excess error)；(2) 分别在单环境 $\mu$ 的最坏情形与按先验 $w$ 的平均情形下给出 $w_\mu$ 与 $\eta$ 的依赖关系；(3) 证明从训练先验 $w$ 到测试先验 $w'$ 的支配型分布偏移定理，统一平均与最坏两种保证；(4) 推广到 $D_{KL}$ 可能无界的有限采样（神经网络/Transformer 训练）设定。
AI.result: (1) 任何满足 $D_{KL}(\xi\|\rho)\le\eta$ 的 $\rho$ 其累积期望平方预测误差有界；(2) $\xi$ 在环境 $\mu$ 中误差为 $O(\log(1/w_\mu))$，而 $\rho$ 相对 $\xi$ 的额外误差存在紧的 $\Theta(\eta/w_\mu)$ 界——先验概率小的环境性能可被显著恶化；(3) 按先验 $w$ 平均时额外误差仅为 $O(\eta)$，与最坏情形形成鲜明对比；(4) 给出支配型先验偏移定理，在两极端之间插值；(5) 有限采样情形下给出鲁棒性分析。
AI.conclusion: 近似最优性并非一致鲁棒：度量 $D_{KL}$ 下的小近似误差可在低先验概率环境被放大至 $\Theta(\eta/w_\mu)$ 的额外误差，但在先验平均意义下退化仅为 $O(\eta)$，分布偏移定理刻画二者过渡。这为理解大模型「近似贝叶斯混合」的泛化与失效模式、以及通用预测器的有限样本训练提供理论依据。

title: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Companion paper to arXiv:2601.13749
summary: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the rate unchanged, but removing the 7% of instruction examples that concern AI cuts it by 14 percentage points, below the level of the pretrained models it starts from. Data rewarding helpfulness raise it by 9 points, while data ranked by the preferences of diverse simulated users lower it by 9. Finally, with models held fixed, asking for the "best" option or for what to do "right now" raises the rate by 8 and 18 points, whereas telling the model it is an AI advisor adds 4. Overall, the tendency starts in pretraining, and what models learn afterward, together with how a question is phrased, decides how strongly it appears.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在回答"学什么、做什么职业、做什么产品"时倾向推荐AI相关选项。该倾向源于预训练，并由后续微调数据与提问措辞共同放大或削弱。
AI.motivation: 作者关注LLM在建议类问题上系统性偏向AI相关答案这一现象，旨在厘清其来源：是预训练固有，还是指令微调/对齐训练所致，以及提问方式的影响。
AI.method: 对比预训练模型与已发布指令微调模型；自行做多组微调实验（通用指令微调、删除涉及AI的7%指令样本、以有用性为奖励的数据、以多样模拟用户偏好排序的数据）；并在固定模型条件下变换提问方式（"最佳"选项、"现在"该做什么、告知模型其为AI顾问）。以推荐中含明确AI/ML术语的比例为指标。
AI.result: 预训练模型27%的回答含AI/ML术语，已发布指令微调版本达59%。通用指令微调不改变该比例；删除AI相关指令样本使其下降14个百分点，甚至低于起点；有用性奖励数据使其上升9个百分点，多样模拟用户偏好排序数据使其下降9个百分点。固定模型时，问"最佳"提升8个百分点，问"现在"提升18个百分点，告知其为AI顾问提升4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该AI推荐倾向始于预训练阶段，微调内容（而非微调本身）与问题措辞共同决定其显现强度；通过调整指令数据与偏好数据可显著削弱该偏差。

title: Look Beyond the Question: Preserve-Focus-Fuse for Whole-Slide Image Question Answering
summary: A question about a whole-slide image rarely names every morphological finding needed to answer it. Question-guided patch selection can therefore overlook supporting morphology, while slide-level compression can dilute focal evidence. Inspired by how pathologists combine broad slide review, question-directed examination, and integration of their findings, we introduce BEYONDPATH, a Preserve-Focus-Fuse framework for whole-slide image question answering. Preserve learns a question-agnostic Morphology Bank through answer supervision across multiple questions about each training slide. Focus retrieves questionspecific evidence from all foreground patches, including regions outside the Bank. Fuse integrates the preserved morphology at the retrieved evidence positions through Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion, producing a fixed 96-token visual prefix. On WSI-Bench, BEYONDPATH achieves an Avg-9 of 0.769 and leads all eight reported report-generation metrics using the same checkpoint. It also achieves 0.639 zero-shot overall accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB. Controlled ablations show complementary benefits from morphology preservation and question-directed retrieval, and support cross-question supervision and fusion at the evidence positions. These results support looking beyond the question's explicit cues: preserving broader slide morphology while retaining the ability to seek evidence for each question.

AI.tldr: BEYONDPATH：面向全切片图像问答的"保留-聚焦-融合"框架，兼顾全局形态保留与问题定向取证。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像（WSI）问答问题通常不会指明回答所需的全部形态学线索：问题导向的patch选择易遗漏支撑性形态，而切片级压缩又会稀释局灶性证据。作者受病理医生"整体浏览—问题定向检视—整合所见"的工作流程启发，试图同时保留广泛形态信息并保留按问题定向取证的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出Preserve-Focus-Fuse三阶段框架。Preserve：通过每张训练切片对应多个问题的答案监督，学习与问题无关的"形态库"（Morphology Bank）。Focus：从全部前景patch（含形态库之外区域）中检索问题特异证据。Fuse：通过"Morphology-on-Visual-Evidence Fusion"将保留的形态注入检索到的证据位置，生成固定96 token的视觉前缀。
AI.result: 在WSI-Bench上Avg-9达0.769，且在同一checkpoint下于8项报告生成指标上均领先；在SlideBench-BCNB上实现0.639的零样本总体准确率。
AI.conclusion: 受控消融显示形态保留与问题定向检索具有互补收益，并支持跨问题监督与证据位置融合，说明应超越问题的显式线索：在保留更广泛切片形态的同时保持对每个问题取证的能力。

title: ExpEvolve: Structuring and Reusing Experience for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. In this work, we propose ExpEvolve, which injects idea-level extraction and control into evolution: it discovers and leverages the high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences among different programs. We characterize theoretical conditions on when discovery with idea factors improves sample efficiency. We also build a practical framework to show that the extracted high-level idea factors are helpful for guiding exploitation from experience and exploration when discovery comes to a plateau. Across 11 open-ended mathematical tasks, ExpEvolve significantly improves the final performance and sample efficiency up to 5.0x. The improvements also transfer to 4 other LLMs and to 6 machine learning tasks from MLS-Bench. Analysis shows that ExpEvolve can discover idea-level factors to provide better exploration and exploitation for evolutionary discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExpEvolve，将"想法层面"的因子提取与控制引入演化式编码智能体，从程序中挖掘可解释评分差异的高层因子，理论上刻画其提效条件，并在11个开放式数学任务上实现最优性能与最高5.0倍样本效率提升，且可迁移至其他LLM与MLS-Bench任务。
AI.motivation: AlphaEvolve 等演化编码智能体虽成功，但其变异主要停留在程序表层启发式的低层次操作，缺乏持久的控制单元；而科学知识的积累本质上是"想法（idea）"层面的复合，因此需要把想法级别的抽象引入演化过程。
AI.method: ExpEvolve 从候选程序中提取能解释程序间评分差异的高层"想法因子（idea factors）"，并将其作为演化中的持久控制单元：一方面给出理论条件，刻画基于想法因子进行发现何时能提升样本效率；另一方面构建实用框架，用提取出的高层想法因子指导经验利用（exploitation），并在发现进入平台期时引导探索（exploration）。
AI.result: 在11个开放式数学任务上，ExpEvolve 显著提升最终性能与样本效率（最高5.0倍）；改进可迁移到另外4个LLM以及 MLS-Bench 的6个机器学习任务；分析表明其确实能发现想法级别的因子，从而为演化发现提供更好的探索与利用。
AI.conclusion: 将想法层面的提取与控制注入程序演化，可弥补低层次表层变异缺乏持久控制单元的缺陷；理论与实验共同支持该范式的有效性与可迁移性，为 LLM 驱动的 AI Scientist 提供了更具科学积累特性的演化机制。

title: MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAPS框架，通过"搜索动量"概念刻画推理过程中查询意图的演化，并采用宏观自适应并行推理来调控搜索动量、缓解查询意图漂移，在六个问答基准上超越代表性RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 现有交错式（交错推理与检索）RAG方法存在子查询冗余或无效、查询探索多样性不足的问题；且由于推理与检索紧密交错，难以厘清演化中的推理过程如何影响查询意图。
AI.method: 引入"搜索动量"（search momentum），即沿推理轨迹由历史子查询变化累积形成的检索倾向，并据此分析发现查询生成倾向于沿既有检索轨迹持续演化。基于此提出MAPS（Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning）框架：先保留检索到的知识与精炼的推理状态，以降低历史推理轨迹对后续子查询生成的影响；再将传统串行推理扩展为并行推理范式，每次迭代识别互补检索方向、并行生成对应子查询并整合检索证据以更新知识与推理状态。
AI.result: 在六个问答基准上，MAPS在不同骨干模型下均持续优于代表性RAG方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过调控搜索动量并采用并行推理可有效缓解查询意图漂移、提升检索多样性与RAG效果；代码与资源已开源。

title: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.

AI.tldr: ALLOT：一种免训练的稀疏度分配方法，通过单元探测与轨迹校准估计各"层-去噪步"对最终视频误差的贡献，在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元密度，在等时或更短耗时下取得最优画质。
AI.motivation: 视频 Diffusion Transformer 中全 3D 注意力开销高昂，块稀疏注意力可降成本，但现有方法忽视稀疏度分配优化，或依赖启发式规则与局部指标来指导分配。
AI.method: 观察到不同层与不同去噪步的稀疏化对最终视频保真度影响差异显著，且最敏感的"层-步"组合在不同输入间几乎不变。据此将每个层-步对视为一个单元，通过(i)单元探测与(ii)轨迹校准估计其对最终视频误差的贡献，再在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元密度；保留既有选择策略与 kernel，仅替换分配组件。
AI.result: 在等时或更短墙钟时间下，ALLOT 配合 XAttention 优于所有对比分配策略，在 HunyuanVideo 上 PSNR 提升 11.8 dB；在 Wan2.1、Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 上共四个已发表流水线的九个设置中，全部优于或持平默认配置。
AI.conclusion: 层-步维度的敏感度分布稳定可迁移，可作为免训练稀疏度分配的有效依据；ALLOT 作为可插拔的分配模块，与现有稀疏注意力机制正交结合，广泛适用。

title: Interpretable Cutting Plane Selection for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Using Genetic Programming
summary: Cutting planes (cuts) remove fractional solutions from mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) without excluding any feasible integer solutions, making them a key ingredient in modern MILP solvers. Current state-of-the-art solvers rely on fine-tuned handcrafted cut strategies, which, despite their effectiveness, remain inherently static and can be suboptimal. More recently, learning-based approaches have been proposed to design adaptive cut strategies; however, most of these methods are based on neural networks, offering limited interpretability and providing no guarantees of convergence. In this paper, we propose \emph{Genetic Programming and Statistics-based Cut Selection} (GPSCS), the first learning-based framework that explicitly generalizes handcrafted cut selection heuristics into a fully interpretable policy. First, a genetic programming model evolves a symbolic scoring function that ranks candidate cuts using features derived from the cuts and the solving context. Second, a lightweight statistics-based mechanism adaptively determines the number of top-ranked cuts to add at each separation round by detecting significant score dropouts. We evaluate GPSCS within the SCIP solver on seven classes of synthetic and real-world benchmark instances, with a strong emphasis on generalization: evaluation instances are on average 41 times harder than those used for training. Experimental results show that GPSCS improves average solving time by $6\%$ compared to SCIP's default cut selection strategy and achieves a two-fold speedup over both a recent neural-network-based approach and a no-cut baseline, demonstrating strong robustness and generalization across heterogeneous MILP families.

AI.tldr: 提出GPSCS：用遗传编程演化可解释的割平面评分函数，并用统计机制自适应确定每轮加入的割数量，在SCIP中平均提速6%，较神经网络方法快约2倍。
AI.motivation: 现代MILP求解器的割平面选择依赖人工调优的静态启发式，难以适应不同场景；已有学习型方法多为神经网络，可解释性差且无收敛保证。
AI.method: 首个将手工割选择启发式显式泛化为可解释策略的学习框架：1）遗传编程演化符号化评分函数，基于割特征与求解上下文对候选割排序；2）轻量级基于统计的机制，通过检测得分显著掉落自适应确定每轮加入的top-ranked割数量。
AI.result: 在SCIP中于7类合成与真实基准实例上评测，测试实例平均比训练实例难41倍；相比SCIP默认割选择策略平均求解时间缩短6%，相比近期神经网络方法与无割基线均实现约2倍加速，跨异构MILP族展现良好鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: GPSCS以可解释的符号化策略实现自适应割选择，性能优于手工启发式与神经网络方法，并具备强泛化能力。

title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.

AI.tldr: 该短篇实证研究在LoCoMo单一对话上比较四种记忆方案与三种编码智能体，结论是：智能体记忆是弱模型的高成本补丁，对强模型价值有限，模型强到能自行检索时，让智能体直接搜索原始历史更优。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统（如Mem0、Zep）在问题到来前就预先决定保留什么，而编码智能体保留原始历史并用自身工具检索。作者追问：当模型足够强、能自行检索时，预先设计的记忆是否仍有增益，以及各方案的成本与精度权衡如何。
AI.method: 在LoCoMo的一段对话（419轮、152个问题）上进行单次运行、单格单跑的短篇实证。对比四种记忆方法（完整上下文、BM25、Mem0、Zep）与三种编码智能体（Pi、Codex、Claude Code），每格分别搭配GPT-4o-mini、GPT-6 Luna和Claude Opus 5.5，并记录每次rollout的成本。
AI.result: Mem0仅在搭配GPT-4o-mini时优于完整上下文，且其构建成本本身高于一次完整上下文rollout。记忆存在由写入模型决定的上限，更强的读取模型无法弥补弱写入模型的遗漏。使用Claude Opus 5.5时，Pi位于成本-精度前沿最优点，以不到完整上下文一半的成本达到99%得分，其唯一失分源于答案键错误。领先部分来自仅智能体能读取的照片说明；在88个证据不含图片的问题上，Pi与完整上下文的答案仅差一个。
AI.conclusion: 智能体记忆本质上是弱模型的高成本补丁，其上界由写入模型决定。当模型具备自主检索能力时，保留原始历史并让智能体自行搜索在成本与精度上更有优势；设计的记忆系统仅在模型能力受限时才有明显价值。

title: Beyond Shortcut Learning: Hierarchical Spatial Prototype Regularization for Face Forgery Detection
summary: Recent advances in generative models have enabled highly realistic face forgeries, yet generalizing deepfake detectors to unseen manipulation pipelines remains a major challenge. One critical yet underexplored issue is that the learned forensic representation itself may fail to remain stable across different manipulation sources. In this paper, we provide new evidence that naively fine-tuned vision models suffer from severe \textit{forensic representation collapse}: their extracted cues are often entangled with unstable, dataset-specific artifacts, resulting in structurally fragile representations and poor cross-domain generalization. Leveraging this insight, we propose \textbf{H}ierarchical \textbf{S}patial \textbf{P}rototype (\textbf{HSP}) regularization, which explicitly models the forgery manifold by learning a structured prototype subspace over spatial features. We further introduce prototype orthogonality and second-order assignment balance, which jointly preserve the geometric independence of latent forgery factors and promote high-effective-rank utilization of the forensic representation, thereby reducing reliance on dataset-specific shortcuts. Empirical results demonstrate that our method substantially improves generalizability, yielding average frame-level AUC gains of 5.6\% and 5.3\% in the cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings, respectively. Moreover, when used as a plug-in module, HSP boosts the average video-level AUC of existing state-of-the-art detectors to 95.3\% (+1.8\%). These results demonstrate the practical value of HSP as an easy-to-adopt regularization module for enhancing deepfake detectors.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化空间原型(HSP)正则化，建模伪造流形以缓解"取证表征崩溃"，提升深度伪造检测器的跨域与跨操纵泛化。
AI.motivation: 生成模型使伪造人脸高度逼真，检测器泛化到未见操纵流程仍是难题；作者指出一个被忽视的关键问题：朴素微调的视觉模型存在"取证表征崩溃"，即提取的线索与不稳定的、数据集特有的伪影纠缠，导致表征结构脆弱、跨域泛化差。
AI.method: 在空间特征上学习结构化原型子空间，显式建模伪造流形；并引入原型正交性与二阶分配均衡，保持潜在伪造因子的几何独立性、促进表征的有效秩利用，从而降低对数据集特定捷径的依赖。可作为插件模块使用。
AI.result: 跨数据集与跨操纵设置下帧级AUC平均提升5.6%和5.3%；作为插件将现有SOTA检测器视频级AUC提升至95.3%(+1.8%)。
AI.conclusion: HSP是一种易于采用的正则化模块，能有效增强深度伪造检测器的泛化能力，具有实际应用价值。

title: YingLan: A Multimodal Ocean Foundation Model for Unified Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations. Existing approaches largely focus on task-specific ocean modeling, while learning transferable representations from heterogeneous observations remains an open problem. To address this challenge, we propose YingLan, a multimodal ocean foundation model that integrates physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining. Specifically, the dynamic encoding mechanism generates adaptive input projections conditioned on physical semantics and observation characteristics, enabling flexible representation of heterogeneous ocean variables. STIC models multiscale spatiotemporal dependencies through cross-scale interactions of latent temporal increments. The pretraining strategy further combines masked observation reconstruction with temporal evolution objectives to facilitate the learning of coherent ocean-state representations across different prediction horizons. YingLan is implemented using MindSpore and trained on Huawei Ascend 910B NPUs, demonstrating its compatibility with domestic AI computing infrastructure. In a seven-day sea surface salinity (SSS) forecasting task conducted in the Shenzhen coastal waters, YingLan achieves an average RMSE of 0.687508 PSU, corresponding to relative error reductions of 0.58%, 5.31%, and 12.42% compared with LangYa, XiHe, and GloNet2, respectively. These results provide initial evidence of the model's effectiveness in regional ocean forecasting, while broader cross-task and cross-regional evaluations remain necessary to assess its generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态海洋基础模型YingLan，融合物理属性条件动态编码、时空增量耦合(STIC)与状态演化感知预训练，在深圳近海7天表层盐度预报中RMSE为0.687508 PSU，相对误差较LangYa、XiHe、GloNet2分别降低0.58%、5.31%、12.42%。
AI.motivation: 卫星影像、网格化海洋要素场与浮标观测在数据结构、物理语义和时空特性上高度异质，现有多数方法局限于任务专用的海洋建模，如何从异质观测中学习可迁移表征仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 构建多模态海洋基础模型YingLan：1) 物理属性条件化的动态编码机制，按物理语义与观测特性生成自适应输入投影，统一表征异质海洋变量；2) 时空增量耦合(STIC)模块，通过潜变量时间增量的跨尺度交互刻画多尺度时空依赖；3) 状态演化感知预训练，将掩码观测重建与时间演化目标结合，学习跨预测horizon的一致海洋状态表征。基于MindSpore实现并在昇腾910B NPU上训练。
AI.result: 在深圳近海7天表层盐度(SSS)预报任务中平均RMSE为0.687508 PSU，相对LangYa、XiHe、GloNet2分别降低0.58%、5.31%和12.42%；同时验证了与国产AI算力基础设施(MindSpore+昇腾910B)的兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 结果初步证明该模型在区域海洋预报中的有效性；作者指出尚需跨任务、跨区域的更广泛评估以检验其泛化能力。

title: S-EDL: Eliciting Self-Evidence from Sequence Likelihoods for Semantic Calibration of LLMs
summary: Calibrating large language models (LLMs) in open-ended generation is uniquely challenging because many distinct token sequences can express the same underlying meaning. Prior calibration techniques target either fixed-set classification confidence or the binary correctness of individual strings, making them inherently ill-suited for the dynamic, multi-string nature of open-ended semantic outcomes. To bridge this gap, we introduce S-EDL, a novel evidential method that natively optimizes LLMs for semantic calibration. By eliciting evidence from the sequence likelihoods of the model itself, S-EDL constructs a differentiable Dirichlet prior over prompt-specific semantic classes. Optimizing the evidential loss under this prior yields a calibration-aware training signal over variable semantic classes, completely bypassing the need for fixed multiple-choice options. Evaluations across four open-ended benchmarks and three models demonstrate that S-EDL substantially reduces semantic calibration error while improving accuracy. By aligning generative likelihoods with semantic correctness, this work establishes a framework for deploying trustworthy LLMs in complex, open-ended applications. Code is available at: https://github.com/sandylaker/s-edl.

AI.tldr: 提出S-EDL，一种基于证据学习（EDL）的方法，通过构造可微的Dirichlet先验对语义等价类建模，实现开放生成场景下的语义校准，在四个基准与三个模型上显著降低语义校准误差并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 开放生成任务的校准具有独特挑战：同一语义可由多条不同token序列表达。既有校准方法只针对固定集合分类置信度或单字符串二值正确性，与开放语义结果的多字符串、动态类别特性不匹配，因此需要原生面向语义校准的方法。
AI.method: S-EDL：从模型自身的序列似然中获取证据，针对提示特定的语义类别构造可微的Dirichlet先验；在该先验下优化证据损失，从而在变化的语义类别上产生校准感知的训练信号，完全无需固定的多项选择选项。
AI.result: 在四个开放生成基准和三个模型上进行评估，S-EDL显著降低语义校准误差，同时提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过使生成似然与语义正确性对齐，该工作为在复杂开放应用中部署可信LLM建立了框架，代码已开源。

title: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training
summary: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention. However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations. We uncover a topology-first, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallow-layer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BlazeVGGT, a training-free framework for structure-aware frame-level key--value sparsification. At each global-attention block, BlazeVGGT constructs a view-level similarity kernel from camera-token relations and employs greedy determinantal point process inference to select a compact set of mutually complementary views. The selected views constitute the key--value context, while all input frames are retained as queries. This asymmetric attention design preserves dense per-frame predictions while eliminating redundant cross-view computation, allowing our method to be directly integrated into pretrained VGGT as a plug-and-play module without parameter updates. Its advantages become increasingly pronounced with sequence length: at 2,000 frames, BlazeVGGT achieves approximately 13$\times$ faster inference than VGGT while reducing the Chamfer Distance from 0.41 to 0.32. Extensive experiments demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off in point-cloud reconstruction and camera-pose estimation, compatibility with existing VGGT accelerators such as FastVGGT and LiteVGGT, and transferability to VGGT-based models including StreamVGGT and PAGE-4D. Codes are publicly available at https://github.com/MagiciannnY/BlazeVGGT.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BlazeVGGT，一个无需训练的即插即用框架，通过视图级结构感知的键值稀疏化，消除 VGGT 中全对全跨视图注意力的冗余计算，在 2000 帧序列上实现约 13 倍加速并降低 Chamfer Distance。
AI.motivation: VGGT 类前馈视觉几何模型依赖稠密全局注意力实现多视图重建，但全对全跨视图计算随视数二次增长，长序列推理代价高昂；同时高度重叠观测带来大量帧级冗余。作者还观察到 VGGT 相机 token 呈"先拓扑后几何"的演化规律，为稀疏化提供依据。
AI.method: 浅层相机 token 可靠刻画局部视图邻域、深层 token 渐进编码全局视图间几何关系。BlazeVGGT 在每个全局注意力块中，基于相机 token 关系构建视图级相似性核，并用贪心行列式点过程（DPP）推理选取一组互相补充的紧凑视图作为键值上下文，而所有输入帧仍保留为查询，形成非对称注意力设计，无需参数更新即可插入预训练 VGGT。
AI.result: 在 2000 帧时推理速度约为 VGGT 的 13 倍，Chamfer Distance 由 0.41 降至 0.32；在点云重建与相机位姿估计上取得良好的精度-效率权衡，且兼容 FastVGGT、LiteVGGT 等加速器，并可迁移到 StreamVGGT、PAGE-4D 等基于 VGGT 的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于相机 token 演化规律的结构感知 KV 稀疏化能在不训练的前提下显著提升长序列效率并保持甚至改善精度，具有良好通用性与可组合性。

title: DISRL: Dual-Scale Incremental Semi-Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Community Tracking
summary: Dynamic local community detection tracks the evolving community of designated seed nodes across graph snapshots. However, it faces two critical challenges: temporal supervision uncertainty, where sparse and outdated labels fail to provide seed-specific guidance under topology changes, and unbounded error cascades, where sequential policy transfer accumulates exploration errors over long horizons. To address these challenges, we propose DISRL, a Dual-scale Incremental Semi-supervised Reinforcement Learning framework. DISRL introduces a supervision construction module that dynamically generates seed-specific guidance from sparse known communities, and a dual-scale community exploration module that stabilizes policy evolution by decoupling short-term adaptation within temporal windows from long-term parameter consolidation across windows. Furthermore, we construct a dynamic graph benchmark with diverse community evolution scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DISRL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under various dynamic settings.

AI.tldr: 提出DISRL——双尺度增量半监督强化学习框架，用于动态局部社区检测，解决时序监督不确定与误差级联两大问题。
AI.motivation: 动态局部社区检测需在多个图快照中追踪指定种子节点的演化社区，但面临两个关键挑战：(1) 时序监督不确定性——标签稀疏且过时，在拓扑变化下无法提供种子特定引导；(2) 无界误差级联——顺序策略迁移在长时程上累积探索误差。
AI.method: DISRL包含两个核心模块：(1) 监督构建模块，从稀疏已知社区中动态生成种子特定引导信号，以半监督方式缓解标签稀疏/过时问题；(2) 双尺度社区探索模块，将时间窗口内的短期适应与跨窗口的长期参数固化解耦，从而稳定策略演化、抑制误差累积。此外构建了含多样社区演化场景的动态图基准。
AI.result: 在多种动态设置下的大量实验表明，DISRL持续优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过半监督监督构建与双尺度策略演化机制，DISRL有效应对动态局部社区检测中的监督不确定性与误差级联问题，并在新构建的动态图基准上取得一致领先性能。

title: Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training
summary: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将“概念增强”（用概念相关词替换目标词生成微变句）从名词扩展到动词和形容词，考察承载概念信号的词性（POS）是否影响困惑度、下游性能与内部表征。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测（NTP）奖励预测特定token，而不显式建模不同词语或表达间的语义相似性；已有概念增强方法可缓解该问题，但其有效性是否依赖于概念在句子中出现的位置/词性尚不明确。
AI.method: 复现并扩展既有的“概念增强”工作：以最小变异的句子增强训练数据，将名词替换扩展至动词与形容词，比较不同POS下的困惑度与下游任务表现；并使用CKA与线性探针进行表征分析。
AI.result: 概念增强在新闻语料上的困惑度提升最稳定，且与POS无关；动词带来的下游增益最可靠。CKA与线性探针显示，下游增益最大的条件未必是内部表征改变最大的条件。
AI.conclusion: 概念增强的有效性取决于训练中概念信息“在何处”以及“以何种方式”引入；行为层面的收益与表征层面的变化并不一致对应。

title: Extending Affordance Segmentation for Wearable Robots to Multi-Object Images
summary: This paper proposes a refinement to existing vision-based portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts. Such pipelines can effectively support automatic grasp selection and preshaping in upper-limb prosthetic devices. However, realistic scenarios in which multiple objects are present still represent a challenge. The proposed method exploits a minor modification to the conventional hardware setup and a custom training approach to extend the applicability of vision-based pipelines. A laser pointer is introduced in the setup as an effective mechanism for object disambiguation. Accordingly, a suitable retraining of the deep convolutional neural networks supporting recognition of graspable parts is implemented. A mixed reality strategy allows the reuse of available high-quality segmentation masks to generate realistic images procedurally, extending the range of scenarios supported by the final device. Experimental results confirm that the proposed pipeline improves target disambiguation accuracy by up to 9% compared with existing solutions, while preserving the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文对基于视觉的便携式可抓取部件识别流水线进行改进：在硬件中引入激光笔以实现多目标场景下的目标消歧，并配套重训练深度CNN，结合混合现实程序化生成仿真图像扩充数据，在保持计算成本的同时将目标消歧准确率最高提升9%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的便携式流水线可支持上肢假肢的自动抓取选择与预塑形，但在存在多个物体的真实场景中难以准确确定目标，构成实际应用瓶颈。
AI.method: 对常规硬件配置作小幅修改，加入激光笔作为目标消歧机制；据此对识别可抓取部件的深度卷积网络进行针对性重训练；采用混合现实策略复用已有高质量分割掩码，程序化生成逼真图像以扩展所支持场景范围。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有方案，该流水线将目标消歧准确率最高提升约9%，且计算成本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过低成本硬件增强与定制化训练数据生成，可有效扩展视觉流水线在多目标场景下的适用性，为假肢自动抓取提供实用方案。

title: BrainCodes: A Lightweight EEG Foundation Model over Discrete Neural Codes
summary: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. Beyond predictive accuracy, our evaluation framework characterizes the geometry and invariances of learned EEG representations across measurable spatial, temporal, and spectral signal properties.

AI.tldr: BrainCodes：轻量级EEG自监督基础模型，用紧凑架构（量化式神经分词器+支持任意电极配置的时空编码器）在800+小时、1000+名被试数据上预训练，参数最多减少97%却达到或超越SOTA，并可部署于低资源可穿戴设备。
AI.motivation: 当前EEG基础模型日益追求模型规模，导致难以部署在资源受限设备与日常环境中。作者主张可迁移的EEG特征不必依赖大模型，而可由紧凑架构学得。
AI.method: 构建轻量基础模型，采用自监督学习在>800小时、>1000名被试的EEG记录上预训练。架构由基于量化的神经分词器（neural tokenizer）与时空编码器组成，支持任意电极配置。预训练目标通过通道位置编码显式引入空间连通性，并通过辅助训练目标增强对窄带神经振荡的敏感性。评估框架还刻画所学表征在空间、时间、频谱属性上的几何结构与不变性。
AI.result: 在睡眠分期、注意力评估、认知负荷估计等多种神经生理监测任务上达到或超越SOTA；相较同类架构最多减少97%的可训练参数，并能有效迁移至低资源可穿戴设备。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑架构配合针对性自监督目标即可获得可迁移的EEG表征，规模并非EEG基础模型的必要条件；所提评估框架为EEG表征的几何与不变性分析提供了系统手段。

title: Investigating the Impact of Learner Errors on Social Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.

AI.tldr: 现有偏见基准多在流畅规范的英语上评估大模型，忽视了非母语写作者的语法错误；本文构建受控框架向提示注入学习者常见语法错误，发现语法错误会放大社会偏见，且错误率越高影响越大。
AI.motivation: 现有社会偏见基准主要使用流畅、规范的英语，反映母语者用法，非母语写作者被排除在外，因此需要考察非母语语法错误如何影响社会偏见的测量。
AI.method: 构建受控框架，将常见学习者错误注入提示；在三个偏见基准上应用，覆盖性别、种族、宗教的刻板印象对齐与人群偏好；考察四种常见错误类型及不同错误率的影响，并分析理解干扰机制与错误文本微调的效果。
AI.result: 语法错误会提高偏见水平，且效应随错误率上升而增强；在四类错误中，介词错误的刻板印象对齐提升最大且最一致；分析表明当错误更可能干扰理解时偏见增幅更大；在含错误文本上微调可减弱语法错误导致的偏见上升。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于规范提示的偏见评估可能低估语法错误用户所经历的偏见；偏见评测应考虑非母语语言变异。

title: Balancing Foundation Models and Trait-Specific Learning for Forehead-Crease Recognition
summary: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了前额皱纹作为辅助生物特征在部分面部遮挡下的识别能力，比较了可解释零样本推理、域自适应学习与特征专用建模三类方法。
AI.motivation: 部分面部可见（如口罩遮挡）时，传统面部线索失效导致生物识别性能下降；而前额区域始终可见且含独特皱纹模式，可作为互补生物特征，但缺乏统一评估。
AI.method: 提出统一评估框架：FIRE利用多模态大模型实现可解释零样本验证；同时将预训练人脸识别模型通过基于margin的学习适配到前额域（Edge-Forehead）；并开展特征专用建模。
AI.result: 开集评估下，最佳零样本模型GPT-4o+FIRE取得18.22% EER；Edge-Forehead取得8.30% EER与54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大模型可提供可解释的零样本验证，但特征专用学习对鲁棒的前额皱纹生物识别更有效。

title: Reader--Writer Coupling in Transformer MLPs
summary: A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. Ranked by this coordinate, each block we measure has a small core of strongly coupled channels; where initialization gives either sign equally, the core is nearly all opposed: each writer points against the direction its reader responds to. This opposed core recurs from the smallest models trained from scratch to released checkpoints; its sign is in place within a few percent of training and holds while the coupling grows. Read as couples, most channels return their contribution against the reader that fired it, and the readers of later blocks take it up; few show in the logits. Training holds the couples in place: flipping the opposed writers moves the output toward common tokens, and a writer permuted onto another reader regrows to fit that reader while the reader stays.

AI.tldr: 该文把Transformer的MLP视作"读者—写者"键值记忆，提出用MLP更新映射的Jacobian与其转置的一致性构造每通道的"有符号配对坐标"，发现各层存在一个强耦合、且几乎全部"反向"（写者方向与读者响应方向相反）的小核心，该结构极小规模训练初期即形成并稳定保持。
AI.motivation: MLP中每个隐藏通道承担两种角色：读者（决定何时响应）与写者（决定写入残差流的内容），二者仅通过共享索引配对，无法由任一因子单独度量；而训练通过联合更新将二者耦合，因此需要一种能把两个因子一起读取、联合测量的工具。
AI.method: 利用MLP写回其所读取的同一残差流这一块结构，得到其更新的精确Jacobian为方阵；将Jacobian与其转置的一致性分解为读者—写者项，以内积给出每个通道作为"配対"的有符号配对坐标；按该坐标排序，测量各块的耦合核心，并追踪初始化符号、训练早期形成、微调/置换实验。
AI.result: 每个被测量的块都有一个由强耦合通道构成的小核心；当初始化对正负号等概率时，该核心几乎全部为"相反"配对（写者指向读者响应方向的反向）。该反向核心从最小的从头训练模型到公开checkpoint均复现；其符号在训练早期（几个百分点）即确定并在耦合增强过程中保持；多数通道把贡献返回给触发它的读者并由后续块的读者接手，很少体现在logits中。
AI.conclusion: 训练将读者—写者配対"锁定"在特定结构中：翻转反向写者会使输出趋向常见token，把写者置换到另一读者上时写者会重新生长以适配新读者而读者保持不变，说明读者与写者角色在训练中分化解耦为可分别重适配的结构单元。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
summary: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了罗马尼亚语-英/德/法/意语码混合的讽刺检测数据集CS-SeLeRoSa（60万余样本），并给出人工裁定的金币基准CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold，系统评测多语言大模型在零样本、思维链与微调下的表现。
AI.motivation: 语码转换是自然语言中的普遍现象，但其对高阶推理任务（如讽刺检测）的影响在罗马尼亚语等低资源语言中研究不足；讽刺检测高度依赖文化与句法线索，大模型难以捕捉，且缺乏高质量合成与人工校验的评测资源。
AI.method: 以句子级人工标注的罗马尼亚语新闻讽刺检测数据集为起点，采用四种方法（随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析、大语言模型）与英语、德语、法语、意大利语合成语码混合句，扩充出CS-SeLeRoSa；详述生成流程分析，并构建人工裁定的金币基准CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold；在合成语料与金币集上评测多种多语言大模型，比较零样本、思维链与微调三种范式。
AI.result: 较旧开源模型性能显著退化（宏F1降至37%–55%）；Gemma 4 31B零样本达68.1%，接近GPT-5 mini的69.5%；微调显著降低格式错误并提升效果，Gemma 4 31B在CS-SeLeRoSa上达77.5%、金币集上达72.6%，超过前沿模型的零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: 语码混合会明显削弱模型讽刺检测能力，模型规模与代际差异影响显著；微调是提升语码混合场景鲁棒性与输出规范性的有效手段，可使中等规模开源模型超越前沿闭源模型的零样本表现；所提数据集与金币基准为该方向提供可复用评测资源。

title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
summary: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoPhyX，一个文本条件驱动的空间变化物理属性预测框架，单次前向即可为多类 3D 表示赋予物理合理的参数。
AI.motivation: 高保真 4D 物理仿真需要准确的物理参数赋值。现有方法存在瓶颈：逐场景优化计算开销大；纯视觉前馈预测存在固有歧义（如仅凭外观难以区分橡胶刚度）。故引入文本条件以消除歧义。
AI.method: 1) 构建部件可控数据生成流程：将复杂 3D 资产分解为语义部件，配对物理合理且多样的参数与文本描述，提供细粒度监督；2) 跨模态调制机制：以文本特征动态调制视觉特征，实现精确物理接地；3) 将属性预测建模于体素场，兼容 mesh、点云、Gaussian Splatting、NeRF 等多种 3D 表示。
AI.result: 实验表明单次前向即可完成物理合理、文本驱动的参数赋值，精度高，并对野外物体具备稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AutoPhyX 以文本条件弥补视觉歧义，实现高效、通用、可跨表示的空间变化物理参数预测，为物理密集型具身与机器人应用奠定基础。

title: Benchmarking and Error Analysis of Deep Search and Deep Research LLM Agents
comment: Proceedings of the 1st ICML Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN), Seoul, South Korea, 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous Deep Search and Deep Research Agents capable of executing long-horizon, multi-step tasks, evaluating their reliability becomes increasingly critical. However, existing evaluation paradigms predominantly focus on final task outcomes, leaving a significant gap in understanding the intermediate execution traces, where agents are highly susceptible to various errors. To address this critical gap, we introduce a comprehensive methodology and analytical framework designed specifically to diagnose errors in intermediate workflows. Building upon this framework, we establish a structured taxonomy that categorizes these vulnerabilities into two primary dimensions: System-Level Errors and Task-Level Errors. Through a systematic examination of step-by-step execution traces and agent-environment interactions, we reveal how these underlying errors affect overall performance. Finally, through empirical experiments and systematic analysis of the identified error types, we provide actionable design guidelines, aiming to enhance the robustness, reasoning capabilities, and reliability of Deep Search and Deep Research agents.

AI.tldr: 现有评测只看最终结果，本文提出面向中间执行轨迹的Deep Search/Deep Research智能体错误诊断方法学与分类体系，并通过实证给出设计指南。
AI.motivation: LLM演进为可执行长时程、多步任务的自主Deep Search与Deep Research智能体，其可靠性评估愈发关键；但现有评测范式主要聚焦最终任务结果，忽视了中间执行轨迹，而智能体恰在中间环节极易出错，形成理解盲区。
AI.method: 提出一套完整的方法学与分析框架，专门诊断中间工作流中的错误；据此构建结构化分类体系，将脆弱性划分为系统级错误（System-Level Errors）与任务级错误（Task-Level Errors）两个主维度；系统性考察逐步执行轨迹与智能体—环境交互。
AI.result: 通过逐步执行轨迹与环境交互的系统性分析，揭示底层错误如何影响整体性能；并基于对已识别错误类型的实证实验与系统分析，提炼出可落地的设计准则。
AI.conclusion: 强调从结果导向转向过程导向的评测视角，旨在提升Deep Search与Deep Research智能体的鲁棒性、推理能力与可靠性。

title: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究针对特定人类价值的微调是否会带来非预期的副作用，发现价值特定的训练会影响未训练的价值维度、风险偏好、社会认知与安全特质，呼吁价值对齐评估应纳入更广泛的行为评测。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益部署于价值敏感场景，价值对齐已成为 NLP 后训练目标；但当前评估范围狭窄，且价值之间相互关联，特定价值微调如何影响无关能力与行为尚不明确。
AI.method: 基于 Hofstede 价值维度，对四个指令微调 LLM 分别在各单一价值维度上进行适配训练，并在跨价值迁移及更广泛行为（风险偏好、社会认知、安全特质）上进行评测。
AI.result: 价值特定训练在未训练的价值维度、风险偏好、社会认知和安全特质上产生了非预期副作用（负向迁移/溢出效应）。
AI.conclusion: 后训练阶段的价值对齐应纳入更广泛的行为评估；需进一步研究额外的价值训练在训练流程中的最佳位置。

title: Supervision-Adaptive Curriculum and Guarded Anti-Curriculum Learning for Dense Prediction
summary: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agreement, robustness, reference consistency, and penalties. A pairwise preference objective measured against the frozen Phase-I reference, together with an anchor, refines the prediction. The framework supports full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Experiments across context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), broader dense-prediction tasks, and foundation-model and cross-modal adaptations show accuracy gains. Targeted diagnostics indicate improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings. PaceShift preserves the deployed architecture and adds no inference computation. Code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: PaceShift：先稳定后挑战范式，将监督可靠性与时间更新价值分离，第一阶段用监督自适应课程选择，第二阶段用带守卫的谱后训练精炼预测。
AI.motivation: 课程学习仅按难度排序样本，但难度不等于监督可靠性：简单样本可能暴露捷径，困难样本可能有信息量，噪声或歧义样本会误导训练。因此需要一个区分“监督可靠性”与“时间更新价值”的框架。
AI.method: 两阶段：Phase-I 从可用监督、增强一致性、模型分歧、预测确定性估计可靠性，用时间统计指导样本加权，并用像素不确定性权重降低早期不确定区域影响；Phase-II 对多谱视图预测按监督一致性、鲁棒性、参考一致性及惩罚项排序，基于冻结的 Phase-I 参考构造成对偏好目标并加入锚点精炼预测。支持全监督、弱监督、半监督及模型生成监督。
AI.result: 在上下文纠缠内容分割(CECS)、更广泛密集预测任务，以及基础模型与跨模态适配实验中均取得精度提升；针对性诊断显示在评估设置下池化校准与腐蚀鲁棒性改善。
AI.conclusion: PaceShift 保持部署架构不变且不增加推理计算，代码将公开。

title: Data Schedules and Learning Rate Schedules Should Be Designed Together
summary: Mid-training (MT) is a training phase in LLM training pipelines that continues pretraining (PT) on smaller datasets of higher value. Taking the PT and MT phases as a whole, training usually starts with only PT data and then transitions completely to MT data. In this work, we view this complete transition from PT to MT data as a special case of a broader class of data mixing schedules that specify how the proportions of PT and MT tokens in each batch change over training. Under fixed total training compute and MT token budgets, we ask: Is this complete transition to MT data optimal for minimizing final MT loss? We show that the answer depends on the learning rate (LR) schedule: one data schedule may outperform another under one LR schedule, but changing only the LR schedule can reverse the outcome. Specifically, when the LR decays throughout continued training, introducing MT data earlier and mixing it with PT data lowers the final MT loss compared with placing all MT data at the end of training, but this result is reversed if we use constant LR. We therefore study how to jointly choose when to introduce MT data and when to decay the LR through ablation studies, and find that it is better to decay the LR only after MT data enters training. Finally, we develop a theoretical model that explains why the optimal data schedule for a fixed MT token budget depends on the LR schedule.

AI.tldr: 在固定总训练算力与MT token预算下，PT→MT数据配比（数据混合调度）是否“完全切换”最优取决于学习率调度：LR衰减时提前引入MT数据并与PT混合更优，恒定LR时结论反转；且应在MT数据进入后再衰减LR，并给出理论解释。
AI.motivation: LLM训练中mid-training（MT）阶段通常先只用PT数据、再完全切换到MT数据。作者质疑这种“完全切换”是否为降低最终MT损失的最优数据调度，并考察其与LR调度的交互作用。
AI.method: 将PT与MT的完整切换视为更一般的数据混合调度族（每个batch中PT/MT token比例随训练变化）；在固定总训练算力和MT token预算下比较不同调度。通过ablation研究联合选择MT数据引入时机与LR衰减时机，并构建理论模型解释最优数据调度对LR调度的依赖。
AI.result: 最优数据调度依LR调度而变：LR持续衰减时，提前引入MT数据并与PT混合可降低最终MT损失（优于把全部MT数据放在训练末尾）；使用恒定LR时该结论反转。消融表明，宜在MT数据进入训练之后再衰减LR。
AI.conclusion: PT→MT的完全切换并非普遍最优；数据调度与LR调度存在耦合，需联合设计。实践建议：在MT数据进入后衰减LR，并考虑提前引入MT数据与PT混合；理论模型解释了固定MT预算下最优数据调度依赖LR调度的原因。

title: Task-Preserving Multilingual Instruction Tuning for Open-Ended QA in WMT 2026 MIST
summary: This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-OEG and summarisation in the target languages but decline for context-grounded QA there and across all three tasks in the non-target languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文为 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务的系统报告。作者用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3-8B，训练数据包含组织方数据、EuroAlpaca 与 CrossEuroAlpaca；在匹配解码条件下，目标语言开放式问答的 Gemma-4 平均评分相对基线提升 7.8%，Aya 评测套件的宏平均 ROUGE-L 相对提升 41.5%、BERTScore-F1 提升 2.9%。但增益具有任务与语言特异性，非目标语言上多任务性能反而下降。
AI.motivation: 参与 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务，探索在开放问答（QA-OEG）场景下，如何以轻量适配方式提升多语言指令遵循能力，并借助任务保持式的本地化与跨语言增强来缓解多语言指令数据稀缺问题。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-8B 为基座，采用 LoRA 进行参数高效微调；训练数据由三部分组成：组织方提供数据、EuroAlpaca（通过任务保持式本地化构建的多语言指令数据集）、CrossEuroAlpaca（跨语言增强，对指令、上下文与回复分别指定不同的源语言与目标语言）。系统覆盖辅助数据所含的十种共享任务语言，以 QA-OEG 为目标任务，采用匹配解码进行对比评测，并用 Gemma-4 作为评判模型、Aya Evaluation Suite 作为补充评测。
AI.result: 匹配解码条件下，目标语言 QA-OEG 的 Gemma-4 平均评判分数相对基座模型提升 7.8%；在全部共享任务语言上使用 Aya Evaluation Suite 评测，宏平均 ROUGE-L 相对提升 41.5%，BERTScore-F1 提升 2.9%，目标语言上的提升幅度更大。
AI.conclusion: LoRA 适配结合本地化与跨语言增强可显著提升目标语言生成质量，但增益具有任务与语言特异性：目标语言上 QA-OEG 与摘要任务的 Gemma-4 评分提升，而上下文接地问答（context-grounded QA）在目标语言上下降，且三类任务在非目标语言上均出现性能退化，提示存在多语言能力迁移的负干扰与任务泛化权衡。

title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Melange，一个覆盖七类社会偏见的合成视觉基准，基于BBQ数据集受控生成视觉场景，用于评估多模态大模型的偏见，并发现从文本切换到视觉会显著降低公平性。
AI.motivation: MLLM应用广泛，但其偏见研究远少于标准LLM，可能带来现实社会风险。已有从LLM向多模态扩展的偏见分析要么只覆盖少数偏见类别，要么无法确保被比较群体在图像中有清晰的视觉线索。
AI.method: 构建合成视觉基准Melange：基于BigBench的BBQ数据集，通过受控生成视觉场景扩展其构造语境，使目标属性在视觉上清晰呈现；图像经两阶段验证——VQA自动筛查加人工标注审查；在text-only、image-only、image-with-context三种匹配设置下系统评估23个开源MLLM，以隔离输入模态的公平性效应。
AI.result: 从文本切换到视觉平均使公平性下降0.291，该差距随模型家族而非仅随规模变化；感知控制实验显示模型对图像属性识别准确率达90–95%却仍未能拒答；当模型给出有偏答案时，极性感知的刻板印象对齐分析显示约四分之三情况下选择人类刻板印象响应。
AI.conclusion: Melange提供了广覆盖、可靠的视觉偏见评测基准，揭示视觉输入本身会系统性削弱MLLM的公平性，且该效应非视觉理解不足所致，而是决策层面的偏见表达，需针对多模态场景进行专门偏见缓解。

title: GaP-MoE : Explicit Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts via Orthogonal Gradient Accumulation and Projection
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models improve scalability by routing input tokens to only a subset of expert networks, but they often suffer from representation collapse, in which multiple experts converge toward similar functions and lose their intended diversity. Prior work has addressed this limitation either by improving router architectures or by introducing auxiliary loss terms that implicitly penalize similarity among experts. However, router-based approaches remain vulnerable to routing collapses, and loss-based approaches can conflict with the task's original objective during optimization. In this work, we propose GaP-MoE (Gradient Accumulation and Projection in MoE), which induces expert specialization by directly manipulating expert output gradients rather than modifying the loss function. At each training step, GaP-MoE stochastically selects one of the $TopK$ routed experts as a leader based on normalized routing scores, and projects the gradients of the remaining follower experts onto the orthogonal complement of the subspace spanned by the leader's recent gradients. This removes directional overlap between expert gradients without altering the task loss, allowing specialization to emerge as a direct consequence of the optimization dynamics rather than an externally imposed constraint. We evaluate GaP-MoE in both fine-tuning settings (BERT-based, on GLUE) and from-scratch pretraining settings (GPT-2-based, on WikiText-103, enwik8, and text8), and further confirm its compatibility as a drop-in module for existing SMoE architectures. Experimental results show that GaP-MoE achieves performance comparable to or better than standard SMoE.

AI.tldr: GaP-MoE通过直接操纵专家梯度（将follower专家梯度投影到leader专家近期梯度的正交补空间）来诱导专家特化，避免表征坍缩，且不修改任务损失。
AI.motivation: SMoE中专家间易发生表征坍缩（多个专家收敛到相似函数、丧失多样性）。已有方法要么改进路由架构但仍易路由坍缩，要么引入辅助损失隐式惩罚相似性但会与任务原始目标冲突。
AI.method: 每个训练步，根据归一化路由分数从TopK路由专家中随机选一个作为leader，将其余follower专家的梯度投影到leader近期梯度所张成子空间的正交补上，从而去除专家梯度间的方向重叠；不改变任务损失，特化由优化动态自然涌现。
AI.result: 在微调（BERT-based，GLUE）与从头预训练（GPT-2-based，WikiText-103、enwik8、text8）设置下评估，性能与标准SMoE相当或更优，并可作为即插即用模块兼容现有SMoE架构。
AI.conclusion: GaP-MoE以梯度层面正交化替代损失约束，是一种通用、无需改动损失函数的专家特化机制，可有效缓解SMoE表征坍缩。

title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning.
