ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出ThreadRAG：以语义拓扑图替代离散符号化知识图谱，通过能量驱动路径查找生成连贯文本证据路径，在多跳QA上显著优于基线并大幅降低token开销。
AI.motivation: 现有结合知识图谱的RAG在复杂多跳问答中受限于知识结构化与推理过程，存在两大瓶颈：(i) 严重语义损失——将连续文本蒸馏为离散符号会剥离上下文细节与叙事连贯性；(ii) 显著模态失配——碎片化图结构与LLM预训练的连续文本不匹配，而改写为自然语言又引入生成噪声并丢失信息。
AI.method: ThreadRAG框架包含两模块：1) 语义拓扑映射器（STM），将检索文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点，并以叙事、语义、词汇三类边构建语义拓扑图（STG）；2) 能量驱动路径查找（EDP），通过能量扩散定位查询相关子图，并确定性地将其线性化为连贯的文本证据路径。
AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上一致优于强基线：HotpotQA上相对文本中心方法EM提升14.4%；2WikiMultihop上超过最佳基线5.8% EM；同时token开销降至最强基线的23.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以语义拓扑图保留上下文完整性、以确定性线性化实现模态原生推理，可同时提升多跳QA准确性与效率，为KG增强RAG的语义损失与模态失配问题提供可行路径。

title: Hyperspherical Simplex Representations for Backward-Compatible Retrieval
summary: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. They leverage the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels as a common geometric reference across model updates. Since this reference depends on the number of classes, adding new ones expands the simplex, misaligning existing class prototypes with their earlier counterparts. We therefore derive a deterministic linear transformation to restore their alignment. Our theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility definition identifies two geometric conditions under which its inequalities hold in expectation, assuming von Mises--Fisher class distributions with increasing concentration across updates. Aligned regular-simplex representations satisfy these conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the proposed representations under the stated assumptions. Without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or architectural modifications, the proposed representations achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, including expanded class sets, more expressive architectures, and independently trained models from public repositories.

AI.tldr: 提出基于 softmax 输出与 logits 的"超球单纯形表示"，作为独立训练模型间的共同几何参考实现向后兼容检索，并通过确定性线性变换对齐新增类导致的单纯形扩张，无需兼容性专用训练或学习映射。
AI.motivation: 模型更新会改变内部特征表示；检索系统中更新模型通常需对 gallery 全量重建索引，规模代价高。现有向后兼容方法依赖兼容性专用训练、学习映射函数或结构修改，且显式依赖旧模型。
AI.method: 利用 one-hot 标签下 softmax 交叉熵训练诱导的单纯形结构作为跨模型更新的公共几何参考，由 softmax 输出和 logits 构造超球单纯形表示；针对新增类导致单纯形扩张、旧类原型错位的问题，推导确定性线性变换恢复对齐；在 von Mises–Fisher 类分布且更新中集中度递增的假设下，从向后兼容性的形式化定义出发给出不等式在期望意义下成立的两个几何条件。
AI.result: 对齐的规则单纯形表示满足该两个几何条件，在所述假设下为方法提供理论依据；不使用兼容性专用损失、学习映射或结构修改，在标准兼容性基准（含扩充类集、更强架构、公共仓库中独立训练的模型）上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 超球单纯形表示为独立训练模型间的向后兼容检索提供了无需重训练、无学习映射、且不显式依赖前一模型的简洁方案，并具备可分析的理论支撑。

title: Towards English - Mizo Legal Machine Translation: Corpus Creation, Analysis, and Benchmarks
summary: Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.

AI.tldr: 本文构建首个英语-米佐语印度法院判决平行数据集（13,168句对），分析法律领域借词规律，并微调NLLB-200-1.3B模型，在1,000句对平衡法律测试集上达到27.47 BLEU（较基线提升7.16），但仍存在英文借词使用频率过高的问题。
AI.motivation: 印度法院程序以英语进行，而米佐语等低资源语言的翻译技术有限，导致相关使用者难以获取司法信息；同时缺乏该领域的高质量平行语料。
AI.method: 从古瓦哈提高等法院与印度最高法院收集判决书，由专业母语米佐语译者翻译完整文档，人工对齐句子并由两名独立评审者校验，构建13,168句对的英-米佐平行语料；基于该数据微调NLLB-200-1.3B模型，并统计分析借词与变音符号使用模式。
AI.result: 微调模型在1,000句对的平衡法律测试集上取得27.47 BLEU，较基础模型提升7.16 BLEU；但模型使用英文借词的频率约为人工译者的三倍。语料分析显示官方与法律术语几乎总保留英语，而日常动作、情境、结果类词汇多用本土米佐语表达，且变音符号使用不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了首个英语-米佐法律平行数据集，揭示了法律文本中高度选择性的借词规律；微调显著提升翻译质量，但模型在借词分布上与人工译者仍存在明显差距，是低资源法律机器翻译的重要改进方向。

title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
summary: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generalized-CycleGRPO-Page/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Generalized CycleGRPO，首个统一耦合区域理解与定位的强化学习框架，跨空间、时间、时空三类域，用"生成描述—再定位—重构重叠"的循环一致性作为可验证奖励，并给出新基准 DOVE。
AI.motivation: 细粒度多模态智能既需理解指定区域，也需从语言定位区域。现有方法用独立目标和任务特定标注分别学习这两个方向，割裂了互为逆映射的关系，且依赖参考描述或外部语言模型评判，难以扩展到时间与时空任务。
AI.method: 统一强化学习框架：给定区域，MLLM 生成候选描述，再对每条描述做定位以重构输入区域；重构重叠度作为描述生成的可验证奖励，单条定位的奖励改进逆映射。采用统一的区域空间公式，把循环从图像掩码/框扩展到视频区间与带时间戳的空间证据；无需参考答案或外部 LLM 评审。视频场景下该循环促使描述区分目标事件与相似重复事件。另构建 DOVE（Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation）人工核验的对比基准。
AI.result: GroundingSuite 上 SAMTok 的 gIoU 由 57.5% 提升至 68.2%；GRES 平均 gIoU 由 71.2% 升至 78.7%。时间任务：Charades tIoU 51.9%（Qwen3-VL 初始化 45.6%），DOVE 时间证据覆盖率 33.3%（对比 14.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 区域—文本循环一致性可作为多模态理解与定位的通用自评估原则，统一处理空间、时间与时空任务，且无需人工标注或外部评审模型。

title: Cascading Bandits with Noisy Observations: Algorithms and Regret Bounds
summary: We propose a novel stochastic cascading bandit setup where probing an ordered shortlist of $K$ out of $L$ arms incurs position-dependent costs, and the learner observes only noisy feedback regarding each arm's true output. We identify a sub-class of noise models for which the optimal shortlist can be found by sorting arms according to a per-arm score: such a score exists for both selection and ordering when the channel has no false positives, and for ordering alone (but not selection) when measurements are costless; however in general neither selection nor ordering is separable once noise and cost are both present. For the case where both selection and ordering scores exist, we provide a UCB-based algorithm with $O((L-K)\log T)$ instance-dependent regret over a time horizon $T$, which matches an algorithm-agnostic lower bound (up to constant factors). For the more challenging scenario where scores don't exist, we develop a new algorithmic template, DP-UCB, that embeds optimism directly inside an exact dynamic program, yielding $O\big(LK\log T\big)$ regret. Finally, we validate our theoretical results through extensive numerical evaluations and simulations over both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机级联赌博机（stochastic cascading bandit）新设定：从 L 个臂中探测有序短名单（K 个），成本依赖位置，且仅能获得关于各臂真实输出的含噪反馈。作者刻画了"存在逐臂打分可排序得到最优短名单"的噪声模型子类，并针对存在/不存在打分两种情形分别给出 UCB 类算法与 DP-UCB 算法，取得理论与实验验证的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 经典 cascading bandit 通常假设无噪声反馈、成本结构简单。现实中探测有序短名单既有位置相关成本，观测又含噪声，此时"选出哪些臂"与"如何排序"是否能分解为逐臂打分排序并不显然；论文旨在厘清噪声与成本同时存在时可分解性的边界，并为不可分解情形设计高效算法。
AI.method: 1) 形式化带位置相关成本与噪声反馈的随机级联赌博机模型；2) 分析可分解性：无假阳性信道时选择与排序均存在逐臂打分，测量无成本时仅排序存在打分，噪声与成本并存时一般二者均不可分离；3) 对可分解情形给出基于 UCB 的算法；4) 对不可分解情形提出 DP-UCB，将乐观性嵌入精确动态规划。
AI.result: 可分解情形下 UCB 算法达到 O((L−K)log T) 的实例相关遗憾，与算法无关下界匹配（至常数因子）；不可分解情形下 DP-UCB 达到 O(LK log T) 遗憾；并在合成与真实数据集上通过大量数值实验与仿真验证理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 论文界定了噪声与成本共同作用时短名单选择/排序的可分离性条件，并在两类情形下分别给出近最优或高效的算法；DP-UCB 的"乐观性嵌入动态规划"模板为处理不可分解的组合决策问题提供了通用思路，理论与实验均支持其有效性。

title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
summary: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CulturalRiddles，一个由人类社区参与创作、扎根文化语境的文化谜题基准，覆盖 62 种文化（45 个国家、51 种语言），用于评估 LLM 的文化理解与应用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 文化评估基准多以英语为中心，文化覆盖面有限，且偏重事实性知识而非其在真实文化情境中的应用；随着 LLM 语言覆盖扩张，亟需更贴近文化实践、考察推理与关联能力的评测工具。
AI.method: 采用参与式社区共创方式，完全由人工撰写原创文化谜题，覆盖 62 种文化、45 个国家、51 种语言；谜题深度嵌入本土文化，需依赖溯因推理与组合推理、细粒度事实性与社会性知识、语言技能及文化特有关联；使用自动评测与大规模人工评测对 28 种 LLM 配置进行基准测试。
AI.result: 即使前沿模型在部分文化社区上准确率最高也仅约 22%；基准同时公开全部工件并提供开放众包贡献流程，以扩展语言与文化覆盖。
AI.conclusion: CulturalRiddles 揭示了当前 LLM 在深层文化理解上的显著不足，强调将文化知识应用与推理纳入评测的必要性，并通过开放贡献机制推动文化评测的可持续扩展。

title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
summary: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的退化感知训练框架用于水下图像增强：文本条件扩散生成多样退化配对数据，配合渐进退化课程学习与透射引导一步扩散模型，在多个基准上取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有配对清水-退化水下数据集规模有限且难以获取，难以覆盖真实水下环境的多样退化，导致增强模型泛化受限；因此需要真实、可控的退化建模来刻画真实水下条件并提升增强鲁棒性。
AI.method: （1）Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline：利用文本引导扩散模型合成多样且语义一致的退化样本，为后续课程学习提供配对数据；（2）Progressive Degradation Curriculum：按多属性、多难度组织训练，促进均衡学习；（3）Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model：借助该渐进过程处理大范围退化程度与复原歧义。
AI.result: 在多个水下图像基准上的大量实验表明所提方法取得更优性能（superior performance）。
AI.conclusion: 退化感知训练框架可有效弥补配对数据不足、提升水下图像增强的泛化与鲁棒性；代码与模型将在论文发表后公开。

title: Parallelizable Probabilistic Latent Reasoning for Diverse Reasoning Trajectories
summary: Language models relying on verbalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) are constrained to token-by-token generation in the language space, where many tokens serve textual coherence rather than core reasoning. This entangles genuine differences in logical trajectories with superficial variations in verbalization. Moving reasoning into a compact, continuous latent space offers a promising alternative for efficiently representing and exploring diverse reasoning trajectories. However, current latent models remain largely deterministic, capturing only a single reasoning trajectory rather than modeling a distribution over multiple valid alternatives. While stochastic approaches parameterize distributions over latent reasoning steps, they frequently suffer from unstable optimization and limited empirical performance. Furthermore, their reliance on autoregressive latent prediction during training precludes effective parallelization, leading to prohibitively long training times. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose Probabilistic Latent Reasoning Models (PLRM), a parallelizable variational framework for probabilistic latent reasoning. PLRM adopts a JEPA-style objective in which the posterior infers latent distributions in parallel from observed reasoning trajectories, while the prior learns to predict the subsequent latent distribution via teacher forcing. To model heterogeneous reasoning processes, we introduce a discrete strategy variable together with a mixture-based prior, allowing the model to preserve the Gaussian-mixture structure induced by multiple distinct reasoning trajectories rather than collapsing them into a single Gaussian. Across diverse benchmarks, PLRM achieves performance competitive with deterministic latent reasoning models on single-trajectory datasets while enabling efficient training and consistently outperforming competing stochastic baselines on multi-trajectory datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出可并行化的变分概率潜空间推理框架 PLRM，用 JEPA 式目标并行推断潜分布，并以离散策略变量与混合先验保留多推理轨迹的高斯混合结构。
AI.motivation: 语言空间中的显式 CoT 逐 token 生成，大量 token 仅用于文本连贯而非核心推理，把逻辑轨迹的真实差异与表层的措辞变化纠缠在一起。将推理移入紧凑连续的潜空间是更高效的替代方案，但现有潜空间模型多为确定性、只建模单一轨迹；随机方法虽参数化潜步骤分布，却优化不稳定、性能有限，且训练时依赖自回归潜预测、无法有效并行，训练耗时过长。
AI.method: PLRM 采用 JEPA 风格目标：后验从观测到的推理轨迹并行推断潜分布，先验通过 teacher forcing 预测后续潜分布；引入离散策略变量与基于混合的先验，建模异构推理过程，保留多轨迹诱导的高斯混合结构，避免坍缩为单一高斯；整体为可并行化的变分框架。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，PLRM 在单轨迹数据集上取得与确定性潜空间推理模型相当的性能，同时训练高效；在多轨迹数据集上稳定优于对比的随机基线。
AI.conclusion: PLRM 通过并行变分推断与混合结构先验，缓解了随机潜空间推理的优化不稳定与训练不可并行问题，兼顾性能与效率，并具备刻画多种有效推理路径分布的能力。

title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
summary: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态超图记忆MHG-Mem，联合组织实体身份、状态演化与视觉证据溯源，并配合超图智能体检索，在三个基准上较最强基线提升8.20-9.98%。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体的长期记忆存在两难：基于抽象的记忆把图像压缩为文本，丢失细粒度视觉判别信息；像素保留式记忆虽保留原始观察，却难以将多样观察可靠关联到持久实体身份并追踪其状态演化。
AI.method: 将实体提及与观察事实作为独立节点，用"出现超边"聚合身份一致的提及与事实；再合成方面特定的演化状态，并通过演化超边与证据超边连接支撑实体、事实与来源证据；检索端提出基于超图的智能体搜索，自适应选择入口层、跨层级遍历类型化超边、在需细粒度核验时检视源观察。
AI.result: 在三个基准上开展大量实验，相较最强基线性能提升8.20%–9.98%。
AI.conclusion: 统一身份、状态演化与证据的多模态超图记忆可同时支持细粒度视觉核验与跨会话状态变化推理，优于文本抽象式与像素保留式记忆方案。

title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
summary: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 在流匹配模型中，训练信噪比（SNR）分布是决定空间布局遵循能力的关键因素；将训练重心向高噪声阶段偏移即可在不改动架构的前提下大幅提升细粒度空间控制。
AI.motivation: 基础模型图像合成能力虽强，但细粒度空间控制通常依赖辅助结构适配器或复杂的推理期引导；作者假设现代VLM文本编码器已具备编码空间坐标的潜在能力，而生成模型未能利用，其根因在于训练噪声调度/SNR分布。
AI.method: 构建由几何基元组成的合成基准，剥离自然图像中的纹理复杂性以单独考察结构机制；提出严格的颜色感知布局度量量化空间保真度；对比中心化SNR分布与向高噪声阶段偏移的训练策略，并考察分辨率与长宽比方差的影响，最后在COCO数据集上验证。
AI.result: 中心化SNR分布训练下布局遵循率仅25.9%；将训练重点转向高噪声阶段后提升至80.8%，接近VAE重建上限83.6%；该偏移的必要性随分辨率和长宽比方差增大而增强；FLUX.1等模型采用的保守噪声调度不足以实现精确布局遵循；在COCO上平均精度由1.0提升至57.3。
AI.conclusion: 高噪声区间是空间定位的"关键学习阶段"；仅通过训练SNR分布调优即可解锁最先进的布局遵循能力，无需任何架构修改，且结论可从合成基准迁移至真实图像。

title: Nominate-then-Adjudicate: LLM-Assisted One-Pass and Per-Instance MIP Solver Tuning
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Accepted as a short paper at IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive. We frame this as configuration for heterogeneous Big Data optimization workloads and propose a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline built around two design choices. First, a fixed portfolio is sampled once and reused across instances, removing per-instance configuration search at inference; on the evaluated families, the resulting shortlist retains substantial oracle headroom, making selection within it the empirical focus. Second, the fixed 20-feature representation can map structurally different instances to the same vector, preventing a feature-only selector from distinguishing them even when they prefer different configurations. The foundation model receives no task-specific weight updates, and selection is one-pass: one model call and no solver calls at inference. The study represents structural Variety through distinct formulation families and decision Value through solver-performance outcomes; the one-call, zero-solve protocol specifies the decision interface and leaves end-to-end latency unmeasured. Among comparisons exceeding a 20% practical-difference threshold, the complete adjudicator records 538 wins and 185 losses against the top nominee, while its win rate against the default rises from 84.9% to 90.2%. Against per-instance configuration baselines under a matched one-pass protocol it leads the cluster-level methods and the best-performing evaluated per-instance baseline, ISAC+.

AI.tldr: 提出"提名-裁决"(nominate-then-adjudicate)两阶段流水线：一次性采样固定组合(portfolio)并在所有实例间复用，消除推理期逐实例参数搜索；再由基础模型对短名单做单次调用、零求解器调用的裁决式选择。对结构异质的MIP实例族，完整裁决器相对首选提名取得538胜/185负，对默认配置胜率由84.9%升至90.2%，并优于集群级方法与最佳单遍逐实例基线ISAC+。
AI.motivation: MIP求解器有数百至数千个参数且最优取值随实例而异，逐实例调参代价过高；同时把问题放在异构大数据优化工作负载的配置视角下，需要兼顾结构多样性(Variety)与决策价值(Value)，并希望推理期只做一次模型调用、不调用求解器以控制成本。
AI.method: 1) 固定组合：一次性采样参数组合组合并在所有实例上复用，避免推理期逐实例搜索，仅保留一个短名单供选择；2) 指出固定20维特征表示会把结构不同的实例映射到同一向量，使纯特征选择器无法区分；3) 基础模型不做任务特定权重更新，采用单遍选择——一次模型调用、零求解器调用；4) 以不同建模范式体现结构Variety、以求解性能结果体现决策Value，协议为一调用零求解，端到端时延未测量。
AI.result: 在超过20%实际差异阈值的比较中，完整裁决器对首选提名记录538胜、185负；对默认配置的胜率从84.9%提升到90.2%；在匹配的单遍协议下，优于集群级方法以及表现最好的逐实例基线ISAC+。
AI.conclusion: 固定组合复用加一次模型裁决的选择范式可在不做逐实例求解搜索的前提下显著改善配置选择，提示特征表示的可区分性比单纯特征驱动选择更关键；但结论限于已评估实例族与单遍协议，端到端时延尚未测量。

title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.

AI.tldr: 将微调神经AI文本检测器通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）转化为基于人类可读概念的可解释分类器，兼顾可解释性与OOD性能。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本检测器被广泛部署于同行评审、教育、招生、新闻与内容审核等高风险场景，其输出直接影响个体。然而性能最强的检测器是决策不透明的微调神经分类器，而透明的替代方案（文体计量与语言特征分类器）性能大幅落后。因此需要弥合可解释性与性能之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出一条管线：直接在检测器的残差流上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），对每个SAE特征赋予自动解释（auto-interpretation）标签，仅保留生成描述通过全局保真度阈值的特征，再在这些可解释特征上训练轻量分类器。
AI.result: SAE恢复了对应于高度具体且具预测性的AI生成文本语言"破绽"（tells）的潜在概念；基于这些提取特征构建的分类器不仅高度可解释，而且在分布外（OOD）文本上的表现优于神经检测器与文体计量替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过SAE对检测器内部表征进行概念化解耦，可构建既透明又在OOD场景下更具鲁棒性的检测器，为高风险场景下可解释AI文本检测提供了可行路径。

title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.

AI.tldr: 提出CineEvolve——将"导演"与"评论家"统一于单一视觉-语言策略的智能体自进化框架，用于电影级多镜头视频生成；通过交替强化学习与E-GRPO实现二者协同进化，并构建40K电影轨迹数据集CineTraj，实验优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 电影级多镜头视频生成既需叙事规划，又需迭代精修。现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理能力，要么采用无策略更新的前馈式流程，无法像真实电影制作那样"边导演边评审"地持续改进。
AI.method: 1) 在单一VLM策略内统一Director与Critic两种角色；2) 交替强化学习：Director暴露缺陷以强化Critic，更新后的Critic再指导Director做针对性修改；3) 提出Evolutionary GRPO（E-GRPO），用历史锚定（historical anchoring）与修改保护（revision safeguarding）缓解优势膨胀（advantage inflation），稳定协同进化；4) 构建CineTraj数据集（4万条覆盖创作-评论-修改的电影轨迹）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明CineEvolve在电影级多镜头视频生成上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事规划与批评反馈统一为可自我进化的策略，并以稳定的交替RL训练，是提升多镜头视频生成叙事先验与迭代质量的有效范式；代码将开源。

title: Progressive Permutation Alignment with Temperature-Controlled Spectral Sharpening
summary: In implicit neural representations (INRs), 3D signals are encoded directly in network weights, making stable weight-space operations essential. However, permutation symmetry causes independently trained yet functionally equivalent models to appear distant in weight space, often inducing large loss barriers under linear interpolation. Existing neuron alignment methods either commit early to discrete matches and become trapped in inconsistent local optima or rely on computationally expensive gradient optimization over continuous relaxations, both of which are unreliable in challenging cases such as NeRF. We adopt progressive alignment, a layer-wise strategy that follows inter-layer dependencies from input to output. At each layer, a correlation matrix is estimated and aligned with a discrete anchor obtained by the Hungarian algorithm, after which temperature-controlled spectral annealing gradually sharpens the correlation structure toward a permutation matrix. This update is deterministic and lightweight, avoiding the inner-loop gradient optimization required by continuous relaxation methods. A final refinement stage further optimizes the network layer-by-layer via weight matching, starting from the aligned solution. Experiments on MLPs, CNNs, and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) show that the proposed method reliably recovers neuron correspondences and achieves stable alignment across architectures. In practical experiments aligning independently trained NeRF models, our method reduces the loss barriers under weight interpolation compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种逐层渐进式神经元对齐方法，结合匈牙利算法离散锚点与温度控制谱退火，可靠恢复INR网络的神经元对应关系并降低权重插值损失障碍。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经表示将3D信号编码于网络权重中，但置换对称性使独立训练但功能等价的模型在权重空间相距甚远，线性插值时常出现大损失障碍。现有神经元对齐方法要么过早确定离散匹配而陷入局部最优，要么依赖连续松弛上的昂贵梯度优化，在NeRF等困难场景下不可靠。
AI.method: 采用按输入到输出顺序、遵循层间依赖的逐层渐进对齐策略。每层估计相关矩阵，并以匈牙利算法得到的离散锚点进行对齐，随后通过温度控制的谱退火逐步锐化相关结构使其趋近置换矩阵；该更新确定性强且轻量，无需连续松弛方法的内循环梯度优化。最后在对齐解基础上用权重匹配逐层精化。
AI.result: 在MLP、CNN和NeRF上的实验表明该方法能可靠恢复神经元对应关系并在不同架构上稳定对齐；在实际对齐独立训练的NeRF模型时，相比现有方法显著降低了权重插值下的损失障碍。
AI.conclusion: 逐层渐进+离散锚点+谱退火的确定性对齐方案兼具可靠性与效率，可作为INR权重空间稳定操作的有效手段。

title: What the Author Wrote, What the Agent Reads: Silent Cue Loss in Enterprise Document Ingestion
summary: Enterprise agents act on documents. Before an agent can follow a policy, answer a compliance question or file a ticket, some ingestion layer must turn a Word file or PDF into tokens - and that layer is where an agent deployed in the wild silently loses information. We show that one layer is lost by every mainstream converter - the meaning an author encodes in how text looks - and that the loss makes agents confidently wrong rather than visibly incomplete. We build a task from 76 real policy documents: recover the requirements the author singled out, scored against the file's own OOXML properties by a deterministic matcher with no LLM judge. Formatting-blind ingestion collapses from micro F1 0.690 to 0.150 (docling) and 0.075 (plain text), a gap that replicates across six answering models from two vendors - five Claude models spanning the Opus, Sonnet and Haiku tiers, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6. An agent that cannot see the cue guesses, and docling's false-positive rate on requirements the author did not flag is four times ours. A span-level leave-one-out localises the loss to two cues - highlight (+0.302) and colour (+0.262), both Holm-adjusted p < 1e-4 - while bold, italic, monospace and strikethrough each sit within +/-0.003 of zero. The same asymmetry appears in PDF. Colour is also the cue no mainstream converter preserves and no parsing benchmark scores, and it is common: 32.8% of 6,460 documents carry a deliberate colour or highlight, 10.3% on an obligation. A pre-registered test shows that typing a cue for the agent adds +0.085 beyond merely preserving it (Holm-adjusted p = 0.049). We validate the labels against rendered page images through an independent modality (kappa = 0.72) and bound what wording alone can achieve (AUC 0.664). For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.

AI.tldr: 主流文档转换器在摄取阶段会丢失作者通过"看重方式"（高亮、颜色等排版线索）编码的语义，使企业智能体对要求的识别从 micro F1 0.690 骤降至 0.150（docling）与 0.075（纯文本），导致智能体"自信地答错"而非明显缺失。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体需在文档上执行政策问答、合规判断与工单流转，而摄取层是把 Word/PDF 转为 token 的唯一通道。作者认为现有转换器普遍丢失"格式即语义"这一层信息，且该损失会造成高置信度错误，因此需量化这种隐性信息损失及其对下游智能体的影响。
AI.method: 构建基于 76 份真实政策文档的任务：恢复作者特意标注的要求项；以文件自身 OOXML 属性为金标准，用无 LLM 评判的确定性匹配器打分。在 6 个答案模型（5 个 Claude 模型，覆盖 Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 层级，以及 GPT-5.6）上复现格式盲摄取与保留格式摄取的差距。用 span 级 leave-one-out 定位损失来源；在 PDF 上检验同一不对称性；统计 6,460 份文档中颜色/高亮的出现频率；预注册实验检验"向智能体显式标注线索"的增量效果；通过渲染页面图像的独立模态验证标签（kappa=0.72），并界定纯文本措辞的上限（AUC 0.664）。
AI.result: 格式盲摄取使 micro F1 从 0.690 降至 0.150（docling）和 0.075（纯文本），跨 6 个模型一致复现；docling 对未被作者标注要求的假阳性率是本文方法的 4 倍。span 级 leave-one-out 显示损失集中在两个线索：高亮（+0.302）与颜色（+0.262），均 Holm 校正 p<1e-4；而加粗、斜体、等宽、删除线均在 ±0.003 内接近零。PDF 呈现相同不对称性。颜色是主流转换器普遍不保留、也无意解析基准评分的线索，且很常见：32.8% 的 6,460 份文档带有刻意的颜色或高亮，10.3% 落在义务条款上。预注册测试显示，在"保留"之外再"显式标注"线索可额外带来 +0.085（Holm 校正 p=0.049）。
AI.conclusion: 对企业智能体开发者而言，可靠性胜负在摄取层而非推理层，且修复成本低、效果可测：需保留并以类型化方式显式传递颜色/高亮等排版线索。研究也指出解析基准忽视颜色这一维度，应纳入评测。

title: No Frames, Just Frequencies: Bandwidth-Efficient Deployment-Time Adaptation for Smart Glasses
summary: Deep neural networks deployed on smart glasses must adapt to changes in the distribution of incoming data while adhering to strict privacy and device constraints. We present No Frames, Just Frequencies, a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework that characterizes distribution shifts using compact frequency descriptors computed on-device. Rather than transmitting camera frames, the glasses compute and send frequency descriptors to a host device that contains a replica of the model. The host device maps the received frequency descriptor to a distribution shift operator that synthesizes out-of-distribution data and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol. We evaluate the framework on mixtures of ImageNet-C corruptions using convolution-based (ConvNeXtV2-Femto), self-attention-based (DeiT-Tiny), and hybrid (TinyViT-5M) vision models, on person classification (Visual Wake Words), and on object detection (MS-COCO). Our results reveal that adaptation driven solely by the transmitted descriptors recovers $93-95\%$ of the supervised oracle adaptation gain on all three architectures, $82\%$ on Visual Wake Words and $94$--$98\%$ on MS-COCO. Notably, adaptation quality degrades gracefully as the descriptor resolution decreases from $224 $ to $28$ pixels, consistently across architectures, enabling bandwidth reductions from $213\times$ to $784\times$ across the frequency descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出"No Frames, Just Frequencies"框架：智能眼镜端仅计算并传输紧凑的频域描述子而非原始图像帧，宿主端用描述子映射分布漂移算子并合成OOD数据来适配模型副本，在保持隐私与低带宽的同时恢复93–95%的监督oracle适配增益。
AI.motivation: 部署在智能眼镜上的深度网络需应对输入数据分布漂移，但受严格隐私（不能上传原始帧）与设备带宽/算力约束，传统的源端发送图像帧做测试时/源辅助适配不可行。
AI.method: 设备端计算紧凑的频域描述子刻画分布漂移，替代相机帧传输；宿主端持有模型副本，将收到的频率描述子映射为分布漂移算子，据此合成分布外（OOD）数据，并按预定义适配协议对模型副本进行适配。在ImageNet-C腐败混合上评估ConvNeXtV2-Femto、DeiT-Tiny、TinyViT-5M，并评测Visual Wake Words人物分类与MS-COCO检测。
AI.result: 仅凭传输的描述子驱动的适配，在三类架构上恢复93–95%的监督oracle适配增益；Visual Wake Words上82%，MS-COCO上94–98%。描述子分辨率从224降至28像素时适配质量平滑退化，跨架构一致，可实现213×至784×的带宽降低。
AI.conclusion: 频域描述子是替代原始帧进行源辅助适配的高效、隐私友好信号，能在极低带宽下逼近oracle适配性能，且退化行为可控、跨架构稳健。

title: The Predictive--Optimization Gap in GuanDan Self-Play
summary: Outcome-predictive signals are often treated as promising optimization targets in reinforcement learning, but predictive validity and optimization utility are different claims. We expose this distinction in GuanDan, a multi-round imperfect-information game in which the implication of a round outcome depends on the public match state. Held-out analysis shows that state--gain interactions provide incremental predictive value beyond a constant signed-gain effect, establishing that match progress is predictively meaningful. We then use changes in a frozen match-win predictor, $ΔΦ$, as a controlled round-level supervision intervention in a matched DanZero-style Monte Carlo self-play protocol. The intervention can succeed in an individual lineage: a selected progress-augmented checkpoint substantially outperforms its matched Baseline on a locked evaluation. Yet the method-level result reverses this impression: none of five preregistered replication seeds is positive, the pooled ten-seed interval includes zero, and across-iteration effects repeatedly change sign without a common late-stage advantage. These results identify a predictive--optimization gap: under the studied learner, a signal can describe outcome-relevant progress while failing to provide a reliably beneficial optimization direction.

AI.tldr: 论文区分"预测有效性"与"优化效用"：在掼蛋中，回合结果的预测价值可被验证，但以其变化量ΔΦ作为自对弈监督干预，在五种子复制中均未带来稳定增益，从而揭示"预测—优化鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中常把结果预测性信号当作有前景的优化目标，但"能预测结果"与"能作为有效优化方向"是两个不同命题，论文旨在用受控实验暴露这一区别。
AI.method: 以多轮不完全信息博弈掼蛋为平台：先做留出集分析，检验状态—收益交互项相对常数符号增益效应的增量预测价值；再以冻结的回合胜率预测器变化量ΔΦ作为回合级监督干预，嵌入匹配的DanZero式蒙特卡洛自对弈协议，并进行五种子预注册复制。
AI.result: 留出集分析证实状态—收益交互具有增量预测价值，比赛进程具有预测意义。干预在单条训练谱系中可使某增强检查点显著优于匹配基线，但方法层面结论反转：五个预注册复制种子无一为正，合并十种子置信区间包含零，跨迭代效应反复变号且无共同后期优势。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的learner上存在预测—优化鸿沟：信号能刻画与结果相关的进程，却不能提供可靠有益的优化方向；单谱系成功不足以支撑方法级结论。

title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
summary: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. We find that looping significantly improves training efficiency: looped UDLMs reach the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on about 0.5 trillion tokens with up to 2.8x fewer training FLOPs on OpenWebText and 3.3x fewer on FineWeb-Edu. We also find that, at a matched NFE budget, looped UDLMs reach up to 9.8% lower generation perplexity than the non-looped UDLM, with most gains achieved at moderate loop counts. Finally, we study different loop-count distributions and find that sampling smaller loop counts more frequently during training improves inference efficiency: on downstream tasks, this strategy uses 12% fewer loops than uniform loop-count sampling without degrading accuracy.

AI.tldr: 在保持训练目标与采样器不变的前提下，将选择性循环（selective looping）引入均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM），可显著提升训练与推理效率。
AI.motivation: UDLM 需在可能不可靠的上下文上做去噪，训练目标比 MDLM 更困难、FLOP 开销更大（但下游推理更强）。MDLM 中已证实每步去噪内递归复用少量早期 Transformer 层可提升等 FLOP 下的训练效率，作者考察该机制是否同样适用于 UDLM。
AI.method: 在每个去噪步内对少量早期 Transformer 层做递归循环（selective looping），训练目标与采样器保持原样；在 OpenWebText 与 FineWeb-Edu 上与无循环 UDLM 对比训练 FLOP、验证 NLL；在固定 NFE 预算下比较生成困惑度；并研究不同循环次数分布（如提高小循环数的采样频率）对推理效率的影响。
AI.result: 循环 UDLM 达到无循环 UDLM（约 0.5T token 训练）的验证 NLL 时，训练 FLOP 在 OpenWebText 上最多减少 2.8 倍、在 FineWeb-Edu 上最多减少 3.3 倍；相同 NFE 预算下生成困惑度最多降低 9.8%，多数收益在中等循环数时即已获得；训练时更频繁采样较小循环数，可在下游任务上比均匀循环数采样少用 12% 的循环且不损失准确率。
AI.conclusion: 选择性循环是提升 UDLM 训练与推理效率的有效手段，且无需改动其训练目标与采样器；训练期循环数分布的设计可进一步降低推理循环开销。

title: Diff-IrisPAD: Modeling Bona Fide Iris Distributions for Unsupervised Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.

AI.tldr: Diff-IrisPAD是一个基于布朗桥扩散的无监督虹膜呈现攻击检测框架，仅用真实样本建模虹膜分布，通过重建不一致性检测攻击，在12.5万+多传感器数据集上取得ACER 30.52并对未见攻击具强泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有虹膜PAD方法依赖有监督学习且需要攻击样本，导致对未见攻击类型和新传感器泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出基于Brownian Bridge Diffusion的无监督框架，仅建模bona fide（真实）虹膜分布，不使用攻击样本；从退化输入重建干净虹膜纹理，并利用ViT评分与像素级度量基于重建不一致性判定攻击。
AI.result: 在大规模多传感器数据集（125K+图像，NIR与VIS，8类攻击）上总体ACER为30.52，显著优于基于扩散的基线方法，并展现对未见攻击的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明基于扩散的真实样本建模对稳健且可扩展的虹膜PAD是有效的。

title: Alternative Strategies for Active Learning with Bayesian Bradley Terry Model
summary: Comparative judgement uses pairwise comparisons to rank items, but recovering accurate rankings from a limited number of judgements depends on both the inference method and the pairs selected. We developed a Bayesian Bradley-Terry model (BBTM) that uses Polya-Gamma data augmentation for efficient Gibbs sampling and quantifies uncertainty in latent abilities and ranks. We propose three active learning strategies based on the knowledge gradient (KG) principle. We define our acquisition functions using Kendall's tau distance, posterior rank entropy, and posterior separation. Approximate one-step updates to posterior moments reduce the computational cost of evaluating candidate pairs. We also introduce Posterior Separation Reliability (PSR), which measures the spread of posterior mean abilities relative to posterior uncertainty. It provides an internal indicator of ranking reliability without requiring a reference ranking. In synthetic experiments covering different item counts, comparison budgets, and noise levels, BBTM generally recovers ranking more accurately than preference-based Bayesian comparative judgement (PBCJ). At low to moderate noise levels, the pairwise entropy pair selection strategy performs best in ranking recovery. However, at the highest noise levels, the KG strategy based on posterior separation produces better point rankings. PSR increases alongside improvements in ranking accuracy as comparisons accumulate. Robustness experiments identify the proportion of informative outcomes needed to meet specified accuracy targets within a fixed comparison budget. In a moderate noise setting, replacing 30\% of outcomes with random choices has little effect on ranking performance. These findings demonstrate the value of Bayesian inference and active learning pair selection for recovering ranks from limited, noisy paired comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Polya-Gamma数据增强的贝叶斯Bradley-Terry模型（BBTM），结合三种基于知识梯度（KG）的主动学习配对选择策略与无需参考排序的可靠性指标PSR，用于在有限、带噪的成对比较中更准确地恢复排名。
AI.motivation: 成对比较可用于对项目排名，但从有限判断中恢复准确排名同时取决于推断方法与所选配对；需要兼顾不确定性量化、高效采样与高效配对选择。
AI.method: 构建BBTM，用Polya-Gamma数据增强实现高效Gibbs采样，量化潜在能力与排名的后验不确定性；提出三种基于KG原则的主动学习策略，其采集函数分别基于Kendall's tau距离、后验排名熵与后验分离度；采用对后验矩的近似一步更新降低候选配对评估开销；提出后验分离可靠性（PSR），以后验均值能力的离散程度相对后验不确定度衡量排名可靠性，无需参考排名。实验覆盖不同项目数、比较预算与噪声水平。
AI.result: BBTM在合成实验中通常比基于偏好的PBCJ更准确地恢复排名；中低噪声下，成对熵配对选择策略排名恢复最佳；最高噪声下，基于后验分离的KG策略点排名更优；PSR随比较积累与排名精度提升而上升；稳健性实验中识别出在固定预算内达到精度目标所需的信息性结果比例，中等噪声下将30%结果替换为随机选择对排名性能影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯推断与主动学习配对选择对从有限、带噪成对比较中恢复排名具有明确价值。

title: GoiBERT: Compact Vietnamese Language Models via Two-Stage Knowledge Distillation
summary: Vietnamese pre-trained encoders have improved rapidly, but the strongest ones are large, multilingual-vocabulary models or depend on external word segmentation, which makes them costly to deploy. We present GoiBERT, a family of two compact Vietnamese encoders with 26M and 49M parameters that operate directly on raw text. GoiBERT learns from two complementary teachers. A same-tokenizer Vietnamese encoder first teaches general-purpose representations. A much larger teacher then provides task-level guidance through soft labels that are generated without ever labeling its own training data. Across eight benchmarks covering text classification, aspect-based sentiment analysis, natural language inference, and named entity recognition, GoiBERT-large achieves the highest average score among non-teacher models. It does so with fewer than half the parameters of the strongest compact baseline and twice its throughput. GoiBERT-base retains 99% of that baseline's performance at a quarter of its size. Our analysis shows that compression is nearly lossless for sentiment and classification tasks but remains costly for inference and entity recognition, which points to clear directions for future work. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/Nhantran65/GoiBERT.git

AI.tldr: GoiBERT：两个紧凑越南语编码器（26M/49M），直接在原始文本上运行，通过同分词器越南语编码器与更大教师模型的软标签双教师蒸馏，在八项基准上以不到最强紧凑基线一半参数、两倍吞吐取得非教师模型最高平均分。
AI.motivation: 现有最强的越南语预训练编码器要么体量大、使用多语种词表，要么依赖外部分词，部署成本高；因此需要紧凑、可直接处理原始文本的越南语编码器。
AI.method: 提出 GoiBERT 系列（26M 与 49M 参数），直接作用于原始文本。采用两阶段互补教师：先用同分词器的越南语编码器蒸馏通用表示，再由更大的教师通过软标签提供任务级指导，且教师软标签的生成无需对其自身训练数据进行标注。
AI.result: 在文本分类、方面级情感分析、自然语言推断和命名实体识别共八项基准上，GoiBERT-large 取得非教师模型最高平均分，参数量不足最强紧凑基线的一半且吞吐为其两倍；GoiBERT-base 以四分之一规模保留该基线 99% 的性能。分析显示压缩在情感与分类任务上近乎无损，但在推断与实体识别上仍有明显损失。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑越南语编码器可在分类与情感任务上以显著更低成本替代大型模型；推断与命名实体识别仍是压缩的主要瓶颈，为后续工作指明方向。代码与模型已开源。

title: An interpretable deep learning method for early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis on multiphase CT
summary: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with multiphase computed tomography and at least one liver lesion were included, while lesions larger than 40 mm were excluded. Histology served as the reference standard for hepatocellular carcinoma, and a composite reference standard was used for non-hepatocellular carcinoma lesions. The lesion-level accuracy of dLI-RADS and LI-RADS were compared on the internal evaluation set using 10,000-repetition bootstrap non-inferiority tests, with 5% margins and significance levels. On the external test set, sensitivities were similarly compared. dLI-RADS was non-inferior to LI-RADS for lesion-level accuracy in the internal evaluation set, achieving 80% accuracy compared with 74% for LI-RADS (p = 0.04)...

AI.tldr: 该文提出可解释AI方法dLI-RADS，融合神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的定量影像测量，经逻辑回归整合，估计多期CT上小肝癌病灶的HCC概率。
AI.motivation: HCC早期诊断关乎根治性治疗机会。LI-RADS提供基于主要视觉特征的无创诊断标准，但视觉特征评估一致性差，尤其在小病灶中更困难。
AI.method: dLI-RADS：以人工分割的肝脏病灶多期CT为输入，将神经网络预测与手工提取的、对应LI-RADS主要特征的定量影像测量组合，用逻辑回归融合。多中心回顾性研究，纳入有多期CT且至少一个肝脏病灶者，排除>40 mm病灶；HCC以病理为参考标准，非HCC采用复合参考标准。内部集用10000次bootstrap非劣效检验（5%界值）比较病灶级准确率，外部集比较敏感度。
AI.result: 内部评估集上dLI-RADS对LI-RADS的病灶级准确率非劣效：80% vs 74%（p = 0.04）；外部集敏感度比较结果摘要中未完整给出。
AI.conclusion: dLI-RADS在保持与LI-RADS影像概念一致、可解释的前提下，病灶级诊断准确率不劣于放射科医师采用的LI-RADS，并有望改善小肝癌病灶诊断的一致性。

title: Generalization Bounds via Vector-Valued $L_p$ Correlation $V_α$
summary: Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. We study a one-parameter family of dependence measures, the vector-valued $L_p$-norm correlation $V_α$, and derive generalization bounds whose dependence terms interpolate between total variation (TV) at $α=1$ and variance and $χ^2$ related behavior at $α=2$. For $α>2$, the Hölder-conjugate loss moment is below two, yielding heavy-tailed specializations that can remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite. A particularly interpretable specialization occurs at $α=2$, where the bound can be expressed in terms of the variability of the algorithm's output density across datasets, $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$. We show that the entire $V_α$ family is invariant under smooth bijective reparameterizations of the hypothesis space. We also introduce an adaptive density stability (ADS) condition that implies explicit control of $V_2$, and we verify it for Gibbs-type posteriors under bounded losses (yielding rates that depend on the inverse temperature and sample size). To address scaling, we extend the framework to a conditional formulation using supersamples, analogous in spirit to conditional mutual information (CMI), and discuss evaluations in the output space as a practical surrogate for estimating dependence. Simulations on Bayesian linear regression illustrate how tuning $α$ can change the tightness of the resulting bounds across regimes. Additional supersample experiments on noisy MNIST and on a pretrained ResNet-50 for CIFAR-10 show similar behavior of the projected loss-space bounds beyond the original clean-MNIST setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一类单参数依赖度量——向量值 $L_p$ 范数相关 $V_\alpha$，并据此推导泛化界：$\alpha=1$ 退化为全变差(TV)界，$\alpha=2$ 对应方差/$\chi^2$ 型行为；$\alpha>2$ 时 Hölder 共轭损失矩小于二，可处理无穷方差的重尾情形。作者证明 $V_\alpha$ 族在光滑双射重参数化下不变，提出自适应密度稳定性(ADS)条件以显式控制 $V_2$，并扩展出基于 supersample 的条件形式（类比 CMI）。
AI.motivation: 随机学习算法的泛化仍是核心难题。互信息界与全变差界分别刻画数据—假设依赖，但在高维情形下表现差异显著；单一依赖度量难以在不同维度、不同损失尾行为下同时取得紧致性，因此需要一类可调、可插值的依赖度量框架。
AI.method: 构造单参数依赖度量族 $V_\alpha$（向量值 $L_p$ 范数相关），推导相应泛化界；在 $\alpha=2$ 处给出以输出密度跨数据集变异性 $\int\sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}\,dw$ 表达的界；证明 $V_\alpha$ 对假设空间光滑双射重参数化不变；提出自适应密度稳定性(ADS)条件以控制 $V_2$，并在有界损失下对 Gibbs 型后验验证（速率依赖逆温度与样本量）；进一步用 supersample 给出条件化版本（类比 CMI），并以输出空间评估作为依赖估计的实用替代。
AI.result: $V_\alpha$ 界的依赖项在 $\alpha=1$ 与 $\alpha=2$ 之间插值 TV 与方差/$\chi^2$ 行为；$\alpha>2$ 时给出可在损失方差无穷时仍有限的重尾界；ADS 条件对 Gibbs 后验给出显式速率；贝叶斯线性回归模拟显示调节 $\alpha$ 可改变各 regime 下界的紧致度；在噪声 MNIST 及 CIFAR-10 的预训练 ResNet-50 上的 supersample 实验显示投影损失空间界呈现类似行为。
AI.conclusion: $V_\alpha$ 提供了一个统一、可调且重参数化不变的依赖度量框架，兼顾 TV、方差/$\chi^2$ 与重尾情形，并通过 ADS 与条件化 supersample 扩展提升可计算性与可扩展性；实验表明 $\alpha$ 的调节能有效影响界紧致度，且该框架可推广至深度模型场景。

title: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
summary: Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.

AI.tldr: 提出P2NPCBench基准，将12类NP完全问题与其多项式时间孪生问题以相同表面形式配对，并用AgentGAN对抗式改写去除教科书线索，揭示模型在NPC侧系统性劣于P孪生（35.4% vs 63.8% pass@1）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么固定任务措辞、要么忽略问题的复杂度类别，无法区分模型的失败源于对复杂度边界的推理能力不足，还是对教科书题面的记忆/熟悉度。
AI.method: 构建P2NPCBench：12个问题族中每个NPC问题配一个表层相同的P孪生（如3着色vs 2着色）。用AgentGAN多智能体对抗框架改写题面——生成器迭代改写直至一组冻结代码模型全部失败，同时以可执行的合法性校验保证改写保持答案与复杂度类别不变。最终得到2,114条"硬化"题面，并配人工核验的参考求解器；评测12个闭源与开源模型。
AI.result: 所有模型在NPC题上的得分均低于其P孪生（35.4% vs 63.8% pass@1）；95.1%的模型族配对在NPC侧失败率更高；时间限制放宽10倍仅使NPC准确率从28.5%升至31.9%，说明失败源于程序错误或崩溃而非速度不足；硬化改写将类别差距从24.8点缩小到14.6点。
AI.conclusion: 模型在复杂度边界两侧存在显著且系统性的能力落差，但其中一部分"差距"实则来自对教科书措辞的熟悉度而非复杂度类别本身；硬化基准能更干净地度量真实的算法推理能力。

title: FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026), PMLR 318:13-24. Available at https://proceedings.mlr.press/v318/abedi26a.html
summary: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. These predictions are subsequently refined through non-maximum suppression and confidence filtering. The student model then learns from strongly augmented target sample using the Varifocal loss to mitigate pseudo-label noise. The teacher is updated via exponential moving averaging to ensure stable and continuous adaptation. Experiments show that FogTTA outperforms prior baselines, delivering improved detection accuracy and stability while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 提出在线测试时自适应框架 FogTTA，使 RF-DETR 目标检测器在雾天场景中无需源数据或重训练即可稳健工作。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶目标检测模型在训练数据（晴天）与真实运营条件（雾天、能见度与对比度下降）之间存在域偏移，导致部署时性能显著下降，需要实时适应以提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用教师-学生架构：以部署模型为教师，对弱增强目标输入生成伪标签，经非极大值抑制与置信度过滤精炼；学生模型用强增强样本结合 Varifocal 损失学习，以缓解伪标签噪声；教师通过指数滑动平均更新，保证稳定连续的自适应。
AI.result: 实验表明 FogTTA 优于已有基线，在保持实时性能的同时提升了检测精度与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于教师-学生与 EMA 的无源在线测试时自适应可有效应对雾天域偏移，为 Transformer 检测器的实时鲁棒部署提供可行方案。

title: BIRD-RL: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning over Stateful Data-Centric Environments
summary: While agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training small language models (SLMs), existing frameworks are predominantly tool-centric and struggle with data-centric environments. Specifically, applying tool-centric frameworks to stateful tasks like SQL debugging introduces severe spatial inefficiencies since proper environment isolation typically requires a separate database container per rollout. Naively reusing databases without tracking evolving states across multi-turn interactions causes trajectory contamination and cross-trajectory interference, which severely destabilizes policy updates. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce BIRD-RL, a novel four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational agent reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration to circumvent the instability inherently associated with direct end-to-end learning. Crucially, to support this curriculum, BIRD-RL is driven by a Trajectory-scoped Persistent Execution Infrastructure, which enables safe database replica reuse while preserving trajectory isolation. This design improves spatial RL efficiency by 12.8x, successfully enabling scalable agentic RL for complex data-centric tasks without needs of Kubernettes. Empirical evaluations on the BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite benchmark demonstrate that our 7B and 14B models achieve Success Rates of 44.40% and 48.00%, respectively, showing competitive performance against strong proprietary model-based agents such as Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent (48.20%). Furthermore, BIRD-RL successfully trains unified SLMs capable of both advanced SQL debugging and generation, highlighting its broader potential for multi-objective optimization across heterogeneous, real-world data-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: BIRD-RL：面向数据密集型状态任务的四阶段 agentic RL 课程框架，配合轨迹级持久化执行基础设施，实现数据库副本安全复用，空间效率提升 12.8×，7B/14B 模型在 BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite 上成功率 44.40%/48.00%。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic RL 框架以工具为中心，难以适配数据密集型状态环境。将工具中心范式用于 SQL 调试等有状态任务时，为环境隔离需为每个 rollout 单独启动数据库容器，造成严重空间低效；而朴素复用数据库却不追踪多轮交互中的状态演变，会导致轨迹污染与跨轨迹干扰，严重破坏策略更新的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出 BIRD-RL 四阶段 agentic RL 课程，交替强化基础智能体推理与轨迹自适应的同策略探索，以规避直接端到端学习固有的不稳定性；并由轨迹级持久化执行基础设施（Trajectory-scoped Persistent Execution Infrastructure）支撑该课程，在保证轨迹隔离的前提下安全复用数据库副本，无需依赖 Kubernetes。
AI.result: 空间 RL 效率提升 12.8×；在 BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite 基准上，7B 与 14B 模型分别取得 44.40% 与 48.00% 的成功率，与 Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent（48.20%）等强专有模型智能体具竞争力；同时成功训练出兼顾高级 SQL 调试与生成的统一 SLM。
AI.conclusion: BIRD-RL 通过课程化训练与轨迹级持久化执行基础设施，解决了数据密集型任务中 agentic RL 的空间效率与稳定性瓶颈，可扩展至异构真实数据任务的多目标优化，并展现出统一 SLM 在调试与生成双重能力上的潜力。

title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
summary: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.

AI.tldr: 提出Quant-Arena基准与公开排行榜，用于A股真实数据的端到端量化研究，九个前沿LLM中无一在2024年封存测试期跑赢等权市场。
AI.motivation: 量化研究是"提出假设—实现为可执行信号—回测—取舍"的迭代闭环，但现有基准仅评测公式、代码或单笔交易决策，无法判断LLM能否独立完成整个闭环并产出研究期之外依然有效的策略。
AI.method: 构建Quant-Arena基准：模型自主构造特征与股票打分代码，仅在2022–2023年获得反馈，随后冻结一个策略在封存的2024年评估；使用现金账户评估器施加交易约束与成本（含基于模拟订单簿估计的市场冲击）；评分以已实现超额收益为主，辅以信号质量与特征多样性。
AI.result: 评测九个前沿模型，GPT-6 Astra得分最高，但没有任何模型在2024年超越等权市场基准。
AI.conclusion: 端到端量化研究闭环对当前LLM仍是开放难题；Quant-Arena以公开排行榜形式开放任意模型或智能体框架提交，用于持续追踪进展。

title: OpenEarth-OVS44: A Multimodal Remote Sensing Dataset for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: In remote sensing, open-vocabulary segmentation is particularly important for flexible and scalable land-cover understanding across diverse regions, as it improves generalization to novel categories without requiring exhaustive pixel-level annotations. Despite its great promise, progress in this area remains largely constrained by existing datasets with limited category coverage and overly coarse taxonomies, and therefore struggles to support fine-grained semantic understanding required in real-world applications such as urban functional zoning, carbon accounting, and post-disaster assessment. To address these challenges, we present OpenEarth-OVS44, a multimodal benchmark with 290,587 expert-verified segments from 2,832 RGB images and 1,341 strictly registered RGB-SAR pairs at sub-meter spatial resolution, covering 40 cities across France, Japan, and the United States under a unified 44-class taxonomy organized into 9 base categories. Three evaluation tracks are provided: an RGB-only fine-grained benchmark, a multimodal track with diverse synthetic cloudy conditions for weather-robust evaluation, and a held-out cross-region track. Extensive experiments on representative open-vocabulary segmentation models demonstrate that training on OpenEarth-OVS44 substantially improves fine-grained segmentation performance over the strongest training-free baseline, with improvements of up to 7.1 mIoU points on unseen categories and 27.6 mIoU points on seen categories. The dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenEarth-OVS44 多模态开放词汇分割基准，296k 专家标注段、亚米级 RGB/SAR 数据、统一 44 类体系，含 RGB-only、多云鲁棒、跨区域三条评测赛道。
AI.motivation: 遥感开放词汇分割对精细地物理解（城市功能区划、碳核算、灾后评估）至关重要，但现有数据集类别覆盖有限、分类体系过粗，难以支撑细粒度语义理解。
AI.method: 构建包含 2,832 幅 RGB 影像与 1,341 对严格配准 RGB-SAR 影像的基准，亚米级分辨率，覆盖法、日、美 40 座城市，采用 9 大类下 44 类的统一分类体系，共 290,587 个专家核验分割段；设置 RGB-only 细粒度、合成云条件下多模态鲁棒性、留出跨区域三条评测赛道，并在代表性 OVS 模型上开展实验。
AI.result: 在 OpenEarth-OVS44 上训练相较最强免训练基线，未见类别 mIoU 提升最高 7.1 点，已见类别提升最高 27.6 点。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可有效推动遥感细粒度开放词汇分割研究，数据与代码将公开。

title: One Act, Many Masks: Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Recent advances in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on complex, long-horizon interactive tasks. However, despite progress in fine-grained credit assignment, policy optimization still applies these learning signals through response-specific probability ratios. Different textual responses can induce the same executable effect, yet credit differences arising from subsequent outcomes remain tied to their individual textual realizations. We identify this mismatch as credit-update misalignment. Our analysis reveals that credit-text pairing directly shapes policy-update directions, even when the policy context and executable effect are held fixed. Motivated by this finding, we propose Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO), which aligns policy optimization with execution-level equivalence through an effect-level surrogate that couples updates across alternative textual realizations. EMPO preserves the original credit signals, integrates with both trajectory-level and step-level credit estimators, and requires no additional critics or rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban show that EMPO outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and learning efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别多轮强化学习中“信用-更新错配”问题：不同文本响应可产生相同可执行效果，但信用差异仍绑定在各自文本实现上；为此提出EMPO，通过效果级代理目标在不同文本实现间耦合更新，在不增加critic或rollout的前提下提升任务性能与学习效率。
AI.motivation: 多轮RL提升LLM智能体性能，但策略优化仍以响应特定的概率比施加信用信号。不同文本响应可能具有相同可执行效果，而由后续结果产生的信用差异仍绑定于各文本实现，导致信用更新与执行效果不对齐。
AI.method: 分析表明在策略上下文与可执行效果固定时，信用-文本配对会直接影响策略更新方向。据此提出Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO)，用效果级代理目标在替代文本实现间耦合更新，保留原始信用信号，并兼容轨迹级与步级信用估计器，无需额外critic或rollout。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Sokoban上，EMPO在任务性能与学习效率两方面均优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 将策略优化对齐到执行级等价性、而非文本实现层面，可有效缓解信用更新错配，且以低额外开销实现性能与效率双重提升。

title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
summary: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

AI.tldr: 提出动态智能体基准 Environment Duels，让九个前沿 LLM 在交互式环境中既"写环境"又"解环境"，发现求解能力与出题能力是两种独立技能，并通过对战互动揭示模型间"互教互学"的生态规律。
AI.motivation: 现实中 LLM 通过合成训练流水线与开放网络共享数据互相吸收彼此（及前代/竞品）的产出，形成生态式互动。但现有评测多只考察模型作为"求解者"的能力，缺乏对其作为"创造者"以及在生态中相互影响方式的系统刻画。因此需要一个能在受控条件下同时评估"创作"与"求解"双重角色、并把模型间交互本身当作研究对象来测量。
AI.method: 构建 Environment Duels 基准：评估以交互式环境为载体的双角色能力。每个模型编写环境，且每个环境附带一条 privileged hint（特权提示），设计目标是"强求解者在无提示时失败、有提示时通过"。在九个前沿 LLM 上进行成对（head-to-head）对战，收集解决得分与出题/提示质量的配对交互数据；并开展强化学习研究，用 Qwen3.8-27B 作为学习者在作者生成的环境上训练，比较 hint lift 与迁移到 held-out 推理与智能体基准的表现。
AI.result: 1) 求解与出题是两种独立技能：最强求解者并非最强出题者；较小的模型更善于从他人对局的玩法中学习，反而写出最难的环境和最有用的提示。2) 配对交互构成模型相互影响的"微观缩影"：正面交锋结果具有传递性，可产生稳定排名；独立作者对环境设计趋于收敛。3) 在 Qwen3.8-27B 的 RL 实验中，学习者在某作者环境上的 hint lift 能预测在该环境上训练后于 held-out 推理与智能体基准上的提升幅度，且无论环境来自自身还是他模型均成立。
AI.conclusion: Environment Duels 通过对战式受控设置，将"创作—求解"双能力评估与模型间互动的刻画统一起来，提示这些模式在对战之外模型相互塑造的现实中均有对应。该基准为观察 LLM 如何相互教学、相互挑战与相互学习提供了一个窗口。代码已开源（https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels）。

title: Joint Semantic-Channel Coding and Modulation for Generative Image Transmission
summary: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.

AI.tldr: 提出SemQAM——一种面向生成式图像传输的联合语义-信道编码与调制方案，将源直接映射为QAM符号。
AI.motivation: 传统数字图像传输将信源编码、信道编码与调制分别优化，限制了源表示对信道损伤的自适应能力。
AI.method: 用VQ表示潜在特征，将每个VQ索引映射到QAM符号，并利用检测符号更新对应码字使信道损伤直接影响码本学习；采用接收码字条件期望近似接收端重建以减小自回归编码误差传播；单一模型支持多SNR与多CBR，SemQAM-C支持常规信源编码。
AI.result: 相同LDPC与QAM设置下，SemQAM-C在LPIPS与DISTS上优于OneDC且复杂度显著更低；相比分离方案，在匹配LPIPS下减少18.57%信道使用，并优于对比JSCC方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合编码与调制可有效提升生成式图像传输效率，统一模型兼具竞争性信源编码能力。

title: How Far Can Foundation Models Be Distilled for Efficient Jet Tagging?
comment: 34 pages, 16 figures, 23 tables. Code and model weights: https://github.com/JayAgarwal25/distilling-jet-taggers
summary: Jet tagging is one of the most important applications of machine learning at the Large Hadron Collider. Recent models build in more physics knowledge or rely on large-scale pretraining, but the experiments place strict limits on their inference cost. Knowledge distillation can transfer their performance to small students that are cheap to run. We ask which properties of a teacher help the student, how small a student can get and how close it can come to the state of the art. On a jet tagging benchmark, we distil six teachers that differ in architecture, symmetry and pretraining, including two foundation models, into five small students. Every teacher improves every student, and the gain depends mainly on the strength of the teacher. We then shrink our two strongest distilled students, Transformer and L-GATr-slim, in width and in depth. With 20 thousand parameters, a distilled L-GATr-slim outperforms every published jet tagger trained from scratch at a fraction of the inference cost of every teacher. Even with two thousand parameters, it matches ParT, a model with a thousand times as many parameters. We also study what the students learn from their teachers. Our benchmark of inference cost shows that students of the same size can differ by almost an order of magnitude in speed. We release the code and the weights of all trained models.

AI.tldr: 将6个架构/对称性/预训练各异的教师模型（含2个基础模型）蒸馏到5个小学生模型中，验证"所有教师都能提升所有学生、增益主要由教师强度决定"，并将两个最强蒸馏学生按宽度与深度压缩；20k参数的蒸馏L-GATr-slim在同量级推理成本下超越所有已发表的从零训练jet tagger，2k参数即可匹敌参数量多1000倍的ParT。
AI.motivation: LHC上的jet tagging是机器学习的重要应用，近期模型通过引入物理知识或大规模预训练提升性能，但实验对其推理成本有严格限制。知识蒸馏可将大模型性能迁移到廉价的小学生模型，因此需要系统回答：教师的哪些属性有助于学生、学生能有多小、能多接近SOTA，并量化同尺寸学生的推理速度差异。
AI.method: 以jet tagging基准为实验平台，选取6个在架构、对称性、预训练上各不相同的教师（含两个基础模型），蒸馏到5个小型学生；分析教师属性与蒸馏增益的关系；对两个最强蒸馏学生（Transformer与L-GATr-slim）在宽度和深度两个维度上逐步收缩；并建立推理成本基准测试，比较同尺寸学生的推理速度。
AI.result: 每个教师都能提升每个学生，增益主要取决于教师强度而非具体属性差异；20k参数的蒸馏L-GATr-slim在远低于任何教师的推理成本下超越所有已发表的从零训练jet tagger；仅2k参数时即可匹敌参数量为其1000倍的ParT；同尺寸学生的推理速度可相差近一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏是获得高性价比jet tagger的有效途径，教师强度是蒸馏收益的关键因素，且学生可被压缩至极小规模仍保持SOTA级性能；推理成本须作为与参数量并列的独立评价维度。作者开源全部代码与训练权重。

title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/zhennan1/LongZero
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

AI.tldr: LongZero 让大模型在无任何外部数据条件下自学长上下文推理：先以紧凑结构化形式自造问题-答案-证据，再单独将证据扩展为长多文档上下文，并结合自造多轮检索任务用 GRPO 训练，在五个长上下文基准上优于外部语料合成数据的 RL 基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可提升大模型长上下文推理，但需要长、多样、有挑战且可验证的训练数据。人工标注昂贵，自然数据稀缺难以支撑 RL，现有合成方法依赖外部语料或更强的教师模型，而随着被训练模型变强，这些资源愈发难以获得。已有的"零数据 RL"（模型自提议任务）仅针对短上下文任务。
AI.method: 提出 LongZero：不基于现有文档撰写问答，而是先让模型以紧凑结构化形式合成问题、答案及其支撑证据，再将证据单独扩展为长多文档上下文；将此自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮检索任务结合，用 GRPO 进行训练。
AI.result: 在两个 LLM、五个长上下文推理基准上评测，并与基于外部语料合成数据的 RL 方法对比：LongZero 能泛化到真实任务，且优于两个基线。
AI.conclusion: LongZero 表明无需外部数据即可自我提升长上下文推理能力，是一条可行且有前景的路径。

title: MS2CAST: A Video Anomaly Detection Framework via Multi-Scale Spatial Cross-Attention and Efficient Spatiotemporal Networks
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a challenging task for surveillance systems due to the scarcity and diversity of anomalous events. While semi-supervised VAD approaches have advanced the field, many rely on computationally intensive optical flow networks to capture motion dynamics. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are also widely used for spatial encoding, but their effective receptive field is highly local. To address these limitations, we introduce MS2CAST, an end-to-end semi-supervised predictive VAD framework. For spatial encoding, we employ a multi-scale cross-attention encoder that fuses the hierarchical feature representations from a vision transformer (MViTv2-S) and a CNN (ConvNeXt-T) to exploit their distinct receptive fields. To model spatiotemporal dynamics without optical flow estimation, we integrate two interchangeable spatiotemporal modules in the latent space. One module (SwinLSTM) incorporates a Swin Transformer, while the other (VMRNN) integrates Vision Mamba blocks. Our objective function combines L1 loss, Gradient Difference Loss (GDL), and Multi-Scale Structural Similarity Index Measure (MS-SSIM) to ensure pixel-wise accuracy, sharpness, and structural integrity. Evaluations across the UCSD Ped2, CUHK Avenue, and ShanghaiTech datasets demonstrate frame-level Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Area Under the Curve (AUC) scores that are competitive with top-tier techniques while maintaining a peak GPU memory usage of under 1 GB.

AI.tldr: 提出MS2CAST端到端半监督预测式视频异常检测框架，用多尺度交叉注意力编码器融合ViT与CNN特征，并以SwinLSTM或VMRNN在潜空间建模时空动态替代光流，配合L1+GDL+MS-SSIM损失，在三个数据集上取得有竞争力的帧级AUC且显存低于1GB。
AI.motivation: 视频异常检测面临异常事件稀缺与多样的问题；现有半监督方法多依赖计算昂贵的光流网络捕捉运动动态，且CNN空间编码的有效感受野高度局部化，限制了特征表达能力。
AI.method: 提出MS2CAST端到端半监督预测式框架：空间编码采用多尺度交叉注意力编码器，融合MViTv2-S（ViT）与ConvNeXt-T（CNN）的分层特征以利用不同感受野；潜空间中集成两种可互换时空模块（含Swin Transformer的SwinLSTM与含Vision Mamba块的VMRNN），无需光流估计即可建模时空动态；目标函数结合L1损失、梯度差分损失GDL与多尺度结构相似性MS-SSIM。
AI.result: 在UCSD Ped2、CUHK Avenue、ShanghaiTech数据集上，帧级ROC-AUC与顶级方法相当，同时峰值GPU显存占用低于1GB。
AI.conclusion: 融合异构感受野的多尺度编码与潜空间时空建模可在避免光流计算开销的前提下实现高性能、低显存的视频异常检测，验证了该设计的有效性与实用性。

title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出"Harness Scaling"这一agentic RL新扩展维度，将训练从单一harness扩展至多样化执行配置，通过构造因子化harness空间、选取均衡因子覆盖的训练子集并组织跨harness训练，显著提升对未见白/黑盒harness配置的泛化。
AI.motivation: Agent harness决定模型如何调用工具、管理上下文与协调长程交互，但现有RL训练通常固定单一harness，导致过拟合于特定配置、跨harness迁移能力受限。
AI.method: 构建因子化(factorized) harness空间；选取具有均衡因子覆盖(balanced factorial coverage)的紧凑训练子集；组织跨harness训练，将全局覆盖与同一任务上的受控变化相结合。
AI.result: 在多个基准、模型规模与RL算法上，对未见白盒配置的泛化一致提升；经结构化白盒变异训练的模型可有效迁移至未见外部黑盒harness，并优于用单一复杂黑盒harness训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: harness多样性构成agentic RL的有效扩展维度，且多样性的组织方式对跨harness泛化至关重要。

title: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
summary: Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together. We introduce Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose parallel revisions and evaluate a candidate draft. We train the denoiser to reconstruct every token from uniformly corrupted drafts, teaching both preservation and repair. Its predictions specify revisions directly, without a diffusion reverse transition. Evaluation requires a different use of these predictions: confidence in an existing token reflects both contextual support and evidence from observing the token itself. Using the known corruption process, we correct for this self-token evidence to estimate how well each token is supported by the prompt and the remaining draft. Aggregating these estimates yields a cavity energy computed in one forward pass, without an additional scoring model. Each round proposes a revision, reads the completed candidate in its revised context, and retains it only if its energy is lower. Across Countdown, Sudoku-Extreme, and Maze-Hard, our method outperforms autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. With 6M parameters, DRLM reaches 44.4% on Countdown-5 and 93.9% on Sudoku-Extreme. The results establish complete-draft parallel refinement as an effective alternative to reverse diffusion for complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLM)，用单一去噪器对草案进行并行修正，并通过一次前向计算得到的"空腔能量"评估候选草案，在Countdown、Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard上优于自回归与离散扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 推理模型起草答案后可结合其他决策重新审视每个决策，但重复的扩散去噪并不能保证"逐个看似合理的token更新"组合起来会形成更好的答案。作者希望实现"整份草案的并行精修"，并避免为候选打分而额外训练评分模型。
AI.method: 1) 训练单一去噪器从均匀随机扰动的草案中重建每个token，同时学习保留与修复；2) 其预测直接给出修正，不依赖扩散逆向转移；3) 评估时利用已知的扰动过程，从观测到token本身的"自证据"中校正置信度，估计该token在提示与其余草案上下文下的支持度；4) 聚合得到cavity能量，一次前向传播内完成，无需额外打分模型；5) 每轮提出一个修正、在修订后的上下文中读取完整候选，仅当能量更低才保留。
AI.result: 在Countdown、Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard上优于自回归与离散扩散基线。仅6M参数时，Countdown-5达44.4%，Sudoku-Extreme达93.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，完整的草案并行精修是复杂推理任务中替代逆向扩散的有效思路。

title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering

AI.tldr: SGS通过在关键去噪时间步从DiT注意力图提取逐人掩码，对每个人独立施加不同人口统计向量，实现多人物场景中的图像内多样性，兼顾总体平衡与图像质量，且无需微调或布局输入。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型会复现社会刻板印象，而现有缓解方法对整幅场景施加统一的人口统计校正，导致多人物场景中的权衡：全局引导只通过同质化图像内人物来改善总体平衡；Embedding Arithmetic等引导方法使用图像内多样性低于未引导基线；文本与潜空间投影方法仅带来边际多样性增益。
AI.method: 提出空间门控引导（SGS）：在关键去噪时间步，从扩散Transformer（DiT）内部注意力图中提取逐人掩码，使用基于冻结DiT注意力特征的轻量分割器在早期时间步定位主体，并在剩余时间步内对每个掩码施加不同的人口统计向量，从而独立引导每个人物的人口统计属性。方法无需微调、反演或布局规格。
