AI.result: 在具有偏斜的职业提示词上，SGS达到较高的图像内种族与性别多样性，同时总体平衡保持竞争力，图像质量接近基线；结果在FLUX.1-Dev与SD3.5-Large两种架构不同的扩散Transformer上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 逐人空间门控引导可有效缓解多人物场景生成中的同质化权衡；作者开源了代码与模型权重。

title: Asymmetry Tunneling Beyond Adaptive Equivariance Relaxation
summary: Equivariant neural networks encode prescribed symmetries as powerful inductive biases, yet real-world data may exhibit symmetry-breaking structure that these priors cannot fully capture. Prior work has largely addressed this challenge through model-side equivariance relaxation, seeking an appropriate level of equivariance for the data. This raises a complementary question: must equivariance relaxation be adaptively controlled? To investigate this question, we introduce a residual path alongside a strictly equivariant model and deliberately restrict their interface to examine the transmission of task-relevant structure. Across five benchmarks, we observe both residual collapse and survival despite these restrictions; we call the latter phenomenon asymmetry tunneling. We further characterize this phenomenon through four complementary diagnostics. Our results suggest that adaptive control of equivariance relaxation is not a prerequisite for capturing potential symmetry-breaking structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究等变松弛是否必须自适应控制，通过在严格等变模型旁引入受限接口的残差路径，发现即使接口受限，任务相关结构仍可传递（"不对称隧穿"），表明自适应控制并非捕捉对称性破缺结构的必要条件。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要从模型侧松弛等变性以适应数据中的对称性破缺，但作者提出互补问题：等变性松弛是否必须被自适应地控制？
AI.method: 在严格等变模型旁增设一条残差路径，并刻意限制二者的接口，以考察任务相关结构的传递情况；在五个基准上观测残差坍缩与残差存活现象，并用四项互补诊断刻画该现象。
AI.result: 在五个基准上同时观察到残差坍缩与残差存活；后者被称为"不对称隧穿"（asymmetry tunneling），并通过四项诊断加以刻画。
AI.conclusion: 等变性松弛的自适应控制并非捕捉潜在对称性破缺结构的先决条件。

title: Learning to Reason Like a Cytopathologist:Clinically Grounded Multiscale Evidential Learning for Cervical Cytology
summary: Cervical cytology presents a fundamentally ambiguous diagnostic landscape, where equivocal categories such as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) occupy a morphological grey zone that is definitional. For clinical decision support, the goal extends beyond assigning a definitive label to every sample: cases must also be distinguished by whether the available evidence supports a confident decision or warrants further consideration, a distinction conventional classification models are not designed to explicitly represent. We propose a multiscale evidential framework that models cervical cytology along an ordinal disease continuum using clinically grounded soft anchors, representing progression from benign reactive changes to precancerous lesions and malignancy. Three biologically motivated spatial contexts--nuclear morphology, cytoplasmic characteristics, and neighbourhood cellular architecture--are independently encoded using a shared frozen DINOv2 backbone, preserving inter-scale disagreement that early fusion may obscure. Calibrated predictions are transformed into Dempster--Shafer belief masses and fused with reliability discounting, allowing conflicting evidence and insufficient support to remain explicitly uncommitted rather than forcing a decision. The fused belief state drives interpretable routing that separates confidently classified cases from those with irreducible evidential insufficiency, enabling clinically meaningful triage. Across two independent publicly available conventional cytology datasets, RIVA and CRIC Cervix, the framework generalises consistently, with uncertainty strongly associated with diagnostic difficulty: incorrect predictions carry 1.94x-4.13x higher uncertainty than correct ones.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度证据框架，将宫颈细胞学建模为有序疾病连续谱，用Dempster–Shafer证据融合与可靠性折扣显式保留未决证据，并据此实现可解释分诊。
AI.motivation: 宫颈细胞学中ASC-US等模糊类别构成定义性形态灰区；临床决策支持不仅需要给出标签，还需区分证据充分可自信决策与需进一步检查的样本，而常规分类模型无法显式表达这一区分。
AI.method: 以临床依据的软锚点将细胞学建模为从良性反应性改变到癌前病变及恶性的有序连续谱；用共享冻结DINOv2骨干独立编码三种生物学动机的空间上下文（核形态、胞质特征、邻域细胞架构）以保留早期融合可能掩盖的跨尺度分歧；将校准后的预测转为Dempster–Shafer信度质量，并以可靠性折扣融合，使冲突证据与支持不足保持显式未决；由融合信度状态驱动可解释路由，将高置信分类样本与不可约证据不足样本分离。
AI.result: 在RIVA与CRIC Cervix两个独立公开常规细胞学数据集上一致泛化；不确定性强烈关联诊断难度，错误预测的不确定性为正确预测的1.94–4.13倍。
AI.conclusion: 证据融合加多尺度独立编码能显式刻画诊断歧义并量化不确定性，实现与诊断难度一致的风险分层，为细胞学筛查提供可解释的三分诊支持。

title: Density-Level Backward Error for Low-NFE Generative Flows
comment: 37 pages, including appendices. Accepted as a poster at ICOMP 2026
summary: Low-NFE generative ODE sampling is constrained not only by solver order, but also by how a fixed budget of network evaluations is distributed along the flow. We develop a density-level backward-error framework that identifies the component of a solver's modified-equation defect that changes the evolving marginal, while excluding solenoidal trajectory distortion that is invisible in Wasserstein tangent geometry. The resulting residual induces a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and, through gauge freedom, an objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives of the same density path. This separates our approach from schedule search driven by trajectory or endpoint surrogates and from higher-order solver design. Exact Gaussian and mixture models establish the mechanism, including cases where curvature-based allocation fails and continuum-optimal transport is not discretization-optimal. On a pretrained CIFAR-10 EDM probability-flow ODE, density-aware allocation consistently improves fixed-update Euler sampling in the low-NFE regime. Matched-seed convergence to a dense Euler reference confirms that the method accelerates approximation of the same high-NFE flow rather than changing the asymptotic sampler.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于密度级后向误差（density-level backward-error）的框架，用于分析低NFE生成式ODE采样，并据此导出自适应算力分配规则与速度表示选择目标，在CIFAR-10 EDM概率流ODE上改善了低NFE下的固定更新Euler采样。
AI.motivation: 低NFE生成式ODE采样的质量既受求解器阶数限制，也受固定的网络评估预算如何沿流分配所制约。已有方法多依赖轨迹或端点代理指标做调度搜索，或单纯设计高阶求解器，缺乏从密度演化层面刻画误差的准则。
AI.method: 构建密度级后向误差框架，从求解器修正方程缺陷中分离出真正改变演化边缘分布的成分，排除在Wasserstein切空间几何中不可见的无散（solenoidal）轨迹畸变。该残差导出一个求解器阶数感知的算力分配规则，并借助规范自由度（gauge freedom）构造目标，用于在同一密度路径的多个数值行为更优的速度表示之间进行选择。
AI.result: 在精确高斯与混合模型上验证了机制，包括基于曲率的分配失效、以及连续最优传输并非离散化最优的情形。在预训练CIFAR-10 EDM概率流ODE上，密度感知的分配在低NFE区间稳定优于固定更新Euler采样；匹配种子的收敛实验显示方法加速了向同一高NFE稠密Euler参考解的逼近，而非改变渐近采样器。
AI.conclusion: 误差分析应在密度层面进行，排除对分布无影响的轨迹畸变后所得的残差可有效指导NFE分配与速度表示选取；该方法在不改变目标采样的前提下提升低NFE效率，与调度搜索和高阶求解器设计形成互补。

title: Rethinking Post-hoc Debiasing of Large Pretrained Models
summary: Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. We show that the pattern that such methods seek is readily observable in the frozen geometry. Specifically, cross-class training pairs placed closest together by the frozen encoder almost always share a spurious attribute, regardless of the bias type, without requiring access to the bias labels. Based on this, we propose a novel approach to identify such pairs and learn a single linear map that transforms the features to perform post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach achieves competitive performance across all datasets without access to bias attribute annotations or any LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该文发现现有事后去偏方法依赖"偏置特征需被文本识别与表达"，在多偏置共存时性能受损；作者利用冻结特征几何中跨类最近邻对几乎总共享伪相关属性的现象，提出无需偏置标注与LLM的线性映射去偏方法。
AI.motivation: CLIP等冻结特征提取器的嵌入继承训练数据的虚假相关（spurious correlation），带来偏置。现有多数事后去偏（post-hoc debiasing）方法保持骨干不变，但隐含要求偏置特征能被识别并用文本表达。作者指出该依赖并非无害：在UrbanCars等存在两个共现偏置属性的基准上，这类方法甚至不如在偏置冻结特征上训练的普通分类器，且即使给出真实偏置身份也无法弥补差距。
AI.method: 先在冻结特征空间中观察几何结构：由冻结编码器拉得最近的跨类训练样本对，几乎总共享某一伪相关属性，与偏置类型无关，且无需偏置标签即可观察到。据此提出新方法——识别此类跨类最近邻对，并学习单一线性映射（linear map）对特征做变换，实现事后去偏；全程不使用偏置属性标注，也不依赖任何大语言模型。
AI.result: 在UrbanCars等基准上证实：依赖文本偏置表达的方法在多共现偏置情形下劣于偏置特征上的vanilla分类器，提供ground-truth偏置身份也无法弥补。所提方法在所有数据集上取得有竞争力的性能，且无需偏置属性标注与LLM。
AI.conclusion: 偏置信息已隐含于冻结特征几何之中，可通过跨类最近邻对无监督地捕获；单个线性映射即可实现有效事后去偏，摆脱对文本偏置描述与偏置标注的依赖。

title: Generative Modeling via Nonlinear Schrödinger Bridges and Branching Diffusions
summary: We propose a new generative modeling framework grounded in forward-backward partial differential equations (PDEs). These equations arise naturally in mean-field game (MFG) theory, and are closely related to nonlinear Schrödinger systems. Our main contribution is to reinterpret this connection within the setting of generative modeling and to develop an efficient numerical methodology for its practical implementation. Specifically, we derive and characterize a nonlinear extension of the classical Schrödinger bridge problem through a coupled system of PDEs, yielding a model we call SBNL (Schrödinger Bridge NonLinear). To compute its solution, we design a simulation algorithm based on branching diffusions and the probabilistic representation of semilinear PDEs. The resulting method is embarrassingly parallel, scalable to high dimensions, and applicable to a broad class of nonlinear interaction functionals. We validate the approach through numerical experiments, including recovery of the classical Schrödinger bridge, nonlinear extensions with convex penalties (Gross-Pitaevskii) as well as potential interaction terms, and high-dimensional generative tasks such as image synthesis on the MNIST and FFHQ human face dataset. Furthermore, the same framework embeds score-based generative modeling, diffusion models, and tractable gaussian Schrödinger bridges.

AI.tldr: 提出基于前向-后向偏微分方程（源自平均场博弈理论）的生成建模框架SBNL，将经典Schrödinger桥推广为非线性耦合PDE系统，并用分支扩散与半线性PDE概率表示设计可并行、高维可扩展的求解算法。
AI.motivation: 前向-后向PDE在平均场博弈中自然出现且与非线性Schrödinger系统密切相关，但尚未被引入生成建模；作者希望在此视角下重新诠释该联系，构建可实用的高效数值方法。
AI.method: 通过耦合PDE系统推导并刻画经典Schrödinger桥问题的非线性推广（SBNL）；求解采用基于分支扩散过程与半线性PDE概率表示的模拟算法，方法高度可并行、可扩展至高维，并适用于广泛的非线性交互泛函。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了方法的有效性：复现经典Schrödinger桥、带凸惩罚（Gross-Pitaevskii）及势能交互项的非线性扩展，并在MNIST与FFHQ人脸数据上完成高维图像生成任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一并嵌入分数匹配生成模型、扩散模型与可解的高斯Schrödinger桥，提供了一个涵盖非线性交互的一般性生成建模范式。

title: Efficient Generative Image Compression with Quantized Latents Refinement
summary: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.

AI.tldr: 提出GR-GIC：一种快速推理且重建质量强的生成式图像压缩方法，通过引导式细化（GR）提升低码率重建、通过重组织的投影残差向量量化（P-RVQ）实现并行加速。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像压缩（GIC）中，强感知质量方法依赖预训练扩散模型、延迟高；轻量GIC方法延迟低但感知质量较差。作者观察到：在低码率下，轻量GIC的粗糙确定性量化会把对应不同细节的邻近编码器隐变量坍缩到同一量化点，导致细节难以恢复。
AI.method: 1) Guided Refinement（GR）：将熵上下文引导的隐变量细化与自适应扰动训练正则化相结合，共同改善低码率重建；2) 重组织的投影残差向量量化（P-RVQ）：将残差更新等价重组织为低维查找表，暴露更多并行性、减少串行计算；3) 高度优化的工程实现。
AI.result: Kodak上，相比OneDC，GR-GIC在LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR、FID上分别取得23.19%、37.71%、22.30%、22.14%的BD-rate节省。NVIDIA A100上编码/解码耗时4.60/5.98 ms；P-RVQ重组织实现在同FP32设置下平均加速3.14倍；在Jetson Orin NX上延迟与轻量GIC方法相当。
AI.conclusion: GR-GIC在保持快速推理的同时实现了有竞争力的重建性能，兼顾了感知质量与低延迟，适用于资源受限平台。

title: Rethinking Agentic Model Orchestration for Time Series Forecasting
comment: Accepted by the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) perform unevenly across forecasting tasks. Recent work uses agentic model orchestration (AMO) to select or combine TSFMs, often outperforming individual forecasters. Yet these gains may reflect stronger or more complementary candidates rather than better orchestration. To disentangle these effects, we introduce FairAMO, a controlled evaluation protocol with frozen candidate forecasts. Experiments on GIFT-Eval show that AMO improves accuracy, but its gains are bounded by the candidate TSFMs. The best orchestrators reduce MASE by less than 6% relative to the best single TSFM across all tasks. These gains depend on complementarity (different candidates excel on different tasks) rather than the number of candidates. Adding members yields diminishing returns, and a redundant member can erase these gains. The value of historical evidence also saturates quickly. A few recent windows capture all gains, and further history adds none. These findings separate system-level forecasting gains from the contribution of orchestration itself.

AI.tldr: 提出FairAMO控制评测协议（冻结候选预测），在GIFT-Eval上量化发现：AMO的精度增益受候选TSFM上限约束，最优编排器相对最佳单一TSFM的MASE降低不足6%，增益主要源于候选互补性而非数量，历史证据价值迅速饱和。
AI.motivation: 近期工作中，agentic model orchestration（AMO）用于选择或组合时间序列基础模型（TSFM），常优于单一预测器；但这些提升可能来自更强或更互补的候选模型，而非编排本身更好，因此需要解耦"系统级收益"与"编排贡献"。
AI.method: 提出FairAMO：一种使用冻结候选预测的受控评测协议，在GIFT-Eval基准上进行实验，并对候选数量、候选冗余度、历史证据长度等因素做可控消融分析。
AI.result: AMO确实提升精度，但增益受候选TSFM上限约束：在所有任务上，最优编排器相对最佳单一TSFM的MASE降低不足6%；增益取决于候选互补性（不同候选在不同任务上占优）而非候选数量；增加成员收益递减，冗余成员甚至可抹去增益；历史证据价值快速饱和，仅少数近期窗口即捕获全部增益，更长历史无额外贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究将系统级预测增益与编排自身贡献相分离，表明AMO的价值受限于候选池质量与互补性，为TSFM编排方法的评测与设计提供了更公平、可解释的基准。

title: Forward-Only Learning for Shared-Kernel Wavelet Neural Networks without Backpropagation
summary: Backpropagation remains the dominant training paradigm, using backward gradients and local updates that can suffer from vanishing or exploding gradients in deep networks. Although the Forward-Forward algorithm avoids conventional backpropagation, it remains mainly local or layer-wise, motivating global whole-network learning using forward evaluations only. For shared-kernel wavelet neural networks, we therefore propose a CMA-ES-based global forward-only learning framework. We further introduce structure-aware parameter decomposition and channel-specific credit assignment, factorizing the search into three subspaces. On BSDS500, our method reduces test MSE from 4.1783 to 4.0130 and improves PSNR from 42.621 to 42.787~dB over Adam/BP without backward propagation. Beyond these gains, training requires only 6 training-set coverages, compared with 1500 epochs for BP. Ablations show that structural decomposition and aligned credit assignment are more important than increasing population size, demonstrating the feasibility of whole-network forward-only learning for compact reconstruction networks. These results suggest a potential route toward forward-only optimization of compact reconstruction models for resource-constrained imaging and edge or near-sensor systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对共享核小波神经网络提出基于CMA-ES的全局前向学习框架，结合结构感知参数分解与通道级信用分配，在BSDS500上无需反向传播即超越Adam/BP的重建性能，且训练数据覆盖次数极少。
AI.motivation: 反向传播依赖梯度回传与局部更新，在深层网络中易出现梯度消失/爆炸；Forward-Forward虽避免反向传播但仍是局部或逐层学习，无法实现全网络全局前向优化。因此作者希望仅用前向评估实现整网全局学习。
AI.method: 以CMA-ES作为全局优化器，对共享核小波神经网络进行纯前向训练；引入结构感知参数分解，将搜索空间拆分为三个子空间，并设计通道级信用分配以对齐参数更新与网络结构。
AI.result: 在BSDS500上，测试MSE由4.1783降至4.0130，PSNR由42.621 dB提升至42.787 dB，优于Adam/BP且不使用反向传播；训练仅需6次训练集覆盖（BP需1500个epoch）。消融显示结构分解与对齐信用分配比增大种群规模更重要。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑重建网络的全网前向学习可行，为资源受限成像及边缘/近传感器系统的前向优化提供潜在路径。

title: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult. We revisit this problem through the lens of shortcut learning, where models prefer the easiest predictive cues (e.g., background or textures) over object-centric semantics, especially under scarce and biased supervision. We find that this tendency is amplified for tail classes: limited examples often share similar contexts, making non-semantic signals highly correlated and thus tempting shortcuts, whereas head classes with diverse appearances and environments encourage more stable object-focused representations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that transfers object-focused explanations from head to tail classes. SRCD operates in the Class Activation Map (CAM) space, where a CAM provides a class-specific spatial evidence map for a prediction. SRCD aggregates CAMs from a small set of head-class candidates into a shortcut-resistant teacher using an energy-model weighting based on coherence and concentration, and distills it to the tail-class CAM. We provide a theoretical analysis that quantifies shortcut reliance as shortcut-region evidence mass in CAM space and shows that SRCD suppresses tail shortcuts. Extensive experiments on long-tailed benchmarks consistently improve strong baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Haifeng3/SRCD.

AI.tldr: 提出 Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD)，通过在 CAM 空间将头部类的“抗捷径”解释迁移到尾部类，抑制长尾分布下的捷径学习并提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 长尾数据中尾部类样本少且上下文高度相似，非语义线索（背景、纹理）与类别强相关，模型更易依赖这些捷径而非物体语义；头部类外观与环境多样，反而促成更稳定的物体中心表征。作者从捷径学习视角重新审视长尾泛化问题。
AI.method: SRCD 为即插即用框架，工作在类激活图 (CAM) 空间：从少量头部类候选的 CAM 中，基于一致性与集中度进行能量模型加权聚合，得到抗捷径教师 CAM，再蒸馏到尾部类 CAM；并给出以 CAM 空间中捷径区域证据质量刻画捷径依赖的理论分析，证明 SRCD 可抑制尾部捷径。
AI.result: 在多个长尾基准上实验一致优于强基线，验证了方法有效性；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 尾部类捷径依赖源于稀缺且偏置的监督，利用头部类可靠的对象中心证据进行 CAM 层面的知识蒸馏，是缓解长尾泛化困难的有效途径。

title: Learning to Measure and Diagnose: A Clinical-Dictionary Radiomic Bottleneck Model for Thyroid Nodule Classification
summary: Thyroid ultrasound supports the assessment of nodule malignancy, but classification predictions often lack evidence linked to familiar clinical descriptions. Radiomics provides explicitly defined measurements that can support such explanations through a clinical dictionary. However, using these measurements as interpretable evidence requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and preservation of measurement fidelity when optimizing classification performance. We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. Within this model, Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families. Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) constructs a fixed bottleneck, followed by joint optimization of measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition then traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Experiments on ThyroidXL and TN3K show competitive classification performance, while case studies illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules. These findings indicate interpretable classification with inspectable quantitative evidence informed by clinical knowledge. Code is available online.

AI.tldr: 提出临床字典引导的影像组学瓶颈模型，实现甲状腺结节良恶性分类，并使决策证据可追溯、可量化解释。
AI.motivation: 甲状腺超声可辅助评估结节恶性风险，但分类预测常缺乏与临床常用描述相对应的证据；影像组学虽提供明确定义的定量测量、可借临床字典支撑解释，但需同时保证从超声图像中可靠估计测量值，并在优化分类性能时保持测量保真度。
AI.method: 构建临床字典影像组学瓶颈模型：Family-Aware Radiomic Learning（FARL）在特征族间施加均衡监督以估计测量值；Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling（FGBM）构建固定瓶颈，并在保真度引导下联合优化测量估计与分类；决策证据分解通过线性分类器回溯特征贡献，并按临床字典类别组织。
AI.result: 在 ThyroidXL 与 TN3K 数据集上取得有竞争力的分类性能；案例研究展示良性、恶性结节的特征贡献分布。
AI.conclusion: 可实现可解释的结节分类，并提供由临床知识引导、可核查的定量证据；代码已开源。

title: BRIDGE: An Acceptance Gate to Block False Improvements in Model Updates, with a Retrospective Clinical Evaluation
comment: 39 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23523985
summary: Models are updated repeatedly, and an update that looks better on validation data but not on new data is a false improvement that can misguide clinical decisions. The naive rule accepts every positive validation gain and is optimistic when the same data choose and judge the update. BRIDGE is a model-agnostic acceptance gate that decides each update from predictions and the available labels, with fixed settings. Each fold of the data judges the update chosen on the other folds (cross-fitting) to reduce selection bias; acceptance requires the gain's lower bootstrap bound to exceed a margin. The four settings are (A) 11 new datasets, (B) synthetic tasks, (C) 12 retrospective clinical tasks, and (D) 39 supporting datasets. The false-improvement rate falls from 19.1% (naive) to 1.1% (BRIDGE) in (A), 20.7% to 1.7% (B), 20.0% to 0% (C), and 12.5% to 0.5% (D); every 95% confidence interval of the reduction over datasets or tasks excludes zero (not over the clinical sources). An equal-size random draw from the naive acceptances contains more false improvements in (A)-(E) (post hoc, p<0.001). On the OpenML collection (E) of 14 new datasets, the false-improvement rate falls from 25.6% to 1.0%. BRIDGE removes 97% to 100% of the false improvements that the naive rule accepts, and its mean gain per deployed update is 1.8 to 3.1 times the naive rule's. The 95% upper bound on the false-improvement rate is below 5.5%: formal in (B) for independent tasks (3.56%), and conditional on the real data tested (0.33% to 5.40%).

AI.tldr: BRIDGE是一种模型无关的更新接受门控：交叉拟合选择、自助法下界+裕度判据，将假提升率从约12%–26%降至0%–1.7%，同时每个部署更新的平均增益为朴素规则的1.8–3.1倍。
AI.motivation: 模型反复更新时，"验证集上更好但新数据上不好"的假提升会误导临床决策；朴素规则接受一切正向验证增益，且在"同一数据既选又评"时系统性乐观。
AI.method: 模型无关的接受门控，仅依赖预测与可用标签，设置固定：用交叉拟合（fold间互判）降低选择偏倚；接受条件为增益的自助法置信下界超过预设裕度。评测设置为(A)11个新数据集、(B)合成任务、(C)12个回顾性临床任务、(D)39个支撑数据集、(E)OpenML 14个新数据集。
AI.result: 假提升率：(A)19.1%→1.1%、(B)20.7%→1.7%、(C)20.0%→0%、(D)12.5%→0.5%、(E)25.6%→1.0%；各数据集/任务层面的95% CI（临床来源层面除外）均不含0。等量随机抽取的朴素接受集合含更多假提升（post hoc, p<0.001）。BRIDGE消除97%–100%的假提升；每次部署更新平均增益为朴素规则的1.8–3.1倍。假提升率95%上界低于5.5%：独立任务形式化为3.56%，实测条件下为0.33%–5.40%。
AI.conclusion: 以交叉拟合+自助下界裕度门控可近乎消除假提升，并以更高平均增益换取更少但更可靠的部署更新；结论在合成与真实临床任务上一致，但置信区间推断仅在实测数据条件下成立。

title: APED-CXR: Adaptive Privileged Evidence Distillation for Chest X-Ray Grounding with Image-Only Inference
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: Compact chest X-ray (CXR) models that localize findings suit deployment, but box annotations are limited and report-aware multimodal models are expensive at inference. We introduce APED-CXR, which distills report-informed spatial evidence from a frozen multimodal teacher into a student with 11.1M parameters that predicts diseases and boxes from shared evidence maps and requires the image alone at test time. During training, the teacher uses the radiograph, report, and queried class to evaluate regions proposed from the student's current evidence maps, and its support scores serve as training targets for the student's pooled evidence scores within these regions. Trained on PadChest and evaluated on held-out PadChest-GR, refreshing the student's proposals for teacher evaluation improves box-level localization F1 from 0.302 with fixed warm-up proposals to 0.338 (IoU >= 0.5; gain 0.036, 95% CI [0.022, 0.049]), while maintaining diagnostic AUC. This gain depends on the teacher checking current proposals: with equally many random boxes, a fixed dense box set, teacher-generated boxes, or report rules instead of the teacher, F1 stays near the fixed-proposal level, and proposals two refreshes old recover only part of the gain. On NIH ChestX-ray14, a secondary test set, box recall also rises from 0.423 to 0.447.

AI.tldr: 提出 APED-CXR：将报告驱动的多模态教师的空间证据蒸馏到 11.1M 参数的学生模型，测试时仅需图像即可同时预测疾病与病灶框。
AI.motivation: 紧凑的可定位 CXR 模型适合部署，但框标注稀缺，而依赖报告的多模态模型推理成本高。
AI.method: 冻结多模态教师接收影像、报告与查询类别，对学生当前证据图提出的区域打分；学生（11.1M）由共享证据图同时输出疾病预测与框，并以教师支持分数作为区域内池化证据分数的训练目标。
AI.result: PadChest 训练、PadChest-GR 测试：刷新学生提案使定位 F1 由 0.302 升至 0.338（IoU≥0.5，+0.036，95% CI [0.022,0.049]），诊断 AUC 不降；随机框、固定稠密框集、教师生成框或报告规则替代教师时增益消失，滞后两次刷新仅恢复部分增益。NIH ChestX-ray14 框召回由 0.423 升至 0.447。
AI.conclusion: 在测试时脱离报告与教师，以提案刷新式证据蒸馏实现轻量可定位 CXR 模型，增益关键在于教师对当前提案的评估。

title: Geometric knowledge spaces, Attention pairing and Architectures
summary: In this paper, we propose a geometric approach to deriving attention mechanisms and exploring potential new transformer architectures. We begin by formalizing the notions of knowledge worlds and attention pairings, then demonstrate how this framework naturally leads to the architectures of standard attention, causal attention, linear attention, tensor attention, and recurrent neural networks. Finally, we introduce several new geometric spaces that may inspire novel neural network architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何视角统一推导注意力机制，并据此探索新的Transformer架构。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力与各类Transformer变体（标准、因果、线性、张量注意力及RNN）多为经验性设计，缺乏统一的原理性解释框架，难以指导新架构的系统性探索。
AI.method: 形式化定义"知识世界"（knowledge worlds）与"注意力配对"（attention pairings）两个概念，在此基础上构建几何框架，并展示该框架可自然导出标准注意力、因果注意力、线性注意力、张量注意力与循环神经网络的结构。
AI.result: 该框架能够统一刻画上述多种已有架构，表明它们在几何意义上是同一原理的不同实例；同时给出若干新的几何空间，可作为新神经网络架构的设计启发。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制可由几何原理统一推导，几何框架兼具解释性与生成性，为Transformer架构的系统化设计提供了新思路。

title: LEAF-Mamba: Feature Adaptation and Fusion for Whole Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging. Multiple instance learning addresses this task by aggregating patch representations from frozen pretrained encoders. Recently, Mamba has enabled efficient modeling of long patch sequences. However, task supervision alone does not explicitly constrain information recovery during feature adaptation, while Mamba couples local processing with long-range propagation rather than retaining separate representations for fusion. Motivated by these challenges, we introduce LEAF-Mamba, a framework that jointly addresses latent evidence adaptation and fusion for frozen-feature WSI analysis. A reconstruction-regularized adapter learns compact, task-specific representations while reconstructing the input features. Parallel Mamba and convolutional streams then capture long-range dependencies and sequence-local interactions, with an input-dependent gate modulating their joint representation before slide-level pooling. Experiments across feature extractors demonstrate improved average performance over strong MIL baselines in both diagnostic classification and survival prediction. Component analyses further support the contributions of adaptation and fusion. These findings highlight the value of jointly designing feature transformation and contextual aggregation to translate pretrained representations into effective slide-level predictions.

AI.tldr: LEAF-Mamba是一个面向冻结特征WSI分析的框架，联合实现潜在证据适配与融合：用重建正则化适配器学习紧凑的任务特定表示，并用并行的Mamba与卷积分支分别建模长程依赖与序列局部交互，经输入相关门控后在切片级汇聚。
AI.motivation: WSI为千兆像素且标注稀缺，切片级学习困难；MIL依赖冻结预训练编码器的patch表示聚合。现有方法有两方面不足：任务监督本身未显式约束特征适配过程中的信息保留；Mamba将局部处理与长程传播耦合，未保留独立表示用于融合。
AI.method: 提出LEAF-Mamba，同时处理潜在证据适配与融合。适配阶段采用重建正则化适配器，在重建输入特征的同时学习紧凑的任务特定表示；融合阶段采用并行Mamba流与卷积流分别捕获长程依赖与序列局部交互，通过输入相关门控调制二者的联合表示，再进行切片级池化。
AI.result: 在多种特征提取器下，诊断分类与生存预测任务的平均性能均优于强MIL基线；消融/组件分析支持适配与融合两部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计特征变换与上下文聚合，可将预训练表示有效转化为切片级预测，说明适配与融合协同设计对冻结特征WSI分析具有价值。

title: Are Joint-Embedding Predictive Objectives Effective for Longitudinal EHRs?
summary: Masked language modelling (MLM) is the dominant pretraining objective for transformer encoders applied to longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). However, reconstructing individual events may overemphasise noisy or weakly informative observations and does not explicitly encourage learning higher-level patient states. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) instead learn by predicting representations in latent space and have shown strong performance in a variety of domains. In this paper, we investigate to what extent JEPA can be adapted to EHR sequence representation. Our empirical investigation using MIMIC-IV shows that although all three of our JEPA formulations train stably without representational collapse, they consistently underperform standard MLM. We find that target size, not target heterogeneity, increases prediction error, yet reducing the target size does not recover downstream performance. This suggests that stable latent prediction alone is insufficient for competitive EHR representation learning and highlights the challenge of defining clinically meaningful latent targets for EHR.

AI.tldr: 本文实证考察联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在纵向电子健康记录（EHR）序列表示学习中的适配效果，发现在MIMIC-IV上三种JEPA变体虽能稳定训练且无表示坍缩，但下游性能一致劣于标准掩蔽语言建模（MLM）。
AI.motivation: MLM是EHR Transformer编码器的主流预训练目标，但逐事件重建可能过度强调噪声或信息量弱的观测，且不显式鼓励学习更高层的患者状态；JEPA在潜空间中预测表示，在其他领域表现优异，因此作者希望探究其能否迁移至EHR序列表示。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-IV数据上设计三种JEPA公式化变体，进行实证对比研究，并与标准MLM基线比较；同时分析目标尺寸与目标异质性对预测误差和下游性能的影响。
AI.result: 三种JEPA变体均训练稳定且未出现表示坍缩，但下游性能一致低于MLM；增大预测误差的主要因素是目标尺寸而非目标异质性，然而缩小目标尺寸并不能恢复下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠稳定的潜空间预测不足以实现有竞争力的EHR表示学习，核心挑战在于为EHR定义具有临床意义的潜空间目标。

title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
summary: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出UniRAP，一个统一模型，将部件级物理可供性与语言指令映射为可执行的几何表示，通过统一接口令牌与统一可供性解码器（UAD）联合完成检测、部件级可供性分割与4-DoF交互位姿估计，并结合课程式迁移训练策略提升数据效率，在指代分割、可供性定位与交互位姿估计上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言感知在自然语言与视觉观察对齐方面已取得显著进展，但将高层语义落地为部件级物理交互仍具挑战；现有方法缺乏从语言到可操作几何表示的统一建模能力。
AI.method: 将问题建模为条件多模态生成任务，通过统一接口令牌机制把视觉输入、文本指令与可选提示整合进共享时空表示空间；设计统一可供性解码器（UAD），借助中间分割特征联合执行目标检测、部件级可供性分割与4-DoF交互位姿估计；并提出课程式迁移训练策略，从通用视觉解析渐进过渡到交互感知。
AI.result: 在指代表达分割、可供性定位与交互位姿估计任务上取得SOTA性能，并在动态视频场景中保持较强的时空一致性。
AI.conclusion: UniRAP证明了统一感知框架在语言引导的物理操作中的有效性，能够将高层语言语义有效落地为可执行的部件级交互几何。

title: Phase Transitions in Learning Driven by Extremal Data
summary: We study an extremal regression problem, an example of multiple instance learning (MIL), where the predictors are given as multisets, called bags. The bag elements (called instances) possess hidden labels which are pooled to produce an observed bag-level label. Max pooling is common in MIL applications, but gives rise to vanishing gradients. To handle this, modern MIL pipelines approximate the max with a softmax, treating the sharpness as a learnable parameter, denoted $λ$. When the max pooling model is the true data generating process, learning will be successful when $λ$ is increased during gradient descent, thereby driving the dynamics into regions of parameter space with vanishing gradients. To understand the conditions under which gradient descent breaks down, we study a minimal model and derive a low dimensional projection of the gradient flow in the joint limit of large bags $n$ and high dimension $d$ with $α=\ln n/d$ fixed. The flow has two distinct phase transitions: an intrinsic freezing transition related to the random energy model of disordered systems, and a retrieval transition occurring in modern Hopfield networks. Numerical simulation confirms both the phase diagram and the convergence of the finite-size training gradient to its predicted asymptotic form.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多重实例学习中的极值回归问题，通过在 n,d→∞ 且 ln n/d=α 固定的联合极限下对梯度流进行低维投影，得到了包含内在冻结相变与现代 Hopfield 网络检索相变的两相图，并由数值模拟验证。
AI.motivation: Max pooling 是 MIL 的常用聚合方式，但会导致梯度消失；现代流程用可学习锐度参数 λ 的 softmax 近似 max，在真实数据由 max pooling 生成时仍须靠增大 λ 驱动训练。作者希望理解梯度下降在何种条件下失效，因此需要刻画训练动力学的相变结构。
AI.method: 构建一个最小化模型，在 bag 大小 n 与维度 d 同时趋于无穷、α=ln n/d 保持固定的联合极限下，推导梯度流的低维投影（有效动力学方程），并分析其不动点与相变；用数值模拟检验相图与有限尺寸训练梯度向渐近形式的收敛性。
AI.result: 梯度流呈现出两种不同的相变：一个与无序系统随机能量模型（REM）相关的内在冻结相变，以及一个出现在现代 Hopfield 网络中的检索相变。数值模拟证实了这两条相界，并验证有限尺寸训练梯度收敛到理论预测的渐近形式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以统一的低维投影框架揭示了 softmax 近似 max pooling 的 MIL 训练动力学中的两类相变，说明梯度消失区域的出现具有可刻画的临界条件；随机能量模型与现代 Hopfield 网络分别对应冻结与检索机制，为诊断和设计 MIL 训练流程提供了理论依据。

title: Key Findings for Small UAS for Post-Disaster Damage Assessment from the CURSE'26 Exercise
summary: The CLARKE building and road damage assessment AI classifier was incorporated into the Catastrophic Unmanned Remote Sensing Exercise (CURSE) 2026, which trained 23 small uncrewed aerial systems (sUAS) teams from state and local agencies and non-governmental organizations in Florida and Missouri on how to collect imagery for an incident command Remote Sensing Cell. Although CLARKE has been operationally deployed to two hurricanes (Debby and Helene), CURSE'26 presented an opportunity to evaluate the machine learning model with a larger set of never-before-seen orthomosaics. The results show that building and road damage assessment together ran in 3.5 minutes on average, and that building damage assessment achieved a Micro F1 of 0.834 with no manual adjustments to correct spatial misalignment and delivered that performance in both Florida and Missouri, demonstrating good geographic transfer. It also showed that road damage assessment performed poorly due to sensitivity to misalignment between road maps and the images, and to lighting and environmental conditions in an urban setting. The analysis of CURSE'26 presents five other findings of value to the sUAS community: that the use of sUAS and machine learning is now operationally normalized and accepted, sUAS teams in the field can improve classification accuracy by timing their flights, exercises are good operational tests but their value for evaluating learning models is less clear, edge computing is needed to overcome the wireless upload barrier, and the application of sUAS and AI to disaster response has ethical and legal ramifications for pilots and data managers.

AI.tldr: CLARKE建筑与道路损毁评估AI分类器在CURSE'26演习中经更大规模未见正射影像测试：建筑损毁评估平均3.5分钟完成、Micro F1达0.834且具备跨州地理迁移能力，道路损毁评估因对齐与光照敏感性表现不佳。
AI.motivation: CLARKE虽已在两次飓风中实地部署，但缺乏在更大规模、从未见过的影像数据上的系统评估；CURSE'26演习提供了训练23支sUAS队伍并检验模型泛化能力的机会。
AI.method: 将CLARKE分类器嵌入CURSE'26演习流程，对佛罗里达与密苏里两地新采集的正射镶嵌影像开展建筑与道路损毁评估测试，记录运行时间与Micro F1指标，并在无人工空间配准修正的条件下评估跨区域性能。
AI.result: 建筑与道路评估合计平均耗时3.5分钟；建筑损毁评估Micro F1为0.834，无需人工空间对齐校正，且在佛州与密州表现一致，显示良好地理迁移性；道路损毁评估因道路图与影像错位、城市光照与环境条件而表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 总结五项对sUAS社区有价值的发现：sUAS与机器学习应用已常态化并被接受；飞行时机可提升分类精度；演习是良好的运行测试但对学习模型评估价值有限；需边缘计算突破无线上传瓶颈；sUAS与AI用于灾后响应存在伦理与法律影响。

title: Block Diffusion for Longitudinal EHR: Accuracy, Efficiency, and Representation Trade-offs
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models have proved effective for zero-shot prediction from longitudinal electronic health records, but impose strictly sequential generation on trajectories containing temporally clustered and interdependent clinical events. We investigate block-based masked diffusion (BD) as an alternative on MIMIC-IV under matched tokenisation, context length, model capacity, and evaluation conditions. Across block sizes, BD exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off, with small-block configurations retaining much of the predictive performance of AR while enabling substantially faster inference. A representative $B{=}8$ configuration achieves approximately $1.43\times$ faster evaluation. Although generative rollout remains below AR in most settings, frozen linear probes on BD and AR representations achieve near-identical performance across clinical prediction tasks, indicating that BD learns comparably informative clinical representations. Increasing the denoising budget yields diminishing returns, while alternative decoding strategies provide limited gains. Overall, our results show that block diffusion is a viable and computationally attractive approach to longitudinal EHR modelling, with further improvements in iterative decoding offering a promising route toward closing the remaining generative performance gap.

AI.tldr: 在MIMIC-IV上以匹配设置对比块式掩码扩散(BD)与自回归(AR)模型：BD存在质量-效率权衡，小块配置保留大部分预测性能且推理约快1.43倍，其表示用于线性探针与AR几乎等同，但生成式rollout仍逊于AR。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型在纵向电子健康记录零样本预测中有效，但对包含时间上聚集且相互依赖的临床事件的轨迹强制严格顺序生成，与数据结构不匹配，因此探索块式掩码扩散作为替代方案。
AI.method: 在MIMIC-IV上进行受控对比实验，匹配分词方式、上下文长度、模型容量与评估条件；系统扫描块大小，并考察去噪预算与不同解码策略；通过冻结线性探针比较BD与AR表示在临床预测任务上的信息量。
AI.result: BD呈现清晰的质量-效率权衡；小块配置保留AR大部分预测性能且推理显著更快，代表性B=8配置约快1.43倍。生成式rollout在多数设置下低于AR；冻结线性探针显示BD与AR表示性能近乎一致；增大去噪预算收益递减，替代解码策略增益有限。
AI.conclusion: 块扩散是可行且计算上具吸引力的纵向EHR建模方法；其表示质量与AR相当，剩余生成性能差距有望通过改进迭代解码来缩小。

title: JointLight: Human-Centric Video Relighting with Asynchronous RGB-Irradiance Joint Modeling
summary: Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real- world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. The code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出异步联合建模范式，让扩散模型同时去噪RGB与真值辐照度帧，实现细粒度光照控制的视频重打光。
AI.motivation: 人本场景光传输建模困难；现有扩散重打光方法缺乏可控性，而基于路径追踪辐照度线索的显式方法受伪影干扰、生成质量受损。
AI.method: 观察到噪声破坏可去除高频伪影并保留低频光传输，故采用两阶段训练联合去噪RGB与真值辐照度帧（独立时间步调度），第二阶段引入域匹配策略弥合辐照度线索与真值图之间的域差距；推理时使用异步劫持生成管线实现灵活光照控制；并用游戏引擎构建多光照高质量合成视频数据集（含配对辐照度图）。
AI.result: 仅在合成数据集上训练，模型仍能稳健泛化到真实场景，在光照保真度和生成质量上均优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 异步联合建模与域匹配有效利用辐照度线索实现精确可控的重打光，配套数据集与代码将公开。

title: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: 1.4x Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
summary: Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation. We introduce a unified framework for stochastic pruning of the DPO computation graph that independently samples response positions for scoring, response prefixes for execution, and preference branches for backpropagation. By making these selections before the corresponding operations, the framework omits computation at each stage of a training step. Our analysis characterizes the objective changes induced by position and sequence pruning and uses inverse-probability weighting to obtain a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator for the sampled objective. Controlled measurements show that position and sequence pruning primarily reduce peak memory, with most output-memory savings attributable to an implementation that retains full response supervision. Branch pruning yields a $1.426\times$ step-time speedup over a concatenated DPO baseline and reduces training time by about 30\% relative to stock DPO across two model families, with slightly lower mean accuracy and benchmark-dependent changes in open-ended scores. These findings relate the resource benefits of stochastic graph pruning to the computation omitted and the resulting changes in the training objective.

AI.tldr: 提出一个对DPO计算图进行随机剪枝的统一框架，可独立采样用于打分的响应位置、用于执行的响应前缀和用于反向传播的偏好分支，以在训练各阶段省略计算。
AI.motivation: DPO在输出打分、序列执行和反向传播上均有训练开销，仅减少监督数据量并不必然节省算力，因此需要直接针对计算图进行剪枝以降低计算与显存成本。
AI.method: 构建随机剪枝DPO计算图的统一框架：在对应运算之前独立采样响应位置、响应前缀和偏好分支；分析位置剪枝与序列剪枝引起的目标函数变化，并用逆概率加权（inverse-probability weighting）得到采样目标的条件无偏单分支梯度估计。
AI.result: 受控测量显示位置与序列剪枝主要降低峰值内存，大部分输出内存节省来自保留完整响应监督的实现；分支剪枝相比拼接式DPO基线获得1.426倍步时加速，在两类模型族上相对原始DPO减少约30%训练时间，平均准确率略降，开放式评分指标呈基准相关变化。
AI.conclusion: 将随机图剪枝的资源收益与其省略的计算以及由此产生的训练目标变化联系起来，为DPO训练效率优化提供了可分析、可度量的统一视角。

title: Open-Vocabulary Models and Label Propagation for Uncertainty-aware Pseudo-Labeling of Object Detection Datasets
summary: Object detection models rely on large-scale annotated datasets that require substantial manual annotation effort. The labeling costs further increase when annotation uncertainty is captured through soft labels, as multiple annotations must be collected for each object. We address this challenge by introducing a semi-supervised framework for the uncertainty-aware annotation of object detection datasets. Our approach leverages open-vocabulary object detectors to generate region proposals and semantically meaningful object representations. Based on these representations, we construct an object-level similarity graph and propagate probabilistic label information. Our framework assigns soft labels to previously unlabeled objects, quantifying both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. We evaluate our method on four object detection benchmarks with soft-label annotations and demonstrate that high-quality annotations can be obtained with only a small fraction of manually labeled objects. Furthermore, we show that detectors trained on semi-automatically annotated data achieve performance comparable to models trained on fully manually annotated data. We achieve state-of-the-art downstream detection performance for the task of semi-supervised object detection on the COCO dataset, with 40.5% AP virtually matching the performance of the model trained on fully manually constructed data (40.9%) at only 1% of labeling costs. These results highlight the potential of open-vocabulary models and graph-based label propagation for efficient, accurate and uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling.

AI.tldr: 提出半监督框架，利用开放词汇检测器与对象级相似图传播概率标签，为未标注目标自动分配同时量化偶然与认知不确定性的软标签，在仅用1%标注成本下于COCO达到40.5% AP，几乎匹配全标注的40.9%。
AI.motivation: 目标检测依赖大规模人工标注，而软标签标注需对每个目标多次标注，成本进一步放大；目标是降低标注成本同时保留不确定性信息。
AI.method: 用开放词汇目标检测器生成区域提议与语义目标表示；基于这些表示构建对象级相似图，在图上传导概率标签信息；对未标注目标分配软标签并量化偶然不确定性（aleatoric）与认知不确定性（epistemic）。
AI.result: 在四个带软标签标注的检测基准上验证，少量人工标注即可获得高质量标注；半自动标注数据训练的检测器性能可比全人工标注模型；COCO半监督目标检测取得SOTA，40.5% AP 对 40.9% AP，标签成本仅1%。
AI.conclusion: 开放词汇模型结合基于图的标签传播可实现高效、准确且不确定性感知的伪标签生成，显著降低软标签目标检测数据集的标注成本。

title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
summary: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WRDO（加权拒绝方向优化），通过学习聚合权重，将逐提示的拒绝方向组合成复合拒绝方向，替代传统的差值均值单一方向，以更有效、更灵活地操纵模型的拒绝表征。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明拒绝行为主要由单一残差流方向介导（通常为有害/无害提示的差值均值向量），易受激活空间或权重空间干预破坏；但该标准构造把异质的有害提示聚合成统一平均，可能混淆不同的拒绝相关现象。
AI.method: 构建逐提示方向库，用可学习的聚合权重将其组合为复合拒绝方向（WRDO）；在三个开放权重语言模型上，以三个guard judges及HarmBench作为外部评测，与既有单方向方法对比；用标准效用基准衡量对通用能力的影响；并在防御设定下反向使用同一优化机制，恢复abliterated检查点的拒绝行为。
AI.result: 加权聚合在操纵拒绝表征上比单方向方法更有效且更灵活；同时报告了干预对通用能力的影响，并显示同一机制可反向用于修复被abliterated模型的拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 不同有害提示应对最终干预方向贡献不等，学习式加权聚合是一种更有效、更灵活的拒绝表征操控机制，兼具攻击与防御双向应用潜力。

title: Compositionality with Primitives: A Unified View from Euclidean to Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 Main Conference, 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning (CZSL) aims to recognize novel combinations of previously observed objects and attributes. Prior work showed that large-scale vision-language models encode decomposable semantic structures that can be recomposed to enable generalization. The Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework formalizes this by identifying directions in the tangent space at the Frechet mean of the embedding distribution, which encode primitive visual concepts. Unseen attribute-object compositions can be synthesized through vector addition of these primitives. We revisit the assumption that compositional generalization requires explicit attribute-object pair re-composition. By means of new compositional scoring functions and extensive evaluations, we show that directly using the decomposed primitives suffices for recognizing unseen compositions. In that, we gain insights on how the geometry of the embedding manifold (Euclidean, spherical, or hyperbolic) and dataset structure affect compositional reasoning. Across models (CLIP, DINOv2, MERU, HyCoCLIP), we show that compositional structure consistently emerges as primitive representations, enabling inference on CZSL benchmarks (MIT-States, VAW-CZSL, UT-Zappos50K, Clothing16K) and group robustness on Waterbirds and CelebA. Code: https://github.com/nis-research/Compositionality-with-Primitives.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视了组合零样本学习(CZSL)中"必须显式重组属性-对象对"的假设，证明直接使用分解得到的原始基元表示即可识别未见组合，并分析嵌入流形几何对组合推理的影响。
AI.motivation: 前人工作(GDE)认为组合泛化需要通过属性-对象对向量的显式相加来合成未见组合。作者质疑这一假设，探究是否直接使用分解出的原始概念基元就足以完成组合识别。
AI.method: 在嵌入分布的Frechet均值切空间上识别编码原始视觉概念的方向，提取可分解的基元表示；提出新的组合评分函数，并在Euclidean、球面、双曲三种流形几何下评测CLIP、DINOv2、MERU、HyCoCLIP等模型。
AI.result: 在MIT-States、VAW-CZSL、UT-Zappos50K、Clothing16K等CZSL基准上，直接使用分解基元即可有效推断未见组合；同时在Waterbirds与CelebA上展现出group鲁棒性。跨模型一致显示组合结构以基元表示形式涌现，并揭示了流形几何与数据集结构对组合推理的影响。
AI.conclusion: 组合泛化并不依赖显式的属性-对象对重组，分解出的原始基元本身已足够；组合结构在多种视觉-语言模型中普遍涌现，嵌入流形几何是影响组合推理的重要因素。

title: SOAR: Social and Opinion-Aware Recommendations
summary: One of the enduring challenges in online platforms is recommendation. Both communities and advertisers face difficulties in analyzing complex user behavior, identifying habits and evolving preferences, and providing timely recommendations that are relevant to user interests. In particular, point of interest recommendation poses the additional challenge of identifying the factors that influence user behavior, capturing user tendencies, and generating accurate, personalized recommendations for each individual. In this work, we propose SOAR, a Social and Opinion Aware Recommendation model that incorporates both the user's friendship network and textual reviews to assess whether a location is suitable for a specific user, with a particular emphasis on the sentiment of shared reviews. Experimental results in real-world datasets demonstrate that incorporating reviews into the recommendation process improves the precision of the recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出SOAR模型，融合用户社交关系网络与评论文本（侧重情感倾向）进行兴趣点推荐，实验表明引入评论信息可提升推荐精度。
AI.motivation: 在线平台推荐面临挑战：难以分析复杂用户行为、识别习惯与偏好演化并及时给出相关推荐；兴趣点（POI）推荐还需识别影响用户行为的因素、刻画用户倾向并为个体生成准确的个性化推荐。
AI.method: 提出SOAR（Social and Opinion Aware Recommendation）模型，同时引入用户好友网络与文本评论，重点利用共享评论的情感（sentiment）来判断某地点是否适合特定用户。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验结果显示，将评论纳入推荐过程可提升推荐精度（precision）。
AI.conclusion: 社交关系与评论情感信息对兴趣点推荐有效，SOAR可作为融合社交与意见信号的个性化推荐方案。

title: GuidedSAM-Plume: An Expert-Guided Segmentation Framework for Volcanic Plumes
summary: Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume.

AI.tldr: 提出开源专家引导框架GuidedSAM-Plume，基于SAM2的零样本空间提示能力实现火山羽流与云的交互式分割，无需重训练即可显著优于全自动专用方案并保持火山学参数可靠性，同时发布标准化重标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 火山羽流与云的RGB图像几何表征受限于专用分割方案稀缺、标注部分依赖手工且普遍缺乏标准化，现有全自动方案性能与可靠性不足。
AI.method: 构建GuidedSAM-Plume开源专家引导交互式分割框架，利用SAM2的零样本空间提示（spatial prompt）能力，以最小用户输入驱动分割；在具有挑战性的数据集上通过专用分割指标与现场相关火山学描述子进行验证，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在最小用户输入下分割性能显著优于全自动专用方案，并保持所导出火山学参数的可靠性；框架适用于复杂、弥散状羽流形态现象。
AI.conclusion: 无重训练需求降低火山学界采用门槛，方法可推广至更广泛的环境科学领域；经专家引导重标注的数据集实现更标准化的发布，框架与数据集均已开源。

title: Implicit Feature Reweighting for Label-Free Graph Generalization
comment: We propose an implicit feature reweighting method to enhance graph-level OOD generalization without class labels
summary: Graph-level out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is critical for deploying graph neural networks in real-world applications where distribution shifts are inevitable. Existing approaches typically require class labels during representation learning to decide which substructures are predictive, limiting their applicability. We propose SCARCE, a label-free representation-learning framework that yields distribution-shift-robust graph representations from an environment partition of the training graphs alone, whether that partition comes from dataset metadata or, when none is available, from clustering a self-supervised embedding. Our method operates in two stages: (1) a variational graph autoencoder is warm-started for graph reconstruction; and (2) an adversarial confusion mechanism forces the encoder to produce representations from which a discriminator cannot distinguish environments, while preserving graph-reconstruction fidelity. We provide theoretical analysis showing that environment confusion contracts environment-discriminative directions in the representation space, which, under regularized downstream classifiers, is equivalent to imposing a stronger directional penalty on environment-associated features. This feature-reweighting mechanism reduces reliance on spurious correlations without erasing information, offering a label-free, continuous relaxation of last-layer reweighting methods. Experiments on a controlled synthetic datasets and the DrugOOD datasets show that SCARCE achieves state-of-the-art OOD generalization among label-free methods, using no class labels during representation learning.

AI.tldr: SCARCE提出一种无需类标签的图表示学习框架，仅依赖训练图的环境划分（元数据或自监督嵌入聚类）即可获得对分布偏移鲁棒的图表示，在DrugOOD上取得无标签方法中的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 图级OOD泛化对GNN实际部署至关重要，但现有方法在表示学习中依赖类标签来判断哪些子结构具有预测性，限制了其在无标签场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：（1）以变分图自编码器进行图重构热启动；（2）引入对抗混淆机制，通过判别器迫使编码器产出无法区分环境的环境不变表示，同时保持重构保真度。环境划分来自数据集元数据，或缺失时对自监督嵌入聚类获得。理论分析表明环境混淆在表示空间中收缩环境判别方向，在正则化下游分类器下等价于对环境相关特征施加更强的方向性惩罚。
AI.result: 在受控合成数据集与DrugOOD数据集上，SCARCE在表示学习不使用任何类标签的前提下，取得无标签方法中最优的OOD泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 环境混淆实现了一种连续松弛的特征重加权机制，降低对虚假相关性的依赖而不擦除信息，构成对last-layer重加权方法的无标签连续松弛；验证了无标签图OOD泛化的可行性。

title: Early versus Late RGB-Infrared Fusion for Counter-UAV Detection: A Comparative Study
comment: This version differs from the article published in IEEE Access. It includes revisions requested by the reviewers during the final review round that could not be incorporated into the published version
summary: This paper presents a novel strategy for UAV detection through visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) fusion, in order to improve accuracy and precision in harsh environments and weather conditions. In this research, two opposite approaches have been studied and implemented: the first concerns image-level (early) fusion, which merges two different spectra into a single image to which one detector is applied. On the other hand, the second approach, called decision-level (late) fusion, focuses on blending together the output bounding boxes of two different detection pipelines, aiming to create a common result that can be applied to both spectra simultaneously. Both strategies have been extensively tested in a dedicated environment, which included alternating low and high brightness scenes, different backgrounds (sky and ground), distances (5, 25 and 60 m), altitudes and zoom levels (1X, 2X and 4X). These tests allowed for the assessment of actual detection capabilities and system reliability in real-world applications. Furthermore, the two fusion strategies were evaluated and compared over a set of aligned images in order to highlight the better approach of the two. The results indicate that early fusion achieves better raw performance, since it incorporates the thermal information from the beginning of the training process. However, late fusion presents an innovative and useful detection workflow that can be applied in cases of sensor or frame misalignment. Both positive and negative aspects have also been pointed out and discussed, in order to give a more comprehensive overview. Finally, the paper outlines implementation considerations and practical recommendations based on operational priorities. Overall, the findings contribute to the research in RGB-IR fusion modalities, with the goal of enhancing UAV detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文对比了RGB-IR无人机检测中的图像级（早期）融合与决策级（晚期）融合两种策略，发现在多场景测试下早期融合原始性能更优，而晚期融合在传感器或帧失配情况下更具实用价值。
AI.motivation: 为提升恶劣环境与复杂气象条件下无人机检测的准确性与精度，需研究可见光与红外多模态融合的有效方式，并厘清两种融合层级各自的优劣与适用条件。
AI.method: 提出并实现两种对立融合策略：图像级（早期）融合将两个光谱合并为单幅图像后输入单一检测器；决策级（晚期）融合则对两条独立检测流程输出的边界框进行融合，生成可同时适用于两光谱的统一结果。在专用测试环境中系统评估，覆盖低/高亮度交替场景、天空与地面背景、5/25/60 m 距离、不同高度及1X/2X/4X变焦，并在对齐图像集上对两种策略进行对比。
AI.result: 早期融合取得更优的原始检测性能，因其从训练之初即引入热红外信息；晚期融合则提供了一种创新且实用的检测流程，适用于传感器或帧失配情形。论文同时指出了两者的优缺点以给出全面评估。
AI.conclusion: 论文总结了实现层面的考量与基于操作优先级的实用建议，为RGB-IR融合模态研究及无人机检测能力提升提供了参考依据。

title: Private Online Prediction from Experts with Small Losses
summary: We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints. Existing private algorithms achieve near-optimal regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the time horizon. However, this bound becomes suboptimal when $L^\star$, the cumulative loss of the best expert, is significantly less than $T$. In this work, we present the first differentially private algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$, offering a substantial improvement in the low-loss regime. Our regret bound matches the non-private lower bound up to poly-logarithmic factors for constant privacy parameters, demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost in this setting. Our result assumes that the input sequence is oblivious, i.e., it is fixed in advance and independent of the algorithm's outputs. We also prove that an $\tildeΩ(\sqrt{T})$ regret is inevitable for adaptively generated inputs, even when $L^\star = 0$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个在专家在线预测中实现 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ 遗憾的差分隐私算法，在低损失情形下几乎匹配非隐私下界；同时证明自适应输入下 $\tilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾不可避免。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私专家预测算法的遗憾为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，当最优专家的累积损失 $L^\star \ll T$ 时该界次优，缺乏低损失区间的隐私算法与理论刻画。
AI.method: 针对遗忘型（oblivious）输入序列设计差分隐私在线预测算法，使遗憾界依赖于 $L^\star$ 而非 $T$；并对自适应输入给出下界分析。
AI.result: 在常数隐私参数下取得 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ 遗憾，与非隐私下界仅差多对数因子；并证明自适应输入下即使 $L^\star=0$，$\tilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 隐私在低损失遗忘型输入下代价很小，但该改进依赖于输入非自适应；自适应输入下隐私带来本质性的遗憾下界。

title: Revealing Hidden Failure Modes in Chest X-ray Classification via Spectral Domain Analysis
summary: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出以频谱分析为核心的data-centric框架，用图像的频域能量分布剖面做无监督聚类，发现胸片异常检测模型的失败并非随机，而高度集中于特定频谱簇，从而无需失败标注即可预测可靠性并定位导致性能下降的数据切片。
AI.motivation: 胸片异常检测的深度学习模型对细微分布漂移（采集技术、患者相关因素、预处理）敏感；传统误差分析依赖语义元数据或模型嵌入，容易掩盖导致性能退化的低层信号变化，故需从低层信号层面自动发现失效模式。
AI.method: 数据中心的自动化失效模式发现：将图像投影到频域，提取概括各频带信号能量分布的紧凑频谱剖面；对该剖面进行无监督聚类，并分析各簇内的模型失败分布，实现“盲点”隔离、可靠性预测与退化数据切片发现，无需ground-truth失败标注。
AI.result: 模型失败并非随机分布，而是强烈集中于特定频谱簇；频谱聚类可有效隔离模型“盲点”，据此预测模型可靠性并识别造成性能下降的数据切片。
AI.conclusion: 频谱剖面聚类为胸片异常检测提供了一种无需失败标注、可解释且轻量的数据中心失效诊断手段，补充了语义元数据与嵌入分析的不足。

title: The Reflexivity Threshold: A Phase Transition for Multi-Agent Performative Prediction
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, including appendix and checklist. Code: https://github.com/AhmedMahrous00/reflexivity-threshold
summary: Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future models are trained. In multi-agent settings, this feedback is routed through a network of interacting learners, so stability depends not only on the strength of performativity but also on who affects whom. We study repeated retraining in multi-agent performative prediction and identify a spectral threshold that separates stable learning from worst-case learning obstruction. Prior work often collapses cross-agent feedback into a scalar contraction constant, missing this network structure. We instead introduce the reflexivity matrix $Γ$, which records how strongly one agent's deployment can move another agent's best response, defined from per-agent gradient sensitivities and curvature parameters. The threshold occurs when the spectral radius of this matrix crosses one. Below the threshold, repeated retraining converges geometrically to a unique performatively stable equilibrium, with cumulative excess loss bounded uniformly in the time horizon. Above the threshold, we construct noisy supercritical instances in which every local-information learner incurs expected cumulative excess loss growing linearly for horizons up to order $1/(ρ(Γ)-1)$. Together, these results characterize the threshold behavior through upper and lower bounds and recover the single-agent scalar threshold from prior work as a special case.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多智能体performative prediction中的重复再训练稳定性，提出"反身性矩阵"Γ，证明当ρ(Γ)<1时重复再训练几何收敛到唯一performatively stable均衡且累积超额损失一致有界，当ρ(Γ)>1时存在"超临界"实例使任何局部信息学习者的期望累积超额损失随时间线性增长。
AI.motivation: 学习系统具有performative性：部署后的预测会改变未来训练所用的数据分布；多智能体场景中这种反馈通过网络在多学习者间传播，稳定性不仅取决于performative强度，还取决于"谁影响谁"。既有工作把跨智能体反馈压缩为单一标量收缩常数，丢失了网络结构，本文旨在显式刻画这种网络结构下的稳定性阈值。
AI.method: 构造反身性矩阵Γ（reflexivity matrix），其元素由各智能体的梯度敏感度与曲率参数定义，记录一个智能体部署对其他智能体最优响应的影响强度；以Γ的谱半径与1的关系作为阈值判据，分别给出上界（收敛性）与下界（超临界构造）分析，并将单智能体标量阈值作为特例恢复。
AI.result: ρ(Γ)<1时，重复再训练几何收敛到唯一performatively stable均衡，累积超额损失在时间范围上一致有界；ρ(Γ)>1时，构造带噪超临界实例，证明每个局部信息学习者的期望累积超额损失在长达1/(ρ(Γ)-1)量级的时间范围内线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 通过上下界共同刻画了ρ(Γ)=1处稳定性与学习阻碍之间的相变阈值，表明多智能体performative学习稳定性由网络化反馈的谱性质决定，而非单标量收缩系数；结果将既有单智能体阈值作为特例纳入统一框架。

title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
summary: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"聚合器—预测器"视角解释DiT：注意力作为输入自适应的局部聚合器，MLP作为逐token的patch预测器，并以GMRF解析与图像实验验证该功能分工。
AI.motivation: 现有工作难以解释DiT如何表征图像内容、如何学到可泛化的复用规则，且"逐块线性去噪器"等解释缺乏组件层面的功能对应。
AI.method: 理论：在高斯马尔可夫随机场(GMRF)先验下证明全局贝叶斯去噪器仅用子集上下文patch即可近似、误差随上下文半径指数衰减；并证明逐块线性去噪器在充分信息聚合下可恢复经验局部去噪器。分析：将AdaLN调制的注意力刻画为输入与噪声相关的聚合器，MLP刻画为学习到的key-value式逐token预测。实验：真实图像DiT的噪声相关去噪上下文与注意力质量展宽分析、CelebA64上以共享记忆patch预测器替换MLP的对照实验，以及跨数据集组件移植(QK、VO、MLP)。
AI.result: 真实图像训练的DiT呈现与GMRF解析设定相似的噪声相关去噪上下文，注意力质量展宽趋势定性一致；共享记忆patch预测器替代MLP后在去噪与生成性能上具竞争力；组件移植的兼容性模式与QK负责空间加权、VO负责特征传输、MLP负责patch预测的假设一致。
AI.conclusion: 给出了DiT去噪的组件级功能解释，为架构特定的微调与受控干预提供依据。

title: Fast Bayesian Optimization Through Linear Models
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is typically used only for problems where the underlying function is deemed "expensive" (e.g. in time or money), with the speed of the BO algorithm being of little importance. In the real world, however, problems span a continuous range of values, going from cheap to expensive. In this paper, we present BO algorithms through the lens of a speed-performance Pareto frontier: we compare BO against faster algorithms like CMA-ES, and highlight how certain regions of the Pareto frontier are currently empty. As a solution, we propose a new set of fast BO methods that exploit the linear structure in existing BO algorithms, for both continuous and combinatorial inputs (from ~10 to 6000+ dimensions). Our methods achieve performance similar to state-of-the-art BO, while being more than $10^2\times$ to $10^3\times$ faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of problems.

AI.tldr: 该文从"速度—性能"帕累托前沿视角审视贝叶斯优化（BO），指出当前帕累托前沿存在空白区域，并提出利用现有BO算法线性结构的一类快速BO方法，覆盖连续与组合输入（约10到6000+维）。方法在保持接近SOTA BO性能的同时提速10^2至10^3倍以上，将BO拓展至全新问题类别。
AI.motivation: BO通常被假设仅用于目标函数"昂贵"（时间或成本高）的场景，因而算法自身速度被忽视；但实际问题在"廉价—昂贵"之间连续分布。作者希望将BO与CMA-ES等更快算法置于统一的速度—性能权衡框架下比较，并填补帕累托前沿中此前空缺的区域，使BO可用于对算法速度敏感的新问题类别。
AI.method: 以速度—性能帕累托前沿为分析视角，将BO与CMA-ES等快速算法对比；在此基础上利用既有BO算法中的线性结构，设计一组快速BO方法，分别支持连续输入与组合输入，并覆盖约10至6000+维度。
AI.result: 所提快速BO方法达到与当前最优（SOTA）BO相近的性能，同时速度提升超过10^2至10^3倍，从而在帕累托前沿上占据此前空缺的区域。
AI.conclusion: BO的速度不应被默认视为无关紧要；通过挖掘算法中的线性结构可在几乎不牺牲性能的前提下实现数量级加速，使BO可适用于更广泛、对时间与计算成本敏感的问题。

title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

AI.tldr: GeoMem-VLA 将显式 3D 几何监督内化为可学习的 GeoPlan 几何 token，并作为时序记忆持续更新，用于动作生成；推理时无需 3D 教师模型或显式重建，在 LIBERO 达 98.9%、RoboTwin 达 91.10%/91.24%，真实任务平均 78.0%。
AI.motivation: 多数 VLA 模型依赖当前观测的 2D 表征，几何感知方法又需额外 3D 输入；而由单帧观测独立推断的几何往往被丢弃，无法累积为持久任务表征。作者认为动作生成需要紧凑、任务相关且可连续更新的几何抽象，而非每步完整可渲染的 3D 重建。
AI.method: 提出 GeoMem-VLA 框架：训练时用冻结的几何基础模型，通过几何流匹配目标（对当前场景点图与未来末端执行器轨迹）监督可学习的 GeoPlan token；这些 token 与观测表征记忆整合——历史信息被检索、与当前观测自适应融合，并随任务推进将事件帧固化为记忆，且不直接将 VLM 原生视觉嵌入对齐到教师特征空间。推理时仅检索历史表征并与当前工作表征融合以预测动作，不调用 3D 教师模型、不做显式场景重建。
AI.result: 经面向基准的下游适配后，GeoMem-VLA 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.9%，在 RoboTwin 干净/随机设置下分别为 91.10%/91.24%；五项真实世界任务平均成功率 78.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，内化并记忆 3D 场景理解是机器人控制的一条有前景的路径。

title: Fragment-Level Graph Encoding for Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 6-page appendices, to be published in Proceedings of the 8th Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference (NLDL), 2027. For associated code, see https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are among the standard tools for molecular property prediction, but the atom-level explanations of their predictions are hard for medicinal chemists to act on. We propose a change of input representation rather than a new model: molecules are encoded as fragment-level graphs from BRICS decomposition, where each node is a synthetically meaningful fragment whose features are the element-wise sum of its atoms' features. Because only the representation changes, any message-passing GNN and any post-hoc attribution method produces explanations at the resolution of functional groups instead of single atoms. Across four architectures, four prediction tasks, and two explainers under scaffold splits, fragment-level encoding matches atom-level test accuracy on roughly five-fold smaller graphs. Integrated-Gradients attributions recover known pharmacophores above chance on two enzyme targets, namely BACE at 1.5 times the chance rate, and PTR1 at 3.2 times. A like-for-like comparison against an aggregated atom-level baseline shows that post-hoc aggregation is not a stable substitute: its BACE hit rate range both exceeds and falls below the fragment model's hit rate depending on two arbitrary aggregation choices, whereas fragment-level training yields a single convention-free attribution at no predictive cost. The code is available at: https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame

AI.tldr: 将分子编码为BRICS片段级图（节点特征为原子特征逐元素求和），无需改动模型即可让任意GNN与任意事后归因方法输出功能团级解释，且预测精度不降、图规模约缩小5倍。
AI.motivation: GNN是分子性质预测的标准工具，但其原子级解释难以被药物化学家直接采纳和操作；作者希望以"改变输入表示"而非"设计新模型"的低成本方式，使解释对齐到合成上有意义的功能团粒度。
AI.method: 用BRICS分解将分子转为片段级图，每个节点为一个片段，特征为其所含原子特征的逐元素求和；由于仅改变表示，任意消息传递GNN与任意事后归因方法（如Integrated Gradients）均自动产生片段级解释。在4种架构、4个预测任务、2种解释器、scaffold划分下评估，并与"原子级训练+事后聚合"基线做同条件对比。
AI.result: 片段级编码在约小5倍的图上达到与原子级相当的测试精度；IG归因在两个酶靶点上显著高于随机水平（BACE约1.5倍，PTR1约3.2倍）；原子级基线的事后聚合不稳定，其BACE命中率随两种任意聚合选择既高于也低于片段模型，缺乏一致替代性。
AI.conclusion: 片段级表示是一种"无预测代价"的可解释性增强手段：以单一、无约定依赖的归因结果替代事后聚合的不确定性，使解释粒度与化学家的功能团直觉一致。

title: Stochastic Nonlinearities Improve Uncertainty Estimation
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. 33 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important across visual recognition tasks, providing information about the confidence and reliability of model predictions. Many uncertainty estimation methods obtain predictive diversity through mechanisms that can suppress intermediate features, perturb the input, or require substantial additional computation. Stochastic activation functions, where network units randomly select between multiple nonlinearities during a forward pass, have previously been used to improve optimization behavior, mitigate limitations of fixed ReLU activations, and increase output diversity. In this work, we reframe stochastic activation switching as a lightweight mechanism for uncertainty estimation. The proposed method samples between nonlinear activation functions, inducing predictive diversity while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. This enables uncertainty estimation from a single trained model without the training cost of ensembles, task-specific uncertainty heads, or architectural redesign. We evaluate the proposed approach across classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection using convolutional and transformer-based architectures on diverse datasets. Across these settings, stochastic activation switching improves uncertainty quality while preserving competitive primary-task performance, showing that stochastic nonlinearities provide an effective and information-preserving source of predictive variation for visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 将随机激活切换（在多个非线性函数间采样）重新定位为一种轻量的不确定性估计机制，在保持中间特征通路活跃的同时引入预测多样性，单模型即可获得不确定性估计，无需集成、专用不确定性头或结构改造。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法多依赖抑制中间特征、扰动输入或额外大量计算，且集成方法训练成本高。作者希望找到一种信息保留、低成本、可与现有架构兼容的预测多样性来源。
AI.method: 在前向传播中让网络单元随机选择不同的非线性激活函数（stochastic activation switching），通过多次采样获得预测分布以估计不确定性；不改变特征通路结构，避免特征抑制。
AI.result: 在分类、语义分割和分布外检测任务上，使用卷积与Transformer架构及多类数据集评测，随机激活切换提升了不确定性质量，同时主任务性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 随机非线性为视觉识别提供了一种有效且信息保留的预测变异来源，可作为轻量级不确定性估计手段。

title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
comment: 11 pages (main text), 42 pages (supplementary material), 2 main figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可扩展“模态专家库”的医学视觉-语言模型：Multiway Transformer 结合共享视觉计算、确定性路由的前馈专家与独立文本通路，先在1940万无配对图像行上做掩码预训练，再用323万图文对做对比对齐，并通过新增专家实现模态扩展而冻结原有路径。
AI.motivation: 医学影像多模态学习需要在缺少配对文本的情况下利用图像，并在引入新模态时保留已有表征，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 构建可扩展模态专家库；Multiway Transformer 融合共享视觉计算、确定性路由的FFN专家和单独文本通路；模态感知视觉tokenizer提供掩码预训练目标（7种模态、1940万无配对图像行）；随后用323万图文对做对比对齐；新增眼底与OCT专家时冻结原图像与文本嵌入路径；主干ViT-Large。
AI.result: 在9种模态、25个基准中24项取得最佳或并列最佳；零样本分类11项中10项、线性探针10项全部、检索4项全部最优；零样本平均平衡准确率0.674，线性探针0.856，双向检索平均召回20.70%；三随机种子顺序实验中眼底与OCT检索分别提升14.95和9.31个百分点，且先前眼底与病理任务无测得损失。
AI.conclusion: 该技术为医学视觉-语言表征的学习与扩展提供了模块化路径；表征保持性依赖于计算路径与推理条件不变，并通过特征一致性校验在评估输入上验证。

title: Local and Global Recursive Ridge Regression for Online Residual Correction of Frozen Multivariate Forecasters under Label Delay
summary: A frozen multi-horizon forecaster can be corrected online from its own residuals. However, under label delay the target of a block arrives only after the whole horizon has passed, and the corrector's retained state grows with the number of channels. Aiming to combine a small retained state with a large error reduction, we propose DRiC (DCT Ridge Corrector), which fits a ridge regression of the leading discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients of the next residual block on those of the frozen forecast and of the latest input block, with sufficient statistics updated recursively. Its local variant, DRiC-L, keeps one such regression per channel; its global variant, DRiC-G, pools all channels into one regression, whose statistics do not depend on the channel count. A guard tracks a running scale of the frozen forecast's residual for each channel; it skips updates on blocks far outside that scale and clips the issued correction. We evaluate on seven datasets (four ETT series, Weather with its missing-value codes filled, Electricity, and Traffic) with DLinear, PatchTST, and iTransformer backbones, against 10 naive, gradient-trained, and closed-form methods. DRiC-L with eight DCT coefficients (DRiC-L8) reduces the mean squared error (MSE) by 14.55% on average over 126 conditions, against 12.98% for ELF, the most accurate comparator, while retaining 15-17 times less state, although ELF is more accurate on Traffic. DRiC-G retains 14.6 kB on the 321-channel Electricity data and 18.9 kB on the 862-channel Traffic data and is the most accurate method at or below its state on both. However, 5 to 7 of the 10 comparators, all with at least 10 times its state, are more accurate there. On the unfilled Weather file, DRiC-L8 without the guard has on average 8.0 times the frozen forecast's MSE, whereas with the guard it reduces the MSE by 7.94%. Code: https://github.com/keiotakmin/dric.

AI.tldr: 提出DRiC（DCT岭校正器），在标签延迟下用少量保留状态在线校正冻结多步预测器：对下一残差块的主导DCT系数做岭回归，充分统计量递归更新；含逐通道的DRiC-L与单回归的DRiC-G，并配残差尺度守卫。
AI.motivation: 冻结的多步预测器可依据自身残差在线校正，但标签延迟使目标块要到整个预测跨度结束后才到达，且校正器保留状态随通道数增长。目标是在小保留状态与大误差降幅之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 对下一残差块的主导DCT系数，以冻结预测与最新输入块的同阶DCT系数为自变量拟合岭回归，充分统计量递归更新。DRiC-L为每通道一套回归；DRiC-G将全部通道池化为单一回归，统计量不随通道数增长。守卫机制按通道跟踪冻结预测残差的滑动尺度，跳过远超出该尺度的块更新并裁剪输出的校正量。
AI.result: 在7个数据集（4条ETT、Weather（缺失码已填充）、Electricity、Traffic）与DLinear、PatchTST、iTransformer骨干上，对比10种朴素、梯度训练与闭式方法。DRiC-L8（8个DCT系数）在126个条件下MSE平均降低14.55%，优于最准确对照ELF的12.98%，且保留状态少15–17倍（但ELF在Traffic上更准）。DRiC-G在321通道Electricity上保留14.6 kB、862通道Traffic上保留18.9 kB，是同状态量级下最准确的方法，但仍有5–7个状态大10倍以上的对照更准。未填充的Weather文件上，无守卫的DRiC-L8 MSE约为冻结预测的8.0倍，加守卫后降低7.94%。
AI.conclusion: DCT域岭回归校正可在极小保留状态下显著降低多步预测误差，全局池化版本使状态与通道数解耦；残差尺度守卫对异常/未清洗数据至关重要，否则校正可能严重劣化。

title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages.
